title: Tax Specialist
description:
A leading international financial services organisation is seeking an experienced tax professional to join its Singapore-based finance team.

The role will focus on overseeing regional tax matters, supporting statutory and regulatory obligations, and providing tax-related guidance to business stakeholders across multiple Asia-Pacific markets.

This position offers broad regional exposure and the opportunity to contribute to tax governance, financial reporting and business planning within a dynamic international organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage regional corporate tax reporting, including the preparation and review of tax calculations and supporting financial schedules.

  • Coordinate annual tax submissions and statutory reporting requirements for overseas subsidiaries and associated entities.

  • Work alongside appointed tax consultants to ensure accurate filings and compliance with local tax regulations.

  • Oversee tax deadlines, payment schedules and reporting obligations across the region.

  • Assist with tax reviews, audits and information requests from government agencies and regulatory bodies.

  • Assess international tax considerations relating to cross-border transactions, treaty benefits and business operations.

  • Support intercompany pricing policies and related documentation requirements.

  • Advise internal finance and business teams on tax implications arising from new projects, transactions and operational changes.

  • Identify opportunities to enhance existing tax processes, reporting procedures and regional compliance frameworks.

  • Keep abreast of changes in tax legislation and assess their impact on the organisation's regional operations.

Requirements

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance or a relevant discipline.

  • At least 7 years of experience in corporate taxation, preferably covering multiple international markets.

  • Strong understanding of corporate tax reporting, statutory submissions and regional tax regulations.

  • Working knowledge of tax frameworks in Singapore, Hong Kong, China, India and Korea would be advantageous.

  • Exposure to international tax planning, cross-border transactions and intercompany pricing matters.

  • Strong financial reporting and spreadsheet capabilities, with the ability to independently prepare and review complex calculations.

  • Experience managing external consultants and coordinating regional compliance activities.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate technical matters clearly to non-tax professionals.

  • Highly organised, analytical and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced international environment.

  • Professional accounting or taxation qualifications such as CPA or Chartered Accountant are preferred.

  • Background in public accounting, multinational corporations or financial services would be advantageous.

title: Discovery Scientist
description:
As a Discovery Scientist at MMQCI, you will do independent research toward discovery, design, and development of new capabilities for molecular diagnostic quality control products. Are you an energetic, bold, entrepreneurial scientist eager to drive groundbreaking discoveries in molecular diagnostics? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where rapid experimentation and creative problem-solving are the norm? If you're excited by the challenge of shaping the future of molecular diagnostic quality controls, we want you on our team.

What You Will Get to Do
The Discovery Scientist reports directly to the Manager of Discovery and will be responsible for creating and overseeing discovery projects. With the Discovery Scientist’s in-depth educational foundation in Chemistry, they will serve as a scientific resource and collaborator with the Manager of Discovery, Manager of R&D, and the R&D group. The successful candidate will be an experienced scientist with an energetic, entrepreneurial spirit who enjoys performing a variety of tasks at a fast pace and has a history of success and collaboration.

This is not a typical R&D role. We’re looking for a skilled scientist with an entrepreneurial inventive mindset, someone who can think big, move fast, and embrace the unknown, someone who loves a technical challenge. You will design and execute rapid proof-of-concept experiments, identify new technologies, and product opportunities, solve problems and collaborate with cross-functional teams to turn ideas into reality. The Discovery Scientist will:
  • Lead scientific discovery efforts to identify novel approaches for quality control products in diagnostics.
  • Design and execute rapid experiments to test ideas, learn quickly, and pivot as needed—fail fast, refine, and move forward.
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and molecular diagnostic trends to uncover new opportunities.
  • Collaborate across teams (R&D, Manufacturing, Regulatory, and Commercial) to bring innovative ideas from concept to reality.
  • Engage with key opinion leaders and attend industry conferences to ensure our discoveries align with cutting-edge science.
  • Contribute to a fast-moving, high-energy culture where creativity, risk-taking, and learning from failure are encouraged.
Required Skills & Experience
  • Ph.D. in Chemistry (some coursework in biochemistry or molecular biology is preferred)
  • Minimum of 7 years of relevant technical laboratory experience (e.g., biomaterials, polymer chemistry, protein chemistry, analytical chemistry, bioengineering, nanomaterials/nanoparticles, synthetic biology, etc.), with 1-2 years in a commercial/industrial laboratory
  • Demonstrates high energy, inquisitiveness and eagerness to learn
  • Strong problem-solving skills. Creative problem solving by applying novel approaches or considering solutions from alternative disciplines
  • Strong data analysis and troubleshooting skills
  • Interest and up-to-date knowledge of innovative tools and techniques in the candidate’s area of expertise
  • Experience and/or interest in molecular biology techniques used in MMQCI’s product development and manufacturing, including cloning, sequencing, and qPCR/dPCR is a plus
  • Excellent communication, written and oral
  • Proven ability to work with cross functional teams collaboratively and diplomatically
  • Ability to multitask and manage multiple priorities
  • Flexible; accustomed to fast-changing priorities of a small company
  • Knowledge of cGMP or ISO regulations and understanding of the importance of regulations in product development is a plus
Why You’ll Love Working Here
  • You will learn rapidly by working closely with other senior Scientists on cutting-edge molecular projects
  • You will contribute to the development of useful products and technologies that impact molecular diagnostics and patient care
  • You will join a collaborative, energetic team that values curiosity, initiative, and scientific rigor
Benefits We Offer
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Company profit sharing program
  • Paid time off: including vacation, holidays, and sick leave
  • Paid Parental Leave Program
The pay range for this position is $75,000-$122,000 annually

Interested in joining our team? Please submit both a resume and cover letter with your application for consideration.

Get to know the MMQCI team!
https://www.mmqci.com/about/employee-spotlight/employee-spotlight.html

Maine Molecular Quality Controls, Inc. (MMQCI) designs, develops, manufactures, and sells unique quality control products used by hospital laboratories and manufacturers to monitor the accuracy of tests for genetic, oncologic and infectious diseases, and pharmacogenetics. MMQCI has proprietary technologies to stabilize DNA and RNA for use as quality controls and continues to pursue the discovery of novel techniques useful for the development of new quality control products.

MMQCI is conveniently located in beautiful southern coastal Maine, minutes from the Maine Turnpike, Portland International Jetport, and less than 2 hours from Boston. Close by are fabulous Portland restaurants, sandy beaches, and a plentiful supply of Maine lobsters! Many terrific outdoor activities are easily accessible including hiking, biking, kayaking, fishing, skiing and snowshoeing. We’re in a state-of-the-art facility, located in Saco, right next to the Eastern Trail. Come join us!

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer (Zscaler / Netskope)
description:
Job Description

  • Lead the administration, engineering, monitoring and operational management of enterprise cloud security platforms, primarily Zscaler and/or Netskope.

  • Design, implement and maintain cloud security architectures and policies covering Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).

  • Take ownership of security policy design, configuration, optimisation and enforcement, including web filtering, application access, data protection and user access controls.

  • Lead the implementation, configuration and enhancement of cloud security solutions to meet customer security requirements and organisational standards.

  • Manage complex technical troubleshooting and escalations involving connectivity, authentication, proxy, SSL inspection, DNS, routing and policy enforcement.

  • Analyse security logs, traffic patterns, alerts and platform performance to identify potential threats, security gaps and operational issues.

  • Lead security incident investigations, perform root cause analysis (RCA) and recommend corrective and preventive measures.

  • Review and optimise existing security policies, identifying policy conflicts, excessive permissions, security gaps and opportunities for improvement.

  • Manage and execute Change Requests (CR), Service Requests (SR) and Incident Requests, ensuring all activities comply with established change management and operational procedures.

  • Plan and execute security platform upgrades, patches, migrations, feature enhancements and configuration changes.

  • Lead integration activities involving endpoint security, identity and access management (IAM), authentication systems, network infrastructure and cloud applications.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, solution designs, implementation plans, operational procedures, configuration records and network/security diagrams.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and operational support teams.

  • Work closely with customers, vendors, internal technical teams and stakeholders to resolve complex technical challenges and deliver security solutions.

  • Participate in customer engagements, technical discussions and solution design sessions to understand requirements and recommend appropriate security solutions.

  • Identify opportunities to improve security posture, operational efficiency and platform performance through continuous optimisation and automation.

  • Provide remote and onsite technical support, including participation in planned maintenance and project deployments when required.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, network security, cloud security, security engineering or SASE implementation and operations.

  • Strong hands-on experience administering and engineering Zscaler and/or Netskope enterprise security platforms.

  • Proven experience implementing and managing cloud security solutions, including one or more of the following:

    • Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)

    • Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)

    • Netskope Security Cloud Platform

    • Secure Web Gateway (SWG)

    • Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)

    • Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)

    • Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)

  • Strong understanding of security policy architecture, web filtering, SSL inspection, data loss prevention (DLP), application control and access management.

  • Good knowledge of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, VPN, routing, firewalls, proxies and network traffic analysis.

  • Experience integrating cloud security platforms with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA and endpoint security solutions.

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, conduct root cause analysis and implement long-term corrective solutions.

  • Experience managing security incidents, change management, service requests, technical escalations and platform maintenance.

  • Experience in security migrations, enterprise deployments, infrastructure upgrades or cloud security transformation projects.

  • Relevant professional certifications such as Zscaler, Netskope, CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+ or other recognised cybersecurity certifications will be advantageous.

  • Strong technical documentation, communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and take ownership of technical deliverables.

  • Candidates must possess relevant hands-on cybersecurity, network security or cloud security engineering experience. Candidates without relevant experience will not be considered.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday: 9:00am – 6:00pm

title: Direct Entry Captain
description:
Located in Sunny Singapore, Scoot is expanding our Boeing Wide body and Airbus narrow-body operations and inviting applications from experienced B787/A320 Type-Rated Captains who demonstrate strong command capability, safety leadership, and operational discipline.

As an B787/A320 Type Rated Captain, you will benefit from our Fixed Roster Patterns, ensuring predictability in your schedule, where you can anticipate your work and rest days to support you in planning your next getaway! Alongside a very competitive salary, you will also enjoy a more streamlined training process, allowing you to integrate into our operations more quickly.

Join our yellow family to Make Each Journey Better, where you can experience a lifestyle that truly values work-life balance, grow your career beyond a Captain and have a strong sense of security and stability embarking your career with Scoot in Singapore!

Responsibilities:

Sitting on the left-hand seat, you will take command of the flight and ensure the highest personal and professional standards are upheld at all times. Your focus is on ensuring that flights are safe, comfortable and on-time, every time. As a leader and a team player, you set the example and help develop members of the Scoot team to deliver the Scootitude experience to all passengers.

A320 Requirements:

Pilots with Jet experience:

  • Total Flight Hours of more than 3,500 hours on aeroplanes with MTMA of 5,700kg or more

  • Minimum of 1,000 Pilot-in-Command (PIC) hours (exclude P1 U/S hours) on multi-engine jet, commercial airline transport aircraft certificated for multi-crew operation.

B787 Requirements

  • Total Flight Hours of more than 5,000 hours on aeroplanes with MTMA of 5,700kg or more
  • Minimum of 2,000 Pilot-in-Command (PIC) hours (exclude P1 U/S hours) on multi-engine jet, commercial airline transport aircraft certificated for multi-crew operation.

E190 Turboprop Requirements

Pilots without Jet experience:

  • Total Flight Hours of more than 4,000 hours on aeroplanes with MTMA of 5,700kg or more

  • Minimum of 2,000 Pilot-in-Command (PIC) hours (exclude P1 U/S hours) on multi-engine turboprop, commercial airline transport aircraft certificated for multi-crew operation.

Licensing Requirements:

  • A Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore issued ICAO ATPL (foreign ATPL will be required to undergo license conversion which requires an instrument rating and a proficiency check that has a minimum of 6 months’ validity).

  • Demonstrate the ability to speak and understand English with a minimum of ICAO level 4.

  • Satisfy all vaccination requirements as required by CAAS.

Desirable Traits

  • A leader with a strong passion to nurture and guide fellow teammates

  • A team player who demonstrates composure, confidence and maturity

  • A sense of humour to brighten up the day of everyone around you

  • Definitely the 'Scootitude' DNA in you!

Training Co-Payment & Training Bond

  • Where applicable, successful candidates will be trained to acquire an Aircraft Type Rating for the assigned fleet.

  • Successful candidates who are provided with type rating training will be subjected to a co-payment of the training cost and will be required to enter a training bond.

What’s Next

  • Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a series of online aptitude tests.

  • Shortlisted applicants after online assessment stage will be invited to attend an Assessment Centre in Singapore. The Assessment Centre will consist of a group stage and an individual interview

  • Successful candidates will need to attend a Simulator Assessment and Personality Assessment over the period of 2 days.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Demonstrated construction, asphalt paving, or related experience required.
  • Ability to read and comprehend blueprints, site specifications, simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.
  • Safety minded professional who demonstrates good performance, attendance, and punctuality.
  • Demonstrates the ability to work independently, without direct supervision.
  • Demonstrates the willingness to work overtime and weekends/holidays as needed.
  • Demonstrates the willingness to learn and work a variety of job tasks.
  • Demonstrates the ability to work and communicate well with supervisor, plant personnel, and other employees.
  • Demonstrates the ability to conform to and maintain OSHA, MSHA, DOT and all other company or state rules and regulations.

title: Principal Engineer, Machine Learning
description:
Most ML engineering roles at large companies mean contributing to a platform team where your work disappears into a pipeline that fifty other engineers also touch. This role is different. You will be the primary owner of the ML systems that detect product development defects, model material behavior with limited data, and select the highest-value experiments from an active learning pipeline. Your models will run in product development. Your decisions will matter immediately.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deep Learning Model Implementation & Product Development Ownership: Build, train, evaluate, and maintain CNN/U-Net/ViT models for automated inspection and measurement. Own model performance end-to-end — ablation studies, confidence calibration, product development performance monitoring.
  • Anomaly Detection Systems: Build and maintain real-time anomaly detection for product development sensor and time-series data streams — statistical baseline, threshold calibration, drift alerting. Sole implementation owner for this workstream.
  • Surrogate Modeling & Active Learning Operations: Own implementation and iteration of surrogate model pipelines and active learning systems under Technical lead’s architectural direction. Configure acquisition functions; integrate with versioned feature sets.
  • Data-to-Model Interface Ownership: Own the data contract between the Data Engineer and the ML model stack. Define feature specifications, validate datasets against model input requirements, and escalate data quality issues before they reach the training pipeline.
  • MLOps Maintenance & Product Development Reliability: Maintain model versions, training pipelines, and containers under platform architecture. MLflow tracking, CI/CD contribution, product development monitoring, and degradation escalation.
  • Junior Mentorship & Documentation: Provide code review guidance to team; document model design decisions and evaluation outcomes to production-handoff standard.

Qualifications

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related field. AI major or strong AI research focus preferred.

Experience:

  • 1–3 years of hands-on ML engineering experience, or equivalent depth demonstrated through internships, academic research, or open-source contributions. Must show component-level technical ownership within an end-to-end ML pipeline (training through deployment) — not just execution under direction. Kaggle rankings, arXiv preprints, or significant open-source ML contributions are valued as evidence of depth.

Must have Skills:

  • Python: Strong proficiency — primary ML development language
  • PyTorch: Proficient → Expert — independent model training and evaluation
  • Computer Vision: Strong foundation in CNNs, plus hands-on depth in at least one of: U-Net/segmentation, ViT/transformer-based vision, or time-series anomaly detection. Candidates with depth across multiple areas (e.g. full inspection-scope coverage — segmentation, transformer vision, and anomaly detection together) will be considered for the higher end of the band.
  • Surrogate Modeling: Implement and iterate surrogate pipelines under P110 architectural guidance
  • Active Learning: Configure acquisition functions; uncertainty-guided experiment scheduling
  • Data-to-Model Interface: Define feature specs; validate incoming datasets against model requirements; flag data quality issues before training
  • Practical MLOps: MLflow, Docker, Git, basic CI/CD contribution
  • Model Evaluation & Uncertainty Analysis: Ablation studies, confidence calibration, validation methodology
  • Technical Documentation: Model design decisions and evaluation results to production-handoff standard

Good to have Skills:

  • PINNs implementation under technical guidance
  • Bayesian methods — Bayesian neural networks, Gaussian processes, ensemble uncertainty, calibration
  • Reinforcement learning basics — gym environments, policy gradient concepts
  • AWS fundamentals — S3, EC2, SageMaker basics; entry-level cloud ML deployment
  • RAG pipeline fundamentals

title: Technical Delivery Manager, Metadata Management & Data Lineage
company: COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS ASIA PACIFIC PTE. LTD.
description:
Key Responsibilities
As Technical Delivery Manager (TDM) for Data Governance initiatives, you will be responsible for overseeing and ensuring the successful implementations. The role involves coordinating with cross-functional teams, understanding business requirements, and ensuring the alignment of technical solutions with data governance objectives. Key responsibilities for this role are:

Project Leadership: Lead planning, execution, and delivery of Business Glossary, Metadata management and Data lineage solution, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.

Requirements Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, translating them into actionable project plans.

Tool Selection and Implementation: Oversee selection and implementation of metadata management tool, ensuring it meet the organization's needs and integrate effectively with existing systems. Conduct POCs involving new data technologies. Prioritize implementation scope for incremental coverage; Independently install, customize and integrate software packages and programs. Maintain and recommend software improvements to ensure a platform centric management of software applications

Lifecycle Management: Manage full lifecycle of metadata management and data lineage initiatives, from conception and design to implementation, maintenance, and optimization of end to end data lineage extraction; provide remediation for broken data lineage across multiple technologies, products and platforms. Review & deliver documents such as solution design, program specifications for target solutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data stewards, IT professionals, and business analysts, infrastructure & information security teams, to ensure a cohesive and integrated approach to metadata management and data lineage; Create frameworks, technical features which helps in establishing end to end data lineage for Critical Data Elements

Quality Assurance: Implement quality assurance processes to ensure the accuracy, consistency, performance & SLA monitoring and completeness of metadata and data lineage information in SIT, UAT and production environment

Vendor Management: Coordinate with vendors providing metadata management solutions, overseeing their contributions to the successful implementation of the projects.

Project Management & Risk Management: Plan, execute, and deliver metadata management and data lineage projects within scope, on time, and within budget. Identify and mitigate risks associated with metadata management and data lineage projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

Training and Documentation: Provide inputs for training programs and ensure documentation to enhance understanding and adoption of metadata management and data lineage best practices within the organization.

Performance Monitoring: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor the performance of metadata management and data lineage initiatives, making adjustments as needed to meet objectives.

Stakeholder Communication: Maintain transparent and effective communication with stakeholders, providing regular updates on project progress, challenges, and resolutions. Convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders in simple ways.

Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies to enhance Business Glossary, Metadata management and Data lineage capabilities within the organization.

Job Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in implementing data governance solutions with a strong background in deploying such solutions, encompassing both on-premise and cloud-based models.
  • Metadata Management Tools: Proficiency in using metadata management tools such as Informatica IDMC, IBM Cloud Pak for Data or equivalent tools (Collibra, Alation, Solidatus)
  • Data Lineage Tools: Experience with data lineage tools like Informatica IDMC, IBM Manta or similar solutions to establish and visualize end-to-end data flows. Identify and build both business and technical lineage, including strategies for fixing lineage breaks
  • Database Technologies: In-depth knowledge of various database technologies, including but not limited to Hadoop, Teradata, SAS, Oracle, MS SQL, Postgres, and Cassandra DB.
  • ETL/ELT Tools: Expertise in ETL/ELT tools like Informatica PowerCenter, SSIS, and other data integration platforms to understand and document transformation logic.
  • Scripting and Programming: Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Stored Procedures, Bteq scripts, Spart ETL, Python) and programming languages to support metadata extraction and manipulation.
  • Cloud Platforms: Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their services relevant to metadata management and data governance. Strong background in addressing security considerations for cloud-based implementations is crucial, demonstrating the ability to design and implement secure solutions in alignment with industry standards.
  • On-Premise Container Solutions: Expertise with Red Hat Open Container Platform; showcasing proficiency in overcoming complexities related to deploying, managing, and optimizing applications in this environment. Integrate various components seamlessly and ensure a cohesive and efficient operation within the OpenShift cluster
  • Visualization Tools: Experience with data visualization tools such as Qlik, Microsoft Power BI, Tableau to create intuitive representations of metadata and data lineage.
  • Knowledge in Data modelling, working with calculations, leveraging the Set Analysis
  • Experience in Implementing RBAC policies for various user groups such as Data Owners, stewards, consumers/stakeholders etc within the metadata management tool
  • Implementation of out-of-the-box as well as custom workflows, user personas, custom reports / dashboards within the metadata management tool

Functional Skills

  • Business Glossary Management: Strong understanding of business glossary concepts and the ability to work with business stakeholders to define and manage business terms and their relationships.
  • Data Governance Frameworks: Knowledge of data governance frameworks and best practices, including BCBS239, and the ability to implement governance policies for metadata and data lineage.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Understanding of regulatory requirements related to data management, ensuring compliance in metadata and data lineage implementations.
  • Should have worked in large scale data warehouse & on-premise Power BI, Qlik based visualization


Qualifications

  • Certification of leading data governance product providers (Informatica, IBM, Alation, Solidatus, Collibra etc.)

title: Product Manager - Internal AI Enablement
description:
As the Product Manager for Internal AI Enablement, it is your job to discover and build AI-powered solutions that make work easier, faster and more automated for teams across GOVX. Your customers are your fellow employees. You are a problem solver, intellectually curious and motivated by learning.

This is a hybrid role that is equal parts product manager and builder. You will dive deep with teams throughout the organization, learn how their business works, identify the workflows that are ripe for AI automation and then build the agents and tools that solve those problems yourself. Our engineering team is available for support, but this is a hands-on role and you will own the build.

You will start as a solo builder, working across all departments, beginning with Sales and Marketing. To succeed in this role, you'll need a solid background in product management, a track record of shipping AI tools that have a demonstrable impact on real business workflows, an ownership mentality and strong communication skills.

Job Responsibilities

Product

The Product Manager for Internal AI Enablement must become an expert on our internal teams, their processes and the AI tools available to improve them.

  • Customer focus: Your customers are your fellow GOVX employees. You must be passionate about understanding how each team works, showing curiosity about their goals and empathy for the friction they face in their day-to-day work.
  • Business expertise: You must be able to develop deep expertise in how every function of the business operates, including sales, marketing, partner management, merchandising, customer support and finance. You will embed with each team to map their workflows before proposing a solution.
  • Requirements development: You must be able to translate what you learn into clear requirements for AI tools and workflows, prioritizing the opportunities with the greatest impact on the business.
  • Data-informed decisions: You must practice data-informed decision-making. At all times, you should have a clear understanding of how employees are using the tools you've built, grounded in data. Initial measures of success will include the number of workflows and agents in production and employee satisfaction with those tools.
  • Stakeholder communication: You must be able to build trust among stakeholders throughout the organization, from individual contributors to department leaders.
  • AI expertise: You will be expected to stay current on the rapidly evolving AI landscape, including new capabilities within the tools we use, emerging best practices and industry trends.
  • Product expertise: You will become the recognized AI enablement expert within the organization and should be able to effectively demo and teach the tools you build to internal stakeholders.

Build

As the Product Manager for Internal AI Enablement, you are also the builder. Roughly half of your time will be spent hands-on, building and deploying AI tools.

  • Agent development: You will design, build and deploy AI agents and automated workflows using Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio.
  • Microsoft 365 integration: You will build solutions that live where our employees already work, integrating with SharePoint and Teams.
  • Iteration: You will work closely with stakeholders to test, refine and improve the tools you've built after they are in production. Shipping is the beginning, not the end.
  • Deployment and adoption: You are responsible for driving adoption of the tools you build. This includes rollout, training, documentation and ongoing support for the teams that use them.
  • Engineering partnership: You will know when a problem requires engineering support and partner effectively with our engineering team when it does.
  • AI governance: You will play a critical role in helping to evolve our AI governance practices - partnering with Engineering, IT and HR - to ensure the tools you build are secure, compliant and responsible.

Process

As the Product Manager for Internal AI Enablement, you must be well versed in product discovery, optimization and delivery.

  • Product discovery: You will utilize product discovery to tackle risks upfront as much as possible. As such, you must have a strong grasp of multiple product discovery techniques, including stakeholder interviews, process mapping, journey mapping, framing and prototype testing. You must also know how to apply the right technique to tackle the biggest risks in the most cost-effective way possible.
  • Rapid prototyping: You must be comfortable building quick prototypes to validate an idea with stakeholders before investing in a production-ready solution.
  • Product optimization: Once a tool is in production, it is your responsibility to evaluate, improve and refine it to better serve employees and the business.
  • Passion: We are also looking for someone with a passion for their craft. Just as you're constantly improving your tools, we also want you to improve your own product management and building skills.

People

No product manager is successful in a vacuum. Even as a solo builder, it takes collaboration across the company to deliver tools that make a real difference.

  • Build relationships: You must be a team player, with a proven track record of building strong relationships with business stakeholders, engineers and leadership.
  • Foster collaboration: You must have the ability to create a shared understanding with stakeholders throughout the discovery and build process. You should encourage teams to bring their ideas and problems to you.
  • Change management: You must be able to help teams adopt new ways of working, meeting people where they are and building confidence with AI tools at every skill level.
  • Communication: You must have the ability to communicate the broader vision for AI at GOVX. In this role, you will act as an evangelist for AI enablement. You must be able to visualize and articulate both the target outcome and the steps to get there.

Other Responsibilities

title: Staff Engineer, Machine Learning
description:
You will be one of the engineers on a focused AI team solving hard scientific problems in precision product development. You will own two real responsibilities from day one — not toy tasks, but actual team workflow contributions that senior engineers depend on. You will be introduced to physics-informed AI, Bayesian methods, and product development ML systems within your first year under direct mentorship from engineers and researchers who have worked at world-class institutions. If you are the kind of person who learns fast and wants to be in the middle of hard problems early in your career, this is an unusual opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Experiment Tracking & Evaluation Reporting: Own MLflow experiment logging for assigned team model runs; conduct model evaluations using standard metrics; produce structured evaluation reports reviewed by team. Your reports directly inform model iteration decisions.
  • Training Data Quality Validation: Validate training datasets jointly with team — feature distribution checks, label verification, anomaly flagging. Your quality flags are the final check before data enters the model training pipeline. You close the data quality loop between workstreams.
  • Deep Learning Model Contribution: Build and train CNN-based models for image classification and defect detection under team’s guidance. Contribute to model evaluation cycles, configuration comparisons, and training run analysis.
  • ML Pipeline Contribution: Package models in Docker; contribute to CI/CD scripts under guidance; run inference tests and support deployment validation in product development environments.

Qualifications

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field. AI major or strong research focus in degree strongly preferred.

Experience:

  • Fresh graduate to 1 year. Work experience not required — demonstrated ML project competency is the primary criterion. Strong final-year project or thesis with a clear ML component; research internship preferred.

Must Have Skill:

  • Python: Strong proficiency — clean, readable ML code; NumPy/Pandas basics
  • PyTorch: Foundational — build, train, and evaluate a basic neural network independently from scratch
  • CNN Architecture Basics: Understand and implement a basic image classifier; conceptual understanding of convolutional layers
  • Surrogate Modeling Concepts: Why data-efficient ML matters in limited-data scientific settings
  • Active Learning Awareness: Conceptual understanding of uncertainty-guided data selection
  • MLflow Basics: Log experiments, parameters, and metrics for a training run
  • Docker Basics: Write a Dockerfile to containerize a Python/ML application
  • Model Evaluation: Standard metrics; produce a structured evaluation report
  • Learning Mindset: Self-directed learning outside coursework; evidence of picking up new concepts quickly.

Good-to-Have Skill:

  • U-Net or ViT exposure — academic project or course sufficient
  • Uncertainty quantification basics — Monte Carlo dropout, ensemble methods
  • Bayesian methods introduction — any probabilistic ML course or project
  • Time-series or sensor data — any project with sequential or temporal data
  • RL introduction — any RL course or gym environment experiment
  • RAG basics, any LLM project
  • AWS fundamentals; entry-level cloud ML deployment

description:

About the Freight Operations Supervisor job

Pay, benefits and more:

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Full health insurance benefits available on day one
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Earn up to 15 days of PTO over your first year
  • 9 paid company holidays
  • 401(k) option with company match
  • Education assistance
  • Opportunity to participate in a company incentive plan

What you’ll do on a typical day:

  • Lead and supervise all aspects of freight operations
  • Develop and implement strategic work procedures to meet the evolving demands of the department
  • Evaluate, manage, assign and supervise workloads and tasks
  • Supervise hourly staff across various operations and act as primary point of contact for workplace concerns and questions
  • Ensure production goals are met by managing tonnage, payroll and other administrative functions
  • Plan hourly employee schedules to meet daily operations goals and lower costs
  • Enforce all company, FMCSR, OSHA, CCMTA, NSC and DOT policies, rules, regulations, and laws
  • Implement all applicable workplace policies and procedures and enforce compliance to optimize network performance
  • Ensure customer freight is processed, handled, loaded and delivered timely and damage free
  • Coach and develop employees on proper techniques and quality requirements, including conducting new hire employee evaluations and determining whether to issue corrective action for violations of XPO’s workplace policies
  • Effectively direct a team to consistently meet or exceed productivity goals
  • Make recommendations regarding hiring, suspension and termination
  • Develop and present action plans to improve load average and model compliance
  • Participate in internal safety and engagement committees
  • Train employees on safety rules and processes
  • Monitor and maintain organization within the shift to ensure safety and productivity
  • Conduct daily staff meetings and communicate corporate messages, revisions to policies and procedures to all team members
  • Inspect working conditions of tools and equipment needed for safe operation within the workplace and direct the correction of any improper or adverse conditions that exist
  • Provide instruction, analyses, suggestions and ideas for improvement of operations within the shift and the service center
  • Act as a champion of XPO values by demonstrating them and holding your team to the same high standards

Freight Operations Supervisors are required to:

  • Lift objects of various shapes, sizes and weights frequently up to 50 lbs. and occasionally greater than 75 lbs.
  • Reach (including above your head), bend, climb, push, pull, twist, squat and kneel
  • Walk and stand for extended periods on a loading dock that is not climate controlled
  • Work outside in inclement weather

XPO does not provide employment-based immigration sponsorship for employment in the United States for this role. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Annual Salary Range: $70,304 to $81,403 Actual compensation may vary due to factors such as experience and skill set. This is an incentive-based position, which may include bonuses, incentive or commission plans.

XPO is a top ten global provider of transportation services, with a highly integrated network of people, technology and physical assets. At XPO, we look for employees who like a challenge and can communicate effectively in all situations. We want to leverage your skills and years of experience to drive positive results while ensuring a bright future for yourself and XPO. If you’re looking for a growth opportunity, join us at XPO.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, disability, veteran or other protected status.

title: 2027 Electrical Apprentice Signal Trainee (Marion, OH)
description:
Requisition 40470: 2027 Electrical Apprentice Signal Trainee (Marion, OH)

We are accepting applications to build a pipeline of qualified candidates for upcoming hiring needs. Candidates who successfully complete the hiring process may be considered for training classes between late 2026 and mid-2027, based on business needs and location availability.

Description

At Norfolk Southern, we believe that our people power progress. Our culture is built on our SPIRIT values—Safety, Performance, Integrity, Respect, Innovation, and Teamwork—which guide how we work, lead, and grow together. If you're ready to launch a career in railroad signal maintenance and contribute to the safety and reliability of train operations, we invite you to explore the Apprentice Signal Trainee role.

This hands-on, field-based position prepares individuals for a career in signal maintenance through structured classroom instruction and on-the-job training. Apprentice Signal Trainees learn to install, inspect, and maintain signal systems that are critical to safe and efficient rail operations.

What Should You Know

  • This is a seniority-based union position. You will be required to bid on available positions, which may be located outside your training location. Relocation may be necessary based on the outcome of the bid process. Relocation assistance is not provided for this position.

  • You must be available to work on-call, 24/7, including holidays, nights and weekends.

  • Extensive travel is required during training (up to 75%).

  • You will be required to join the Brotherhood of Railroad Signalmen (BRS) within 60 days of establishing seniority.

  • You must obtain a Class A CDL within 90 days of hire (training provided by Norfolk Southern)

Training

Training lasts approximately 52 weeks and includes both classroom and field instruction.

Click on the link below to learn more about our training program:

  • Classroom Training: Three sessions (3 weeks each) at the NS Training Center in McDonough, GA. Hotel accommodations, mileage reimbursement, and meal stipends provided.

  • Field Training: Hands-on experience with construction and maintenance crews across your seniority district.

  • Evaluations: Periodic written and practical assessments.

Successful completion of the training program places apprentices on the seniority roster and makes them eligible to bid on Signal Maintainer position.

Seniority Districts:

  • Eastern Region North (ERN)

  • Norfolk & Western (NW)

  • Southern Lines East (SLE)

  • Southern Lines West (SLW)

  • WRE (Western Region East (WRE)

  • Western Region West (WRW)

A detailed overview of the seniority districts is available in the following video:

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform FRA-required inspections and testing of signal systems and grade crossings.

  • Install, maintain, and repair signal equipment including signal lights, switch machines, and electrical switch locks

  • Crossing warning devices and interlocking systems

  • Positive Train Control (PTC) and cab signal systems

  • Read and interpret electrical schematics and technical diagrams.

  • Operate hand tools, electrical testing instruments, and heavy equipment

  • Accurately document inspections, repairs, and installations.

  • Work safely in outdoor environments under varying weather conditions.

  • Respond to on-call assignments, including nights and weekends.

Qualifications – Required

  • You must be 18 years or older.

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

  • You must obtain a Class A CDL within 90 days of hire (training provided by Norfolk Southern)

  • This includes passing a commercial driver medical certification examination.

  • Must pass pre-employment Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) drug and alcohol screening.

  • Must not have a conviction for, or completed state action to cancel, revoke, suspend, or deny a motor vehicle drivers license for, operating a motor vehicle while under the influence of or impaired by alcohol or a controlled substance

  • In the past 36 months, Must not have conviction for, or completed state action to cancel, revoke, suspend, or deny a motor vehicle driver's license for, refusal to undergo such testing as is required by State or foreign law when a law enforcement official seeks to determine whether a person is operating a vehicle while under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.

Qualifications – Preferred

  • Technical certificate or associate degree in Electrical Technology, Electronics Engineering, or related field.

  • OSHA 10/30, First Aid/CPR, TWIC card.

  • 1–2 years in electrical, mechanical, or field service work.

  • Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Proficient in basic computer applications (Excel, Word, Outlook).

  • Effective time management and communication skills.

Physical and Mental Job Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.

  • Capable of climbing, bending, stooping, and working at heights.

  • Ability to walk long distances on uneven terrain.

  • Must pass FRA/FMCSA physical standards including:

  • Visual acuity (at least 20/40 in each eye separately and both together with or without corrective lenses).

  • Color vision (must pass FRA-approved tests; lenses to improve color vision are not permitted).

  • Hearing (no hearing loss greater than 40B average at 500, 1000, and 2000 Hz in better ear; may be met with hearing aid).

Work Conditions

  • Outdoor field work in all weather conditions.

  • Extensive travel during training (up to 75%).

  • On-call and weekend availability required.

  • Union membership required (BRS).

Compensation and Benefits

  • Weeks 1–3 (Classroom): $1,200 /week

  • Apprentice Periods:

  • First 130 days: $36.48/hr

  • Second 130 days: $36.85/hr

  • Post-Apprenticeship (Signal Maintainer): $37.98/hr+

Benefits Include:

  • Medical coverage begins the first day of the second month after hire

  • Health insurance (80/20 or 85/15 plan)

  • $20,000 life insurance

  • 401(k) eligibility from day one

  • Dental and vision coverage after one year of service

Company Overview

Norfolk Southern Corporation (NYSE: NSC) is a Fortune 300 organization and one of the nation’s premier transportation companies. Its Norfolk Southern Railway Company subsidiary operates approximately 19,500 route miles in 22 states and the District of Columbia, serves every major container port in the eastern United States, and provides efficient connections to other rail carriers. Norfolk Southern is a major transporter of industrial products, including chemicals, agriculture, and metals and construction materials. In addition, the railroad operates the most extensive intermodal network in the East and is a principal carrier of coal, automobiles, and automotive parts.

At Norfolk Southern, we believe in celebrating our individuality. By leveraging the unique backgrounds and viewpoints of our employees, we can create a culture of innovation, respect, and inclusion. We know that employees thrive in a workplace where differing viewpoints, ideas, and experiences are freely shared and valued. As such, we encourage all employees to contribute their distinctive skills and capabilities to our organization.

Equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, and gender identity. Together, we power progress.

title: AI and Data Science Solution Engineer
description:
The Homeland Sensors and Analytics Group designs, builds, and fields solutions that significantly enhance the tactical decision-making process of analysts and operators who secure the homeland. This includes security for critical infrastructure, land and maritime borders, transportation systems, and soft targets / crowded places. It also includes support for law enforcement, special operations, and intelligence analysts who track and disrupt transnational criminal and terrorist organizations. To do this, the group works on a combination of novel sensing technologies and data analytics techniques to provide better threat awareness to decision makers. The group designs systems that collect and process a wide range of data types — including radar, visible imagery and video, non-visible imagery, text, time-series data, and 3D point clouds — often applying advanced machine learning methods to convert raw data into actionable insights. The group places an emphasis on taking technology from the concept phase through deployment and transition to achieve operational impact.

Job Overview

MIT Lincoln Laboratory Technical Staff provide critical through expert multi-domain or new-domain innovative research supporting the Laboratory’s national security mission. They prototype state-of-the-art technology solutions and engage across the program lifecycle, leading projects or major/multiple technical workstreams in partnership with project, program and team/Group leaders. As a Technical Staff member, you will lead complex technical efforts requiring deep expertise, sound judgment, with the ability to successfully navigate technical complexity. Depending on the level, you will lead projects, major workstreams, complex programs, multi-program initiatives, or technical portfolios on extraordinary technology prototype efforts and creative new ideas and approaches that support critical mission needs. Depending on the level, you will translate broad Group strategy into clearly defined research or executional deliverables. Through integrating your deep technical expertise across disciplines, you consistently drive high-quality mission outcomes.

As a successful candidate, you will connect deep and diverse technical expertise with broader Laboratory objectives, perform independent research, develop creative approaches, and translate broad strategy into executable plans. You will work across or guide multidisciplinary teams through ambiguous trade-offs; helping develop and execute programs, creating briefings and reports, and often interfacing with sponsors. You effectively support sponsor, mission-partner, and Laboratory leadership’s needs through daily or weekly technical briefings, program documentation, proposals, and may conduct advanced capability road mapping and development. You will also guide and mentor Associate Technical Staff, Assistant Technical Staff, and other technical support personnel.

Additional Job Overview Details

The Homeland Sensors and Analytics group is seeking a researcher and engineer to build software solutions incorporating advanced algorithms, AI/ML, and data science models. This work will be performed as part of collaborative, interdisciplinary teams, with the selected candidate sometimes serving as the team lead. Specifically, the candidate will direct the design, software implementation, and testing of novel algorithms relevant to Homeland Security and Defense applications. Familiarity with AI/ML concepts (including frontier models), graph analytics, statistical models, or data science methods is considered important, as well as experience with the design and implementation of such methods within robust software frameworks. This position will provide the opportunity to learn about mission-relevant applications of data analytics tools, conduct independent research on applicable models and techniques, and enable the deployment of developed solutions to achieve operational impact. The position will also allow the candidate to interface with different agencies and user bases within the US Government, to discuss technical concepts, and present results.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead projects, complex programs, major technical workstreams, multi-program initiatives, or technical portfolios involving multidisciplinary development, analysis, prototyping, integration, testing, evaluation, and technology transition.
  • Apply deep technical expertise and systems-level judgment to highly complex and ambiguous problems, evaluating alternatives, trade-offs, risks, stakeholder needs, and mission implications.
  • Translate broad or unclear objectives into actionable technical plans and influence program direction, architectures, systems, priorities, and roadmaps across teams, Groups, or mission areas.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, sponsors, mission partners, and internal leaders to align priorities, resolve dependencies, and guide decisions and deliverables.
  • Assess and improve technical tools, processes, methods, documentation, execution practices, and organizational capability.
  • Serve as a technical resource and mentor by reviewing work, framing trade-offs and risks, and developing staff and emerging leaders.
  • Contribute substantially to papers, reports, presentations, proposals, grants, roadmaps, and other materials that advance mission outcomes and technical direction.

Minimum Qualifications

Candidates will be considered for the appropriate level based on their education, experience, demonstrated technical expertise and breadth, leadership responsibilities, and the scale and complexity of programs or technical efforts they have led.

Level 5 – Technical Staff

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline or other relevant technical field and typically 6+ years of relevant experience; or Master’s degree and typically 4+ years of relevant experience; or PhD and typically 0+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Diverse technical expertise with demonstrated ability to adapt that expertise to unfamiliar or emerging disciplines, systems, mission areas, or methods.
  • Established education, skills, and experience demonstrating the ability to apply significant technical judgment to broad challenges requiring integration across related systems or methods.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects or major workstreams and deliver complex technical outcomes.
  • Experience evaluating trade-offs, recommending paths forward, and adapting technical approaches to evolving project needs.
  • Demonstrated mentorship, collaboration, and ability to communicate recommendations, risks, and technical findings to varied audiences.
  • Experience contributing to technical reports, papers, presentations, proposals, or other formal technical deliverables.

Level 6 – Technical Staff

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline or other relevant technical field and typically 8+ years of relevant experience; or Master’s degree and typically 6+ years of relevant experience; or PhD and typically 2+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Deep and diverse technical expertise with demonstrated ability to integrate knowledge across domains and establish direction in evolving systems or mission areas.
  • Established education, skills, and experience demonstrating the ability to incorporate technical judgment, program context, and stakeholder input to solve broad technical challenges.
  • Proven experience leading complex programs, significant program elements, or multi-team technical efforts.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate alternatives, manage technical ambiguity, and influence decisions across teams or stakeholder groups.
  • Strong record of mentorship, collaboration, technical communication, and contribution to team or Group capability development.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, publications, technical reports, presentations, or other materials that shape program direction or technical initiatives.

Additional Minimum Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in computer science, mathematics, statistics, electrical engineering, information science, applied mathematics, data science, or an equivalent field. In lieu of a Ph.D., a Masters with at least 4 years of directly related experience will be considered.
  • Knowledge to develop, implement, test, and evaluate algorithms and software
  • Proficiency with Python
  • Experience with one or more common machine learning, computer vision, or natural language processing toolboxes
  • Experience architecting and building software systems designed to meet end-user requirements.
  • Ability to work both in a team-oriented environment and independently.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly share technical concepts with a wide spectrum of audiences.
  • Experience with some software development best practices and collaboration tools (e.g., github)

Experience in the following areas is desired

  • Statistical modeling and inference
  • Social network analysis
  • AI/ML models and methods
  • Collection and analysis of publicly available information
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages like C++ or Java.
  • Experience with DevSecOps or CI/CD practices

Reporting to the Division SVP, the VP, General Manager will serve as a member of WillScot’s Divisional leadership team and will collaborate with Regional peers and functional leaders within the Division to execute WillScot’s company objectives.

The VP, General Manager is accountable for increasing market penetration of all of WillScot‘s business lines within the Region to drive growth. Responsibilities also include building and leading a high performing team that operates in a manner consistent with WillScot’s core values. The incumbent will be evaluated against a balanced scorecard of KPIs with an emphasis on achievement of annual targets for Revenue, EBITDA, and profitability.

The Regional P&L includes operating locations across multiple MSAs (Metropolitan Statistical Areas) and approximately $100M+ of annual revenue across all of WillScot’s lines of business. title: Myyjä Triplan Normaliin
description:
Etsimme nyt iloista ja energistä myyjää Normal-myymäläämme. Tarjoamme toistaiseksi voimassa olevaa sopimusta. Työt sijoittuvat niin aamu-, ilta- kuin välivuoroihinkin. (klo. 6-22)

Mikäli etsit inspiroivaa, hauskaa ja menevää työpaikkaa, hae ihmeessä meille ja tule osaksi mahtavaa porukkaamme!

Tietoa meistä:

NORMAL on nuori dynaaminen yritys, joka on muutaman vuoden aikana avannut satoja myymälöitä ympäri Euroopan. Myös Suomessa kasvumme jatkuu edelleen.

Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme pysyvästi matalat hinnat ja useita tuhansia ”normaaleja” tuotteita mm. kemikalio-, kosmetiikka- ja kotitaloustuotteiden saralla, unohtamatta jännittäviä uutuuksia useissa eri tuotekategorioissa.

NORMAL on yritys, jossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia ja meillä on yhteiset menestymis- ja tulostavoitteet - ja samalla pidämme hauskaa yhdessä.

Työ:

Myyjänä sinulla on tärkeä rooli myymälässä ja erityisen ostoskokemuksen luomisessa asiakkaille. Tulet työskentelemään tavoitteellisesti jännittävien tuotteidemme kanssa, ja meille on tärkeää, että voimme aina esitellä hyvin ylläpidetyn ja siistin myymälän asiakkaillemme. Sen lisäksi ystävällinen ja mukava asiakaspalvelu sekä tavalliset rutiininomaiset tehtävät ovat luonnollinen osa arkipäiväämme. NORMAL-myymälät ovat jännittäviä paikkoja täynnä mielenkiintoisia tuotteita ja asiakkaita. Työpäiväsi etenee korkealla tempolla ja on tärkeää, että viihdyt hektisessä, inspiroivassa ja huumorintäyteisessä ilmapiirissä.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, lähde mukaan mahtavaan porukkaamme!

Vastuualueesi:

  • Asettaa asiakkaat etusijalle, jotta he tuntevat itsensä aina tervetulleiksi ja palaavat uudelleen

  • Varmistaa myymälän korkea taso, jossa siisteys ja jännittävät esillepanot ovat keskiössä

  • Asiakaspalvelu ja hyllyjen täyttäminen

  • Myymälän avaaminen ja sulkeminen

  • Palveleminen kassalla

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Kokemusta kaupan alalta ja vilkkaasta työympäristöstä

  • Olet kiinnostunut myymälän toiminnoista, olet kauppiashenkinen ja sinulle asiakas on aina tärkein

  • Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja tehokkaasti

  • Olet työtäpelkäämätön ja sinulla on silmää yksityiskohdille - haluat olla rakentamassa upeita esillepanoja

  • Olet tiimityöskentelijä ja olet mukana luomassa hyvää ilmapiiriä

  • Palvelet asiakkaita suomeksi (taitotaso B1) - arvostamme myös etenkin englannin/ruotsin osaamista

Kiinnostuitko?

Hae mukaan heti, käymme hakemuksia läpi jo ennen hakuajan umpeutumista! Käytössämme on myös mahdollisuus laittaa hakemus videon muodossa ja arvostamme suuresti, mikäli tartut mahdollisuuteen!

title: HazMat Operator III

Individual would need hands on experinence with hazardous waste managment to include RCRA and DOT


Education and Experience Requirements

High School Diploma or GED required. 5 years hazardous materials operations. Other Forklift certification required.

Position Purpose:

Under limited supervision, the Hazardous Material Operator III is responsible for, the proper on-site handling, storage, recovery and disposal of hazardous waste/materials, distribution of bulk chemicals, emergency spill response, and required. regulatory inspections.

Job Description

Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

Essential Functions:
  1. Under direction of Manager, Supervisor, or Hazardous Materials Lead conduct collection and movement of hazardous waste for disposal using provided tools (e.g., carts, forklift, pallet jacks, drum dolly/truck) .

  2. Under direction of Manager, Supervisor, or Hazardous Materials Lead conduct delivery of hazardous materials using provided tools (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, drum dolly/truck) .

  3. Under direction of Manager, Supervisor, or Hazardous Materials Lead assist with waste shipments .

  5. Identify operational improvements and work with Manager, Supervisor or Hazardous Materials Lead to initiate corrective action .

  6. Assist in maintaining accurate records of treatment processes, materials, quantities and test results .

  7. Ensures prompt and responsive customer service for applicable hazardous material processes supporting operations .

  8. Receives stores, distributes and disposes of chemicals controlled or regulated by the Hazardous Materials department as prescribed by federal, state and company regulations .

  10. Performs inspections of all waste Satellite Accumulation Areas, as required.

  11. Assists in training/retraining of new personnel .

  13. Directs fellow employees on proper hazardous waste/material handling .

  14. Assist in other required. regulatory inspections (e.g., SPCC inspections) to ensure compliance with legal and other requirements .

  15. Maintain a current knowledge of Federal, State, and Corporate environmental regulations and procedures .

  1. Perform emergency spill response for all facilities. .

title: Customer Retention Supervisor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Retention Supervisor based in South Africa.

Are you an experienced customer retention leader passionate about building high-performing teams and driving measurable business growth? This opportunity allows you to lead and develop a team of retention specialists within the fast-growing fintech and cryptocurrency industry. You will take ownership of customer reactivation, repeat transactions, and revenue recovery while remaining actively involved in outbound customer engagement. Combining hands-on leadership with strategic campaign management, you will develop effective retention processes, coach team members, and continuously improve customer conversion rates. Working in a dynamic, performance-driven environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen customer relationships and maximise business results. This is an ideal role for a proactive leader who enjoys mentoring people, analysing performance, and turning customer engagement strategies into tangible revenue.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead, supervise, and motivate a team of Customer Retention Specialists, establishing clear performance objectives, responsibilities, and accountability standards.
  • Conduct outbound customer calls personally to encourage repeat transactions, reconnect with inactive customers, and demonstrate effective retention techniques by example.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), calling workflows, scripts, and training materials to strengthen team performance.
  • Organise daily outreach activities, manage agent schedules, and allocate campaign assignments to ensure efficient customer engagement.
  • Design and execute customer retention campaigns, including promotional offers, discount incentives, abandoned transaction follow-ups, and reactivation initiatives.
  • Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), including call volumes, conversion rates, repeat transactions, customer reactivation rates, and revenue recovered.
  • Conduct regular call evaluations, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen agents' communication and sales skills.
  • Analyse customer behaviour, transaction activity, and campaign performance to identify retention opportunities and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Maintain accurate customer relationship management (CRM) records, agent scorecards, performance dashboards, and regular operational reports.
  • Manage escalated customer concerns and collaborate with Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effective issue resolution.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and training initiatives to build and maintain a capable, results-oriented retention team.
  • Use relevant digital and AI-powered tools to improve research, script development, workflow efficiency, and overall team productivity.

Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in customer retention, outbound sales, contact centre operations, or a similar customer-facing environment.
  • Demonstrated success in customer conversion, retention, and reactivation, with experience managing performance-driven teams and achieving measurable commercial results.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate teams, manage performance, and encourage continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, particularly when engaging customers over the phone.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable improvement plans.
  • Ability to balance direct customer engagement with team supervision and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards.
  • Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage.
  • Basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies, combined with a genuine interest in financial technology, is considered a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Additional financial rewards directly linked to individual achievements and overall team performance.
  • Paid Annual Leave: 10 days of paid vacation per year.
  • Public Holidays: Paid time off on all U.S. federal holidays.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere in Anywhere, provided you have a professional home-working setup.
  • Leadership and Career Development: Opportunity to lead, develop, and shape a customer retention team while strengthening your management expertise.
  • High-Growth Industry Exposure: Work within the rapidly evolving global fintech and cryptocurrency sector.
  • Direct Business Impact: Take ownership of retention initiatives that directly contribute to customer engagement, recovered revenue, and business growth.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive, high-trust working environment that values initiative, accountability, and professional development.

description:

Location: Ayer Rajah Crescent

Engineering Analyst (1-Year FTE) is responsible for driving manufacturing performance improvement through data analytics, process optimization, industrial engineering methodologies, operational analytics, and digitalization initiatives.

The position plays a key role in supporting factory performance management, enabling data-driven decision-making, standardizing manufacturing processes, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze production, quality, yield, downtime, and operational performance data to identify gaps, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Lead or support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, process efficiency, product quality, and cost performance.
  • Apply structured problem-solving methodologies to investigate operational issues and develop effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Implement, validate, and monitor process improvements to ensure measurable and sustainable performance gains.
  • Establish and standardize best practices, operating procedures, and performance measurement methods across manufacturing operations.
  • Conduct capacity analysis, workload assessments, line balancing studies, and resource utilization reviews to identify production constraints and improvement opportunities.
  • Perform time studies, work measurement, and productivity assessments to establish performance baselines and identify opportunities for efficiency improvement.
  • Evaluate manpower requirements, equipment utilization, and production workflows to optimize resource allocation and manufacturing capacity.
  • Identify bottlenecks and constraints within production processes and recommend solutions to improve throughput and operational flow.
  • Support production planning and capacity expansion initiatives through data-driven analysis and scenario evaluation.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and management reports to monitor manufacturing performance.
  • Consolidate, analyze, and visualize operational data to provide actionable insights and support timely, data-driven decision-making.
  • Utilize data analysis and visualization tools to identify performance trends, detect deviations, and track improvement results.
  • Support the digitalization and automation of manufacturing reporting, data collection, and performance monitoring processes.

Requirements:

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 2–4 years of relevant experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment, preferably involving manufacturing performance improvement, industrial engineering, process optimization, or operational analytics.
  • Ability to structure dashboards and presentations to tell a clear data-driven story, highlighting performance trends, root causes, improvement opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Demonstrated understanding of manufacturing processes, engineering standards, project specifications, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Experience in data analysis, KPI development, performance reporting, or manufacturing digitalization is preferred.
  • Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools, such as Microsoft Power BI and Grafana.
  • Relevant certifications in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Industrial Engineering, or data analytics are an advantage.

title: Records and Privacy Assistant
description:
RECORDS AND PRIVACY ASSISTANT

The City of Belleville, known as the ‘Friendly City’, is located at the mouth of the Moira River where it meets the picturesque Bay of Quinte. Experience world-class fishing, boating, cycling, and walking along approximately 14 kilometers of waterfront trails. Situated between Toronto and Montreal, and less than one hour from the U.S. border, the City truly is at the center of it all.

Approximately 56,000 people make Belleville their home and over 220,000 live within 30 minutes of the City. We are in close proximity to Prince Edward County where you can discover award winning wineries and numerous beaches including Sandbanks Provincial Park. We are home to Loyalist College of Applied Arts and Technology as well as Albert College, Canada’s oldest co-ed boarding independent private school. The historic downtown core provides numerous restaurants, shopping and live music and theater venues for an amazing cultural experience. Our inviting blend of small town warmth and big city amenities, quality of life and affordable housing make Belleville the perfect place to live, work and play. More information is available at

Currently, the City of Belleville has an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated, strategic, and dynamic individual to join our People & Corporate Services Department as a Records and Privacy Assistant.
Position Type: Permanent Full Time
Number of Positions: One (1)
Department: People & Corporate Services Department

Location: City Hall (169 Front Street, Belleville, ON)
Hours: 35 hours per week; Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 4:30pm

Reporting to the Deputy City Clerk, this position provides administrative support, coordinates Freedom of Information (FOI) requests, supports the Corporation’s records management program, and ensures a high standard of customer service to internal and external stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
This position will:
  • Provide timely and accurate information to the Deputy City Clerk and respond to the decisions and directions generated by same, guided by established departmental policies guidelines and procedures and the requirements of Provincial legislation.
