  • Communicate professionally, and effectively, providing a high standard of customer service both internal and external, on matters related to Corporate Services, with a focus on accessibility inclusive of diverse needs.
  • Coordinate the day-to-day administration of FOI requests under the Municipal Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (MFIPPA), including receiving and reviewing requests, communicating with applicants, coordinating departmental searches, reviewing responsive records, preparing correspondence and assisting with the application of exemptions.
  • Maintain accurate FOI files, tracking systems and related documentation, monitor legislated deadlines, and support the preparation of annual statistical reporting to the Information and Privacy Commissioner of Ontario.
  • Assist with the preparation and review of Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) to identify and assess privacy risks, support compliance with applicable legislation, and recommend measures to protect personal information.
  • Maintain the Corporation’s agreement database within the designated document management system SharePoint, including uploading agreements, entering and maintaining accurate metadata.
  • Support the Corporation's records management program, including the organization, classification, retention, retrieval and disposition of corporate records in accordance with TOMRMS, applicable legislation and municipal policies and procedures.
  • Assist with counter coverage for the department in the absence of other staff, including acting as Deputy Issuer of marriage licenses and preparing documents related to vital statistics, with a focus on accessibility inclusive of diverse needs.
  • Appointed as Commissioner of Oaths.
  • Prepare invoices, purchase orders and cheque vouchers.
  • Maintain a register of claims (Insurance & Legal) made against the municipality and prepare related correspondence.
  • Compile, produce and disseminate agendas for committees related to the activities of the Deputy City Clerk and attend committee meetings; record minutes and produce follow-up correspondence, ensuring that content is accessible to all individuals including those with disabilities.
  • Work with multiple competing demands and deadlines.
  • Assist with Municipal Election duties.
  • Perform all tasks and responsibilities through the lens of Equity, Diversity, Inclusion, ensuring commitment to fairness, representation, accessibility and respect for diverse perspectives and cultures in all aspects of work
  • Perform other related duties, as assigned.
Note: the above duties and responsibilities are not to be construed as all-inclusive.

  • Current Satisfactory Criminal Record Check (“CRC”) prior to commencing work at the City of Belleville.

  • Completion of workshops/training sessions related to the position, including but not limited to AMCTO courses such as Municipal Administration Program or FOI learning sessions.

WORK EXPERIENCE:

  • Demonstrated organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a demanding environment

title: Hotel Receiving & Purchasing Clerk - Full Time
description:
Hotel Name: M Social Sunnyvale
Location: Onsite – Sunnyvale, CA
Salary Range: $32.00 Hourly

Join the Team at M Social Sunnyvale

At M Social Sunnyvale, we don’t just welcome guests—we create moments, spark connections, and bring energy to every interaction. Designed for the young at heart, M Social delivers a bold and vibrant hospitality experience.

About M Social Sunnyvale

As the first ground-up M Social in the U.S., this innovative property features 263 rooms, a dynamic courtyard, and the signature Beast & Butterflies social hub. Located in Silicon Valley, the hotel blends technology, design, and social connectivity to create a unique guest experience.

As part of Millennium Hotels & Resorts, a global hospitality leader with over 145 hotels across key destinations worldwide, our hotel is backed by a legacy of quality, consistency, and service excellence—driven by a passion for hospitality, an entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a progressive, solutions-oriented approach."

At Millennium, we are guided by our core values:

  • Passion for Hospitality – Delivering meaningful and memorable guest experiences
  • Entrepreneurial – Taking ownership and acting with agility
  • Innovation & Progressive – Continuously improving how we operate and serve
  • Solutions & Results Oriented – Staying adaptable and focused on results

These values shape how we work, how we lead, and how we create exceptional experiences for our guests and our teams.

About the Role:

As our Hotel Receiving & Purchasing Clerk, you will play an essential role in supporting the daily operations of the hotel by coordinating purchasing activities, receiving deliveries, maintaining accurate inventory records, and supporting the efficient flow of supplies and equipment throughout the property.

You will work closely with Finance, Culinary, Food & Beverage, and other departments to support purchasing needs, monitor deliveries, verify invoices, and maintain organized receiving and storage areas.

This role is ideal for a detail oriented and organized individual who enjoys working collaboratively, takes pride in accuracy, and understands the importance of purchasing controls, inventory management, and operational efficiency in a hospitality environment.

Your Impact – Purchasing & Receiving Operations

You will contribute to the success of M Social Sunnyvale by supporting timely purchasing, accurate receiving, proper inventory controls, and effective vendor coordination.

Your attention to detail, organization, and accountability will help departments operate efficiently, manage costs, and maintain the supplies and resources needed to deliver exceptional guest experiences.

What You'll Be Doing

Purchasing & Procurement

  • Support daily purchasing activities for hotel departments, including Food & Beverage, Culinary, and general operations
  • Prepare and process purchase requisitions and purchase orders in accordance with company procedures
  • Coordinate with department leaders to identify purchasing needs and order requirements
  • Communicate with approved vendors regarding pricing, product availability, order confirmations, and delivery schedules
  • Monitor outstanding purchase orders and follow up on delayed or incomplete deliveries
  • Assist with sourcing products, obtaining vendor quotations, and comparing pricing when requested
  • Maintain accurate purchasing records and supporting documentation
  • Follow established purchasing authorization procedures and financial controls

Receiving Operations

  • Receive, inspect, and verify all incoming deliveries against purchase orders, packing slips, and invoices
  • Confirm quantities, product descriptions, quality, and condition of delivered goods
  • Identify and report damaged, missing, incorrect, or unauthorized deliveries
  • Coordinate returns, replacements, and discrepancies with vendors and department leaders
  • Record received merchandise accurately in purchasing and inventory systems
  • Communicate delivery status and product availability to the appropriate departments
  • Coordinate the timely distribution of received goods to designated storage areas and departments
  • Maintain accurate receiving logs and supporting documentation

Inventory & Storage Management

  • Assist with maintaining accurate inventory levels across hotel storerooms and supply areas
  • Organize and maintain receiving areas, storerooms, and inventory locations
  • Follow proper stock rotation practices, including First In, First Out (FIFO)
  • Monitor product expiration dates, storage conditions, and inventory discrepancies
  • Assist with regularly scheduled inventory counts and reconciliation
  • Support inventory controls to minimize waste, loss, and unnecessary purchasing
  • Maintain appropriate security and access controls for stored merchandise
  • Report inventory shortages, damaged goods, and unusual discrepancies to management

Financial & Cost Control

  • Match purchase orders, receiving records, and vendor invoices for accuracy
  • Identify pricing, quantity, and billing discrepancies and assist with resolution
  • Coordinate with Finance and Accounts Payable to support accurate invoice processing
  • Maintain organized purchasing and receiving documentation for audit purposes
  • Support departmental cost control and purchasing efficiency initiatives
  • Assist with monitoring vendor pricing and identifying potential cost savings
  • Follow company policies regarding purchasing approvals, invoice processing, and inventory accountability

Vendor & Department Coordination

  • Maintain professional and productive relationships with approved vendors and suppliers
  • Coordinate delivery schedules to minimize disruption to hotel operations
  • Communicate purchasing updates, shortages, and delivery concerns to department leaders
  • Partner closely with Culinary and Food & Beverage on food, beverage, and operating supply deliveries
  • Support Housekeeping, Engineering, and other departments with purchasing and inventory requirements
  • Assist with special projects, hotel events, and operational purchasing needs
  • Promote a collaborative and service focused approach when supporting internal departments

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow company purchasing policies, receiving procedures, and internal control requirements
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe receiving and storage areas
  • Follow proper food storage, temperature control, and sanitation requirements when handling food and beverage deliveries
  • Comply with OSHA regulations and hotel workplace safety procedures
  • Use appropriate lifting, handling, and material movement practices
  • Report unsafe conditions, damaged equipment, or potential safety hazards
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation in accordance with company standards

Requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet operational deadlines
  • Basic understanding of purchasing, receiving, and inventory procedures
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple departments
  • Strong problem solving skills and a proactive approach to daily responsibilities
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality, accountability, and ethical purchasing practices
  • Flexibility to work varying schedules based on operational and delivery needs
  • Food Handler Card required

Operational Requirements

  • Minimum 1 to 2 years of experience in purchasing, receiving, inventory control, warehouse operations, or a related field preferred
  • Previous experience in a hotel, restaurant, hospitality, or food service environment preferred
  • Experience receiving merchandise, verifying purchase orders, and maintaining inventory records
  • Ability to coordinate deliveries and communicate effectively with vendors and internal departments
  • Understanding of proper storage, stock rotation, and inventory control practices
  • Ability to maintain accurate documentation and follow established purchasing procedures
  • Experience supporting multiple departments in a fast paced operational environment preferred

Technical / Role Specific Requirements

  • Familiarity with purchasing, inventory management, and receiving systems
  • Experience processing purchase orders, receiving reports, and vendor invoices
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Outlook
  • Ability to accurately enter, review, and maintain purchasing and inventory data
  • Understanding of invoice matching and basic accounting procedures
  • Knowledge of food and beverage receiving standards, including temperature verification and proper storage practices
  • Experience with hotel purchasing or inventory systems such as BirchStreet, Fourth, or similar platforms preferred
  • Ability to operate standard office equipment and material handling equipment when trained and authorized

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous hotel purchasing or receiving experience
  • Experience supporting Food & Beverage and Culinary purchasing operations
  • Familiarity with hotel accounting and purchasing controls
  • Experience conducting inventory counts and resolving discrepancies
  • Knowledge of vendor coordination, purchase orders, and invoice reconciliation
  • Previous hotel opening or preopening experience preferred
  • Bilingual abilities are a plus

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and move throughout the receiving and storage areas for extended periods
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds regularly and handle heavier items with appropriate assistance or equipment
  • Ability to push and pull carts and move supplies using approved material handling equipment
  • Ability to work in receiving docks, storerooms, refrigerated storage areas, and other operational spaces
  • Comfortable working in an active hotel environment with frequent deliveries and changing operational priorities
  • Ability to perform computer based administrative tasks as needed

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Associate degree or coursework in Business Administration, Accounting, Supply Chain Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered

Benefits

At Millennium Hotels & Resorts, we support our employees with a competitive benefits package designed to promote wellbeing and long-term success:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Company-paid Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Coverage
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match (where applicable)
  • Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
  • Hotel Room Discounts across our global portfolio
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to plan terms and company policy.

Why Join Us

At Millennium Hotels & Resorts, you’re not just taking on a role—you’re joining a global organization committed to people, performance, and growth.

Whether you’re supporting operations behind the scenes or delivering service on the front line, your work contributes to a culture focused on hospitality, collaboration, and results.
If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow, contribute, and make an impact, we invite you to join our team.

The District Manager directs all operational activities for 10 to 18 stores, including: day-to-day operations, employee development, merchandising, recruitment and training activities, store openings, financial reporting, sales, productivity, labour and inventory management. He/She is responsible for ensuring that sales targets are met for the territory. He/She will lead store managers and indirectly a team of approximately ten (10) or more employees for each store.

Group Description

The Fabrication Engineering Group provides rapid fabrication, assembly, integration, and testing of advanced hardware prototypes for national security applications. Examples include the precision machining fiber mounts for airborne high-energy laser systems, multi-functional structures using additive processes for ground-based radar systems, custom printed circuit boards (PCBs) for space-borne data processing, and highly integrated mechanical packaging for undersea communication terminals. Core mechanical competencies span precision fabrication, additive manufacturing, and 5-axis machining. The group concentrates on high-complexity parts, quick-turn capabilities, and activities that require concurrent engineering with program teams. Core PCB capabilities include design for manufacturability (DFM), automated solder paste dispensers, precise pick-n-place machines, and automated optical inspection systems. title: Manager / Senior Manager, Operational Excellence and Governance
description:
About Sembcorp
Sembcorp is a leading energy and urban solutions provider headquartered in Singapore. Led by its purpose to drive energy transition, Sembcorp delivers sustainable energy solutions and urban developments by leveraging its sector expertise and global track record.

Join us in shaping a sustainable energy future

Drive Asia’s energy transition with us! Our Gas & Related Services segment is a key growth engine, delivering reliable and efficient energy to industries and communities across multiple countries. We support Asia’s growing energy needs while advancing the shift to a lower-carbon future.

Purpose and Scope

Lead operational excellence, asset reliability, and governance for the Gas & Related Services business by strengthening standards, assurance, and performance oversight across operations. Partner with business and functional leaders to improve control effectiveness, establishes clear accountabilities, enables safe, reliable, efficient, and sustainable performance of assets and operations.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead the operational excellence and governance framework for Gas & Related Services, defining standards, KPIs, review routines, and decision forums to support consistent execution across assets.
  • Develop, govern, and periodically review operational policies, standards, procedures, and process safety requirements, ensuring clear ownership, approval authorities, version control, and implementation discipline.
  • Lead analysis of performance trends, operational losses and recurring issues, and drive prioritised initiatives that deliver measurable improvements in plant availability, efficiency, maintenance effectiveness and cost performance.
  • Drive strategic transformation and asset optimization initiatives across the Gas & Related Services portfolio to maximize asset value, operational performance, reliability, feature readiness and sustainable business outcomes.
  • Monitor applicable industry and regulatory requirements, assess operational impacts, and coordinate timely updates to policies, controls, and implementation plans.
  • Analyse operational losses, recurring issues, maintenance effectiveness, asset reliability trends, and follow-through discipline, then translate findings into prioritised corrective and preventive actions with respective owners, timelines and measurable outcomes.
  • Own and maintain the COE technical standards roadmap, including standardization priorities, document governance, lessons learned, and structured knowledge management to support consistent fleet-level technical execution.
  • Benchmark operational performance, policies, and standards against recognised industry practices, identify material gaps, and maintain a prioritised improvement roadmap based on risk, business value, and implementation feasibility.
  • Evaluate relevant technologies and work practices through structured business cases or pilots, govern disciplined adoption, measure realised benefits, and share lessons learned across the organisation.
  • Advise business and asset leaders on operational excellence and governance priorities, align cross-functional stakeholders on accountabilities, and build organisational capability through communication, training, coaching, and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Asset Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in operational excellence, asset management, maintenance, technical governance or performance improvement within gas-fired power, utilities, energy, process industries or other asset-intensive environments.
  • Proven leadership experience delivering cross-functional governance, assurance, or performance improvement programmes across multiple sites, assets or business units.
  • Strong knowledge of operations and maintenance practices, reliability engineering, and continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and govern and assure implementation of policies, standards, procedures, corrective action tracking, performance dashboards and review routines that support consistent execution and accountability across assets.
  • Experience using data analytics, digital tools, or enterprise systems to improve maintenance performance, operational visibility, compliance monitoring, and decision quality.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, project teams, and operational stakeholders.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as required to support site engagement, reviews, project delivery, and programme implementation.
  • Strong written and spoken English proficiency is required to perform the role, including preparing documentation, facilitating cross-functional discussions, and engaging senior leaders and stakeholders across Singapore and regional operations.

Our Culture at Sembcorp

At Sembcorp, our culture is shaped by a strong set of shared behaviours that guide the way we work and uphold our commitment to driving the energy transition.

We foster an institution-first mindset, where the success of Sembcorp takes precedence over individual interests. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do, as we work seamlessly across markets, businesses, and functions to achieve our goals together. Accountability is a core principle, ensuring that we take ownership of our commitments and deliver on them with integrity and excellence. These values define who we are and create a workplace where our people can thrive while making a meaningful impact on driving energy transition.

Join us in making a real impact!

title: Mekatronikingenjör – testutveckling inom försvarsindustrin
description:
Nu letar vi efter en mekatronikingenjör inom testutveckling till ESSIQ Väst! ESSIQ är arbetsgivaren som anstränger sig lite extra för att du ska må bra. Vad är medarbetarfokus för dig? På ESSIQ handlar det om att sätta medarbetaren i centrum. Genom ett lyhört ledarskap och en öppen företagskultur vill vi ge varje medarbetare möjligheten att forma sin karriär och sin vardag.

Till den här rollen söker vi dig som har erfarenhet av relevanta uppgifter och som är redo för nya utmaningar. Ser du fördelarna med att få variation och erfarenhet från olika kunder och branscher men att utvecklas med en och samma arbetsgivare? Som medarbetare på ESSIQ får du det bästa av två världar.

ROLLBESKRIVNING

Som mekatronikingenjör inom testutveckling arbetar du på plats hos vår kund, företag inom försvars- och säkerhetsindustrin. Du utvecklar hårdvara och testutrustning som används för att verifiera kundens produkter och system, och tar lösningarna hela vägen från koncept till färdig utrustning. Arbetet spänner över mekanik, elektronik, kablage och systemintegration. Du ansvarar för designen av dina lösningar och för att de uppfyller ställda krav. I rollen ingår också att välja material och komponenter, sköta inköp, ta fram och underhålla teknisk dokumentation och samarbeta med leverantörer och mekanikteam kring konstruktion och tillverkning. Du ingår i ett team och arbetar nära kollegor inom testutveckling, elektronik, systemutveckling och produktion. Vi förväntar oss att du har ett användarcentrerat, lösningsorienterat arbetssätt och att du är öppen, nytänkande och professionell. En anställning hos oss innebär både trygghet och frihet, där vi stöttar dig så mycket som du vill och behöver. För oss är det viktigt att du får vara delaktig i att forma din karriärväg och att du är med och påverkar ESSIQ som företag och arbetsplats.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi letar inte efter anställda, vi letar efter medarbetare – efter ESSIQ:are! Nedanstående är de grundläggande kvalifikationerna för tjänsten, men vi kommer även lägga stor vikt vid din personlighet.

Grundläggande kvalifikationer

  • Högskoleingenjör, civilingenjör eller YH-utbildning inom mekatronik, maskinteknik, elektroteknik eller motsvarande

  • Minimum 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet eller annan erfarenhet vi bedömer relevant

  • Kunskap inom konstruktion och 3D-CAD

  • Erfarenhet av eller starkt intresse för kablage, elektronik eller elektrisk integration

  • Strukturerad i ditt arbete med kravställning, komponentval och teknisk dokumentation

  • Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av testutrustning, systemintegration eller verifiering

  • Erfarenhet från försvars-, flyg- eller annan högteknologisk industri

  • Ledarskapserfarenhet, till exempel som teknisk projektledare eller teamledare

Personlighet och engagemang

  • Du är ansvarstagande – kommer i mål, i medvind likväl som i motvind.

  • Du är social och kommunikativ – öppen och tydlig gentemot dina kollegor, och är en produktiv problemlösare. Du är bra på att föra samtal om dig, arbetsteamet och leveransen inför en eller flera åhörare.

  • Du är lyhörd och hjälpsam – tar in kunskap från omvärld och kollegor, och delar gärna med dig av din egen. Du är generös med tips, hjälp och stöd.

OM TJÄNSTEN

  • Anställningsform: tillsvidareanställning på heltid.

  • Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.

  • Lön och förmåner: Konkurrenskraftig fast eller rörlig lön. Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och generösa förmåner.

  • Placering: ESSIQ Väst – på plats hos kund i Göteborg.

  • Uppdraget kan kräva säkerhetsprövning.

OM ESSIQ
ESSIQ är teknikkonsultföretaget där allt börjar med dig. Med fokus på individen, flexibla lösningar och en modern lönepolicy attraherar vi de skarpaste, mest professionella och engagerade personerna i branschen. Med denna vision grundades ESSIQ år 2005, sedan dess har vi utvecklats till ett framgångsrikt företag med kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi består idag av över 150 medarbetare med olika bakgrund, personlighet och nationalitet, med en god fördelning av kvinnor och män.

Vi har över 80 aktiva kunder i spännande branscher – allt från de stora aktörerna till de små innovationsföretagen. ESSIQ:s medarbetare arbetar med användarcentrerad tjänste- och produktutveckling inom följande tjänsteområden: UX & Service Design, Connected & Embedded Systems, IT & Cloud Services, Green Technology & Electromobility, Test & Quality Engineering, Agile Management, Mechanical Engineering samt Simulation & Visualization. Kompetensen levererar vi på plats hos uppdragsgivaren, inhouse och i satellit. Våra medarbetares intressen och ambitioner leder vägen – vårt mål är att göra den perfekta matchningen av individ och uppdrag.

ESSIQ är ett familjärt och socialt företag med visionen att vara Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för alla medarbetare, oavsett roll i organisationen. Vi lägger stor vikt vid gemenskap och har ett uppskattat utbud av professionella och sociala aktiviteter. Vår kommunikationsplattform genomsyras av öppenhet, och främjar nätverkande och kompetensutbyte såväl som fritidsaktiviteter och relationsbyggande.

title: Front of the House Manager- Fine Dining
description:
Gallion’s Fine Dining Restaurant
Front of the House Manager
Position Type: Full-Time
Compensation: Competitive, Based on Experience
Position Overview: The Front of House Manager is responsible for effectively managing, coordinating, and developing the entire FOH team while ensuring the restaurant consistently delivers exceptional guest service and meets operational and financial goals established by management. This position requires a strong hospitality background, exceptional leadership skills, attention to detail, and the ability to lead by example in an upscale dining environment. The ideal candidate is hands-on, guest-focused, organized, and committed to maintaining the highest standards of service, professionalism, and accountability.

title: Claims Executive - Energy, Property & Construction
description:
Claims Executive – Energy, Property & Construction

We are looking for a Claims Executive – Energy, Property & Construction to join our Claims team.

In this role, you will manage a portfolio of commercial claims within assigned authority limits, with a particular focus on Energy, Property and Construction-related losses. You will apply sound technical judgement across coverage assessment, reserving, claims strategy, negotiation and settlement, while ensuring claims are handled fairly, efficiently and in line with internal governance requirements.

You will work closely with customers, brokers, loss adjusters, legal advisers, reinsurers and internal stakeholders to drive timely claims resolution and deliver a high-quality, customer-centric claims experience.

This opportunity would suit someone with 3 to 5 years of commercial claims experience, ideally with exposure to Property, Engineering, Construction or Energy-related claims, who is looking to further develop their technical claims expertise.

Key Responsibilities

Claims Management & Technical Assessment

  • Manage a portfolio of Energy, Property and Construction claims from notification through to resolution, within assigned authority limits and claims handling guidelines.
  • Review policy wording, facts of loss and supporting documentation to determine policy response, coverage and liability, escalating complex coverage matters where appropriate.
  • Develop and execute appropriate claims strategies based on the circumstances, complexity and potential exposure of each claim.
  • Maintain accurate and comprehensive claims records, ensuring claims data and documentation are updated promptly and in accordance with internal standards and best practices.

Reserving, Settlement & Recoveries

  • Establish timely and appropriate claims reserves, including consideration of potential ultimate cost and sensitivities, and conduct regular reviews throughout the claims lifecycle.
  • Assess claim quantum and supporting evidence, challenge costs where appropriate, and negotiate fair and reasonable settlements within assigned authority.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities for recovery, subrogation and contribution, where applicable.
  • Manage and calculate recoveries relating to internal accounts and external reinsurers, ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up.

Stakeholder & Customer Management

  • Proactively manage relationships with customers, brokers, loss adjusters, lawyers, experts, reinsurers and other external service providers to facilitate effective claims resolution.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders, including Underwriting and Distribution, to share relevant claims insights and support effective portfolio management.
  • Communicate claims decisions and technical matters clearly, professionally and empathetically, ensuring a positive customer experience throughout the claims journey.
  • Manage produced and received claims in accordance with applicable claims protocols and agreed service standards.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure claims are managed in accordance with relevant regulatory requirements, internal controls, delegated authority limits and claims governance standards.
  • Identify emerging issues, claims trends and lessons learned, and share relevant insights with stakeholders.
  • Contribute to business planning, process improvement and transformation initiatives within the Claims function.
  • Support initiatives that improve claims efficiency, technical capability, customer outcomes and operational effectiveness.

Qualifications, Experience & Skills

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in commercial insurance claims, ideally with exposure to Property, Engineering, Construction and/or Energy-related claims.
  • Good understanding of commercial insurance principles, policy interpretation, coverage assessment, reserving and claims settlement.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage claims independently within defined authority levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex information and exercise sound judgement.
  • Strong negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple claims and competing priorities effectively.

title: Customer Retention Supervisor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Retention Supervisor based in Sweden.

Are you an experienced customer retention leader passionate about building high-performing teams and driving measurable business growth? This opportunity allows you to lead and develop a team of retention specialists within the fast-growing fintech and cryptocurrency industry. You will take ownership of customer reactivation, repeat transactions, and revenue recovery while remaining actively involved in outbound customer engagement. Combining hands-on leadership with strategic campaign management, you will develop effective retention processes, coach team members, and continuously improve customer conversion rates. Working in a dynamic, performance-driven environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen customer relationships and maximise business results. This is an ideal role for a proactive leader who enjoys mentoring people, analysing performance, and turning customer engagement strategies into tangible revenue.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead, supervise, and motivate a team of Customer Retention Specialists, establishing clear performance objectives, responsibilities, and accountability standards.
  • Conduct outbound customer calls personally to encourage repeat transactions, reconnect with inactive customers, and demonstrate effective retention techniques by example.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), calling workflows, scripts, and training materials to strengthen team performance.
  • Organise daily outreach activities, manage agent schedules, and allocate campaign assignments to ensure efficient customer engagement.
  • Design and execute customer retention campaigns, including promotional offers, discount incentives, abandoned transaction follow-ups, and reactivation initiatives.
  • Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), including call volumes, conversion rates, repeat transactions, customer reactivation rates, and revenue recovered.
  • Conduct regular call evaluations, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen agents' communication and sales skills.
  • Analyse customer behaviour, transaction activity, and campaign performance to identify retention opportunities and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Maintain accurate customer relationship management (CRM) records, agent scorecards, performance dashboards, and regular operational reports.
  • Manage escalated customer concerns and collaborate with Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effective issue resolution.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and training initiatives to build and maintain a capable, results-oriented retention team.
  • Use relevant digital and AI-powered tools to improve research, script development, workflow efficiency, and overall team productivity.

Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in customer retention, outbound sales, contact centre operations, or a similar customer-facing environment.
  • Demonstrated success in customer conversion, retention, and reactivation, with experience managing performance-driven teams and achieving measurable commercial results.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate teams, manage performance, and encourage continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, particularly when engaging customers over the phone.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable improvement plans.
  • Ability to balance direct customer engagement with team supervision and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards.
  • Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage.
  • Basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies, combined with a genuine interest in financial technology, is considered a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Additional financial rewards directly linked to individual achievements and overall team performance.
  • Paid Annual Leave: 10 days of paid vacation per year.
  • Public Holidays: Paid time off on all U.S. federal holidays.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere in Anywhere, provided you have a professional home-working setup.
  • Leadership and Career Development: Opportunity to lead, develop, and shape a customer retention team while strengthening your management expertise.
  • High-Growth Industry Exposure: Work within the rapidly evolving global fintech and cryptocurrency sector.
  • Direct Business Impact: Take ownership of retention initiatives that directly contribute to customer engagement, recovered revenue, and business growth.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive, high-trust working environment that values initiative, accountability, and professional development.

title: AI Engineer - Agentic AI & Cloud Infrastructure
description:
We are seeking a hands-on AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI agents and intelligent automation solutions for enterprise applications who can contribute across the full development lifecycle, from AI agent architecture and backend development to infrastructure deployment, authentication, testing, and production maintenance.

The role involves working with large language models (LLMs), including both commercial and open-source models, with opportunities to fine-tune, customize, evaluate, and optimize models for specific business use cases.

The ideal candidate must have strong software engineering skills, experience working with Microsoft Azure infrastructure, and the ability to develop AI agents that integrate securely with enterprise systems such as Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, and other Microsoft 365 services.

Key Responsibilities:

  • AI Agent Development
    • Design, develop, and deploy AI agents capable of performing multi-step tasks and automating business workflows
    • Build agents using Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry), Azure AI Agent Service, and other agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar technologies
    • Develop agent capabilities including tool calling, function execution, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory management, and workflow orchestration
    • Integrate agents with internal applications, external APIs, databases, and enterprise systems. Implement multi-agent workflows, human-in-the-loop approvals, and appropriate security guardrails
    • Test, evaluate, and optimize agent accuracy, reliability, and performance
  • Microsoft Azure & Enterprise Integrations
    • Build and deploy AI agents that operate within Microsoft Teams and other Microsoft 365 applications
    • Integrate AI agents with Microsoft Graph API to access authorized resources such as SharePoint, Outlook, OneDrive, Teams, and calendars
    • Implement secure authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), OAuth 2.0, and single sign-on (SSO)
    • Work with delegated permissions, application permissions, app registrations, and On-Behalf-Of (OBO) authentication flows
    • Develop backend APIs and services to support agent interactions with enterprise applications. Ensure secure data access and appropriate user-level permissions across integrations
  • Open-Source LLMs & Model Fine-Tuning
    • Work with commercial and open-source/open-weight LLMs, including models such as Llama, Qwen, and Mistral
    • Fine-tune and customize LLMs for domain-specific applications, enterprise workflows, and specialized tasks
    • Apply parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA
    • Prepare training datasets, perform data preprocessing, and develop model evaluation pipelines
    • Experiment with inference optimization, quantization, and model serving frameworks
    • Evaluate and compare open-source and commercial LLMs based on accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost
    • Work with frameworks and libraries such as Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, PyTorch, and related tools
    • Support the deployment and integration of fine-tuned models into AI applications and agent workflows
  • Azure Infrastructure & DevOps
    • Provision, configure, and manage cloud infrastructure for AI applications within Microsoft Azure. Work with Azure services including:
      • Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry
      • Azure OpenAI Service
      • Azure App Service, Azure Functions, and Azure Container Apps
      • Azure AI Search
      • Azure Storage and database services
      • Azure Key Vault
      • Azure Monitor and Application Insights
      • Microsoft Entra ID
    • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps
    • Manage source control, deployments, and environment configurations using Git and Azure DevOps
    • Support infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep
    • Implement monitoring, logging, error handling, and troubleshooting for production AI systems
    • Optimize cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, security, and cost

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a practical, technically capable engineer who enjoys building working AI systems and solving complex engineering problems who is not only knowledgeable in AI but also a hands-on practitioner who can confidently discuss AI solutions with clients, translate technical concepts into business value, and deliver training or knowledge-transfer sessions when needed.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across AI development, backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise integrations. They should be able to take an AI agent from prototype to production, understand how to connect it securely to enterprise applications, and have the technical curiosity to experiment with open-source models and emerging AI frameworks.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a prompt engineering or no-code automation position. We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate working AI agents, real Azure deployments, enterprise integrations, or fine-tuned LLM projects they have personally developed.

Required Qualifications:

  • 2–5 years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, machine learning engineering, or related technical roles
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python, with experience developing backend services and APIs
  • Practical experience developing LLM-powered applications, AI agents, or intelligent automation systems
  • Experience with agent frameworks such as Microsoft Foundry Agent Service, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent tools
  • Working knowledge of RAG, vector databases, embeddings, tool calling, and LLM orchestration
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including deploying and managing cloud applications
  • Experience using Azure DevOps, Git, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Understanding of REST APIs, authentication, authorization, and enterprise system integrations
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, and Microsoft Graph API
  • Experience working with open-source LLMs and familiarity with model fine-tuning techniques
  • Understanding of model evaluation, inference, and performance optimization

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AWS cloud services and architecture
  • Experience building and deploying AI agents within Microsoft Teams
  • Experience implementing OAuth On-Behalf-Of flows and delegated Microsoft Graph permissions
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 Agents SDK, Teams SDK, or Azure Bot Service
  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs using LoRA, QLoRA, or Hugging Face PEFT
  • Experience deploying open-source models using vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face, or similar serving frameworks
  • Familiarity with GPU infrastructure and model inference optimization
  • Experience with Docker, containerized applications, Terraform, or Bicep
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), multi-agent systems, and agent orchestration
  • Experience integrating AI applications with SharePoint, Dynamics 365, SQL databases, or other enterprise systems
  • Familiarity with enterprise AI security, observability, and MLOps practices

Benefits

  • Free lunch meal, fruits, snacks, and drinks (if you are in an onsite shift)
  • Onsite gym with a free professional instructor
  • Weekly fitness activity and an annual fitness challenge where you can win up to Php 70,000
  • Weekly engagement activities with prizes that are up to Php 3,000
  • Free upskilling academy to improve your performance and skillset
  • State-of-the-art facilities from toilets to your workstation
  • Amenities such as sleeping quarters, game area, chat room, shower room

title: STUDENT- PPECS Counter Assistant
description:
PARK PORTABLE EQUIPMENT CENTER & SERVICES (PPECS):

PORTABLE EQUIPMENT COUNTER ASSISTANTS are responsible for…

  • Performing detailed inspections of portable equipment being checked out and returned by student patrons and faculty.
  • Function checking, prepping and checkout of daily reservations for portable equipment.
  • Reporting items found to be missing or broken to the supervisor followed by a ticketing of such resources
  • Checking the database reservations program at the beginning of each shift to see what needs to be prepped or inspected and what items are LATE.
  • Faculty reservations for classroom support must take priority at the beginning of each shift.
  • Assistants should be prepping up to 24 hours in advance, regardless of when their particular shift ends. At the same time, counter assistants should be monitoring the returns screen and make sure to send out notices as soon as equipment becomes late.

When patrons arrive to pickup a reservation that has already been assembled, the counter assistant must once again inspect the items on the cart and compare them with the reservation. Assistants must verify that the equipment number on the cart matches the equipment number on the reservation. Assistant must also confirm that all non-reservable items on the cart match the reservation.

Inspections should be ongoing. Whenever there is a lull in activity at the front counter, assistants should be inspecting equipment on the shelf. Assistants must match contents of each kit or case with contents list noted on case or in the database. Assistants should be inspecting equipment closely for damage or missing items. If you find any discrepancy or problems, it should be brought to the immediate attention of Facilities Manager or Technical Support Manager. If this occurs after hours, equipment should be taken off-line and ticketed with a follow up email to PPECS listserv. IF the item you are taking offline is on a future reservation and you find that there is not a substitution or replacement for that item, please only take the item off-line until the beginning the next reservation. Assistants should then make the Technical Support Manager or Facilities Manager aware of the high priority for repair.

title: Senior Space Planner
description:
Job Title: Senior Space Planner

Job Type: Full-Time/Exempt
Location: Falls Church, VA. Quarterly travel required.
Compensation/Salary: $105,000 - $115,000
Authorization Status: Must be a U.S. Citizen (contract/client requirement).
Clearance Requirements: Must be eligible to pass and maintain a Moderate Risk Public Trust Background Check (HSPD-12)

About Aleto

Aleto specializes in federal property management, space planning, and facility management. Aleto primarily supports federal government agencies to create realty solutions, provide facility and space planning support services, and enhance strategic communications.
We are looking to hire motivated people who are excited to grow with us. You will have the potential to help improve processes and help identify solutions for our government, supporting the organizations that serve American citizens across the country. We offer the opportunity to collaborate directly with clients to have a real impact on the day-to-day operations of federal agencies.
We are a growing company that stands firm on our core values: Accountability, Ingenuity, Reliability, Service, and Stewardship. This is what sets us apart from our competitors.
Our Mission, Vision, and Purpose:
  • Aleto is committed to helping federal agencies improve their workspace.
  • We aspire to be trusted advisors to senior executives for federal leasing and facilities operations decision-making.
  • Our purpose is to enhance your workspace with our innovations while maintaining your trust with dependable, responsible, and high-quality service.
We collaborate with our partners, from start to finish, to ensure we identify and deliver the best solutions based on their business needs.
We offer paid vacation, sick time, paid federal holidays, parental leave, full medical/dental/vision, and a 401(k) with employer match.
We are proud to employ a group of experts from diverse backgrounds. We recognize that recent studies show those from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to roles if they do not meet 100% of the qualifications. We are committed to building an inclusive culture and encourage you to leap with confidence and apply--you may be exactly who we have been looking for.
Aleto is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

What we are looking for

Aleto Inc. is seeking to hire a Senior Space Planner to provide support for space planning, design, and related analytical services to the client's managed lease or owned space to create useable areas. Work includes significant project management responsibility. Expert knowledge of the function and responsibility for the development of work plans or implementation strategic direction; discerns priorities in conjunction with the COR, program/project manager, and the accounts director - assists in the development of the day-to-day tactical plan for the project or team. Ensures accomplishment of projects assigned by the program/project manager and client.

Interview Process

If selected for an interview, you will be contacted for an interview through Microsoft Teams or by telephone. The process averages 3 weeks from initial contact to interview. After all candidates are interviewed, Aleto will notify you of your application status.
If an offer is extended, the start date is determined by availability. The candidate will be able to start with Aleto prior to obtaining their clearance for the DHA client.

Senior Space Planner-Essential Job Duties

Duties include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
  1. Lead comprehensive reviews of all client space assignments, assess utilization trends, and recommend prioritized changes that align space requirements with operational needs and long-term planning objectives.
  2. Lead the development of interior project concepts and planning recommendations that advance the client's brand and workplace innovation strategy, translating stakeholder needs into practical design solutions.
  3. Serve as the primary technical coordination resource for client personnel and external vendors/contractors, resolve documentation discrepancies, and ensure space data and deliverables are accurate and conform to the client's design and software standards.
  4. Develop, document, and improve work and data flow processes; establish consistent practices and provide onboarding, mentoring, and technical guidance to a small team of planners or project support staff.
  5. Manage integrated project planning across design, construction, furniture, moves, and post-occupancy activities; develop work plans, coordinate day-to-day assignments for a small project team, monitor milestones and workload, and escalate resource constraints and delivery risks to the program/project manager.
  6. Lead government agency furniture programs, including procurement advisory services, furniture standards development, and ad hoc furniture project management; advise stakeholders on options, coordinate vendor activities, and guide implementation within approved project requirements.
  7. Oversee the preparation and maintenance of as-built drawings across the space portfolio, verify usable square footage (USF) and rentable square footage (RSF), and review team deliverables for technical accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  8. Manage updates to record drawings (XRef files in IWMS) for all client space and drawing templates using AutoCAD; establish quality-control checks and provide technical directions to team members maintaining these records.
  9. Plan and lead regularly scheduled site walks to validate as-built information, assess space configuration changes, resolve discrepancies, and coordinate timely updates to drawings and associated space data.
  10. Independently evaluate complex space assignment requests, assess necessity and urgency, analyze personnel and equipment needs, and present recommendations for space allocation, reassignment, or reconfiguration that maximize utilization and clearly communicate trade-offs for client decision-making.
  11. Lead space-planning coordination in multidisciplinary meetings with Architecture, AV/IT, Construction, and other stakeholders; communicate recommendations, resolve cross-functional issues, and track decisions and team action items through completion.
  12. Professional development planning for team members

ALETO JOB DUTIES

  • Compliance with all Aleto processes, standards, and guidelines including utilizing the employee and intranet platforms, entering time daily, submitting expense reports, providing monthly progress reports, etc.
  • Participate in recurring bi-monthly performance development meetings with your Aleto manager to discuss current job tasks, promote open dialog/feedback, recognize and celebrate wins, and review positive and purposeful approaches for meeting work-related and professional development goals.
  • Participate in recurring bi-monthly performance development meetings with your Aleto direct reports to discuss current job tasks, promote open dialog/feedback, recognize and celebrate wins, and review positive and purposeful approaches for meeting work-related and professional development goals.
  • Attend team meetings, tri-annual company All-Hands Meetings, and other company-sponsored team-building events to foster and support Aleto's core values, vision, and culture.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.


Education/Experience:
  • Must be able to pass a background check and obtain HSPD-12 public trust credentials (US citizenship required).
  • Bachelor’s degree in architecture or interior design
  • 5+ years of related experience in delivering Architecture or Engineering professional services
  • 2+ years in a supervisory role over 2 or more staff

Technological Skills:
  • Expert proficiency in AutoCAD (preferred) or Revit
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Ability to learn new space planning, drawing, design, specification and facility management software

Required Knowledge and Skills:
  • Expert knowledge of commercial and government office space planning, including GSA space assignment policy and BOMA space standards
  • Ability to read and understand construction documents and blueprints
  • Ability to understand and apply OSHA and ADA requirements, and all building and safety codes
  • Working knowledge of LEED criteria
  • Extensive experience in block and stack workplace design planning, move management, and portfolio consolidation efforts for over 50,000 USF or 300 people
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and must be comfortable presenting to clients and executive personnel.
  • Ability to write clearly and informatively, editing work for spelling and grammar, vary writing style to meet needs
  • Advanced interpersonal and customer relationship management skills
  • Professional demeanor, strong work ethic, discrete, resourceful, and able to maintain confidentiality.
  • Ability to communicate with a variety of people, both internal and external
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Ability to initiate and follow through on work independently.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment.
  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills
  • Strong multi-tasking abilities
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to meet assigned deadlines.
  • Proven critical thinking skills with ability to analyze situations, identify existing or potential problems, and recommend solutions
  • Proven risk management skills, both financial and programmatic
  • Keen analytic, organizational, and problem-solving skills to provide strategic data interpretation, rather than simple reporting.
  • Strong ethics and sound judgment
  • Demonstrated ability to make important decisions under pressure.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain a positive team environment.
  • Highest level of integrity managing Controlled Unclassified Information

What We Offer: Benefits and Perks

At Aleto, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable assets. We are proud to offer the following employee programs and benefits to enhance our employee’s well-being and total rewards package while practicing our core value of Stewardship.
Below is a list of comprehensive benefits offered to employees who work 30 hours or more each week:
  • Medical, Vision and Dental Insurance:
Single, single-plus-one-dependent, or family medical, vision, and dental insurance plans.
  • Pre-Tax Savings Accounts
The option to enroll in an HSA or FSA depending on elected medical insurance coverage. Dependent Care FSAs are also available.
  • Disability Insurance:
Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance.
  • Life Insurance:
Company-paid life insurance coverage.
  • Paid Time Off:
Paid time off includes eleven federal holidays. Full-time employees accrue PTO at the rate of 5 hours per pay period for a total of three weeks per year. In addition, employees are provided with a separate bank of 40 hours of paid sick leave per year.
  • Retirement Plan:
Aleto offers full-time employees a 401(k) qualified retirement plan. The company will match 100% of the first 3% of the employee contribution, then match 50% of the next one-percent match of their contribution to the plan for a total of a 4% employer contribution.
  • Professional Development
After 6 months of employment with Aleto, employees are eligible to apply for education reimbursement under Aleto’s Education Reimbursement Program. The program offers up to $5,250 of reimbursement per year for job-related training to help employees stay updated on key skills and competencies related to the demands of their industry and professions.
Environment and Physical Conditions
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to have ambulatory skills sufficient to visit other locations; and the ability to remain in a stationary position at least 50% of the time, move inside and around an office, position themself to access items located in high or low areas, and transport items weighing up to 20 pounds across the office. Requires the constant operation of a computer and other office productivity machinery and the ability to observe details at a close range typically within a few feet of the observer. The employee interacts frequently with other workers, vendors, and clients and will communicate information and ideas so others will understand and must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. The position consistently requires work to be completed in an office environment with artificial light and air.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

title: Staff Software Engineer

Staff Software Engineer

Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, Payload CMS

ABOUT US

Come Near is a group of people moved to raise the public conversation about Jesus. They create, curate, and connect people to authentic Jesus stories and experiences. Most widely recognized is the group’s “He Gets Us” campaign, which invites people to reconsider Jesus and has reached millions of Americans since launching in 2021. To learn more, visit comenear.org.

Candidates for this role are required to sign the organization’s Statement of Faith, which closely aligns with Come Near’s mission-driven focus of inviting all people one step closer to the authentic Jesus from wherever they are.

POSITION SUMMARY

Come Near is a lean, fully distributed nonprofit behind the He Gets Us campaign, reaching hundreds of millions of people across the world’s largest media moments. We’re hiring a Staff Engineer to own the technical design of our highest-priority initiative: a personalized digital engagement platform.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and document end-to-end architecture spanning products, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Define technical standards, API patterns, and integration contracts for both internal and vendor engineering teams.

  • Architect systems for reliability, scalability, observability, and operational resilience, including support for high-impact, high-traffic events and traffic spikes.

  • Review vendor designs, implementations, and code contributions for architectural quality, security, performance, and long-term maintainability.

  • Collaborate with the AI and data teams on personalization logic, event tracking, and pipeline architecture, with specific attention to how personal/sensitive user data is collected, stored, and used.

  • Set and enforce a practical security and data privacy baseline appropriate to handling sensitive personal data at scale.

  • Identify and mitigate architectural, security, operational, and vendor-related risks before they become delivery, reliability, or business issues.

  • Remain an active technical contributor by shipping critical code, prototyping architectural decisions before standardizing them, and leading through implementation rather than direction alone.

  • Make build-vs-buy and build-vs-vendor recommendations that balance technical quality, delivery speed, operational complexity, and cost.

  • Set the standard for technical documentation across the organization, including architecture decision records (ADRs), design documents, technical standards, and operational runbooks.

  • Advise the Sr. Engineering Manager and VP of Engineering and Analytics on architecture strategy, technical risk, platform evolution, and major technical investment decisions.

COMPETENCIES

  • Able to influence internal engineers and external vendor teams without formal authority through technical expertise, sound judgment, and credibility.

  • Async-fluent and self-directed, capable of driving complex, multi-week technical initiatives with minimal oversight.

  • Strong technical writing skills, producing clear architecture decisions, design documents, implementation guidance, and review feedback.

  • Comfortable holding a technical line under pressure, pushing back when shortcuts introduce unacceptable long-term risk.

  • Pragmatic about tradeoffs, balancing engineering rigor with delivery realities in a lean, mission-driven environment.

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and incomplete requirements, bringing structure and clarity to loosely defined problems.

  • Demonstrates strong systems thinking, understanding how technical decisions affect reliability, security, maintainability, cost, scalability, and team effectiveness.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful experience operating at the Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Architect, or equivalent level; education - at minimum a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field required.

  • Deep expertise in modern web platform architecture, including frameworks such as Next.js or comparable technologies, API design, content platforms, and edge/CDN architecture, plus working knowledge of mobile platform architecture.

  • Strong cloud infrastructure expertise (AWS preferred), including identity and access management, resiliency patterns, autoscaling, observability, and cost optimization.

  • Experience owning infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform or equivalent) and CI/CD systems, not merely consuming them.

  • Experience defining, improving, or scaling testing and quality strategies across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.

  • Experience working alongside external agencies, vendors, or contractors in shared codebases and architectural environments, including reviewing and challenging technical decisions when necessary.

  • Experience designing, building, and operating highly scalable distributed systems with demanding reliability and performance requirements.

BONUS SKILLS

  • Experience architecting or operating large-scale data platforms, analytics infrastructure, or data-intensive systems.

  • Experience building, integrating, or shipping AI/ML-powered products and capabilities.

  • Familiarity with MLOps practices, including deploying, monitoring, and operating machine learning systems in production.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • A personal relationship with Jesus and a passion for Come Near’s mission.
  • A heart for service, humility, and collaborative leadership.
  • An initiative-taking, meticulous approach to planning and execution

BENEFITS

  • Annual performance bonus (based on organizational performance)
  • 80% employer-paid health and wellness coverage
  • 403(b) retirement plan with 7% employer match
  • Very generous PTO
  • Three annual company rest weeks (around July 4 and between Christmas and New Years)
  • Flourishing Fund stipend
  • Education Reimbursement stipend annually
  • Much more!

So, if you're interested in joining a faith-based start-up in the nonprofit space, with a mission and a vision to see lives changed, apply today!

Business Processes Analyst – Retail & POS

About Us

Born in 1985, Dolce&Gabbana is one of the leading luxury and fashion brands in the world. Its founders, Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana, have always been the creative and stylistic source of all of the brand’s activities, as well as the drivers behind the development strategies. It is also present in the segments of Lifestyle and furnishing collaborations.

Job Description

The selected candidate will join the ICT Department as Business Processes Analyst – Retail & POS, reporting directly to the relevant ICT Manager.

The role is responsible for supporting the analysis, implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of Retail and Point of Sale (POS) business applications, ensuring alignment between business requirements and technology solutions. The position will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, end users and external vendors to support business operations and system evolution across international markets.

Main Activities and Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze and document functional requirements related to Retail and Point of Sale (POS) processes, supporting the continuous evolution of business applications;
  • Analyze and review application processes, ensuring alignment between business needs, existing solutions and future process developments;
  • Manage and support POS applications and Retail systems, providing second-level support to headquarters and boutique users worldwide;
  • Investigate application issues and operational incidents, coordinating with internal technical teams and external vendors to ensure timely resolution and service continuity;
  • Define and execute functional, regression and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, supporting release management, go-live and hypercare phases;
  • Participate in Retail and POS implementation projects and international rollouts, collaborating with local and global stakeholders;

title: Customer Delivery Manager
description:
Who we are:

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

· Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.

· Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.

· Strive: We are driven and determined.

· Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.

· Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role:

Reporting to the Customer Project Delivery Director, the Customer Delivery Manager (CDM) will act as the primary customer-facing delivery owner for our hyperscale customers, overseeing the successful coordination, integration, and delivery of customer requirements from contract signing through to Ready for Service (RFS).

The role works cross-functionally with construction, design, and operations teams to ensure alignment between customer requirements and delivery execution across the project lifecycle. The role is project-specific and will be locally-based for the duration of the project, providing on-site delivery leadership, supported by a platform-level Customer Project Delivery Director to ensure governance, escalation management, and consistency across projects.

Key responsibilities:

Customer Delivery Management:

· Act as the primary point of contact for customers during project delivery (build phase), RFS, and customer onboarding, ensuring alignment to contractual commitments and delivery milestones

· Support customer engagement during pre-contract stage to support requirements definition and smooth transition into delivery

· Ensure key customer milestones (e.g., Early Access, RFS) and contractual requirements are clearly tracked and achieved

· Deliver regular progress reporting and facilitate customer audits and inspections during project delivery phases

· Proactively manage customer expectations, escalations, and risks to maintain delivery confidence and satisfaction

Requirements Definition and Design Coordination

· Translate customer requirements into a structured scope and work breakdown

· Identify and define what needs to be delivered without performing detailed engineering design

· Coordinate with Design Engineering and Solution Engineering teams to validate technical feasibility and design solutions

Project and Program Management

· Develop and manage delivery programmes covering customer scope and key dependencies

· Track progress against milestones and ensure alignment with overall project timelines

Customer Change Request Management:

· Manage customer change requests, ensuring all customer changes are assessed for cost and schedule impact

Fit-Out Vendor Coordination:

· Manage delivery of customer fit-out activities, including vendor coordination, site access, and installation sequencing

Customer Handover and Onboarding

· Own handover of facility to customer during RFS

· Drive successful customer onboarding, working with Customer Success Management and Operationsteams to enable a smooth transition into BAU operations

Key Performance Index

· On-time RFS delivery: % of projects delivered on or before committed RFS date

· Customer satisfaction: Customer satisfaction score (CSAT/NPS) across delivery lifecycle

· Contract adherence: % compliance to contractual scope with minimal deviations, cost deviations, or disputes

· Successful customer onboarding: % of onboarding milestones achieved on time with minimal escalations or rework

The successful candidate:

Technical and Delivery Capabilities

· 10+ years of experience leading and owning end-to-end project delivery within critical operating environments (Data Center preferred)

· Proven experience in driving data centre infrastructure delivery

· Experience making delivery and commercial decisions and managing trade-offs across schedule, cost, and technical constraints

· Experience working with hyperscale or large enterprise customers in data centre, cloud, or IT services

· Strong understanding of data centre infrastructure, especially electrical &mechanical services

· Able to define scope and work breakdown, and coordinate engineering inputs

Customer and Stakeholder Management

· Strong customer-facing experience, having operated as a primary interface in delivery environment

· Customer-oriented, with a proactive approach to ensuring high-quality delivery and satisfaction

· Proven ability to navigate multi-stakeholder environments across internal teams, vendors, and customer organizations

· Able to manage escalations, conflicts, and competing priorities

Tools and Qualifications

· Proficient in MSOffice, MS Project / Aconex (or similar)

· Project Management (PMP) certification preferred

Language Proficiency

· Fluent in spoken and written English

Our Nuclear Services team, based in Pickering and the Durham Region, is looking for a Project Manager to join our team.

Reporting to the Program Manager, the Project Manager is responsible for all aspects of the project, including scope, schedule, cost, safety, and quality. The Project Manager must ensure alignment from all stakeholders, internal and external, to achieve project success. Appropriate project management techniques are required to communicate and manage risk, change, stakeholders, cost, and schedule.

  • Conflict resolution.
  • Risk Management.
  • Concise, and detail oriented.
  • Highly organized and analytical.
  • Dedication, ownership, and accountability.
  • Initiative.
  • Problem solving mindset.

Competencies

Integrity
Quality and Continuous Improvement
Health & Safety Commitment

ESFL is a privately owned, Canadian, multi-trade fabricator and constructor, providing a single-source solution for Industrial, Institutional, Commercial, and Power Generation sectors. ESFL has established a reputation for safety, executing high quality workmanship, operational flexibility, efficiency, and timely project completion.

ESFL Nuclear Services has offices in Oshawa and Kincardine along with on-site locations at the OPG, Bruce Power Nuclear Generating Stations, and Canadian Nuclear Laboratories.   • Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards.
  • Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage.
