title: Senior Engineer - Ventilation
description:
Who are we?

Liontown Limited (ASX: LTR) is one of Australia’s newest lithium producers. Our Kathleen Valley Lithium Operation in Western Australia is a Tier-1 asset with a mine life of more than 20 years. We are scaling underground production while planning the next phase of the operation’s long-term future. With our processing facilities and a passionate team, we are set to become one of the world’s largest hardrock lithium operations.

Our operations are designed with sustainability at their core, powered by renewables and built for long-term impact.

The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Ventilation Engineer to join our Mine Planning team, on a permanent, full-time basis; site-based at Kathleen Valley on an 8:6 fly-in fly-out (FIFO) roster with 12-hour days. This is a senior role with genuine technical ownership. You will hold the statutory Underground Ventilation Officer appointment and act as our subject matter expert for underground ventilation.

Reporting to the Technical Services Superintendent, you will be accountable for ventilation compliance, system integrity and life-of-mine ventilation planning during a critical phase of our operation. You will work closely with Planning, Operations and our underground contractor, and you will be a visible safety leader in the field.

What you will be doing

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Hold the statutory Underground Ventilation Officer appointment and ensure all ventilation activities meet Western Australian mining legislation.

  • Independently manage the Ventilation Control Management Plan, and keep the ventilation logbook accurate, current and ready for statutory inspection.

  • Ensure primary ventilation surveys are completed quarterly and secondary surveys weekly, with defects reported to the Underground Manager and actioned promptly.

  • Maintain and update the life-of-mine ventilation model to reflect current and planned underground development.

  • Produce quarterly ventilation schedules aligned with the mine plan, working with Planning and Operations to make sure ventilation capacity supports scheduled mining.

  • Develop the ventilation capital budget in line with the site budgeting cycle, and prepare capital expenditure requests with clear technical justification.

  • Lead by example on safety through regular field engagement with underground operators, verifying compliance with ventilation controls and helping build a strong safety culture.

What we are looking for

With a safety-first mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities, you will bring:

  • Bachelor of Engineering (Mining) or equivalent qualification

  • Satutory Underground Ventilation Officer appointment, or eligibility to obtain one

  • At least four years’ experience in underground mine ventilation engineering, including ventilation survey programmes, modelling and statutory compliance; and at least two years’ experience maintaining life-of-mine ventilation models and producing ventilation schedules aligned with mine plans

  • Working knowledge of Western Australian mining legislation and the obligations of a Ventilation Control Management Plan

  • Advanced knowledge of ventilation principles, survey methodologies and modelling software such as Ventsim or equivalent

  • Sound understanding of ventilation infrastructure, airflow management, auxiliary ventilation systems and emergency response planning

  • Ability to pass pre-employment medical, drug & alcohol screen; obtain a National Police Clearance; and hold a C Class driver’s licence.

It would also be an advantage to have:

  • Postgraduate qualification in mine ventilation, occupational hygiene or a related discipline.

Why Liontown?

Great projects are built by great people, and we want to make sure the people who choose Liontown are looked after, rewarded and supported to do their best work. At Liontown, we offer:

  • A competitive salary package, including Short-Term Incentives, and participation in our company share scheme

  • Enhanced leave entitlements, including five weeks of annual leave, company-paid parental leave, cultural leave and study leave options

  • Salary packaging and reimbursement options, including relocation assistance, salary sacrifice superannuation, salary sacrifice airport parking, salary sacrifice flights and novated leasing

  • Health, wellbeing and fitness discounts with a variety of corporate partners, and access for all Kathleen Valley Dragonfly Village residents to sports courts, a running track, a gym with a female-only fitness area, fitness classes, personal trainers and an on-site physiotherapist

  • Established performance and development pathways, with real opportunities for professional development and career progression

  • The Liontown Recognition Program, which rewards our employees for living our values

  • A modern Kathleen Valley Dragonfly Village, with a central pavilion to unwind and socialise in after shift, a shop stocked with essentials and barista-made coffee, and comfortable rooms with spacious private bathrooms, a smart TV and Wi-Fi.

You will be part of a high-performing team that will support you and challenge you to be your best.

Apply now

The scale to back you. The size to see you. For more information on Liontown, please visit liontown.com.

title: Cloud - Bare Metal Infrastructure Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud – Bare Metal Infrastructure Engineer based in United States .

This is an opportunity to build and scale the physical infrastructure behind a modern cloud platform, taking a new colocation site from initial deployment to production and beyond. You will design and automate the complete lifecycle of bare metal servers, from hardware discovery and provisioning to maintenance and retirement. Working closely with network engineering and Kubernetes platform teams, you will help make physical infrastructure as accessible and reliable as cloud capacity. Your work will establish the technical foundations and operational standards for future sites and a fleet of thousands of hosts. This role offers significant ownership, technical influence, and the chance to shape infrastructure at the intersection of hardware, automation, and cloud-native systems.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead the deployment of the first colocation site, taking it from an empty facility space to production-ready infrastructure, and scale the architecture across additional sites and thousands of hosts.

  • Design automated server provisioning workflows, including network booting, imaging, BMC-driven hardware discovery, and host identity management.

  • Collaborate with network engineering to define and implement connectivity requirements for the fleet, covering out-of-band management and production networking.

  • Develop the interfaces and tools used by the Kubernetes platform team to request infrastructure capacity, monitor host health, and coordinate maintenance activities.

  • Maintain an authoritative source of truth for hardware inventory, software configuration, and physical infrastructure.

  • Automate the full server lifecycle, including hardware burn-in, acceptance testing, fault remediation, staged firmware deployments, and return merchandise authorization (RMA) processes.

  • Build reliable, production-grade automation with safeguards for destructive operations and resilience against site-level failures.

  • Influence the technical and operational strategy of the bare metal platform, including build-versus-buy decisions and approaches to managing large-scale infrastructure.

  • Contribute to growing the infrastructure team and establishing the practices needed to operate an expanding fleet.

    • Requirements:

    • Hands-on experience building and operating automation for bare metal server fleets in data centers or colocation environments.

    • Practical experience with both physical infrastructure and software-driven fleet management, including working directly with hardware and colocation providers.

    • Strong programming skills in Go or Python.

    • Experience designing reliable systems using reconciliation loops, idempotent operations, and failure-tolerant automation.

    • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to understand and debug infrastructure tools beyond their abstraction layers.

    • Experience managing real-world infrastructure failures, such as faulty hardware batches, unstable baseboard management controllers (BMCs), or interrupted rollouts.

    • Deep knowledge of Linux and solid networking fundamentals, including DHCP, PXE, DNS, and BGP.

    • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and the ability to design effective integration points between physical infrastructure and the clusters running on it.

    • Clear communication skills, sound technical judgment, and comfort working in ambiguous environments.

    • Willingness to challenge assumptions and raise concerns when technical plans or proposed approaches need reconsideration.

      • Nice-to-have qualifications:

      • Experience operating bare metal fleets at the scale of thousands of hosts.

      • Previous involvement in an early-stage data center or bare metal infrastructure build-out.

      • Experience managing hybrid infrastructure or migrating workloads between public cloud environments and owned hardware.

      • Familiarity with DCIM/IPAM tools such as NetBox or Nautobot, or provisioning technologies such as Ironic, Metal3, Tinkerbell, or MAAS.

      • Experience developing reconcilers or state machines for physical infrastructure.

      • Hardware expertise covering component diagnostics, burn-in tooling, firmware management, Redfish, or IPMI at fleet scale.

      • Experience building internal platforms or APIs for infrastructure teams.

      • Location near colocation facilities or the ability to visit them regularly.

        • Candidates are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet every listed qualification, as relevant experience and transferable skills are also valued.

        Benefits:

        • Annual compensation range of $230,000–$290,000, depending on experience, transferable skills, location, business needs, and market conditions.

title: 3-D Scanning Technician
description:
SCANNING TECHNICIAN - 3-D

Location: Pasadena Service Center

Work Environment: On-site Monday – Friday

The base pay range for this position is $37-42/hour. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.

The 3-D Scanning Technician will be responsible for the use of the Hexagon 3-D scanner using Geo Magic software to capture 3rd party pumps/equipment and compile data for 3-D modeling as well as verification of correctly produced drawing dimensions and geometry features on scanned components. There will be an emphasis on pumps and rotating equipment in a shop environment. We will look to you to bring a safety-first mindset.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Operate Hexagon 3-D scanning equipment to capture accurate dimensional data from pumps, pump components, and rotating equipment.
  • Utilize GeoMagic software to process point cloud data and create models for reverse engineering and design applications.
  • Inspect and verify component dimensions, tolerances, and geometric features against engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Generate inspection reports and provide dimensional analysis to engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to resolve dimensional issues.
  • Maintain scanning equipment, perform routine calibrations, and ensure accuracy of measurement systems.
  • Organize and manage digital scan data, reports, and documentation.
  • Follow established quality procedures, work instructions, and safety requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to manufacturing processes, product quality, and data collection methods.
  • Assist as Lead Inspector as needed.
  • Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in a manner that interfaces well with customers and company team members.
  • Follow safety procedures to assure a clean and safe work environment is promoted and maintained.
  • Standard working hours are Monday – Friday 6am – 2:30pm
  • This role consists of travel to other sites in North America to include 3 additional sites in US, and 2 sites in Canada. Must have a valid U.S Passport. Main office is in Pasadena, Texas. Approximate travel is 20-30%

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of rotating equipment specific to Centrifugal pumps.
  • Read, write, speak and comprehend English.
  • Production of sketches with dimensional measurement of components using industry standard tooling such as calipers, micrometers, ID micrometers, thread gages, etc. (Inspection experience is a must)
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical information such as Sectional Arrangement drawings, Bills of Materials, General Arrangement drawings, Pump Performance Curves, etc.

The role works cross-functionally with construction, design, and operations teams to ensure alignment between customer requirements and delivery execution across the project lifecycle. The role is project-specific and will be locally-based for the duration of the project, providing on-site delivery leadership, supported by a platform-level Customer Project Delivery Director to ensure governance, escalation management, and consistency across projects.

Project and Program Management

Customer Change Request Management:

Customer Handover and Onboarding

  • Own handover of facility to customer during RFS
  • Drive successful customer onboarding, working with Customer Success Management and Operations teams to enable a smooth transition into BAU operations

Key Performance Index

  • On-time RFS delivery: % of projects delivered on or before committed RFS date
  • Customer satisfaction: Customer satisfaction score (CSAT/NPS) across delivery lifecycle
  • Contract adherence: % compliance to contractual scope with minimal deviations, cost deviations, or disputes

The successful candidate:

Technical and Delivery Capabilities

  • Experience making delivery and commercial decisions and managing trade-offs across schedule, cost, and technical constraints
  • Experience working with hyperscale or large enterprise customers in data centre, cloud, or IT services

Customer and Stakeholder Management

  • Customer-oriented, with a proactive approach to ensuring high-quality delivery and satisfaction
  • Proven ability to navigate multi-stakeholder environments across internal teams, vendors, and customer organisations
  • Able to manage escalations, conflicts, and competing priorities

Tools and Qualifications

Language Proficiency

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
Technical Services Engineer
Job Description

Position Type: Full-Time
Travel Requirement: Regular site travel; based remotely
Job Location: Multistate

About Us
National Electrical Engineering Commissioning (NEEC) provides full-service engineering and field support for utilities and renewable developers across the United States. Our core expertise includes Protection & Control (P&C) Substations, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Solar, and Renewable Energy Integration. NEEC’s commissioning team ensures that every system operates safely, efficiently, and in compliance with the highest industry standards.
About the Role
The Technical Services Engineer is the technical backbone of BESS Technical Services, applying NEEC's technical expertise to each customer's project. The role builds the technical side of RFQs, researches technical questions, and is the escalation point for field engineers and crews: it supports testing and energization, reviews test results, solves technical problems, and helps develop the field leads and technicians who do the work.
Position Details
  • Reports to: Director of BESS Operations.
  • Direct reports: None at hire; may lead engineers on assigned sites.
  • Career level: Engineer track; part of BESS Technical Services.
  • Travel: Regular travel to assigned sites for testing, energization and audits; based remotely.
  • Pay: Competitive, based on experience.
Safety Responsibilities
  • Stop work authority: stop any task you believe is unsafe, and back up anyone who stops work.
  • Follow and enforce NEEC's technical safety requirements for testing and energization, including LOTO, energized-work permits, NFPA 70E approach boundaries, red rope and barricade rules, and battery hazards such as thermal runaway, off-gassing and stranded energy.
  • Do not start energization or startup until readiness, LOTO and protection checks are signed off.
  • Confirm crews on assigned sites have a qualified field lead, at least two people on site, and the training and certifications required for the task.
  • Report incidents and near misses with a technical cause the same day, and support the root-cause review.
Key Responsibilities
  • Field engineering support: Provide day-to-day technical support to field engineers and crews on assigned sites or a region: help plan the test sequence, confirm prerequisites and keep testing on schedule.
  • Apply NEEC standards: Apply NEEC's commissioning standard, procedures and acceptance criteria on every assigned site, and flag gaps to the Director of BESS Operations.
  • Customer and OEM requirements: Review each customer's and OEM's requirements before mobilization; brief crews on what's different and make sure the right forms and test methods are used.
  • Procedures: Draft and update commissioning and test procedures, checklists and forms for approval by the Director of BESS Operations.
  • Test quality: Review test results and turnover packages for assigned sites for accuracy and completeness before submission.
  • Energization and hot commissioning: Lead or support energization, hot commissioning, capacity and performance testing on assigned sites, working with OEM reps and the customer.
  • Troubleshooting and escalation: Act as the technical escalation for field leads on assigned sites; drive root cause and escalate unresolved issues to the Director of BESS Operations.
  • Field lead development: Coach field leads and technicians; assess candidates against the field lead qualification standard and recommend them to the Director of BESS Operations.
  • Training: Deliver technical training (OEM, test equipment, procedures) to crews, and keep crew qualifications current for assigned sites.
  • Test equipment: Confirm crews on assigned sites have the right, calibrated test equipment for each scope.
  • Site audits: Perform site audits for test quality and procedure compliance as assigned; track corrective actions to closure.
  • OEM coordination: Work with OEM field reps on technical issues and gather test evidence needed for warranty claims.
  • Bids and estimating: Support RFQ responses with technical scope, test lists and labor-hour estimates for review by the Director of BESS Operations.
  • Research: Research technical questions, new OEM products, firmware and standards changes; share findings and recommendations with the Director and the field.
  • Other duties: Other technical projects and duties as assigned by the Director of BESS Operations.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline required.

title: Customer Retention Supervisor

title: L3 Network Engineer #IFL
description:
The L3 Network Engineer is responsible for providing advanced technical support, troubleshooting, implementation, and management of enterprise network infrastructure across multiple technologies and vendors. The role will serve as the Level 3 technical escalation point for complex network incidents and will work closely with L1/L2 engineers, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to maintain a stable, secure, and highly available network environment.


Key Responsibilities

L3 Network Support & Troubleshooting

- ProvideL3 technical support for complex network incidents escalated from L1/L2 teams.

-Troubleshoot complex issues across LAN, WAN, Internet, WLAN, VPN, routing, switching, and firewall environments.

- Perform detailed network analysis using logs, packet captures, routing tables and network monitoring tools.

- Lead troubleshooting for major incidents and provide technical support during critical outages.

- Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and identify permanent corrective actions.

- Provide technical guidance and mentoring to L1/L2 network engineers.

Network Infrastructure Management

Provide hands-on support and administration across a multi-vendor network environment, including:

- Cisco –Routers, switches, Catalyst, Nexus and related networking technologies.

- Fortinet– FortiGate firewalls, VPN, security policies and Forti Manager/Forti Analyzer where applicable.

- Palo Alto– Next-generation firewalls, security policies, VPN and related security technologies.

- Juniper –Routers, switches and enterprise networking platforms.

- UniFi –Wireless and LAN infrastructure.

- Cisco Meraki – Switches, wireless access points, security appliances and cloud-managed networking.

Routing & Switching

- Configure and troubleshoot BGP, OSPF, VLAN, STP, VRF, trunking, LACP/EtherChannel and inter-VLAN routing.

-Troubleshoot routing and connectivity issues across LAN, WAN and Internet environments.

- Analyse routing paths and network traffic to identify performance and connectivity issues.

- Support network redundancy, high availability and failover configurations.

Firewall & Network Security

-Configure, troubleshoot and maintain Fortinet and Palo Alto firewalls.

- Support firewall policies, NAT, VPN, routing and security profiles.

-Troubleshoot application connectivity and firewall-related issues.

- Work closely with cybersecurity teams on network security requirements.

- Review and implement firewall changes in accordance with approved change-management processes.

Wireless& SD-WAN

- Support enterprise wireless infrastructure across Cisco, Meraki, UniFi and other wireless platforms.

-Troubleshoot wireless connectivity, authentication, coverage and performance issues.

- Support SD-WAN and Internet connectivity where applicable.

- Monitor network performance and proactively identify potential issues.

Network Projects & Changes

-Participate in network migration, upgrade, refresh and infrastructure improvement projects.

- Perform network device upgrades, configuration changes and technology migrations.

- Prepare implementation and rollback plans.

- Conduct pre-change and post-change validation.

-Coordinate with internal teams, vendors and stakeholders during network implementations.

- Ensure all network changes are properly documented and communicated.

Incident & Problem Management

- Take ownership of complex network incidents through to resolution.

-Participate in Major Incident Management and provide technical updates.

- Perform detailed RCA for critical and recurring incidents.

- Identify opportunities to improve network reliability and reduce recurring incidents.

- Maintain technical knowledge articles and troubleshooting procedures.

Required Technical Skills

Networking

- Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VLAN, STP, QoS, VPN and network security.

- Strong hands-on experience with routing and switching.

- Good knowledge of BGP and OSPF.

- Strong troubleshooting skills using packet captures and network diagnostic tools.

-Experience with network monitoring and management platforms.

Vendor Technologies

Cisco|Routing, switching, Catalyst/Nexus

Fortinet|FortiGate, Firewall, VPN, Security Policies

Palo Alto|NGFW, Security Policies, VPN, NAT

Juniper|Routing, Switching and Troubleshooting

CiscoMeraki| Switching, Wireless, Security Appliance

UniFi|Switching, Wireless and Network Management

Experience across multiple vendors is highly preferred.

Qualification s& Experience

- Diploma or Degree in IT, Computer Science, Networking or a related discipline.

- 5–8+years of network engineering experience, with strong L3 troubleshooting experience.

- Hands-on experience supporting enterprise network environments.

-Experience working in a multi-vendor network environment.

- CCNP, JNCIP, Fortinet, Palo Alto or equivalent certifications are preferred.

- ITIL experience and knowledge of Incident, Problem and Change Management processes.

-Experience supporting regional or global environments is an advantage.

Key Competencies

- Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills.

- Strong ownership and accountability.

- Able to independently troubleshoot complex network issues.

- Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

- Able to work effectively under pressure during major incidents.

- Good documentation and reporting skills.

- Proactive approach to network monitoring and problem prevention.

- Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to L1/L2 engineers.

title: EVP, Alternative Delivery
description:
DESCRIPTION

The Executive Vice President, Alternative Delivery leads Michael Baker International's national alternative delivery business, with a focus on winning and delivering large, complex projects across transportation, water, Federal and defense, aviation, rail and transit and other mission-critical infrastructure markets. You own the practice's business strategy and risk governance, and you serve as the senior executive relationship for the contractors, owners, and agencies that drive these markets nationwide.

Strategy and growth

  • Set the national alternative delivery strategy and annual business plan with the National Practice Leads and Regional Directors, including target markets, contractor partners, and delivery models (design build, progressive design-build, CM/GC, and P3).
  • Own the alternative delivery pipeline, backlog, and win-rate targets and lead strategic positioning and capture planning on major opportunities.
  • Partner with Regional leadership, client service teams, and local offices to build targeted client service action plans.

Client and contractor relationships

  • Develop and maintain trusted-advisor relationships with key contractors, owners, and public officials nationwide.
  • Deploy the firm's technical and delivery resources across offices and practices to serve clients and contractors and strengthen the firm's results.
  • Serve as executive sponsor and escalation point for complex alternative delivery projects in progress, and assign and support the project executives who run delivery.

Pursuit and risk governance

  • Lead Go/No-Go decisions with the National Practice Leads, Regional Directors, and Legal, and set the criteria and approval thresholds.
  • Oversee pursuit teams from capture planning through statements of qualifications, proposals, interviews, and negotiations, and lead the transition from pre-award to post-award contracting.
  • Review and approve alternative delivery contracts, including teaming agreements, design subcontracts, and joint venture agreements with contractor clients.
  • Negotiate risk allocation with Legal, including indemnity, insurance, liquidated damages, and limits of liability, and guide the resolution of disputes and claims.

Delivery and financial performance

  • Be accountable for successful contracting and project execution, working with Michael Baker staff and leadership across the country.
  • Support and monitor key financial KPIs for the alternative delivery practice, including project funding, net revenue, margin, cash, and backlog.
  • Promote a strong safety culture, quality assurance and control, and ethical conduct on every project.

People and culture

  • Lead, develop, and plan succession for the alternative delivery leadership team, including the Regional Practice Leaders.
  • Build bench strength in project executives, design managers, and key personnel with alternative delivery experience.
  • Build collaboration across offices and regions so the best talent is applied to each pursuit.
  • Represent Michael Baker in key alternative delivery industry organizations.

What you bring

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering and/or business from an accredited program.
  • At least 20 years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, executing and managing work in transportation, the Federal market, or other infrastructure markets served by the practice (such as water, aviation, and rail and transit).
  • At least 10 years of business development experience, preferably in alternative delivery markets.
  • Proven track record of leading winning pursuits and delivering complex alternative delivery projects, including projects of [insert construction value threshold] or more.
  • Senior leadership experience, including P&L responsibility for a business unit of comparable scale.
  • Experience negotiating and reviewing alternative delivery contracts, teaming agreements, and risk allocation, and resolving disputes.
  • Proven ability to build client and contractor relationships and develop business, with active involvement in industry organizations.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly to senior leaders, employees, clients, and public officials.

Preferred

  • Licensed Professional Engineer (PE).
  • DBIA Design Build certification.
  • Master's degree in engineering, business administration, or a related field.
  • Contractor-side or project executive experience on heavy civil, P3, or large federal design-build projects.
  • Knowledge of federal and state alternative delivery procurement.
  • Established relationships with major heavy civil contractors and public owners.

COMPENSATION

The approximate base compensation range for this position is $325,000-$425,000. This compensation range is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation is dependent upon factors such as education, qualifications, experience, skillset, and physical work location.

BENEFITS​

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including: ​

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance ​
  • 401 (k) Retirement Plan ​
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) ​
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) ​
  • Life, AD&D, short-term, and long-term disability ​
  • Professional and personal development ​
  • Generous paid time off​
  • Commuter and wellness benefits

description:

At Datacom, we combine technology, expertise, and talented people to help organisations thrive in a rapidly changing world. As one of Australasia's leading technology providers, we work with customers across industries to solve real-world problems and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Whether we're supporting governments, enterprise organisations, or growing businesses, we're committed to creating meaningful outcomes for our customers, communities, and each other.

Datacom is a trusted delivery partner across New Zealand and Australia, delivering cutting-edge solutions that are transforming industries. We’re looking for an experienced Programme Manager to drive these high-impact initiatives.

In this role, you’ll lead complex programmes from inception through to delivery, ensuring customer outcomes meet the highest standards of quality, value, and performance. You may work alone on a project or be part of a larger delivery team. Regardless, you’ll own managing scope, timelines, budgets, and stakeholder expectations to deliver exceptional results.

Our customers rightly expect us to be a leader in the AI field, so your knowledge around using AI to deliver technology projects is valued. This is a pivotal role at an exciting time for Datacom, offering the opportunity to shape the future of AI delivery across the region.

What You’ll Do:

As a Programme Manager, you will be required to:

  • Deliver exceptional outcomes and value for our customers.
  • Oversee the project governance & delivery, establishing and managing effective project operations, ensuring quality deliveries across complex, multi-platform IT environments.
  • Lead project design, planning, and scheduling activities for applications and infrastructure projects, maintaining alignment with agreed timelines and customer requirements.
  • Define, source, and manage project resources; prepare and monitor budgets, secure approvals, and track financial performance and benefit realization.
  • Identify and control project risks, issues, dependencies, and scope changes; manage change plans and assess business impacts.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships, exceed expectations through effective communication, and manage vendor contracts and agreements.
  • Oversee the business continuity planning within the functional area, including development, review, testing, and training; ensure health and safety compliance in line with company policy.
  • Manage project teams, provide guidance within company policies, and oversee phases of software development from requirements analysis to implementation.

Due to the dynamic nature of the IT industry and the diverse challenges involved in delivering competitive products and services to our clients, it’s important to gain experience across different areas of the business where possible. As a result, you may be required to take on a variety of roles within Datacom to meet business needs and broaden your understanding.

What You’ll Bring:

We are seeking a resilient and adaptable team player to manage multiple mid to large-sized projects, who can bring a dynamic element to our existing professional project management capability.

You will have:

  • Experience managing programmes in a customer environment. Any understanding of regulatory, compliance, and risk frameworks is advantageous.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and tailor messaging for executives, technical teams, and business leaders.
  • Strong financial governance capabilities, including managing programme budgets, tracking benefits realisation, and understanding cost, utilisation, and revenue impacts.
  • Familiarity with multiple delivery frameworks such as Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid approaches, and the ability to apply them effectively at programme level.

Culture and benefits

Join a team where you'll be supported to grow your career, prioritise your wellbeing, and make a genuine impact. From industry-leading learning and development opportunities to parental leave, wellbeing support, and employee benefits, we're committed to helping our people thrive both professionally and personally.

We're passionate about creating a workplace where people feel supported, empowered, and inspired to do their best work. Whether you're developing new skills, tackling complex challenges, or collaborating with some of the best minds in the industry, you'll be part of a team that values curiosity, innovation, inclusion, and making a genuine difference.

  • Access to industry-leading learning platforms and future skills training
  • Recognition programmes that celebrate great work

title: Data Scientist 2
description:
Requisition ID: 2313

Standard Weekly Hours: 40.00

Location: ULA - Denver

Relocation: Yes- Relocation may be available

Travel Requirements: 10%

At ULA, success comes through the efforts of a strong, united team.

Thanks for your interest in United Launch Alliance, the world's most experienced and reliable space launch company! Successfully launching more than 155 consecutive missions with 100% mission success doesn't happen by accident. It's a testament to the commitment and dedication of our team of rocket scientists and support employees combined with the systems and processes we use to pull them together. As a ULA employee, you'll have the opportunity to grow in your career while working in a team-oriented culture that combines technology, innovation, ingenuity and a commitment to the extraordinary. Whether you are in college just launching your career, or, have experience and want to come work with the best rocket team in the world, our unshakable unity yields stronger solutions and better results as we carry out our mission to save lives, explore the universe, and connect the world. Our team is excited to meet you!

Job Overview & Responsibilities

Qualified candidate will be responsible for providing enterprise level support in the field of Data Analytics/Data Science enrolling through the Systems Engineering organization. This individual will primarily:

  • Interpret data and analyze results using statistical techniques and provide reports, presentations and technical documents as required.
  • Design, analyze, build, test, evaluate, and implement models from diverse datasets to solve problems throughout the company.
  • Develop visualizations to describe data sets under investigation and/or modeling results.
  • Communicate results in clear verbal, reports, or presentation format to engineers, leadership, and other technical/non-technical stakeholders.
  • Work closely with individuals across the enterprise to develop the appropriate tools and methods needed for the various analyses.

This position will have a key role in ensuring continuous improvement of the same tools and processes used to execute their function. Candidate should expect to participate in multidiscipline project teams to evaluate customer/operational needs and to develop new and unique solutions to help support decision making across all engineering, manufacturing, launch operations, and business disciplines. Responsible for identifying and applying appropriate scaling of data science activities corresponding with the specific project needs.

Demonstrated experience in data analytics activities in an aerospace environment is desired. Qualified candidate is preferred to have experience with multi-disciplinary teams to resolve technical and programmatic issues using current and advanced state-of-the-art statistical and/or data science techniques. This position requires excellent written and oral communication proficiency in conjunction with organization skills necessary to maintain focus and achieve consensus within diverse multi-disciplined teams. The candidate may have demonstrated technical knowledge in areas that support launch vehicle and/or satellite vehicle designs, analysis, production and operations. The successful candidate will be a self-starter able to work autonomously, learn and execute processes, and perform in a collaborative environment.

Required Education

Bachelor

Required Years of Experience

Minimum of 2 years of related work experience

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Data Science or Analytics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of experience with emphasis in Data Analytics/Data Science.
  • Technical expertise regarding data models, data mining, data extraction and wrangling techniques.
  • Strong knowledge of and experience using statistical/analytical packages for analyzing small and big data (i.e. Python, R, and/or MATLAB) and leveraging them to impart business insights.
  • Experience in applying machine learning and/or artificial intelligence to business or engineering applications.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Adept at queries, report writing and presentation of findings.
  • Ability to operate independently and work as part of a team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Engineering, Data Science or Analytics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Experience working in Aerospace Industry with existing and evolving launch systems or satellite systems.
  • Knowledgeable in the fields of both engineering as well as statistics and data science.
  • Organization skills necessary to maintain focus and achieve consensus within diverse multi-disciplined teams.
  • Experience in cloud-based analysis/modeling such as AWS, Azure, GCS, etc.
  • Basic understanding of launch vehicles.
  • Self-motivated with demonstrated initiative, teamwork, and leadership skills on previous technical projects.

Please note that the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon a candidate's experience and qualifications, as well as internal equity, market and business considerations. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus in addition to base pay.

What makes ULA different?

Because we understand launch success comes through the collective efforts of a team, we seek the best to join us. We value ethics, ingenuity, engagement and professional development for employees at all levels.

We offer our employees competitive pay and benefits including:

title: Medewerker onthaal & patiëntenadministratie
description:
1 - Werken bij de VUB

VUB is steeds op zoek naar nieuw talent om samen mee te groeien.

De Vrije Universiteit Brussel staat al meer dan 50 jaar voor vrijheid, gelijk(waardig)heid en verbondenheid en dat leeft sterk op onze campussen bij zowel studenten als personeel. Bij de VUB vind je een diverse verzameling aan persoonlijkheden: innovators pur sang, maar vooral mensen die 100% hun authentieke zelf zijn. Met zo’n 4000 medewerkers zijn we de grootste Nederlandstalige werkgever, in de privésector, in Brussel; een internationale stad waarmee we ons maar al te graag verbinden en waar(rond) onze 4 campussen gelegen zijn.

De VUB is bovendien lid van EUTOPIA, een alliantie van 10 gelijkgestemde Europese universiteiten, alle tien klaar om zichzelf opnieuw uit te vinden.

2 - Functiebeschrijving

Voor ons Universitair Tandheelkundig Centrum zijn we op zoek naar een medewerker Onthaal & patiëntenadministratie. In deze functie ben je een centraal aanspreekpunt voor patiënten, tandartsen en assistenten. Je combineert patiëntencontact met telefonie, planning en administratieve opvolging.

In deze functie is het belangrijk dat je vlot schakelt tussen verschillende taken, prioriteiten kan stellen en ook tijdens drukke momenten vriendelijk, nauwkeurig en efficiënt blijft werken.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?

Onthaal en communicatie

  • Je ontvangt en registreert patiënten en helpt hen op een vriendelijke en professionele manier verder.
  • Je beantwoordt telefoons en e-mails vlot en correct in het Nederlands en Frans.
  • Je zorgt voor heldere en professionele mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatie.
  • Je gaat rustig en assertief om met vragen, klachten en moeilijke situaties.

Planning en administratie

  • Je plant, wijzigt en annuleert afspraken en volgt de agenda’s van tandartsen en behandelaars nauwkeurig op.
  • Je verwerkt en actualiseert patiëntgegevens, dossiers, documenten en attesten.
  • Je beheert mailboxen, lijsten, rapporteringen en opvolgingsdocumenten.
  • Je bewaakt openstaande acties en zorgt voor een correcte en tijdige opvolging.

Efficiënte werking en samenwerking

  • Je schakelt vlot tussen onthaal, telefonie, planning, mailbox en administratie en stelt daarbij de juiste prioriteiten.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s, tandartsen, assistenten en studenten.
  • Je signaleert knelpunten of fouten en denkt actief mee over praktische oplossingen.
  • Je neemt initiatief en draagt bij aan een efficiënte en kwaliteitsvolle werking van het onthaal en de backoffice.

Voor deze functie zal Brussels Health Campus (Jette) je thuisbasis worden.

3 - Profiel

Wat verwachten wij van jou?

  • Je beschikt minstens over een diploma hoger secundair onderwijs
  • Ervaring binnen medisch secretariaat, tandartsassistentie, mondhygiëne is een sterke meerwaarde
  • Je spreekt en schrijft zeer vlot Nederlands en Frans. Kennis van het Engels is een pluspunt.
  • Je communiceert vriendelijk, duidelijk en professioneel, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Je bent administratief sterk en werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd.Je kan snel schakelen tussen verschillende taken en vragen, zonder de opvolging uit het oog te verliezen.
  • Je kan prioriteiten stellen en blijft efficiënt werken wanneer verschillende zaken tegelijk je aandacht vragen.
  • Je bent klant- en patiëntgericht, discreet en betrouwbaar.
  • Je bent zelfstandig en neemt verantwoordelijkheid, maar bent tegelijk een echte teamspeler die vlot samenwerkt met collega’s en zorgverleners.
  • Je bent proactief en oplossingsgericht en wacht niet af wanneer je zelf actie kan ondernemen.J
  • .e beschikt over een goede kennis van Microsoft Office, waaronder Outlook, Word en Excel, en maakt nieuwe digitale toepassingen snel eigen.

VUB wil een weerspiegeling zijn van de maatschappij waar ieders talent wordt gewaardeerd, ongeacht het gender, geslacht, leeftijd, religie, huidskleur, migratieachtergrond, functiebeperking en de neurodiversiteit.

4 - Aanbod

Word jij onze nieuwe collega?

Dan bieden we je een voltijds - dee contract van bepaalde duur (1 jaar) aan met een bruto maandsalaris gekoppeld aan graad 3 of 4.

Het salaris is afhankelijk van je competenties en het aantal jaren relevante werkervaring.

Bij de VUB garanderen we een open, betrokken en diverse werkplek en geven we je kansen om je loopbaan (verder) uit te bouwen. Daarnaast geniet je van voordelen als:

  • Een open informele werkomgeving met aandacht voor je work-life balance, een uitzonderlijke verlofregeling met 35 verlofdagen, sluiting tussen Kerstmis en Nieuwjaar en 3 extra verlofdagen;
  • Een kosteloze hospitalisatie- en zeer mooie groepsverzekering met gewaarborgd inkomen;
  • Maximale terugbetaling woon-werkverkeer met het openbaar vervoer en/of een fietsvergoeding;
  • Gevarieerde maaltijden in onze campusrestaurants aan een aantrekkelijk tarief;
  • Voordelige sportmogelijkheden, een gamma aan kortingen via Benefits@Work (in allerlei winkels, op vluchten, in tankstations, pretparken...) en Ecocheques;
  • Kinderdagverblijf vlak bij de campus, korting op vakantiekampen;
  • De ruimte om je job-inhoud mee te vormen en voortdurend bij te leren via onze VUB-leerplatformen en opleidingen;
  • En tot slot: toffe collega's met een gezonde drive en een goed gevoel voor humor.

5 - Geïnteresseerd?

Spreekt deze job je aan?


Stel je dan kandidaat vóór 12/11/2026 via en laad volgende documenten op: cv, motivatiebrief en diploma.

Ons sollicitatieproces ziet er als volgt uit:

Stap 1: CV-screening door een van onze recruiters

Stap 2: Een vergelijkende proef op onze campus in Jette in de 2de helft van november.

Contacteer ons!

Vragen over de job zelf?

Contacteer Suzy Makengo via Suzy.Makengo@vub.be.

Vragen over de selectieprocedure en/of het aanbod?

Contacteer Natasja.Amys@vub.be of 0470/49.38.60.

Wil je graag weten hoe het is om te werken bij de VUB en wil je meer info over EUTOPIA?

Ga dan naar en ontdek alles over o.a. onze campussen, voordelen, strategische doelen en collega’s.

Lees ook verder over als je meer wil weten over ons Europees netwerk van universiteiten.

6 - Kenmerken

We are the UK's aviation and aerospace regulator and recognised as a world leader in its field. Our activities are diverse, enabling the aviation industry to meet the highest safety standards, and we pride ourselves on our ability to adapt to the constantly evolving aviation environment.

The Role

The Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) is the UK's specialist aviation regulator. Its regulatory activities range from making sure that the aviation industry meets the highest technical and operational safety standards to preventing holidaymakers from being stranded abroad or losing money because of tour operator insolvency.

The CAA’s Portfolio comprises a diverse and interesting group of programmes and projects. This includes a large Transformation Programme and other projects and programmes to help us deliver our five-year strategic plan to make aviation better for those who choose to fly - and those who do not. The Transformation Programme will change the way we operate our licensing services, improving efficiency and effectiveness, as well as refreshing key IT systems and supporting our aspirations to become a better regulator and improve choice and value for consumers. The programme includes significant changes to the way we manage information, capture and make use of data, and engage with stakeholders, including online. Examples of projects within the Portfolio include those which relate to airspace and technologies such as space, cyber and drones.

As an organisation that delivers services to our customers, CAA has adopted the core principles of the Government Digital Service that ensures we have a customer-centric approach to all that we do, formalised though our Service Standard and the use of User Research and Service Design activities to complement our core business analysis activities.

To be effective, the post-holder will have the ability to work independently, proactively and with versatility in responding to changing circumstances. The post-holder will need to be able to work at a detailed level, ensuring that business needs are sufficient to enable options to be defined, designed and implemented. The post-holder will maintain a strategic view to ensure that business needs meet the latest CAA Business and Technology strategies. The role requires excellent communication skills and the ability to provide challenge where requirements are inconsistent or do not represent value for money.

Core Accountabilities

  • With support as necessary, lead activity to scope and scale change, leading to the development of business cases that articulate the problem(s), outline solutions, resources, costs and benefits.
  • Using appropriate tools and approaches, accurately analyse and document business requirements in an appropriate format that will clearly define their type (including, for example, functional or non-functional, User Stories and Acceptance criteria), according to defined standards.
  • Baseline current-state processes and design potential future-state processes using the appropriate Business Process Modeling methods and tools to CAA standards. Ensure that legislation, policy and written guidance are clearly identified.
  • Perform and facilitate analysis of business processes to establish gaps in processes and identify and link appropriate Business requirements.
  • Through engagement with business subject matter experts and supplier technical resources, ensure that all proposed process and technology changes are fully articulated and understood by all parties.
  • Provide effective and appropriate guidance / training to functional process teams and the wider business.
  • Work with the Business as necessary to identify options and supporting recommendations (incorporating both process and IT change) to meet the business requirements.
  • Review / assure detailed functional and technical specifications to ensure that business requirements have been effectively translated.
  • Ensure that proposed solutions align with strategic business objectives and identify synergies across differing change initiatives.
  • Support the business change team in accurately identifying relevant stakeholders and their current interest in the project.
  • Support the business change team by effectively monitoring and managing communications between stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle, identifying changes and notifying them appropriately.
  • Work closely with Product Managers and project colleagues, ensuring that their perspectives are understood and work planned accordingly.
  • Act as an ambassador for the Portfolio Delivery Business Analysis practice.

About You

Essential:

  • Have operated as a business analyst in a variety of organisations.
  • Have been fully responsible for the completion of business analysis services on at least 2 projects that were completed successfully.
  • Have a detailed understanding of the BA role in a range of methods, including Agile and Waterfall.
  • Experienced in delivering large-scale and enterprise-wide COTS and bespoke solutions.
  • Be experienced in working with the Business and IT Department to identify the most appropriate solution given the Business objectives, priorities, and other project / programme dependencies.
  • Have excellent people skills with the ability to communicate with staff and management.
  • Can engage and work with relevant technical teams to understand the solution and adherence to requirements.
  • Hold strong stakeholder skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical staff within the business.
  • Can resolve issues with suppliers and members of the business community.
  • Have a high logic capability allied to a very good problem-solving ability.
  • Ensure a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail in defining Requirements.
  • Experienced in working through the end-to-end project lifecycle.
  • Hold an enterprise view of the organisation and can identify synergies across change initiatives.

Desirable:

  • Have operated in a business or IT consultancy environment.

title: Energy Innovation Program Consultant
description:
Our present and future success depends on the creative and dedicated people of our company who demonstrate the principles outlined in the APS Promise: Design for Tomorrow, Empower Each Other and Succeed Together.

Summary

The Energy Innovation Program Consultant is responsible for developing and managing the programmatic aspects of key Energy Innovation and Technology initiatives and projects, both customer- and utility-focused. The role supports successful program delivery through budget oversight and reporting, project work plan implementation, key success indicator tracking and reporting, internal communication plans, training preparation and coordination, advanced technical assessments, and trend analysis. This position develops and maintains technical expertise and may serve as a lead on major projects and programs, coordinating across multiple business units to extract the highest value.
What Your Day Would Be Like
  • Responsible for the overall management, performance, and continuous improvement of the Flex Solutions program, a customer-focused demand response and load flexibility program. Leads day-to-day program management and operations, including customer participation, vendor coordination, financial oversight, performance measurement, stakeholder coordination, and implementation of program processes to achieve customer, operational, and organizational objectives.
  • Monitors program performance and customer experience, identifies opportunities to refine processes and improve participation and operational value, and implements enhancements that strengthen the program and its contribution to broader demand-side management and load flexibility objectives.
  • Provides program expertise and recommendations to management, supports regulatory and business planning activities, manages program risks and issues, and coordinates with internal business units, customers, technology and service providers, and other stakeholders to ensure effective program delivery.
Who We’re Looking For
  • Someone who can develop and maintain technical expertise related to Energy Innovation and Technology initiatives.
  • Experience managing program and project activities, including budgets, work plans, reporting, and success indicators.
  • Ability to conduct advanced technical assessments and trend analysis.
  • Strong ability to coordinate activities across multiple business units and manage major projects and programs.
  • Ability to develop effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to report program status and provide management with advice on issues and opportunities.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelors' degree in Engineering, Science, Information Technology or related field and 8 years of prior relevant experience in the power and natural gas sectors with an understanding of regulatory, technical and business issues impacting the industry including renewables, distributed energy and grid technologies.
  • In lieu of Bachelor's degree, High School/GED plus 12 years directly related experience in the power and natural gas sectors with an understanding of regulatory, technical and business issues impacting the industry including renewables, distributed energy and grid technologies.
  • Detailed knowledge and understanding of one or more emerging energy technologies and related business models, such as solar, energy storage, electric vehicles, energy management software platforms etc.
Preferred Special Skills, Knowledge or Qualifications:
  • Masters' degree in Engineering, Science, Finance or Business.
  • Working knowledge of R&D, Innovation, creation of pilot programs and measurement, and strategic thinking.
  • Ability to facilitate, document and align technical business requirements and functional specifications to support successful selection of technology vendors and execution of Point of Concept (POC) and technology programs of Moderate to High complexity.
  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to research initiatives and stay current with industry trends and developments.
  • Experience building complete and complex business cases using research and analysis. Able to present the case to leadership up to a vice president level.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills and ability to convey complex/technical content in a coherent and compelling story for audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge and exert influence.
  • Ability to establish relationships with multiple technology teams and provide subject-matter expertise and advice relevant to specific business needs.


Major Accountabilities

1) Research and identify emerging and innovative technology solutions to support key customer and utility-focused business initiatives. Develop and manage the programmatic aspects for related programs.

2) Develop and evaluate Point of Concept (POC) test plans and use cases to ensure full integration into program platform. Review and oversee execution of technical requirements as documented throughout the project.

3) In collaboration with lead project managers, develop and implement project work plans and secure buyoff and approval from cooperating departments. Regularly revise work plans to reflect current conditions and update as appropriate.

4) Provide oversight and direction to the teams performing research and analysis related to emerging technologies and impact to business.

5) Monitor and manage project budgets to maximize the benefit to ratepayers and the corporation by assuring projects are come in at or under budget. Provide input and support into internal reporting and communications on budget and progress related aspects.

6) Effectively interface and resolve project issues with departmental staff, other departments, executive management, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders to meet project requirements.

7) Maintain current knowledge of trends (technical, market, regulatory and political) and utilize this knowledge in order to maximize corporate benefits and minimize negative impacts.

8) Develop and maintain relationships with key local and state Energy Innovation stakeholders.

9) Participate as Company representative and technology expert in various forums, committees and working groups dealing with various Energy Innovation technical, policy and regulatory issues. Provide updates on industry and technology trends.


Key Level Differentiators:

  • Works under minimal supervision
  • Works to achieve operational targets with significant impact on departmental results
  • Analyzes and resolves complex technical problems using experience, judgment and range of material/tools; may take a new perspective on existing solution
  • Responsible for making improvements of processes, systems or products to enhance performance of the technical area

title: Group Functions Finance BP
description:
About Hytech



Hytech is a leading management consulting firm headquartered in Australia and Singapore, specialising in digital transformation for fintech and financial services organisations. We deliver end-to-end consulting services and provide robust middle- and back-office solutions that enable our clients to optimise operations, enhance efficiency, and stay ahead in a fast-evolving digital landscape.



With more than 2,000 professionals worldwide, Hytech has a strong and growing international presence, with offices across Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan, the Philippines, Thailand, Morocco, Cyprus, Dubai, and beyond.



About the Role



We are hiring Finance Partners for our Group Functions Finance Partnering team within Group FP&A. Our group functions — including Risk, Operations, Payments, Compliance, Finance and HR & Admin — comprise more than 1,500 people across Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan, China and the Philippines, providing professional services to the Group's brands and forming one of the most significant parts of the Group's cost base. Each Functions FBP owns a portfolio of one to two functions, working directly with the function heads (all based in Singapore) as their primary finance counterpart on budget, headcount, cost and productivity.



The heart of this role is answering three questions: what services your functions provide to the brands and what their cost structure is; how investment should evolve as business volumes and regulatory requirements change; and by what rules next year's headcount and budget should be allocated. You will need to genuinely understand how your functions work and where their workload comes from, and build a trusted day-to-day partnership with their leaders.



Note: this role requires genuine business-partnering experience and the ability to independently face senior function heads. Pure consolidation or accounting backgrounds are not a fit.



Key Responsibilities:



• Own the annual budget, rolling forecasts and long-range planning for your assigned functions; track actuals vs budget and explain variances and risks to function heads and Group management.

• Partner on headcount planning by team and by country, including the cost impact of location mix, hiring plans and organisational changes; build scenario models for volume growth, headcount and re-organisation decisions.

• Develop a deep understanding of each function's structure: each team's functional scope, internal customers and cost composition, maintained as a team-level cost and headcount view.

• Work with function leadership to establish how workload and output are measured (volume-driven service metrics, service levels), and connect these measures to financial data for headcount and resource decisions.

• Identify efficiency topics in how each function is structured and invested — workload-to-headcount alignment, location strategy, automation and process improvement — form hypotheses, validate them with data, and drive change with function leaders.

• Understand and maintain the logic by which function costs are allocated to brands, and clearly explain to brand stakeholders what is allocated to them and why; support the evolution of the Group's allocation and service-pricing framework.

• Lead the monthly cost review for your functions; build and continuously improve function KPIs and management dashboards; support the roll-out of the Group's expense-control processes and drive corrective actions on variances.



Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or related discipline.

• 5+ years in FP&A / Finance Business Partnering / Business Finance; direct experience supporting operations, risk, payments, compliance or other functional / shared-services organisations preferred.

• Background in financial services, FinTech, internet platforms or large multinational shared-service environments strongly preferred.

• Sound understanding of the cost structure and workload drivers of service organisations, with the ability to connect volumes and service levels to headcount and cost.

• Strong financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and scenario planning skills.

• Plus: working SQL / Power BI skills; experience with cost allocation, shared-services pricing or intercompany charging.

title: FTZ Client Import Analyst
description:
Client Import Analyst

Join Livingston and grow your career in the constantly changing world of international trade. Livingston is a market leader offering customs brokerage, international trade consulting, compliance and freight forwarding services around the world. Livingston has over 3,000 employees at more than 90 key border crossings, sea ports, airports and other strategic locations in North America, Europe and Asia.

Our fast-paced and collaborative environment offers you the opportunity to work with leaders in the industry, receive recognition for achievements and develop your expertise in the complex and evolving world of trade. Learn how you can make an impact at Livingston.

JOB SUMMARY

This position reports to the Manager, Service Delivery and acts as the primary support and day to day client contact for the client service teams/operations to ensure quality standards are met and the integrity of the client records/system defaults are maintained and compliant; facilitate release and entry summary completion; accountable for a range of client and customs process management and compliance activities including release support, tariff database management, classifications, client instructions/requirements maintenance and auditing service delivery activities to ensure client service delivery satisfaction. This position assists in ensuring that all entries are classified and billed accurately and within LII service standards to ensure their clients' complete satisfaction.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain excellent, direct working relationship with the client and/or carriers, provides day to day contact and support.
  • Prioritize and complete work according to client's needs, demands, customs requirements and Livingston standards for release conditions and ensure compliance.
  • Create and proactively maintain the client tariff database, ensuring all associated system maintenance files/information, associated vendors and keywords are accurate and current in order to take advantage of data defaults for accurate quality output and one-step processing. Update information as necessary.
  • Verify documentation for release conditions, compliance and rating compliance (e.g., free trade certificates).
  • Create, maintain and adhere to client Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Exceptions to Standard Procedures (ESPs).
  • Identify opportunities to improve service delivery, operational productivity and relationships within North American Brokerage operations.
  • Ensure accurate and timely release and rating of shipments on all modes of transportation for their assigned client base, including auditing work completed by Release Pool or the NSC in Air/Sea locations.
  • Provide support, guidance and mentoring to Release Operations members to ensure accurate release and rating activities are completed to achieve service levels (non-Air/Sea locations only).
  • Escalate items for additional resolutions or return entries to release team members and recommend corrective actions.
  • Create customs entries in appropriate system through proper vendor and keyword selection and interpretation of Customs document for both high and low value shipments. Key in shipment information for EDI release, rating and billing, ensuring that all mandatory fields are completed and accurate.
  • In a professional manner, work directly with and contact clients/carriers to obtain missing documentation, information and/or instructions.
  • Works directly with Customs and PGA's as necessary.
  • Conduct periodic checks to ensure accurate application of tariff and valuation along with proper selection of client/importer information.
  • Responsible to conduct documented internal audit.
  • Assist MSD in compiling and reporting performance measurement statistics for the Client Service Team.
  • Participate fully with other team members in the day-to-day operations of the team, including setting priorities, organizing and scheduling work, coordinating with others, problem-solving and decision-making, participating in meetings and handling special projects.
  • Proactively coordinate and implement electronic data relationships to gain efficiencies and improve one-step processing.
  • Keep abreast of new systems developments.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned by management.
  • Adhere to established policies and procedures.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Excellent oral and written communication and organizational skills.
  • Client Service oriented -- interpersonal skills with internal/external clients and coworkers.
  • Ability to handle large volumes and meet tight deadlines.
  • Strong knowledge of company policies and procedures.
  • Attention to detail; organization, completeness and accuracy.
  • Good analytical skills with problem-solving ability.
  • Ability to make decisions and recommendations within authorized limitations.
  • Excellent time management skills.
  • Ability to present a professional image.
  • Knowledge of Word and Excel software.
  • Office equipment/machinery used: Personal computer and common business machines/software

WORK EXPERIENCE – MINIMUM REQUIRED

3 years of related experience

EDUCATION

Required: High School/GED or equivalent
Preferred: Associates Degree or post-secondary education

CERTIFICATIONS DESCRIPTION

Working towards/or successful completion of the Certified Customs Specialists (CCS) designation with the Canadian Society of Customs Brokers (CSCB) or the National Customs Brokers & Forwarders Association of America (NCBFAA) is a requirement, if not already obtained.

Successful completion of the CCS examination is a mandatory requirement for further advancement.

COMPETENCIES

Business Acumen and Straight Talk
Agility
Customer First Focus
Accountability
Leading and Developing
Inclusion and Collaboration

At Livingston, we are committed to fostering a flexible, growth-oriented environment where you can thrive. Our culture is built on respect, recognition, and collaboration, and we empower our team with trusted expertise, continuous learning opportunities, and long-term support. title: Principal Backend Engineer (Applied AI)
description:
About the Company

Our client is a venture-backed applied AI company rebuilding a $500 billion industry that has never had a real software platform underneath it: civil, structural and MEP engineering. Instead of selling software to engineering firms, they acquire them, keep their people and their names, and install their own technology and engineers inside. They are backed by a top-tier venture firm with significant capital set aside for acquisitions with this being highest-priority engineering hire in the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on Principal engineer seat: you’ll design and build the backend services and product features that bring AI into how engineering firms actually work. That means taking messy, real-world inputs like drawings, specifications, calculations and correspondence, and turning them into reliable production systems built on LLMs and agentic workflows. You’ll own systems from design through production, set the architecture the rest of the team builds on, and work directly with the CTO on technical direction. This is an individual contributor role for someone who still writes code every week.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build and own backend services and APIs, from new product features to core platform services
  • Build production systems that use LLMs, agents and RAG to parse documents, automate workflows and act on unstructured data
  • Design agentic workflows that are reliable in production: evaluation, guardrails, retries, failure handling and human review
  • Lead the architecture of event-driven and asynchronous systems, including queues, background processing and integrations with legacy software
  • Shape multi-tenant architecture so each new firm is faster to onboard than the last
  • Own reliability for what you ship, including observability, incident response and performance
  • Use AI coding tools like Claude every day to move faster, and help set how the team uses them
  • Partner with the CTO and forward deployed engineers on long-term architecture and engineering standards

What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years building backend or distributed systems in production
  • Proven ownership of services with real uptime, latency and scale requirements, with clear stories about what you built, the tradeoffs and what broke
  • Experience designing and evolving APIs, services and event-driven systems
  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered or agentic features to real users, not just prototypes
  • Strong in at least one backend language. Kotlin and Python are used today, but architecture judgment matters more than stack.
  • Experience at a venture-backed startup or a company with a comparably high technical bar
  • Comfort with ambiguity, strong communication, and opinions you’ll change when you hear a better argument

Nice to Have

  • Founding or early engineer experience
  • Document processing, OCR or integrations with entrenched enterprise software
  • Infrastructure ownership on AWS with infrastructure as code
  • Background in civil, structural or MEP engineering, construction tech or CAD/BIM

This Role Is Not a Fit If

  • Your AI experience is mostly research, model training or prompt engineering, without production backend depth
  • Your recent work is mainly DevOps, SRE or cloud operations
  • You’ve moved into management or architecture and no longer write code
  • You need a remote or hybrid role

Compensation and Logistics

  • $200,000 to $300,000 base, depending on experience
  • Founding-stage equity with dilution protection through the Series A
  • Relocation support and full healthcare
  • Title is flexible across Senior, Staff, Principal or Founding Engineer
  • On-site in New York City five days a week, with light, flexible travel to acquired firms

Why This Role Matters

You’ll be the CTO’s right hand, building the platform that an entire industry’s transformation runs on, at the stage where your decisions become the foundation.
