title: Customer Retention Supervisor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Retention Supervisor based in Luxembourg.

Are you an experienced customer retention leader passionate about building high-performing teams and driving measurable business growth? This opportunity allows you to lead and develop a team of retention specialists within the fast-growing fintech and cryptocurrency industry. You will take ownership of customer reactivation, repeat transactions, and revenue recovery while remaining actively involved in outbound customer engagement. Combining hands-on leadership with strategic campaign management, you will develop effective retention processes, coach team members, and continuously improve customer conversion rates. Working in a dynamic, performance-driven environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen customer relationships and maximise business results. This is an ideal role for a proactive leader who enjoys mentoring people, analysing performance, and turning customer engagement strategies into tangible revenue.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead, supervise, and motivate a team of Customer Retention Specialists, establishing clear performance objectives, responsibilities, and accountability standards.
  • Conduct outbound customer calls personally to encourage repeat transactions, reconnect with inactive customers, and demonstrate effective retention techniques by example.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), calling workflows, scripts, and training materials to strengthen team performance.
  • Organise daily outreach activities, manage agent schedules, and allocate campaign assignments to ensure efficient customer engagement.
  • Design and execute customer retention campaigns, including promotional offers, discount incentives, abandoned transaction follow-ups, and reactivation initiatives.
  • Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), including call volumes, conversion rates, repeat transactions, customer reactivation rates, and revenue recovered.
  • Conduct regular call evaluations, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen agents' communication and sales skills.
  • Analyse customer behaviour, transaction activity, and campaign performance to identify retention opportunities and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Maintain accurate customer relationship management (CRM) records, agent scorecards, performance dashboards, and regular operational reports.
  • Manage escalated customer concerns and collaborate with Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effective issue resolution.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and training initiatives to build and maintain a capable, results-oriented retention team.
  • Use relevant digital and AI-powered tools to improve research, script development, workflow efficiency, and overall team productivity.

Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in customer retention, outbound sales, contact centre operations, or a similar customer-facing environment.
  • Demonstrated success in customer conversion, retention, and reactivation, with experience managing performance-driven teams and achieving measurable commercial results.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate teams, manage performance, and encourage continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, particularly when engaging customers over the phone.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable improvement plans.
  • Ability to balance direct customer engagement with team supervision and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards.
  • Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage.
  • Basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies, combined with a genuine interest in financial technology, is considered a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Additional financial rewards directly linked to individual achievements and overall team performance.
  • Paid Annual Leave: 10 days of paid vacation per year.
  • Public Holidays: Paid time off on all U.S. federal holidays.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere in Anywhere, provided you have a professional home-working setup.
  • Leadership and Career Development: Opportunity to lead, develop, and shape a customer retention team while strengthening your management expertise.
  • High-Growth Industry Exposure: Work within the rapidly evolving global fintech and cryptocurrency sector.
  • Direct Business Impact: Take ownership of retention initiatives that directly contribute to customer engagement, recovered revenue, and business growth.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive, high-trust working environment that values initiative, accountability, and professional development.
  • AI-Enabled Work Environment: Opportunities to leverage modern AI tools to improve workflows, customer engagement, and operational efficiency.

title: Hydromet EW Operator Trainee
description:
At Freeport-McMoRan, we are committed to providing an employment package that recognizes excellence, encourages safe production and a culture supported by our core values. Here, you’ll find a collaborative environment where safety is a top priority, all opinions are valued, and people are empowered to grow in their career. Apply Today!

Where You Will Work

Chino is an open-pit copper mining complex located 15 miles from the historic mining community of Silver City in southwestern New Mexico. The historic Chino mine was among the world's first low-grade, open-pit copper mines. Today, the operation consists of a 36,000-metric-ton-per-day concentrator that produces copper and a 150-million-pound-per-year solvent extraction/electrowinning plant that produces copper cathode from solution generated by run-of-mine leaching.

The community of Silver City boasts various restaurants, arts, entertainment, cliff dwellings, festivals and much more. Residents and visitors enjoy gentle four seasons, with three hundred days of sunshine a year and low humidity. From unique shopping finds in the galleries to everyday groceries, schools and housing, there are numerous amenities for everyone. Visit Silver City to learn more.

What You Will Do

  • Safely performs duties related to the electro-winning process and maintenance of electrolytic cells.
  • May assist with and perform cell maintenance such as, draining cells, inspecting for damage, fixing leaks, hydro-blasting, cleaning, repairing/replacing level boxes, and replacing buffer sheets and boards
  • May assist with and perform
    • Harvesting of copper cathodes
    • Blank maintenance
    • Cathode pressing
    • Shipping of copper cathodes
  • May assist with and perform various tasks such as cutting cathode samples, washing down cell lines, and scrap processing
  • May operate mobile equipment such as overhead cranes and forklifts
  • May assist maintenance personnel in performing routine and non-routine equipment maintenance activities
  • Perform area housekeeping
  • Perform other duties as required

What You Bring To Freeport

  • Three (3) months experience in one of the following areas:
    • Mining/Manufacturing
    • Industrial Operations
    • Commercial Construction
    • Commercial Landscaping
    • Commercial Agriculture
  • Must have completed academic and practical competencies required (this includes Line of Progression requirements for internal employees where LOP Exists) and have experience demonstrating the required aptitude. The selected candidate shall demonstrate the ability to apply knowledge and skills while also passing a written assessment where required. This exam is based on skills/abilities and/or academic knowledge; as well as safety.

Preferred Qualifications

  • High School diploma or GED
  • Willing and able to work in a physical labor-intensive environment, including walking five to ten-plus (5-10+) miles per day in the Tankhouse environment
  • Experience operating mobile material handling equipment (forklifts, mobile cranes, etc.)
  • Willing and able to work a rotating shift in a 24/7/265 environment that includes days, nights, weekends, holidays, and both scheduled and unscheduled overtime according to business needs
  • Willing and able to wear all PPE required, including a full face respirator (which requires a clean shaven face) as may be required by the job duties
  • Previous relative work experience preferably in the mining industry

What We Offer You

The estimated pay range for this role is currently $21.00 - $27.00/hour. This range reflects base salary only and does not include bonus payments, benefits or retirement contributions. Actual base pay is determined by experience, qualifications, skills and other job-related factors. This role is eligible for additional discretionary and incentive payment considerations based on company and individual performance. More details will be shared during the hiring process. Click here to view a sample of Total Rewards Estimate for this role.

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with employer contribution/match
  • Paid time off, paid sick time, holiday pay, parental leave
  • Tuition assistance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Discounted insurance plans for pet, auto, home and vehicle
  • Internal progression opportunities
  • Learn more about our competitive and comprehensive benefits package!

What We Require

  • Candidates may be required to pass a medical exam.

title: Lead Project Controls Specialist - Cost - 90373866 - New York/Philadelphia
description:
Your success is a train ride away!

As we move America’s workforce toward the future, Amtrak connects businesses and communities across the country. We employ more than 20,000 diverse, energetic professionals in a variety of career fields throughout the United States. The safety of our passengers, our employees, the public and our operating environment is our priority, and the success of our railroad is due to our employees.

Are you ready to join our team?

Our values of ‘Do the Right Thing, Excel Together and Put Customers First’ are at the heart of what matters most to us, and our Core Capabilities, ‘Building Trust, Accountability, Effective Communication, Customer Focus, and Proactive Safety & Security’ are what every employee needs to know and do to be most impactful at Amtrak. By living the Amtrak values, focusing on our capabilities, and actively embracing and fostering diverse ideas, backgrounds, and perspectives, together we will honor our past and make Amtrak a company of the future.

Job Summary

The individual in this role will manage and execute cost engineering and control activities for capital construction within Amtrak’s Major Power Portfolio. Under general direction from the Project Controls Manager and the Project Manager, the Lead Project Controls Specialist Cost analyzes cost performance, develops estimates, creates and manages budgets, and liaises frequently with Amtrak’s Capital Finance Team. This position supports attainment of department or project-specific goals and outcomes through the delivery of project control services, ensuring close alignment between project control staff and project management team(s).

Essential Functions

  • Serve as Lead Cost Control Specialist, responsible for analyzing, developing, maintaining, controlling and reporting project design and construction cost, forecasts and expenditures. These forecasts include analyses of project cash flow, commitment plans, and funding in accordance with grant and funding contribution agreements.
  • Assure compliance with department and enterprise practices on project budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, change management, cost controlling, and related project-specific requirements. Support maintenance of department policies and procedures on project cost control, cost control tools and techniques, work breakdown structures, risk management, contingency determination, management and draw-down, and earned value management. Incorporate the best current practices used in the construction and transportation industries.
  • Perform monthly analysis and report cost performance, develop “bottom-up” forecasts on a rotating basis to evaluate performance against Total Life of Project Cost and Schedule. Provide detailed analysis to project team to improve project performance and forecasting as well as to Capital Finance team to support corporate reporting and grants management.
  • Collect project performance data such as installed quantities, expended labor and other progress measurements from enterprise tools and/or project management staff to assess project/portfolio cost performance.
  • Maintain reporting mechanisms, dashboards, and presentations about project performance indicators and feed this data to ensure a cohesive picture of project’s contribution to the project and/or portfolio.
  • Assist in development of annual operating plan, including working closely with project managers to estimate costs for upcoming fiscal year as well as out years. Work with Capital Finance to refine plan as necessary. Oversee administration of department budget, including managing off cycle reprogramming requests for new or adjusted funding on projects and preparation and/or approval of purchase requisitions.
  • Work with Project Management team to develop and submit Change Requests to adjust the fiscal plan or annual AOP.
  • Perform investigations such as market analysis, visits to the field, and interviews of delivery staff (e.g., engineers, superintendents, construction managers), to understand construction means and methods to develop cost estimates.
  • Participate in risk eCovaluation sessions or preconstruction reviews and ensure risks are documented and assessed in terms of probability and impact to enable project team to develop risk mitigation plans and contingencies (schedule & cost).

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education, training and/or relevant experience.
  • Plus 6 years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Science, Engineering, or Construction Management
  • Plus 8 years of relevant work experience.
  • Three years of capital construction controls experience in the rail industry, oil and gas, energy, or pharmaceutical industry.
  • One or more of the following certifications / credentials:
    • PSP, CEP, EVP, or CCP (AACE)
    • EVMP
    • RMP (PMI)
  • Experience with SAP, Masterworks, Maximo, Procore, and P6 Scheduling Software

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Past job experience in project/program controls.
  • Knowledge of principles and practices of construction project management through all phases of construction project lifecycle.
  • Ability to implement/organize construction project performance metrics, performance analysis, dashboards and progress reports.
  • Understanding of project financial reporting, forecasting, analysis and monitoring capital project / program / portfolio funding.
  • Familiarity with tools, techniques, and procedures related to project schedule management, control and forecasting in large and/or complex capital construction projects.
  • Applied knowledge of statistical analysis methods.
  • Knowledge of project risk management principles, practices, standards and methods.
  • Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and PowerBI skills.
  • Experience using Maximo to collect labor reports
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills to communicate complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to work diplomatically across teams with varying objectives.

Environmental Conditions/Physical Demands

Environmental Conditions:

  • Office environment; 4 days in the office, 1 day remote.
  • Exposure to computer screens.

Physical Conditions:

  • May require maintaining physical condition necessary for sitting, walking or standing for prolonged periods of time.
  • Travel: up to 25%

description:
THE COMPANY

Careerminds is a leading provider of career transition, talent development, and coaching solutions. We help organizations support their employees through change while promoting talent development and internal and external mobility. Our portfolio includes leading Career Transition and Coaching services, as well as Progression, our application dedicated to career frameworks and workforce intelligence.
THE ROLE
The Career Transition Coach supports participants in Careerminds’ outplacement programs, individually and/or in groups, with their career development and job search.
This is a freelance engagement on a self-employed basis, combining remote work with on-site assignments, depending on client and program needs. title: Legal AI Business Consultant
location: Sydney, New South Wales, Australia; Brisbane City, Queensland, Australia
description:
Apply your legal skills to a new career in Legal Tech! Join our AI Paralegal startup within an established, successful global business - generous commission structure

  • Help law firms start earning revenue from AI Paralegal and widen access to justice for their clients
  • Small, collaborative team – you’ll work directly with our product teams to help shape the product our clients want
  • Flexible, hybrid Sydney or Brisbane based role - 2 days a week in the office with regular travel

About AI Paralegal

AI Paralegal is part of CORTO, a cutting-edge software company dedicated to revolutionising the legal industry. Our mission is to empower legal practitioners with AI-driven solutions that streamline their workflow, boost productivity and provide more efficient client service.

AI is transforming the legal industry and CORTO is at the forefront of this change. There is a huge opportunity for law firms to save time, money and to add more value to their client base. This is where AI Paralegal comes in. AI Paralegal is a startup transforming the way legal work is done to unlock new value for law firms and their clients. We will be utilising our in-house expertise and the power of AI to save hours of work and transform the way law firms provide access to legal justice.

Built on Adieu’s advanced AI technology, AI Paralegal functions as a digital paralegal drafting documents, managing workflows and handling repetitive legal tasks with speed and precision. By integrating seamlessly with LEAP’s ecosystem, it empowers firms to increase efficiency, scale capacity and drive measurable profitability from every matter.

What you’ll do

This role is ideal for a qualified Lawyer who wants to be a part of how AI is transforming the legal industry. You'll join our Implementation team and focus on adoption – taking new firms from signed order form to using AI Paralegal every day.

AI Paralegal runs on a revenue share model: when our clients use the product successfully, we both generate revenue. That makes a firm’s first four months critical. In that window, you’ll get them set up, trained and confident with the product, with the goal of reaching their monthly usage targets. Those targets are how your success will be measured.

You’ll work closely with sales, product and our engagement team, and your client interaction and feedback will help shape how we run this first part of the client journey.

To make this happen, you will:

  • Own the end-to-end implementation experience for new firms, from contract signed through to embedded daily usage and live revenue
  • Partner with sales across the full cycle, joining the conversation before the deal closes and staying close after
  • Lead onsite and remote training sessions tailored to the firm: structured pre-work, a half to full day onsite for smaller firms and deliberate follow-up
  • Run targeted outreach after go-live to help firms reach their monthly usage targets
  • Run a clean handoff to the engagement team once firms are settled, so they can optimise long-term usage and revenue
  • Build and refine the implementation process, training and how we approach firms of different sizes
  • Bring feedback back to product and sales: what’s working, what’s blocking adoption and what we need to build next
  • Manage multiple implementations in parallel and continuously improve cycle time without trading off adoption quality

What you’ll bring

  • Admitted lawyer or legal practitioner with 3+ years of experience
  • A consultative style, with a focus on change management over technical configuration
  • Strong stakeholder management across internal teams (sales, product, support, engagement) and on the client side

You are the type of person who

  • Has a genuine interest in AI and how it’s changing professional work. You don’t need to be a builder but you should be a curious user
  • Enjoys getting in a room (or on a call) with legal professionals to understand how they work
  • Is happy to build structure where it doesn’t exist yet. We are still building our implementation process
  • Is energised by being in early – when the product is still taking shape and your input actually changes it
  • Thrives in a small, fast-moving team where new ideas are welcome and there’s no room for ego

CORTO is an inclusive, people-first company committed to breaking down institutional barriers that keep people from reaching their potential. If you meet some, but not all the requirements above, we encourage you to still submit your application.

Why join CORTO?

  • Your work matters. We solve real world problems that improve and support local, everyday law firms. So they can do their best work for the people in the communities they serve.
  • Make an impact. You won’t be another ‘cog in the wheel’ here. We give full trust and autonomy for you to be heard, to work on big & complex projects and to make a real difference.
  • Work with a group of authentic, passionate people who love what they do.
  • Well-funded and global. CORTO is part of ATI, one of the largest international LegalTech companies.
  • Flexible and hybrid working. We engage, share and collaborate on ideas and workflows.
  • Career and learning opportunities; we move fast and need smart people to get us where we're going. We are a scaling business and looking for people who want to grow with us.
  • Have fun with us. Celebrations. Socials. Sports teams. Access to sailing and yacht events.
  • We value your well-being - Wellness focus with additional time off, gym membership and other perks.
  • Fast-paced tech environment, if we don't disrupt ourselves someone else will do it!
  • Access to LEAP Home - a program unique to LEAP to support you in buying your primary residence.

title: Työnjohtajat Seinäjoen suurimmalle työmaalle / Construction Supervisors for the Largest Construction Site in Seinäjoki
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme rakennusalan Työnjohtajia vahvistamaan suuren työmaan organisaatiota Seinäjoella.

Tarjolla on vastuullinen tehtävä kansainvälisessä työympäristössä ja pitkäkestoisessa hankkeessa, jossa pääset johtamaan käytännön tekemistä.

Mitä tulisit tekemään?

Työnjohtajana johdat rakennus- ja asennusryhmän päivittäistä työskentelyä sekä jaat työtehtävät. Ohjaat muun muassa julkisivuelementtien asennuksia, kipsilevy- ja metallirankatöitä, teknisten välikattojen rakentamista sekä sisärakentamista. Varmistat, että työryhmällä on käytössään oikeat piirustukset, materiaalit ja työvälineet sekä että työt toteutetaan turvallisia työmenetelmiä noudattaen. Seuraat työvaiheiden etenemistä, aikataulua ja laatua, ratkaiset työmaan päivittäisiä käytännön haasteita ja sovitat työryhmäsi tekemistä yhteen muiden urakoitsijoiden kanssa kansainvälisessä työympäristössä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Odotamme sinulta aikaisempaa kokemusta rakennusalan työnjohdosta, työmaakympin tehtävistä tai muusta vastaavasta vastuuroolista sekä käytännön ymmärrystä talonrakentamisen työvaiheista ja rakennus- ja rakennekuvien lukutaitoa. Pystyt johtamaan kansainvälisiä työryhmiä selkeästi ja käytännönläheisesti, ja työskentelet sujuvasti englanniksi. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää oma-aloitteista työotetta sekä valmiutta tarvittaessa pidempiin työpäiviin ja viikonlopputyöhön. Taustallasi voi olla soveltuva rakennusalan koulutus tai kokemuksen kautta hankittu vahva ammattitaito.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme sinulle pitkäkestoisen työn merkittävässä hankkeessa Seinäjoella sekä mahdollisuuden rakentaa pidempää uraa tulevilla työmailla Suomessa ja ulkomailla. Normaali työaikasi on maanantaista perjantaihin klo 7.00–15.30, minkä lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus työskennellä tarpeen mukaan pidempiä työpäiviä ja viikonloppuja. Palkkaus sovitaan kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Jos kiinnostuit tehtävästä, haluamme ehdottomasti kuulla sinusta. Jätä hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 19.11.2026. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja tehtävässä pääset aloittamaan loppuvuodesta 2026.

Tehtävästä yhteydenotot Biisonille, Roope Takala roope.takala@biisoni.fi ja Susanna Tallbacka susanna.tallbacka@biisoni.fi.

We are looking for Construction Supervisors to strengthen our client’s site organisation on a major construction project in Seinäjoki.

This is a responsible role in an international working environment and a long-term project, where you will take an active role in leading day-to-day site operations.

What will you be doing?

As a Construction Supervisor, you will lead the daily work of a construction and installation team and assign tasks to the team members. You will supervise work including the installation of façade elements, plasterboard and metal stud framing, technical suspended ceilings and interior construction.

You will ensure that the team has access to the correct drawings, materials and tools, and that all work is carried out in accordance with safe working methods. You will monitor the progress, schedule and quality of the work, resolve practical day-to-day challenges on site and coordinate your team’s activities with other contractors in an international working environment.

What do we expect from you?

We expect you to have previous experience in construction supervision or in a similar role involving responsibility for a construction team. You have a practical understanding of building construction processes and are able to read construction and structural drawings.

You are capable of leading international teams in a clear, practical and hands-on manner, and you are able to work fluently in English. Success in this role requires a proactive approach and the flexibility to work longer days and weekends when necessary.

You may have a relevant qualification in construction or strong professional expertise gained through practical work experience.

What do we offer?

We offer long-term employment on a significant project in Seinäjoki, as well as the opportunity to build a longer-term career on future construction sites in Finland and abroad.

Your standard working hours will be from 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., Monday to Friday. Depending on the needs of the site, you will also have the opportunity to work longer days and weekends.

Your salary will be agreed based on your experience and expertise.

Interested?

If this opportunity interests you, we would be delighted to hear from you. Please submit your application through the application link as soon as possible, but no later than 19 November 2026.

We will review applications during the application period, and the positions are expected to start in late 2026.

For further information about the role, please contact Biisoni: Roope Takala roope.takala@biisoni.fi, Susanna Tallbacka susanna.tallbacka@biisoni.fi

title: Sr. Manager, Trade Compliance - EU/EMEA
description:
Job Req ID: 30677

About Supermicro:

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are amongst the fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer many new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us to drive accelerated growth and technology-led innovation in the global marketplace.

Job Summary:

Supermicro is seeking an experienced Sr. Manager, Trade Compliance - EU/EMEA to lead and strengthen trade compliance operations at our Netherlands (BV) location and across the EMEA region. This position will play a critical role in developing and maintaining a robust regional compliance program, ensuring adherence to Dutch, EU, U.S., and applicable international import and export regulations.


The successful candidate will have extensive experience in EU and Dutch export controls, strategic goods licensing, customs compliance, sanctions, and regulatory risk management, particularly within the technology, semiconductor, or advanced computing industries.

This role will serve as the primary regional trade compliance leader, providing strategic guidance on complex cross-border transactions, managing export licensing requirements for advanced technology products, strengthening internal controls, and supporting the continued development of Supermicro's EMEA compliance framework.

The Sr. Manager will work closely with Global Trade Compliance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to implement scalable compliance processes, improve operational efficiency, and proactively address evolving regulatory requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

EU Export Controls and Licensing:

  • Contribute and support the trade compliance operations for Supermicro BV and support regulatory compliance across the EMEA region.
  • Manage Dutch and EU export licensing requirements, including applications, regulatory assessments, license conditions, and ongoing compliance obligations.
  • Provide expert guidance on the export and re-export of advanced computing products, GPUs, AI servers, semiconductor technology, software, and other controlled items.
  • Oversee EU Dual-Use Regulation compliance, Dutch strategic goods controls, applicable U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), international sanctions requirements, and evaluate complex international transactions.
  • Monitor regulatory developments affecting advanced computing and semiconductor technologies and assess their operational and commercial implications.

Import and Customs Compliance:

  • Oversee customs compliance activities, ensuring adherence to EU customs regulations and the Union Customs Code (UCC).
  • Provide guidance on tariff classification, customs valuation, country of origin, preferential trade agreements, and import documentation.
  • Evaluate opportunities to improve customs processes, duty management, and operational efficiency while maintaining regulatory compliance.
  • Manage customs-related inquiries, audits, and regulatory reviews in coordination with customs authorities, brokers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Establish effective oversight of customs brokers, freight forwarders, and logistics service providers to ensure compliance.

Compliance Program Development and Risk Management:

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve regional trade compliance policies, procedures, and internal controls aligned with Supermicro's global compliance framework.
  • Establish and strengthen the EMEA trade compliance program to support business growth, regulatory requirements, and operational scalability.
  • Conduct risk assessments and support enhanced due diligence reviews for complex or high-risk transactions.
  • Lead regional compliance monitoring, internal audits, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Identify compliance gaps and implement practical, risk-based solutions to strengthen governance and accountability.

Trade Compliance Systems and Process Improvement:

  • Support the implementation, enhancement, and optimization of SAP Global Trade Services (GTS) and other trade compliance automation solutions.
  • Partner with IT and business stakeholders to improve automated screening, export classification, licensing controls, transaction monitoring, and audit trails.
  • Develop business requirements, participate in system testing, and support the implementation of standardized compliance workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline trade compliance processes, improve data integrity, and reduce manual intervention while maintaining effective regulatory controls.

Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to integrate compliance requirements into business processes.
  • Provide practical guidance to business leadership regarding regulatory risks, licensing timelines, and transaction requirements.
  • Develop and deliver regional trade compliance training to strengthen regulatory awareness and accountability.
  • Coordinate closely with Global Trade Compliance leadership to ensure consistency in policies.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in International Trade, Business, Law, Supply Chain Management, or a related field required; advanced degree or relevant professional certification preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive trade compliance experience, including significant experience managing EU and Dutch import/export compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrated expertise in the EU Dual-Use Regulation, Dutch strategic goods licensing requirements, EU sanctions, and applicable U.S. export controls.
  • Strong knowledge of EU customs regulations, including tariff classification, customs valuation, origin determination, and import procedures.
  • Experience managing export licensing for controlled technology, advanced computing products, semiconductors, GPUs, or other dual-use goods strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience developing, implementing, and improving trade compliance programs, policies, and internal controls within a multinational organization.
  • Experience working directly with Dutch regulatory authorities, including export licensing and customs agencies, highly desirable.
  • Experience with SAP GTS or comparable trade compliance systems, including automated screening, classification, and licensing workflows, strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex international transactions, identify regulatory risks, and develop practical compliance solutions.
  • Strong leadership, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence business decisions across regional and global organizations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Dutch language proficiency is an advantage.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, multinational technology environment.

EEO Statement

It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

title: Right of Way Title Supervisor
description:
Project: A major natural gas pipeline project in the Permian Basin, Texas

Reports to: Project Manager or ROW Supervisor

Classification: Full-time

Location: Permian Basin, Texas — on-site; travel across the project area as assigned

Purpose

The Title Supervisor leads title research and land-records work supporting the acquisition, development, operation and maintenance of natural gas pipeline infrastructure. This role supervises title agents and coordinates with right-of-way agents, attorneys, surveyors, project managers and government agencies to identify ownership, determine property interests, resolve title issues and maintain accurate land records — holding the team to Gray Hawk’s Title Standard: accuracy, detail and pace are co-equal.

Core Responsibilities

• Supervise, assign and review the work of title agents and other assigned staff.

• Plan and monitor title work to meet project schedules, quality standards and budget.

• Oversee examination of deeds, easements, leases, probate records, liens, judgments, tax records, plats and other public documents.

• Ensure ownership and property interests are accurately identified and documented — legal descriptions, exceptions, encumbrances and gaps in the chain of title.

• Review title commitments, title reports, ownership reports and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

• Identify and coordinate resolution of title defects and complex ownership issues, escalating legal matters to counsel as appropriate.

• Coordinate with right-of-way agents on acquisition packages, landowner information, easement documentation and closing requirements.

• Maintain title files, databases, maps and document-management systems to company standards and applicable retention requirements.

• Develop and improve procedures, templates, quality-control practices and reporting for title operations.

• Track workload, status, deliverables and costs; provide regular updates to the Project Manager and project teams.

• Build productive working relationships with landowners, title companies, courthouse personnel, agencies and vendors.

• Lead the team’s field safety: walk each new team member through the Field Safety Manual and Safety Training and complete the sign-off with them; hold the daily safety briefing and keep the Daily Safety Log.

• Train and mentor title agents; give performance feedback and support their development.

Success Metrics

• Title agents working under clear assignments, with their work reviewed before it leaves the team.

• Title deliverables accurate and on pace — neither perfectionism nor pace pressure compromising the work.

• Title defects and complex ownership issues identified and escalated early, before they delay acquisition.

• No unresolved title escalations aging beyond 3 days without documented status.

• Title files and databases current and audit-ready.

• No team member working alone in the field before their Field Safety acknowledgment and Safety Training sign-off are complete.

Required Qualifications

• Minimum ten (10) years of right-of-way title experience.

• Minimum five (5) years supervising title agents.

• 5+ years of Texas title experience.

• Leadership experience on FERC-regulated natural gas pipeline projects.

• Proven ability to lead and develop a team of title agents — assigning, reviewing and holding the work to a standard.

• Strong working knowledge of deeds, easements, leases, probate records, liens, judgments, tax records and plats as they affect ownership, legal descriptions and marketable title.

• Experience with land-management databases (such as Irth Land Management or comparable) and the ability to learn new client databases quickly.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel).

• Strong organization, written communication, research and problem-solving skills.

• Must supply their own mobile phone that can receive email, and a computer capable of doing the job effectively.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent right-of-way experience or IRWA certification (SR/WA or RW/AC) accepted in its place.

• Available to start within weeks of an offer and to work on-site in the Permian Basin.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience preparing Chains of Title and Limited Title Certificates.

• Specialized title expertise (e.g., government title, Indian land title, mortgages and liens).

• Experience with ESRI GIS software.

Don’t meet every requirement? If you have strong FERC pipeline leadership experience but not in Texas, we still want to hear from you.

title: Head of Trading
description:
Work Arrangement: Hybrid

Department: Crude Oil Marketing & Trading Group

Pembina Pipeline Corporation is a dynamic energy transportation and midstream provider, serving customers for more than 70 years. Chances are, we do more than you think. We own pipelines that transport hydrocarbon liquids and natural gas products produced primarily in Western Canada. We also own gathering and processing facilities and an oil and natural gas liquids infrastructure and logistics business. Our operations along the hydrocarbon value chain allow us to offer a full state of midstream and marketing services to our customers in the energy industry.

We are an organization that cares not only about results, but how those results are achieved. Our organization is grounded in the values of Safe, Trustworthy, Respectful, Collaborative and Entrepreneurial Pembina has a diverse and inclusive working environment that provides employees with a positive and engaging work experience where they are recognized and empowered. Learn more about our values and strategy.

We value the safety of our communities, customers, contractors and employees, and believe that all incidents are preventable. Compliance with all policies, procedures and regulations is a requirement, and our Life Saving Rules are basic rules. Employees embed physical, psychological, and cyber safety into all work practices while taking personal accountability to maintain compliance, support audit readiness, proactively identify risks, and protect our people, assets, and data. Working for Pembina means working safely.

Overview:

Pembina’s Marketing team in Calgary is actively hiring a Head of Trading to lead Crude, NGL and Natural Gas trading strategy, portfolio optimization, risk management, and commercial performance.

Reporting to the Vice President of Marketing, this role develops and executes Pembina’s Crude, NGL and Natural Gas trading strategy, optimizing the physical and commercial portfolio through market intelligence, asset optionality, transportation, storage, blending, market access and arbitrage opportunities.

The Head of Trading leads Crude Trading, NGL Trading, Natural Gas Trading, and Trade Analytics & Optimization, translating market fundamentals, customer needs and asset capabilities into strategies that maximize risk-adjusted value and strengthen trading governance.

As a senior commercial leader, the Head of Trading builds industry relationships, advises senior leadership on market opportunities and risks, and partners across the organization to enhance the value of Pembina’s integrated asset and commercial portfolio.

Pembina’s Marketing team creates value through the strategic buying, selling and optimization of natural gas, NGLs, condensate and crude oil. Leveraging transportation, storage, fractionation, market access, rail and logistics capabilities, the team improves market access, pricing and commercial opportunities for Pembina and Western Canadian producers.

Responsibilities may include but not limited to:

  • Develop and execute integrated Crude, NGL and Natural Gas trading strategies that maximize risk-adjusted value, margin and optionality;
  • Lead trading activities across physical markets, including transportation, storage, blending, market access, timing, location and product optimization;
  • Identify and execute arbitrage opportunities by leveraging Pembina’s assets, contracts and market positions;
  • Translate market fundamentals, supply and demand dynamics, customer requirements and asset capabilities into actionable trading strategies;
  • Maintain deep knowledge of North American energy markets, pricing, infrastructure and global market drivers;
  • Build Analytics & Optimization capabilities using data, modelling and scenario analysis to improve portfolio economics;
  • Establish performance reporting, KPIs and P&L attribution to support timely commercial decisions;
  • Promote data-driven decision-making, automation and continuous improvement across Trading;
  • Partner across Asset Teams, Commercial, Logistics, Finance and Market Risk to capture value across the enterprise;
  • Ensure trading complies with approved mandates, risk limits, governance and regulatory requirements;
  • Monitor exposures and external developments, balancing commercial opportunity with disciplined risk management;
  • Provide senior leadership with clear advice on portfolio performance, market opportunities, risks and trends;
  • Lead major negotiations and maintain strong relationships with customers, counterparties and industry participants;
  • Identify emerging markets, products and commercial structures that strengthen Pembina’s competitive position;
  • Build a high-performing culture through accountability, collaboration, coaching and talent development; and
  • Champion Pembina’s Zero by Choice safety culture and Life Saving Rules by embedding physical, psychological, and cyber safety into all work practices while taking personal accountability to maintain compliance, support audit readiness, proactively identify risks, and protect our people, assets, and data.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, economics, finance, engineering, or a related discipline;
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in trading, marketing, commercial development, asset optimization in related energy markets;
  • Proven success developing and executing profitable trading and commercial strategies in complex market environments;
  • Deep knowledge of North American crude, NGL and natural gas markets, including transportation, pipeline and storage infrastructure, pricing, refinery and petrochemical economics, supply and demand, risk management, and physical and financial trading;
  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to identify market opportunities, manage risk, and deliver sustainable value;
  • Accomplished people leader with experience building, developing, and retaining high-performing commercial teams and future leadership talent;
  • Strategic thinker who translates market intelligence into business decisions and long-term growth opportunities;
  • Exceptional communication, influencing, and relationship-management skills with internal and external stakeholders;
  • Proven ability to lead through complexity, align teams, and foster accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement; and
  • Executive presence and leadership maturity, with the ability to advise senior leaders and represent the organization in high-profile commercial discussions and negotiations.


    Pembina’s Flexible Work Standard provides the option for eligible employees to work remotely on Fridays

The successful candidate must be legally able to work in the country of the position. The final candidate will be required to undergo Pre-Employment Background Checks including a Criminal Record Check.

This position is scheduled to be posted until end of day: 11/16/2026. In rare circumstances, a position may be posted for less time if there has been significant interest in the role.

Our expectations are high, and our total rewards package reflects this.

Diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences contribute to our collective success and enrich our workplace culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences. title: Product Quality Analyst
description:
Auto req ID: 63071
Title: Product Quality Analyst
Job Function: Manufacturing
Location: YORK
Company: Harley-Davidson Motor Company
Full or Part-Time: Full Time
Shift: SHIFT2

In 1903, out of a small shed in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, four young men lit a cultural wildfire that would grow and spread across geographies and generations. Their innovation and imagination for what was possible on two wheels sparked a transportation revolution that would make Harley-Davidson the most recognizable motorcycle brand in the world. Today, we continue to define motorcycle culture, evoking soul-stirring emotion reflected in every product and experience we deliver - like we have for well over a century and will for generations to come. Are you ready to ride with us?

The Harley-Davidson Motor Company Vehicle Operations facility in York is our final assembly plant. Employees at York also perform a variety of manufacturing operations, including fabrication, welding, polishing and painting and produce a wide range of current and replacement parts for all models. Join our team as a Product Quality Analyst.

Job Summary

Perform comprehensive quality audits, technical evaluations, and diagnostic assessments of current and future motorcycle models while serving as a key technical resource and escalation point for internal teams. Leverage extensive motorcycle service, diagnostic, and quality expertise to evaluate vehicle performance, functionality, reliability, cosmetic appearance, and overall customer experience. Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Product Development, Supplier Quality, Dealer Technical Support, and Leadership teams to identify quality concerns, resolve complex technical issues, drive corrective actions, and improve product quality, customer satisfaction, and operational performance. Act as the voice of the customer by providing technical feedback, mentoring team members, and ensuring effective communication of quality and service-related information.

Job Responsibilities

• Conduct dynamic vehicle evaluations on controlled test tracks and public roadways under varying speeds and operating conditions to assess motorcycle performance, ride quality, handling characteristics, functionality, and customer experience.

• Perform detailed visual, cosmetic, mechanical, electrical, and operational inspections of motorcycles to verify compliance with quality standards, engineering specifications, and customer expectations.

• Execute advanced diagnostic evaluations on mechanical, electrical, and software-related systems, utilizing available tools, resources, and technical expertise to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.

• Serve as a primary technical escalation point for complex product, diagnostic, and service-related issues reported by internal stakeholders.

• Develop, document, and present audit findings, diagnostic results, and quality assessment reports to stakeholders including engineering teams, manufacturing personnel, supplier representatives, technicians, union employees, and leadership.

• Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Product Development, Supplier Quality, and Technical Service teams to communicate findings, recommend improvements, and implement corrective actions that enhance product quality, reliability, serviceability, and customer satisfaction.

• Participate in future model build events, prototype evaluations, and launch activities, providing feedback as the voice of the customer and identifying opportunities for product improvement.

• Research, create, update, and maintain technical documentation, diagnostic procedures, and knowledge databases to support effective troubleshooting and knowledge sharing.

• Identify opportunities to improve key performance indicators (KPIs) for internal and external stakeholders through trend analysis, problem resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Demonstrate expert-level proficiency in motorcycle systems, diagnostic methodologies, and quality evaluation processes while supporting continuous improvement and problem-solving initiatives.

• Perform a variety of complex assignments requiring independent judgment, technical expertise, and collaboration across multiple functions.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or Equivalent Required

Education Specifications

• Completion of a post-secondary program from an accredited institute specializing in motorcycle diagnostics and repair preferred.

• Must hold a valid motorcycle operator's license.

• Technical Service Training preferred.

Experience Requirements

• Typically requires 8+ years of motorcycle maintenance, repair, diagnostics, quality evaluation, or related industry experience.

• Demonstrated expertise in mechanical, electrical, and software diagnostics, including complex problem-solving and root cause analysis.

• Experience performing component measurements, vehicle inspections, and diagnostic testing utilizing industry-standard tools and equipment.

• Proficient in the use of hand tools and diagnostic equipment for motorcycle service, troubleshooting, and repair.

• Ability to safely operate and evaluate all types of 2- and 3-wheeled motorcycles in a variety of operating conditions, including negotiating curves at speeds up to 65 miles per hour.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to a wide range of audiences.

• Ability to develop technical reports, document findings, and clearly communicate conditions, causes, and corrective actions within data management systems.

• Strong computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office Suite and technical information systems.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently with minimal supervision, and effectively collaborate in team-based and remote environments.

• Experience coaching, training, and mentoring technicians or team members.

• Ability to travel up to 10% to support future model build events, dealer support activities, and field investigations.

• Overtime as needed to support production, product launches, and business objectives.

The pay range shown represents the national average pay range for this role. Your pay may be more or less than the stated range and is dependent on your geographic location and level of experience.

description:

POSITION SUMMARY:

Coordination of the building construction procurement process and assistance in the execution of the varied functions, specifically civil, mechanical and electrical building systems, assigned to the Capital Planning Services Department.

  • Completed Post-secondary education from a recognized institution related to the construction field
  • Five years experience in the facilitation and coordination of construction/renovation projects with the full range of construction and consultant specialties, with special emphasis in civil, mechanical and electrical systems
  • Documented history of continuing education related to the construction and capital planning processes
  • Other combinations of education and experience may be considered
  • Proficiency with the utilization of various Canadian Construction Documents Committee (CCDC) contracts, specifically CCDC 2, CCDC 5a and 5b and CCDC 14
  • Experience and training related to the current CSA Z8000 and CSA Z317.13 Guidelines
  • Required proficiency with the Microsoft suite of office products (Outlook, Word, Excel, Access and PowerPoint)
  • Required proficiency with Microsoft Projects
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of AutoCAD
  • Province of Manitoba Class 5 Drivers License and access to a personal vehicle to provide service within the Prairie Mountain Health
  • Demonstrated Working knowledge of design document and specification interpretation, change directive process, as built drawing process, and operation and maintenance manual process as it relates to electrical, mechanical, architectural and structural systems
  • Demonstrated experience in initiating changes and improvements, including skills in workplace re-engineering within a Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) environment
  • A thorough knowledge of occupational hazards, safety precautions and regulations applicable to construction sites
  • System/building commissioning experience
  • Demonstrated leadership and supervisory ability
  • Demonstrated written and oral communication skills
  • Demonstrated experience in employee and labour relations
  • Ability to prioritize in a changing environment
  • Sensitivity to the human and political dynamics of health care management
  • Strong organizational, decision making and problem solving skills
  • Demonstrated ability to develop Policy and Procedures
  • Ability to display independent judgment
  • Ability to respect and promote a culturally diverse population
  • Ability to respect and promote confidentiality
  • Ability to perform the duties of the position on a regular basis

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Overview:

All listed functions are representative of the evolving capital planning process. Each phase of the process requires changing levels of coordination and management and is project specific. The role is critical to the development and successful execution of all capital projects of a minor or major nature.

Involvement throughout the various phases of the capital planning process includes functional and architectural programming, schematics, design development and construction documentation review, operational/occupancy planning, equipment selection/coordination, coordination/implementation and monitoring of physical construction techniques and documentation processes for Capital Planning Services.

  • Participates in the development of functional and architectural programs for assigned projects.
  • Participates in the process of preparing data for and reviewing feasibility studies, schematics, construction documents, equipment lists and associated data for assigned projects.
  • Assists in the monitoring of construction budgets for approved projects.
  • Travels to various PMH sites in the performance of the duties required of the Coordinator.
  • Leads the review, along with the various design consultants, trades persons and user groups; of architectural, electrical, mechanical and structural presentations and specifications as they relate to the various phases of construction consultation.
  • Develops schedule of accommodations, temporary and permanent, of services and programs throughout the various phases of renovation.
  • Coordinates the development of occupation and construction schedules for redevelopment projects.
  • Initiates contracts, supervises, monitors and acts as the owner’s representative as necessary, in the inspection, verification, recording and reporting on the daily progress of major and minor construction/renovation projects to ensure that proper construction materials are being installed and the work completed as specified.
  • Ensures the full dissemination of all project correspondence such as Requests For Information, Inspection Reports, Immediate Field Authorizations, Proposed Change Notices and Change Orders.
  • Coordinates and executes necessary field decisions.

title: Credit Control Assistant (6-month contract)
description:
About the Role

The Credit Control Assistant (6-month contract) is a hands-on operational contributor within DKSH's Finance – Credit Control team in Singapore, responsible for supporting Accounts Receivable (AR) follow-up activities. This role is central to ensuring the timely circulation of Statements of Account, submission of invoices through customer portals, and effective coordination of disputes and outstanding documents to reduce backlog and improve collection outcomes.

Candidates with no experience are welcome to apply.

What You Will Deliver

  • Prepare and send Statements of Account to customers based on the assigned follow-up list, ensuring timely and accurate distribution
  • Follow up with customers on outstanding invoices, missing documents, payment status, and required supporting details to drive timely resolution
  • Maintain proper tracking of follow-up status, customer responses, pending actions, and next follow-up dates to ensure full visibility and accountability
  • Escalate unresolved or delayed customer responses to the Credit Control team where further action is required
  • Assist with submission of invoices and supporting documents through customers' online portals, monitoring submission status and following up on rejected, pending, or incomplete submissions
  • Coordinate with internal teams to retrieve missing invoices, delivery documents, purchase orders, or other supporting documents required by customers for successful portal submissions
  • Ensure submission records are properly updated to maintain a complete tracking and audit trail
  • Assist in identifying and tracking customer disputes, short payments, rejected invoices, and portal-related issues, ensuring they are followed up in a timely manner
  • Liaise with relevant internal stakeholders including Customer Service, Sales, Business Units, Supply Chain, and Finance to obtain clarification or supporting documents required for dispute resolution
  • Escalate recurring or long-outstanding issues to the Credit Control team for further review and action
  • Support AR housekeeping activities including updating collection trackers, follow-up logs, and customer status reports to maintain operational accuracy
  • Assist in reconciling customer balances and preparing ageing, collection, or invoice submission status updates as required
  • Administrative duties and coordination tasks as required

What You Bring

  • Diploma, Nitec, or Higher Nitec in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline
  • Prior experience in Accounts Receivable, Credit Control, Billing, Customer Service, or Finance Operations is an advantage
  • SAP experience is an advantage
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, particularly Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP, to manage listings, trackers, and status reports effectively
  • Basic understanding of Accounts Receivable and invoice follow-up processes
  • Good tracking and follow-up discipline with the ability to manage multiple items concurrently and maintain accurate records
  • Comfortable with customer follow-up via email and phone, communicating clearly and professionally at all times
  • Able to work effectively with internal stakeholders to resolve invoice, payment, and dispute-related matters
  • Detail-oriented and responsible, with a willingness to perform hands-on operational follow-up work
  • Organised, responsive, and accountable in managing assigned tasks with minimal supervision
  • Able to work independently with guidance and escalate issues appropriately when required
  • Willing to learn and support the team during peak workload or transition periods

Why Join DKSH

At DKSH, we help companies grow in Asia and enable people to perform at their best. You will be part of an organization that values accountability, collaboration, and long-term partnerships. We offer a dynamic environment where your contributions are visible and where you can build a meaningful career in Finance.

title: 2027 Electrical Apprentice Signal Trainee (Moberly, MO)
description:
Requisition 40472: 2027 Electrical Apprentice Signal Trainee (Moberly, MO)

We are accepting applications to build a pipeline of qualified candidates for upcoming hiring needs. Candidates who successfully complete the hiring process may be considered for training classes between late 2026 and mid-2027, based on business needs and location availability.

Description

At Norfolk Southern, we believe that our people power progress. Our culture is built on our SPIRIT values—Safety, Performance, Integrity, Respect, Innovation, and Teamwork—which guide how we work, lead, and grow together. If you're ready to launch a career in railroad signal maintenance and contribute to the safety and reliability of train operations, we invite you to explore the Apprentice Signal Trainee role.

This hands-on, field-based position prepares individuals for a career in signal maintenance through structured classroom instruction and on-the-job training. Apprentice Signal Trainees learn to install, inspect, and maintain signal systems that are critical to safe and efficient rail operations.

What Should You Know

  • This is a seniority-based union position. You will be required to bid on available positions, which may be located outside your training location. Relocation may be necessary based on the outcome of the bid process. Relocation assistance is not provided for this position.

  • You must be available to work on-call, 24/7, including holidays, nights and weekends.

  • Extensive travel is required during training (up to 75%).

  • You will be required to join the Brotherhood of Railroad Signalmen (BRS) within 60 days of establishing seniority.

  • You must obtain a Class A CDL within 90 days of hire (training provided by Norfolk Southern)

Training

Training lasts approximately 52 weeks and includes both classroom and field instruction.

Click on the link below to learn more about our training program:

  • Classroom Training: Three sessions (3 weeks each) at the NS Training Center in McDonough, GA. Hotel accommodations, mileage reimbursement, and meal stipends provided.

  • Field Training: Hands-on experience with construction and maintenance crews across your seniority district.

  • Evaluations: Periodic written and practical assessments.

Successful completion of the training program places apprentices on the seniority roster and makes them eligible to bid on Signal Maintainer position.

Seniority Districts:

  • Eastern Region North (ERN)

  • Norfolk & Western (NW)

  • Southern Lines East (SLE)

  • Southern Lines West (SLW)

  • WRE (Western Region East (WRE)

  • Western Region West (WRW)

A detailed overview of the seniority districts is available in the following video:

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform FRA-required inspections and testing of signal systems and grade crossings.

  • Install, maintain, and repair signal equipment including signal lights, switch machines, and electrical switch locks

  • Crossing warning devices and interlocking systems

  • Positive Train Control (PTC) and cab signal systems

  • Read and interpret electrical schematics and technical diagrams.

  • Operate hand tools, electrical testing instruments, and heavy equipment

  • Accurately document inspections, repairs, and installations.

  • Work safely in outdoor environments under varying weather conditions.

  • Respond to on-call assignments, including nights and weekends.

Qualifications – Required

  • You must be 18 years or older.

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

  • You must obtain a Class A CDL within 90 days of hire (training provided by Norfolk Southern)

  • This includes passing a commercial driver medical certification examination.

  • Must pass pre-employment Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) drug and alcohol screening.

  • Must not have a conviction for, or completed state action to cancel, revoke, suspend, or deny a motor vehicle drivers license for, operating a motor vehicle while under the influence of or impaired by alcohol or a controlled substance

  • In the past 36 months, Must not have conviction for, or completed state action to cancel, revoke, suspend, or deny a motor vehicle driver's license for, refusal to undergo such testing as is required by State or foreign law when a law enforcement official seeks to determine whether a person is operating a vehicle while under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.

Qualifications – Preferred

  • Technical certificate or associate degree in Electrical Technology, Electronics Engineering, or related field.

  • OSHA 10/30, First Aid/CPR, TWIC card.

  • 1–2 years in electrical, mechanical, or field service work.

  • Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Proficient in basic computer applications (Excel, Word, Outlook).

  • Effective time management and communication skills.

Physical and Mental Job Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.

  • Capable of climbing, bending, stooping, and working at heights.

  • Ability to walk long distances on uneven terrain.

  • Must pass FRA/FMCSA physical standards including:

  • Visual acuity (at least 20/40 in each eye separately and both together with or without corrective lenses).

  • Color vision (must pass FRA-approved tests; lenses to improve color vision are not permitted).

  • Hearing (no hearing loss greater than 40B average at 500, 1000, and 2000 Hz in better ear; may be met with hearing aid).

Work Conditions

  • Outdoor field work in all weather conditions.

  • Extensive travel during training (up to 75%).

  • On-call and weekend availability required.

  • Union membership required (BRS).

Compensation and Benefits

  • Weeks 1–3 (Classroom): $1,200 /week

  • Apprentice Periods:

  • First 130 days: $36.48/hr

  • Second 130 days: $36.85/hr

  • Post-Apprenticeship (Signal Maintainer): $37.98/hr+

Benefits Include:

  • Medical coverage begins the first day of the second month after hire

  • Health insurance (80/20 or 85/15 plan)

  • $20,000 life insurance

  • 401(k) eligibility from day one

  • Dental and vision coverage after one year of service

Company Overview

Norfolk Southern Corporation (NYSE: NSC) is a Fortune 300 organization and one of the nation’s premier transportation companies. Its Norfolk Southern Railway Company subsidiary operates approximately 19,500 route miles in 22 states and the District of Columbia, serves every major container port in the eastern United States, and provides efficient connections to other rail carriers. Norfolk Southern is a major transporter of industrial products, including chemicals, agriculture, and metals and construction materials. In addition, the railroad operates the most extensive intermodal network in the East and is a principal carrier of coal, automobiles, and automotive parts.

At Norfolk Southern, we believe in celebrating our individuality. By leveraging the unique backgrounds and viewpoints of our employees, we can create a culture of innovation, respect, and inclusion. We know that employees thrive in a workplace where differing viewpoints, ideas, and experiences are freely shared and valued. As such, we encourage all employees to contribute their distinctive skills and capabilities to our organization.

Equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, and gender identity. Together, we power progress.

In addition, the Specialist will support SAP testing activities and perform J-SOX controls as required.

1.) Processing of Credit and Collections Transactions: You will be responsible for processing Credit & Collection transactions and supporting key daily activities, including submitting MyRequest templates for Customer Receipts, AR Clearings, Sundry Invoices and Credit Notes, reviewing customer payment proposal reports, and processing Bad Debts Write-offs. You will also monitor and review sales orders on hold, assess customer credit risk, track and manage customer inquiries, and investigate and resolve Credit & Collection-related issues. As part of your monthly responsibilities, you will ensure that all received documents are properly validated and processed within the required month-end closing timelines, while also completing all related month-end closing activities accurately and on time.

2.) Control and Compliance: You will help ensure compliance with Global Operating Guidelines, policies, and procedures by following applicable Corporate policies and procedures, GBS procedures, and internal guidelines, while also supporting entities in adhering to Corporate and GBS requirements. As part of your responsibilities, you will execute and provide appropriate evidence for JSOX controls where you are identified as the control owner in the JSOX GRM. You will ensure that these controls are completed accurately and on time, in full compliance with JSOX GRM requirements and in line with internal and external audit standards.

3.) Analytics, Reporting and Process Improvement: You will prepare routine reports and analyses, ensuring they are high-quality, accurate, and delivered on time, as well as support additional reporting requests from the Team Lead when required. You will also continuously review current processes and monitor performance against monthly KPIs and performance metrics to help identify potential areas for improvement. Where opportunities are identified, you will collaborate with the Team Lead to discuss and explore ways to improve processes, efficiency, and overall performance.

4.) TeamSupport and Projects: You will provide assistance and support to the Team Lead to help ensure the team’s objectives and targets are achieved. You will also collaborate with and support other AR Specialists to foster strong teamwork, particularly in document processing and resolving AR-related issues. Where required, you will participate in and contribute to cross-functional activities across GBS, as well as support relevant Corporate and GBS projects and initiatives.

5.) Entity Support: You will demonstrate a commitment to service excellence and a customer-focused approach by ensuring timely communication and resolution of queries and issues. You will provide effective support to Entities by developing a strong understanding of their business and operational needs, enabling you to provide relevant advice and solutions on AR-related matters.

title: Senior Manager, Transformation AI Lead (Finance)
description:
Role Overview

Reporting to the Group CFO, the Senior Manager, Transformation AI Lead drives the strategic adoption of AI and the transformation of Finance across the Group. This is a hands-on role: setting the roadmap, redesigning processes and roles, building and testing solutions, and accelerating the scaling of those that work, while equipping the Finance team for the future. The role sits within Finance, with the opportunity to extend its scope to transformation and AI initiatives across the Group.

Finance AI and Transformation Strategy

  • Define and own the Finance AI and transformation roadmap, aligned with the Group’s strategy.

  • Assess the AI readiness of Finance processes, data and systems, and prioritise initiatives through business cases based on value, feasibility, cost and risk.

  • Track benefits realisation, milestones and KPIs, and report progress to the CFO and steering committee.

  • Share solutions and lessons learned with other functions, supporting the extension of AI adoption beyond Finance as opportunities arise.

Process and Organisation Redesign

  • Redesign end-to-end Finance processes (record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, planning and forecasting) for AI-enabled workflows, with clear ownership, embedded controls and human review points.

  • Standardise processes and policies across entities to support a faster, more reliable close and consolidation.

  • Recommend the future Finance operating model and redesign roles around AI-enabled processes, working with HR on training and reskilling team members.

AI Solution Assessment and Delivery

  • Stay tool-agnostic, maintaining a current view of the market across AI-native finance platforms, AI features in existing systems, generative AI and agent platforms, and custom builds.

  • Lead structured solution evaluations, including build, buy or partner decisions, vendor selection and proofs of concept, assessing fit, total cost of ownership, security, integration and scalability.

  • Build and test prototypes, configure AI tools and workflows, and run proofs of concept, rather than relying solely on vendors or consultants.

  • Lead cross-functional project teams and external vendors to pilot, implement and scale AI solutions, translating Finance needs into clear requirements and holding vendors to agreed scope, timelines and outcomes.

AI Governance and Data

  • Working with IT, establish guidelines and controls for responsible AI use in Finance, covering accuracy, human review, auditability, data privacy (PDPA) and security.

  • Partner with IT and data owners to improve data quality and governance so Finance data is ready for AI and automation.

Change Management and Capability Building

  • Drive adoption through training, communications and feedback loops, and track adoption metrics.

  • Build a Finance AI community of practice and lead upskilling programmes for the Finance team.

  • Engage and influence senior leaders and stakeholders, explaining technical concepts in clear business terms.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Finance, Accountancy, Business, or a related discipline; AI and transformation certifications are an advantage.

  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in finance and business operations, including 3 years leading transformation programmes.

  • Working knowledge of core finance processes such as month-end close and reporting is an advantage; candidates without this must demonstrate the ability to quickly learn a business domain.

  • Proven hands-on experience piloting and deploying AI in an organisation, such as generative AI, agentic workflows and intelligent automation, with measurable results.

  • Hands-on generative AI skills, with a track record of building assistants, agents or automated workflows, and of judging the quality and limits of AI outputs.

  • Experience leading cross-functional project teams and managing external vendors, bridging business, finance and technology stakeholders including IT and data teams.

  • Strong communicator and structured problem-solver who is resilient and comfortable in dealing with ambiguity and change.
