  • Deep Learning Systems Architecture & Ownership : Design and own CNN, U-Net, and ViT systems for precision inspection, measurement, and defect classification. Own real-time anomaly detection from sensor and time-series product development data streams. Highest day-to-day output responsibility.
  • Physics-Informed AI & Surrogate Modeling: Validate and deploy PINNs methodology originated by the ARS — own product development implementation, physics-constraint validation against engineering requirements, and surrogate model pipelines. You are the product development -side authority; the ARS designs the methodology; you validate and deploy it to real product development systems.
  • Active Learning Pipeline Architecture: Architect active learning pipelines and Bayesian experimental design frameworks — integrating ARS-designed acquisition functions with DE-supplied feature data and laboratory scheduling systems. This workstream directly reduces physical experiment cost.
  • MLOps Platform Ownership: Own the full ML platform: MLflow, Docker, AWS EKS/Kubernetes, LLM Gateway (LangFuse/PortKey), CI/CD, observability, and model monitoring. Architect the platform; delegate maintenance to team once stable.

Qualifications

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related field. AI major or strong AI research focus preferred. Equivalent depth demonstrated through open-source contributions, or significant GitHub portfolio will be considered.

Experience

  • Minimum 3-5 years of hands-on technical experience
  • Demonstrated technical ownership of AI systems from design to product development deployment.
  • Proven direction of a small ML or AI engineering team —clear technical leadership with evidence of design reviews, mentoring, and cross-functional delivery.

Must have Skills:

  • Python: Expert-level proficiency - Primary language for all ML System work

  • Computer Vision: CNN, U-Net, ViT — full architecture range for inspection, defect detection, and measurement
  • Anomaly Detection: Real-time anomaly detection from sensor and time-series product development data streams

title: Service Coordinator
description:
Our present and future success depends on the creative and dedicated people of our company who demonstrate the principles outlined in the APS Promise: Design for Tomorrow, Empower Each Other and Succeed Together.

Summary

Serve as liaison between APS and municipalities, contractors, and customers for new installations, upgrades, conversions, and relocations to electrical service. Ensure customer requirements and expectations are accurately understood, communicated and executed. Schedule, coordinate, and ensure completion of all facets of projects from initiation through close out.

Minimum Requirements

  • High school diploma/GED and two (2) years experience in customer facing role or construction.
  • Must successfully complete training program in four (4) to six (6) months.

Preferred Special Skills, Knowledge or Qualifications: Computer skills:

  • Windows, Word Excel, CC&B, GIS, and work order management programs such as Maximo and Primavera.
  • Ability to understand and apply algebra and trigonometry formulas related to APS calculations.
  • Ability to assume project leadership and communicate effectively with customers.
  • Basic understanding of electrical theory, policies, procedures and rates.
  • Familiarity with customer construction standards and safety manual.
  • Effective communication and customer service skills.
  • Working knowledge of construction standards and practices, Electric Service Requirement Manual (ESRM) specifications, extension policy provisions, service plan rates, and types of construction materials utilized.
  • Fieldwork may constitute 50% or more of this job.

Major Accountabilities

1) Provide customer service and coordination for primary or service installation projects including upgrades, relocations, conversions, maintenance, street lights, dusk to dawn lights and new services. Entails planning, designing, scheduling, and coordinating all facets of the project from initiation through construction, energization, and close out

2) Determine the best source of APS power, the most cost-effective design, the usability of existing equipment based on load analysis and voltage drop calculations, and the adherence to required specifications, and request of the customer.

3) Effectively interface with customers and municipalities to assess their needs, determine the scope of the project, obtain plans/maps/drawings, and make key decision regarding the layout of APS facilities. Often, these decisions require consultation with our external customers and/or municipality liaison.

4) Evaluate the need to obtain easements from property owners and permits from municipal authorities; as necessary process through APS right of way to obtain required easement and permits documents.

5) Prepare work authorizations (WA) and job estimates. Determine and communicate customer charges required in advance of construction in accordance with APS extension policy or Municipality agreements. Prepare and present invoices to customers and manages scheduling to ensure monies collected prior to releasing jobs to crews. May prepare and communicate billing in compliance with APS policies and rates for street lighting and within the contractual limits of the APS and Municipality agreement.

6) Upon completion of preliminary work, release the project to construction and/or schedule the work with the Construction Coordinator, crews or other related contractors. Conduct inspection(s) of APS facilities prior to and upon completion of construction to ensure compliance with APS and safety code requirements.

7) Trouble shoot and resolve problems encountered throughout the project. Keep internal and external departments and agencies informed of activities that affect current and future facilities. May act as the control desk or initial intake and triage of all customers based on the requirements of the specific office.

8) May set up new accounts in Customer Care & Billing (CC&B) system, create orders for crews to run service lines, set meters, and locate APS facilities; field inspect new accounts; ensure the information in CC&B is updated appropriately. Update related databases and close out the project upon completion.

title: Systems Analyst
description:
The Homeland Sensors and Analytics Group designs, builds, and fields solutions that significantly enhance the tactical decision-making process of analysts and operators who secure the homeland. This includes security for critical infrastructure, land and maritime borders, transportation systems, and soft targets / crowded places. It also includes support for law enforcement, special operations, and intelligence analysts who track and disrupt transnational criminal and terrorist organizations. To do this, the group works on a combination of novel sensing technologies and data analytics techniques to provide better threat awareness to decision makers. The group designs systems that collect and process a wide range of data types — including radar, visible imagery and video, non-visible imagery, text, time-series data, and 3D point clouds — often applying advanced machine learning methods to convert raw data into actionable insights. The group places an emphasis on taking technology from the concept phase through deployment and transition to achieve operational impact.

Job Overview

MIT Lincoln Laboratory Technical Staff provide critical through expert multi-domain or new-domain innovative research supporting the Laboratory’s national security mission. They prototype state-of-the-art technology solutions and engage across the program lifecycle, leading projects or major/multiple technical workstreams in partnership with project, program and team/Group leaders. As a Technical Staff member, you will lead complex technical efforts requiring deep expertise, sound judgment, with the ability to successfully navigate technical complexity. Depending on the level, you will lead projects, major workstreams, complex programs, multi-program initiatives, or technical portfolios on extraordinary technology prototype efforts and creative new ideas and approaches that support critical mission needs. Depending on the level, you will translate broad Group strategy into clearly defined research or executional deliverables. Through integrating your deep technical expertise across disciplines, you consistently drive high-quality mission outcomes.

As a successful candidate, you will connect deep and diverse technical expertise with broader Laboratory objectives, perform independent research, develop creative approaches, and translate broad strategy into executable plans. You will work across or guide multidisciplinary teams through ambiguous trade-offs; helping develop and execute programs, creating briefings and reports, and often interfacing with sponsors. You effectively support sponsor, mission-partner, and Laboratory leadership’s needs through daily or weekly technical briefings, program documentation, proposals, and may conduct advanced capability road mapping and development. You will also guide and mentor Associate Technical Staff, Assistant Technical Staff, and other technical support personnel.

Additional Job Overview Details

The Homeland Sensors and Analytics group is seeking a candidate who will work on a broad range of problems related to homeland protection and national security missions. The core job is to apply technical subject matter expertise, clear analytical thinking skills, modeling and simulation, and data analysis to draw conclusions about the novel application of technologies. The conclusions may address performance assessment of existing technologies in new use cases, opportunities for the development of new technology solutions, or recommended systems and architectures for the operational deployment of new capabilities. The work will require an ability to understand a variety of sensing modalities (e.g., electro-optical, radar), platforms (e.g., airborne, maritime), and data exploitation techniques (e.g., AI/machine learning, tracking, data fusion) that will factor into the solutions being analyzed. Selected candidates will have an opportunity to work in a highly collaborative environment with experts across different technical fields, acquire new knowledge about mission-relevant problems and potential solutions, and produce analysis results that are impactful for national security.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead projects, complex programs, major technical workstreams, multi-program initiatives, or technical portfolios involving multidisciplinary development, analysis, prototyping, integration, testing, evaluation, and technology transition.
  • Apply deep technical expertise and systems-level judgment to highly complex and ambiguous problems, evaluating alternatives, trade-offs, risks, stakeholder needs, and mission implications.
  • Translate broad or unclear objectives into actionable technical plans and influence program direction, architectures, systems, priorities, and roadmaps across teams, Groups, or mission areas.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, sponsors, mission partners, and internal leaders to align priorities, resolve dependencies, and guide decisions and deliverables.
  • Assess and improve technical tools, processes, methods, documentation, execution practices, and organizational capability.
  • Serve as a technical resource and mentor by reviewing work, framing trade-offs and risks, and developing staff and emerging leaders.
  • Contribute substantially to papers, reports, presentations, proposals, grants, roadmaps, and other materials that advance mission outcomes and technical direction.

Minimum Qualifications

Candidates will be considered for the appropriate level based on their education, experience, demonstrated technical expertise and breadth, leadership responsibilities, and the scale and complexity of programs or technical efforts they have led.

Level 5 – Technical Staff

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline or other relevant technical field and typically 6+ years of relevant experience; or Master’s degree and typically 4+ years of relevant experience; or PhD and typically 0+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Diverse technical expertise with demonstrated ability to adapt that expertise to unfamiliar or emerging disciplines, systems, mission areas, or methods.
  • Established education, skills, and experience demonstrating the ability to apply significant technical judgment to broad challenges requiring integration across related systems or methods.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects or major workstreams and deliver complex technical outcomes.
  • Experience evaluating trade-offs, recommending paths forward, and adapting technical approaches to evolving project needs.
  • Demonstrated mentorship, collaboration, and ability to communicate recommendations, risks, and technical findings to varied audiences.
  • Experience contributing to technical reports, papers, presentations, proposals, or other formal technical deliverables.

Level 6 – Technical Staff

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline or other relevant technical field and typically 8+ years of relevant experience; or Master’s degree and typically 6+ years of relevant experience; or PhD and typically 2+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Deep and diverse technical expertise with demonstrated ability to integrate knowledge across domains and establish direction in evolving systems or mission areas.
  • Established education, skills, and experience demonstrating the ability to incorporate technical judgment, program context, and stakeholder input to solve broad technical challenges.
  • Proven experience leading complex programs, significant program elements, or multi-team technical efforts.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate alternatives, manage technical ambiguity, and influence decisions across teams or stakeholder groups.
  • Strong record of mentorship, collaboration, technical communication, and contribution to team or Group capability development.
  • Experience contributing to proposals, publications, technical reports, presentations, or other materials that shape program direction or technical initiatives.

Additional Minimum Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in computer science, mathematics, statistics, electrical engineering, information science, applied mathematics, data science, or an equivalent field. In lieu of a Ph.D., a Masters with at least 4 years of directly related experience will be considered.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technical areas and apply that knowledge effectively to solve challenging mission problems.
  • Knowledge to develop, implement, test, and evaluate novel algorithms and concepts.
  • The candidate must work both in a team-oriented environment and independently.
  • The candidate must have excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly share technical concepts with a wide spectrum of audiences.
  • Proficient at high-level prototyping software languages (e.g., Python)

Experience in one of more of the following areas is desired

  • AI/ machine learning
  • RF system design and/or testing
  • Signal processing
  • Communication systems
  • Statistical models

Technical Staff 5 Hiring Range: $140,000 - $187,000

title: CT Journey Worker
description:
Puget Sound Energy is looking to grow our community with top talented individuals like you! With our rapidly growing, award winning energy efficiency programs, our pathway to an exciting and innovative future is now.

PSE's Generation & Natural Gas Storage team is looking for qualified candidates to fill an open CT Journey Worker position!


Specific details regarding the work arrangements for this position will be discussed in further detail during the interview process.

Job Description

Puget Sound Energy is looking for a Combustion Turbine Journey Worker (CTJW) to join the team at our Goldendale Generating Station. This is a combined-cycle facility that is rated to produce 315 MW of power when operating at maximum capacity. A qualified CT Journey Worker operates mobile equipment, tools, computer systems, as well as performs similar and incidental duties as required. All CT Journey Workers are required to complete site qualifications toward becoming a plant operator. This position responds to plant emergencies and contains some irregular work schedules and overtime.

This position is located at our Goldendale Generating Station! Goldendale is located in South Central Washington and is framed by Mount Adams as well as Eastern Columbia River Gorge. There is an abundance of outdoor activities as well as museums and cultural activities all located within close proximity to larger metropolitan areas.

A CTJW is a journeyman level position working in operations or maintenance as required by the plant. Specific details regarding the work arrangements for this position will be discussed in further detail during the interview process.

This job is considered “safety sensitive” as defined in RCW 49.44.240 and is subject to pre-employment drug screening that includes screening for the presence of marijuana and marijuana metabolites.

Job Responsibilities

  • Operate, inspect, and maintain generation plant electrical and mechanical equipment, especially as it applies to combustion turbines, steam turbines, pumps, motors, valves, cooling systems, hydraulics, lubrication systems, HVAC, chemical pumps, and plant support systems.
  • Operate and maintain mobile equipment, tools, computer systems, and site tools.
  • Utilize organizational and communication skills to communicate effectively with Company personnel, Service Providers, Contractors, City, State and Federal agencies and the public when applicable.
  • Attend training sessions and successfully complete formal training as required by the company.
  • Comply with all Company standards, policies, practices, procedures and State and Federal regulations as they pertain to the job.
  • Perform similar and incidental duties as required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Candidate must have completed a recognized combustion turbine apprenticeship program or its equivalent and be proficient in using the tools and equipment of the trade as related to combustion turbine work.
  • Must have ability to communicate effectively with others.
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license.
  • This position requires the employee to obtain and maintain a First Aid, CPR and AED Certificate, and lift truck certification.
  • Employees must have a working knowledge and comply with all Company standards, policies, practices, procedures and State and Federal regulations as they pertain to the job.

Desired Qualifications

Additional Information

The duties and responsibilities are generally performed in both indoor and outdoor environments. The position generally involves sitting, standing, walking, moderate to heavy lifting, moderate carrying, bending, reaching, kneeling, twisting, balancing and climbing, operation of light equipment, tools and machinery and operation of heavy equipment and machinery.

Performance of the position requires working in varied outdoor environments such as all weather conditions, all noise levels, hazardous conditions and on the full range of outdoor work surfaces. The use of protective clothing and safety devices is required.

May require driving of automobiles/vans/trucks.

At PSE, we value our employees and provide them with opportunities to excel. We offer a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package. To learn more about why PSE is a great place to work, see our Employee Value Proposition, which highlights our commitment to employee growth, work-life balance, and meaningful career opportunities in the energy sector.

The pay range for this position is $74.10 - $74.10, and this position is eligible for annual goals based incentive bonuses.

PSE offers a suite of benefits to our employees. Employees are eligible for medical, dental, vision, basic life, and short- and long-term disability insurance. There are additional voluntary options of supplemental life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, flexible spending accounts for health care and dependent daycare, and an Employee assistance program (EAP). For long term savings, PSE offers a 401(k) investment option and a cash balance retirement plan. Employees will also receive Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays throughout the calendar year. Detailed benefit overviews can be found on our Career page - Why Work For Us (pse.com).

Our steadfast commitment to serving Washington communities with safe, dependable and efficient energy started in 1873. Today we're building the Northwest's energy future through efforts like our award winning energy efficiency programs and our leadership in renewable energy.

title: Sovellustuen asiantuntija, Insta Advance
description:
Haluatko työskennellä Windows-ympäristöjen parissa ja kehittää osaamistasi teknisesti erityislaatuisissa ratkaisuissa? Etsimme nyt Insta Advancelle sovellustuen asiantuntijaa pitkäkestoisiin ja monipuolisiin IT-projekteihin.

Insta on turvallisen ja kestävän tulevaisuuden ratkaisija. Olemme edelläkävijä ja luotettava kumppani teollisuuden, puolustuksen, ohjelmistokonsultoinnin ja kyberturvallisuuden asiakkaillemme. Yhdistämällä huippuosaamisen ja älykkään teknologian kehitämme turvallisuutta ja suorituskykyä yhä nopeammin muuttuvassa digitalisoituvassa maailmassa. Ihmiset, osaaminen ja vastuullisuus ovat toimintakulttuurimme perusta.

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?
Sovellustuen asiantuntijana työskentelet Windows- ja sovellusympäristöjen parissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu sovellusten käyttöönottoja, asennuksia, päivityksiä, integraatioita ja konfigurointia sekä ympäristöjen ylläpitoa ja turvapäivityksiä. Työssä yhdistyvät olemassa olevien ympäristöjen ylläpito ja jatkokehittäminen sekä uusien ratkaisujen rakentaminen. Muutoksia testataan eri ympäristöissä ja samalla selvitetään niiden vaikutuksia muihin järjestelmiin, joten työpäivät vaihtelevat suunnitellun kehitystyön ja ylläpidollisten tehtävien välillä.

Työympäristö sisältää myös julkisesta internetistä erillään olevia verkkoja. Ympäristön erityispiirteiden vuoksi kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi, vaan pääset kasvattamaan osaamistasi työn kautta. Työskentelet tiiviisti muiden sovellustuen asiantuntijoiden, tietoliikenneasiantuntijoiden ja arkkitehdin kanssa, ja työnkuvaa voidaan painottaa jonkin verran oman osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

Työpisteesi sijaitsee joko Espoon Keilarannassa tai Tampereen Sarankulmassa, ja työ tehdään pääasiassa lähityönä Instan toimistolla. Työskentelyä on satunnaisesti myös asiakkaiden tiloissa, ja tehtävään voi sisältyä päivämatkoja Suomessa.

Etsimme tehtävään pitkäaikaista tekijää, jonka kanssa tavoitteena on rakentaa pysyvä ura Installa. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen, ja se solmitaan alkuun Biisonin kanssa. Olet alusta lähtien tärkeä osa Instan työyhteisöä ja tavoitteena onkin siirtyminen 9–12 kuukauden jälkeen Instan omaksi työntekijäksi.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
Sinulla on käytännön kokemusta Windows-ympäristöistä sekä sovellusten asentamisesta, päivittämisestä, käyttöönotosta, integroinnista, konfiguroinnista tai ylläpidosta. Etenkin työasemapuolen ymmärrys on eduksi, mutta myös Windows Server- tai domain controller -ympäristöistä hankittu kokemus antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis Windows-syväosaaja, vaan tärkeintä on hyvä tekninen perusosaaminen, käytännönläheinen työote ja kyky ottaa haltuun uusia järjestelmiä ja teknologioita. Eduksi katsomme Linux-osaamisen sekä osaamisen esimerkiksi tietoturvasta, käyttöjärjestelmien kovennuksista, automaatiosta tai skriptauksesta.

Soveltuva koulutus tai vastaava käytännön kokemuksen kautta kertynyt osaaminen antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan. Tehtävässä tarvitset sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista osaamista sekä hyvää kirjallista englannin kielen taitoa. Arvostamme lisäksi huolellista ja pitkäjänteistä työotetta, ongelmanratkaisukykyä sekä halua oppia uutta.

Tehtävään valittavalle henkilölle tullaan teettämään perusmuotoinen turvallisuusselvitys sisältäen ulkomaansidonnaisuuksien selvityksen.

Miksi meille?
Insta on suomalainen, pitkän historian omaava teknologiayhtiö, joka kehittää ratkaisuja teollisuuden, puolustuksen, ohjelmistokonsultoinnin ja kyberturvallisuuden tarpeisiin. Pitkäjänteinen tekeminen, asiakaslähtöisyys ja vahva suomalainen arvopohja näkyvät sekä tavassa tehdä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden kanssa että siinä, miten ihmisistä pidetään huolta arjessa.

Pääset työskentelemään pitkäaikaisissa asiakkuuksissa ja projekteissa, joissa rakennetaan aidosti merkityksellisiä ratkaisuja suomalaiselle puolustukselle. Työyhteisössä yhdistyvät korkea asiantuntijuus, osaavat kollegat ja matalan kynnyksen yhteistyö. Meillä luotetaan ihmisiin ja tarjotaan aktiivisesti mahdollisuuksia uuden oppimiseen ja osaamisen syventämiseen.

Tehtävän palkkahaarukka on alustavasti 4500–5500 euroa kuukaudessa, ja lopullinen palkka määritellään kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko?
Mikäli mielenkiintosi heräsi, haluamme ehdottomasti kuulla sinusta lisää! Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 26.11.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja valinta tehdään heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa, jonka kanssa työsuhde myös solmitaan. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Biisonin rekrytointikonsultti Nea Repo, nea.repo@biisoni.fi.

Huomioithan, että käsittelemme vain rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta tulleet hakemukset, emme ota hakemuksia vastaan sähköpostitse.

title: Associate, Orbital Academy
description:
Job title: Associate, Orbital Academy

Program: 6 month internship structured training – work and learn

(ideal for: fresh graduates / final year students; training stipend provided)

Interview day: 19 November 2026

About the Program

The Orbital AI Academy is a new, pioneering 6-month internship training program designed to build the next generation of AI-savvy talent inside TEAM LEWIS. We're recruiting curiously minded individuals to join a dedicated founding cohort in Singapore. This program will be working hands-on with Orbital, our global AI-powered marketing operating system. Orbital is designed to help shape how the marketing industry works.

This is a training-first program, not a standard entry-level job. You'll be learning, applying, and building in real time, supported by structured training and direct access to senior Orbital and commercial leaders throughout. Upon successful completion of the 6 months, high-performing Associates will have the opportunity to convert into a permanent role within the core business.

We're not looking for marketing or agency backgrounds. We're looking for people who are genuinely AI-savvy, curious, and excited by the idea of building something new from the ground up. Then growing with it.

The Program Structure

  • Training: A structured curriculum covering Orbital's full agent suite, AI fundamentals, and how AI is applied in a commercial, client-facing environment.

  • Applied Work: Hands-on execution across client materials, agent-run tasks, and new product testing - applying what you learn in real time.

  • Outcome: At the end of the 6 months, high-performing Associates will have the opportunity to convert into a permanent role within the core business.

Selection Process

  • Applications reviewed on a rolling basis.

  • As part of your application please submit a short recorded video introduction (3–5 minutes) covering who you are and why you want to be part of this program. Applications will be shortlisted based on video submissions before moving to the interview stage.

  • Interview Day: Thursday 19 November 2026 - shortlisted candidates will be invited to a single, dedicated in-person interview day in Singapore, designed around the kind of collaborative, hands-on working style used throughout the program.

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of the responsibilities for this role. Other responsibilities may be added from time to time.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Help build out client materials and profiles within Orbital, supporting teams across the business.
  • Run execution via Orbital's suite of AI agents (Scout, Ping, Coach, Prism, Editor, Presenter and more) across live client and internal work.
  • Test and feed back on new product builds as Orbital continues to evolve, directly shaping the tool's development.
  • Work closely with senior Orbital and client leads to understand how AI is applied in real client scenarios.
  • Be part of a pioneering team helping define new ways of working across the marketing industry.

Requirements

  • A genuine interest in and curiosity about AI - self-taught, experimented with AI tools, or simply fascinated by the space.
  • No marketing or agency experience required or expected - we want fresh perspectives and different skillsets.
  • Fast learner, comfortable with ambiguity, and energised by being part of something new and unproven.
  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to test, break, and improve new product builds.
  • Collaborative, proactive, and excited by the idea of being part of a "founding cohort" shaping how this program and Orbital evolve.

title: STUDENT-Library Access Services Student Assistant
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

As a library student employee, you will greet and assist library users and perform a variety of Library Access Services activities including:

  • Checking out, returning & reshelving materials
  • Troubleshooting and assisting with printing and computer questions
  • Retrieving and/or digitizing library materials
  • Assisting with stacks maintenance, archives, course readings or interlibrary loan tasks and projects


The library typically schedules student assistants in two-hour blocks. Students at the Library Access Services Desk work 8-12 hours per week on average. Every student employee is expected to collect library usage data at the beginning of each shift and check in for daily projects. Depending on timing, availability, and interest, some shifts may be designated as "Interlibrary Loan", "Stacks", or "Archives". These shifts are not desk oriented, are often project-based, and require a higher level of attention to detail/critical thinking. Student Assistants that have worked for a semester or more are eligible to apply to be a Library Student Manager.

SUPERVISION:
This position reports to Access Services Staff and indirectly Library Student Managers. This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities. This position pays $16/hr.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

  1. Routine desk duties, including, but not limited to, checking out and returning materials, placing recalls/holds, and utilizing library systems.
  1. Monitor and record building usage at the beginning of each scheduled shift.
  1. Provide a high level of customer service to patrons. Advise users of library policies or procedures; refer questions regarding overdue, lost items, fines, claims and returns to library staff when needed. Protect student and colleague privacy and confidentiality.
  1. Assist with the operation of printers and other technology located within the library; assist with paper jams; report any ongoing problems to Library Staff.
  1. Accept faculty course reading materials to be added to the personal course readings collection.
  1. Perform stacks related tasks including but not limited to: Tracing/searching for missing library materials, organizing and reshelving library materials, shelf-reading, and inventory.
  1. Facilitate interlibrary loan services by retrieving and scanning library materials and packing or unpacking or sorting mail when requested.
  1. Assist with Library College Archives as assigned
  1. Notify the Access Services Staff of any problems or suggestions related to policies, procedures, or building security.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Ithaca College Student; strong attention to detail, organizational, interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, working knowledge of personal computers. Candidates that can commit to 2 or more semesters are preferred. Experience working at a library or customer service desk preferred.

SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS FOR SPRING 2027:
This spring we are especially interested in candidates that can reliably work 11pm-2am shifts, weekends, or are interested in learning the more complicated and detailed processes of Interlibrary Loan. If this sounds like you, please explain your interest and what skills you could offer in your cover letter.

HOW TO APPLY:
Interested applicants must apply online at ithaca.edu/jobs and attach a resume and cover letter. Questions about online applications should be directed to the Office of Human Resources at humanresources@ithaca.edu.

title: Supervisor - Macquarie
description:
At Sephora, beauty is about feeling seen, valued, and empowered, individually and collectively. It is connecting deeply with others, celebrating diversity and inclusivity, unlocking your potential and making a difference every day. Together, we belong to something beautiful.

Be part of Sephora's management team at our Macquarie Centre store as a Supervisor (Senior Beauty Advisor), on a Full-Time basis. This is a pivotal role designed for experienced leaders. This is an exceptional opportunity for a boutique manager looking to make their way into large format stores within a global business. We are seeking individuals who are ready to bring their strategic vision, proven leadership, and passion for luxury retail to a leading global beauty retailer.

The Impact You'll Make:

As a Supervisor, you will play a critical role in shaping the client experience and leading a dynamic team. The scope, team size, and commercial exposure you will gain in this role are comparable to senior leadership positions in smaller retail brands. You will lead teams of 20+ beauty advisors, fostering a high-performance culture and ensuring operational excellence. This is ideal for Store Managers or Assistant Managers from smaller-format retailers looking to transition into a larger, high volume and premium retail environment.

You will be instrumental in:

  • Operational Command: Serving as the Client Experience Lead (CEL), confidently overseeing client and team matters within a fast-paced environment and making critical store decisions.

In this role, you will gain exposure across all our categories - beauty, skincare, haircare, and wellness - along with comprehensive involvement in sales management and back-of-house operations. You will receive extensive initial onboarding training and continuous professional development through our unique online learning platform and field trainers. As part of Sephora and the LVMH community, your options for career growth within our global group of high-end luxury brands are endless.

We are looking for leaders who:

  • Possess extensive retail management experience, including managing profit and loss, sales forecasting, people management and training, stock control, and visual merchandising.

  • Are available to work a rotating roster that supports store needs, including key trading times such as late nights, weekends, and public holidays (our busiest days are Thursday to Sunday).

The Perks:

title: EM, DDAI Strategy & Performance Intelligence

Why join us?
We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:

You will take ownership of customer reactivation, repeat transactions, and revenue recovery while remaining actively involved in outbound customer engagement. Combining hands-on leadership with strategic campaign management, you will develop effective retention processes, coach team members, and continuously improve customer conversion rates.   • Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage.

title: Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join our engineering team responsible for building and maintaining both consumer-facing and internal back-office applications. In this role, you will develop scalable, high-performance systems that support Kashable’s consumer lending and employee benefits platform. This position involves working across the full technology stack—including backend Java development, database design, cloud and SaaS integrations, ETL processes, and modern front-end frameworks—while collaborating closely with senior engineers and cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate brings strong experience building large-scale enterprise applications, a solid understanding of object-oriented design and software development best practices, and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality code in a fast-paced, agile environment.

  • Work across multiple layers of product infrastructure, including relational database development, low-level protocol integrations, ETL operations and automation, SaaS/PaaS cloud integrations, and frontend development. Thus, a commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and product quality is essential
  • Execute architectural designs from Senior Engineers by writing efficient, reusable, and reliable source code in Java -- and other languages where applicable, e.g., SQL for RDBMS development

Required Skills & Abilities

  • Solid understanding of OOP concepts and various design/programming patterns, including concurrency patterns
  • Familiarity with Java Streams and Optional
  • Familiarity with concepts of MVC, JDBC, CRUD/REST, and multi-tier architecture

  • Familiarity with Spring and Hibernate
  • Familiarity with build tools such as Ant, Maven, and/or Gradle

title: AI Solutions Senior Manager
description:
The AI Solutions Senior Manager will lead the design and delivery of AI solutions across our global retail business. Based in Singapore, this role will work with business, technology, data, and security teams across regions to turn high-value opportunities into solutions that improve customer experience, employee productivity, and operational performance.

The successful candidate will combine hands-on knowledge of AI with strong delivery leadership. They will help teams choose the right approach, move solutions from pilot to production, and measure whether those solutions deliver meaningful results.

Key responsibilities

  • Partner with global and regional leaders to identify, assess, and prioritize AI opportunities across commerce, stores, customer service, supply chain, and corporate functions.
  • Lead AI initiatives from discovery and business case through solution design, implementation, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
  • Design solutions that bring together enterprise data, applications, AI models, and user workflows, working closely with architecture and engineering teams.
  • Guide the use of generative AI, AI agents, predictive models, and automation where each is appropriate for the business need.
  • Establish practical standards for solution quality, evaluation, monitoring, security, privacy, and responsible AI in partnership with the relevant governance teams.
  • Manage delivery partners and technology vendors, including solution assessments, implementation plans, performance, and costs.
  • Work across regional time zones and business cultures to align global capabilities with local market needs.
  • Define success measures for each initiative, track adoption and business outcomes, and share progress with senior stakeholders.
  • Develop and coach team members while building AI delivery skills across the broader organization.

Qualifications and experience

  • Significant experience delivering enterprise technology solutions, including several years leading AI, data, or advanced automation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success taking AI solutions beyond proof of concept into reliable production use.
  • Working knowledge of generative AI, large language models, AI agents, data platforms, APIs, cloud services, and the practices needed to operate AI solutions at scale.
  • Experience integrating new capabilities with existing enterprise systems and business processes.
  • Strong judgment in assessing value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and total cost of ownership.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical choices and business outcomes to senior leaders.
  • Experience in retail, consumer brands, or another customer-facing global business is preferred.

title: Data Scientist, AI
description:
Volta Software is seeking an Applied Data Scientist to measure and improve the accuracy of its AI system across real purchase orders. You will build evaluation harnesses, perform error analysis, and enhance retrieval and extraction from complex documents.

You will work with Python, Pandas/Polars, and LLM APIs to turn varied data sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets) into clean, structured order lines, with rigorous per-field metrics and CI-integrated tests. Hybrid Milan/Paris location preferred.

Own the accuracy number across customers, per field, per release. Build evaluation harnesses and CI-integrated tests for regression protection. Improve product and customer matching using Elasticsearch-based retrieval. Turn emails, PDFs, and spreadsheets into clean order lines with prompts and schemas. Perform rigorous error analysis to identify root causes and fixes and verify in production. Turn customer fixes into reusable templates and configurations by industry. 3+ years shipping ML or NLP to production. Strong Python, pandas or polars and testing habits. Hands-on with LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic or similar). Evaluation datasets and metrics (precision/recall, per-field accuracy, confidence calibration). Search and retrieval (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, BM25, embeddings, reranking). Solid SQL. Fluent English; French or Italian. Nice to have: GCP (Cloud Run, Vertex AI); LLM tracing/evaluation tooling.

title: Customer Retention Supervisor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Retention Supervisor based in France.

Are you an experienced customer retention leader passionate about building high-performing teams and driving measurable business growth? This opportunity allows you to lead and develop a team of retention specialists within the fast-growing fintech and cryptocurrency industry. You will take ownership of customer reactivation, repeat transactions, and revenue recovery while remaining actively involved in outbound customer engagement. Combining hands-on leadership with strategic campaign management, you will develop effective retention processes, coach team members, and continuously improve customer conversion rates. Working in a dynamic, performance-driven environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen customer relationships and maximise business results. This is an ideal role for a proactive leader who enjoys mentoring people, analysing performance, and turning customer engagement strategies into tangible revenue.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead, supervise, and motivate a team of Customer Retention Specialists, establishing clear performance objectives, responsibilities, and accountability standards.
  • Conduct outbound customer calls personally to encourage repeat transactions, reconnect with inactive customers, and demonstrate effective retention techniques by example.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), calling workflows, scripts, and training materials to strengthen team performance.
  • Organise daily outreach activities, manage agent schedules, and allocate campaign assignments to ensure efficient customer engagement.
  • Design and execute customer retention campaigns, including promotional offers, discount incentives, abandoned transaction follow-ups, and reactivation initiatives.
  • Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), including call volumes, conversion rates, repeat transactions, customer reactivation rates, and revenue recovered.
  • Conduct regular call evaluations, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen agents' communication and sales skills.
  • Analyse customer behaviour, transaction activity, and campaign performance to identify retention opportunities and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Maintain accurate customer relationship management (CRM) records, agent scorecards, performance dashboards, and regular operational reports.
  • Manage escalated customer concerns and collaborate with Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effective issue resolution.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and training initiatives to build and maintain a capable, results-oriented retention team.
  • Use relevant digital and AI-powered tools to improve research, script development, workflow efficiency, and overall team productivity.

Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in customer retention, outbound sales, contact centre operations, or a similar customer-facing environment.
  • Demonstrated success in customer conversion, retention, and reactivation, with experience managing performance-driven teams and achieving measurable commercial results.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate teams, manage performance, and encourage continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, particularly when engaging customers over the phone.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable improvement plans.
  • Ability to balance direct customer engagement with team supervision and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards.
  • Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage.

  • Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location.

title: AI Delivery Manager [CCP for ICT Professionals (Strategy and Governance)]
description:
About Dayos
Dayos is the AI-first version of the systems integrators and application management firms that have supported enterprise ERPs for decades. We're building this company in Singapore, for the long term.

Hero, our platform, doesn't just watch your systems. It logs in, does the work, and validates the output inside Oracle, Workday and SAP. At a Singapore enterprise, Hero closed 9 of 10 support tickets that had been open for an average of three weeks, taking roughly 10 minutes per request.

Every company in the world runs Oracle, Workday or SAP, and many run more than one. Yet no school teaches students how to implement and manage them, and fewer people do this work every year. That gap is what we're built to close.

Enterprises spend billions every year supporting these systems, and much of that work is still manual. Three years building Hero. Enterprise customers already in production. Now we're closing our seed round and building the Singapore go-to-market team from the ground up.

Why Join Us?
We're creating a new category of delivery leadership—one that blends customer onboarding, agile execution, and success storytelling in a single role. If you want to lead programs that actually deliver results (not get handed off between departments), this is your opportunity.

What You Will Do
As an AI Delivery Manager, you will:
- Formulate and embed Agile coaching frameworks tailored to AI delivery projects, guiding internal teams (Product, Engineering, Delivery) in adopting Agile principles and practices.
- Provide hands-on coaching to strengthen sprint planning, backlog management, and cross-functional collaboration, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability across enterprise AI solution deployments.
- Adapt delivery plans to customer business changes – Stay responsive when customer priorities shift due to leadership changes, project reprioritization, or resource constraints.
- Understand the customer's business landscape – During onboarding, identify industry-specific constraints or regulations (e.g., data residency in financial services or compliance in public sector) that could impact delivery. Use this knowledge to shape realistic delivery plans and stakeholder communication.
- Spot new opportunities during delivery – Identify high-impact areas for additional automation or AI tooling as project unfold.
- Contribute to customer success storytelling – After successful go-lives, gather measurable outcomes and turn them into case studies or internal references, in collaboration with Marketing.
- Translate business requirements into structured onboarding plans with measurable KPIs.
- Align internal teams (Product, Engineering, GTM) and external stakeholders around a single delivery plan with clearly documented milestones.
- Bridge sales intent and engineering output by ensuring all delivery aligns to customer-specified requirements.
- Track IT risks and unblock delivery issues – Proactively flag potential blockers, document them, and work with Sales or Engineering to keep timelines on track.
- Manage customer transitions through change – Guide stakeholders through delivery phases with clear communication, documentation, and user education.
- Implement data analytics processes to capture and interpret delivery performance, AI adoption rates, and customer usage trends across enterprise SaaS integrations.
- Transform data insights into dynamic dashboards and interactive visualisations using tools such as Power BI and Notion.
- Track ERP/HCM AI tooling developments – Stay current on emerging enterprise AI capabilities (e.g., automated reconciliations, intelligent routing, predictive analytics) and apply user-centered thinking to design onboarding journeys and post-launch adoption strategies that improve customer enablement and long-term success.
- Support customer and team readiness through structured learning moments – Share onboarding insights, update delivery playbooks, and mentor new team members on our implementation lifecycle.
- Collaborates with internal teams to anticipate resourcing needs for upcoming customer programs.
- Builds partnerships and client rapport during onboarding and ongoing program collaboration.
- Evaluate organisational structures, resource availability, and decision-making processes to identify factors that may impact delivery performance and use these insights to adjust stakeholder engagement approaches, documentation cadence and delivery workflows
- Continuously improve delivery workflows – Conduct retrospectives and co-develop delivery processes that improve efficiency, eliminate friction, and drive measurable value.
- Contributes to refining delivery frameworks and feedback loops that support scalable team operations.
- Monitor individual program performance and delivery health using Agile metrics and practices - Track key performance indicators across projects to ensure milestones are being met, and identify coaching needs or resource misalignments.
- Owns planning, coordination, and end-to-end delivery of AI implementation milestones.
- Adjust stakeholder engagement and documentation cadence based on the customer's reporting structure and operational bandwidth
- Executes structured onboarding, delivery, and storytelling workflows aligned with Dayos GTM strategy.

Who You Are
We're looking for mid-career professionals with a strong interest in customer engagement, delivery execution, and process innovation.
Minimum Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, account coordination, or project support
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Ability to work cross-functionally and manage competing priorities
- Strong interest in enterprise platforms, AI solutions, and agile execution
- Singapore Citizen or PR, with full-time employment commitment (min. 12 months)
Bonus If You Have:
- Exposure to SaaS, ERP, HCM, or enterprise support environments
- Familiarity with Agile, design thinking, or customer onboarding
- Experience using Power BI, Notion, or customer success tools

You will be trained and mentored across
- Business Needs & Requirements Mapping
- Change Management & Strategy Implementation
- Process Improvement & Performance Tracking

What You Will Learn
- Business Innovation & Emerging Technology Awareness
- Data Analytics & Visualization
- Stakeholder & Partnership Management
- Design Thinking & Customer Journey Design
- Business Environment & Organisational Analysis
- Agile Project Management

What We Offer
- Structured Training – Learn on the job with guidance from senior delivery and product leaders
- Career Repositioning – Transition into a high-demand field without prior experience in technical delivery
- Global Collaboration – Work with teams in Singapore, Sydney, Budapest, São Paulo, and across the U.S.
- Fast Career Progression – Grow into leadership roles as we expand our AI-powered services
- Remote-First with Co-Working Stipend – Work from anywhere, but stay connected and supported
- Purpose-Driven Impact – Own end-to-end programs that result in real business transformation

Compensation and Benefits
- Base salary. S$5,600 per month, S$67,200 per year, plus bonuses
- Career growth. Grow into leadership roles as we expand
- Leave. Unlimited PTO, plus Singapore public holidays
- Medical. Comprehensive coverage included
- CPF. Contributions for eligible employees
- Global exposure. Customers across Southeast Asia, North America and Europe
- Equipment. Whatever you need to do the job well

Requirements

Job Overview & Responsibilities

As a Propulsion Structural Analysis Team Lead who has ownership over technical scope assigned to the team, job responsibilities include the following:

  • Candidate will lead a team of analysts through Vulcan Development activities, including Centaur V on SLS in support of Artemis and Upper Stage Advancement long-duration capabilities
  • Candidate will act in an analysis SME (Subject Matter Expert) role to lead the team through complex structural analysis problems where solutions require significant cross-discipline coordination and creative thinking
  • Candidate will support propulsion and mechanical analysis, system integration, project management, and anomaly resolution
  • Candidate will lead the team in advanced strength, fatigue, and fracture analyses of structural components, including nonlinear analyses
  • Candidate will perform self-guided work, with focus on helping the team resolve analysis challenges and developing new analysis tools/methodologies/processes to drive long-term organizational improvements
  • Candidate will help build the capabilities of lower-level engineers in order to strengthen the enterprise expertise through knowledge transfer, mentoring, and formal training

  • Candidate will make engineering design recommendations with consideration of thermal, mechanical, and pressure loading using appropriate material properties, configurations, safety factors, etc.
  • Candidate will drive internal peer reviews, tabletop reviews, and formal design reviews as needed
  • Candidate will interact with key suppliers, working to ensure that their analysis products are conducive to contracted efforts and that there are seamless transitions among analyses products used for verifications
  • Candidate will support fast-paced design/analysis cycles and evaluate hardware nonconformances to support production activities
  • Candidate will assist the team in creating analysis automation tools

Bachelor

Required Years of Experience

Minimum of 8 years of related work experience

  • 3+ years of experience serving in a lead role for an analysis team where large program objectives were supported directly
  • Ability to make design recommendations based on first-order analysis results and engineering judgement/experience
  • Ability to resolve technical issues, leveraging all available analysis tools and methodologies
  • Ability to make design recommendations based on analysis results/experience
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Agile tools, including Jira

  • Experience developing tools for analyzing propulsion systems including tubing, ducting, bellows, and supplier components
  • Understanding of fatigue/fracture analysis methodology and the ability to develop tools that facilitate this analysis
  • Understanding of bolted joint analysis and modeling and the ability to develop tools that facilitate this analysis
  • Understanding of GD&T standards and principles
  • Understanding of analysis best practices and underlying assumptions, along with the ability to establish these standards for the team
  • Understanding of basic hand calculations
  • Experience resolving hardware nonconformances
  • Familiarity with the following tools/software:
    • Nastran (static, modal, dynamic and nonlinear analysis solutions)
    • Femap pre-/post-processor

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with component suppliers to drive requirements for component development and qualification
  • Experience running/creating analysis automation and pre- and post-processing scripts using the following tools:

  • Experience leading structural optimization techniques for mass savings
  • Experience integrating with system-level analysis models (e.g. coupled loads models)
  • Experience with NASA man-rating analysis and qualification requirements, including but not limited to NASA-STD-5019 and NASA-STD-5001
  • General knowledge of fabrication methods for mechanical hardware, such as machining, welding, processing and assembly
  • Familiarity with mechanical support equipment
  • Familiarity with composite structural analysis
  • Experience leading analysis efforts that support cross-functional teams

title: Data Analysts
description:
The Homeland Decision Support Systems Group focuses on end-to-end system architectures design, decision support, and advanced analytics to enhance the protection of the homeland and U.S. interests overseas. In collaboration with industry and academia, we are working at the frontiers of AI to develop and integrate advanced decision support prototypes that can address national security needs in the land, sea, air, and space domains. We have deployed real-time enterprise and edge solutions that support the warfighters at multiple Combatant Commands across the globe, providing a measurable impact to their missions. Our technical expertise spans deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, graph theory, big data architectures, operations research, and system autonomy. Our goal is to enhance national security by leading the nation in developing and deploying advanced decision support systems utilizing cutting edge AI and machine learning technologies.

Job Overview

MIT Lincoln Laboratory Assistant Staff provide critical support for domain-level innovative research supporting the Laboratory’s national security mission. They prototype state-of-the-art technology solutions and engage in many steps of a program lifecycle. As an Assistant Staff member, you will work with multidisciplinary project teams assisting with solutions to complex to moderately complex problems through research and technology development activities. In this highly contributory role, you will develop and grow your understanding of the Laboratory and the work we do for our research sponsors and on behalf of the nation while taking on defined research and technical assignments. Depending on the level, you will complete clearly scoped assignments with guidance or apply established methods with limited oversight while taking greater ownership of defined technical work.

As a successful candidate, you will bring a strong technical foundation, curiosity, and an aptitude for technical growth. You will develop or deepen expertise within a primary technical domain, broaden your awareness of adjacent areas, and support activities such as hardware and software development, systems analysis, data analysis, component fabrication, system integration, testing, and documentation.

Additional Job Overview Details

Our group is seeking highly motivated entry level scientists, data analysts and engineers who are interested in solving challenging technical problems that make a difference in the real world. Typical activities for our analysts include data analysis, modeling and algorithm development while working as part of an interdisciplinary team. In this role, the candidate will help to develop/implement techniques for analysis of varied data sets, implement leading edge data processing and algorithms from academia, and work within our team to develop concepts that address national security challenges. The candidate will work with an experienced team to learn about the homeland protection mission and to develop a career path matching their technical interests.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Support design, development, data analysis, programming, testing, troubleshooting, modeling, simulation, and documentation of systems or prototypes.
  • Apply basic or established technical practices, tools, and procedures to complete defined tasks and solve routine technical problems.
  • Contribute to data collection, documentation, and component- or subsystem-level deliverables supporting broader research and mission-focused efforts.
  • Learn and apply relevant mission context, technical standards, systems, platforms, and project processes.
  • Communicate progress, technical results, assumptions, risks, and questions clearly and incorporate feedback into technical work products.
  • Depending on level, identify small process improvements and assist new hires, interns, or less experienced staff.

Minimum Qualifications

Candidates will be considered for the appropriate level based on their education, experience, demonstrated technical capabilities, and the scope and complexity of their prior work.

Level 1 – Assistant Staff

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline or other relevant technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Typically, no technical experience or relevant research experience required.
  • Foundational understanding of research principles, analytical methods, and structured problem solving.
  • Ability to learn and apply technical tools, systems, standards, and procedures within a team environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document work clearly, ask clarifying questions, and interact respectfully with colleagues, sponsors, and other stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated collaboration, curiosity, attention to detail, and willingness to receive and apply feedback.

Level 2 – Assistant Staff

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline or other relevant technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Typically, 1+ years of relevant research, engineering, or other technical experience; a Master’s degree may be considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply concepts and technical methods to routine problems.
  • Working knowledge of relevant tools, systems, standards, and documentation practices used in project execution.
  • Ability to complete assigned tasks accurately, manage time effectively, and communicate progress and risks.
  • Collaborative working style with an emerging ability to support others, contribute to team learning, and interact respectfully with colleagues, sponsors, and other stakeholders.

Additional Minimum Qualifications

  • Data analysis skills, including: exploratory analysis, clean, organize, analyze to extract information, find trends/anomalies, synthesize/visualize results
  • Basic statistical and mathematical data manipulation knowledge
  • Proficient with MATLAB, Python, or similar programming language
  • Willing to acquire new skills
  • Attention to detail and ability to manage priorities
  • Ability to develop, implement, test and evaluate novel algorithms and concepts

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong presentation skills a plus
  • Working well in a multi-disciplinary team environment
  • Experience with large, complex multidimensional data handling a plus
  • Experience with software development and source control management tools like GitHub a plus
  • Experience working with various computer OS (Windows/Linux/Unix) a plus

Ihmiset, osaaminen ja vastuullisuus ovat toimintakulttuurimme perusta.

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?
Arkkitehtina tehtäväsi on suunnitella ja ohjata teknistä tekemistä sekä huolehtia kokonaisuuden hallitusta etenemisestä. Ohjaat noin 5–10 hengen asiantuntijajoukon tekemistä, priorisoit tehtäviä ja seuraat teknisten suunnitelmien etenemistä. Pidät kokonaisuuden hallinnassa myös tarpeiden muuttuessa ja arvioit yhdessä asiantuntijoiden kanssa, mihin asioihin kulloinkin keskitytään.

Roolissa yhdistyvät tekninen kokonaisymmärrys, tekemisen suunnittelu ja eri asiantuntijoiden työn yhteensovittaminen. Työskentelet tiiviisti projektipäällikön sekä muun muassa sovellustuen, tietoliikenteen ja muiden teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Lisäksi teet yhteistyötä asiakkaan keskeisten yhteyshenkilöiden kanssa ja viet teknistä kokonaisuutta eteenpäin yhdessä heidän kanssaan.

Projektit ovat luonteeltaan pitkäkestoisia, teknisesti monipuolisia ja ympäristöiltään infrapainotteisia. Työssä pääset tutustumaan laajasti erilaisiin teknologioihin ja kokonaisuuksiin.

Työpisteesi sijaitsee joko Espoon Keilarannassa tai Tampereen Sarankulmassa, ja työ tehdään pääasiassa lähityönä Instan toimistolla. Työskentelyä on satunnaisesti myös asiakkaiden tiloissa, ja tehtävään voi sisältyä päivämatkoja Suomessa.

Etsimme tehtävään pitkäaikaista tekijää, jonka kanssa tavoitteena on rakentaa pysyvä ura Installa. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen, ja se solmitaan alkuun Biisonin kanssa. Olet alusta lähtien tärkeä osa Instan työyhteisöä ja tavoitteena onkin siirtyminen 9–12 kuukauden jälkeen Instan omaksi työntekijäksi.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
Sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta teknisen työn tai asiantuntijoiden tekemisen ohjaamisesta sekä vahva tekninen kokonaisymmärrys. Pystyt hahmottamaan laajoja teknisiä kokonaisuuksia, priorisoimaan tekemistä ja pitämään kokonaisuuden hallinnassa myös tilanteiden ja tarpeiden muuttuessa. Taustasi voi olla esimerkiksi teknisen projektipäällikön tai arkkitehdin roolista, mutta rooli voi sopia hyvin myös kokeneelle tekniselle asiantuntijalle, joka haluaa siirtyä omalla urallaan enemmän kokonaisuuksien hallinnan suuntaan.

Tekninen osaamisesi voi painottua esimerkiksi virtualisointiin, käyttöjärjestelmiin, tietoliikenteeseen ja verkkoihin, tietoturvaan tai IT-ympäristöjen ylläpitoon. Emme odota sinun olevan kaikkien näiden alueiden syväosaaja, vaan riittää, että sinulla on vahvaa ymmärrystä yhdestä tai useammasta osa-alueesta ja kyky omaksua uusia teknisiä kokonaisuuksia.

Koulutustaustaa tärkeämpää ovat osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi, mutta soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto katsotaan eduksi. Tehtävässä tarvitaan sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista osaamista sekä hyvää kirjallista englannin kielen taitoa. Arvostamme lisäksi hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä rauhallista ja pitkäjänteistä työotetta.

Tehtävään valittavalle henkilölle tullaan teettämään perusmuotoinen turvallisuusselvitys sisältäen ulkomaansidonnaisuuksien selvityksen.

Miksi meille?
Insta on suomalainen, pitkän historian omaava teknologiayhtiö, joka kehittää ratkaisuja teollisuuden, puolustuksen, ohjelmistokonsultoinnin ja kyberturvallisuuden tarpeisiin. Pitkäjänteinen tekeminen, asiakaslähtöisyys ja vahva suomalainen arvopohja näkyvät sekä tavassa tehdä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden kanssa että siinä, miten ihmisistä pidetään huolta arjessa.

Pääset työskentelemään pitkäaikaisissa asiakkuuksissa ja projekteissa, joissa rakennetaan aidosti merkityksellisiä ratkaisuja suomalaiselle puolustukselle. Työyhteisössä yhdistyvät korkea asiantuntijuus, osaavat kollegat ja matalan kynnyksen yhteistyö. Meillä luotetaan ihmisiin ja tarjotaan aktiivisesti mahdollisuuksia uuden oppimiseen ja osaamisen syventämiseen.

Tehtävän palkkahaarukka on alustavasti 5000–6000 euroa kuukaudessa, ja lopullinen palkka määritellään kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko?
Mikäli mielenkiintosi heräsi, haluamme ehdottomasti kuulla sinusta lisää! Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 26.11.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja valinta tehdään heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa, jonka kanssa työsuhde myös solmitaan. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Biisonin rekrytointikonsultti Nea Repo, nea.repo@biisoni.fi.

Huomioithan, että käsittelemme vain rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta tulleet hakemukset, emme ota hakemuksia vastaan sähköpostitse.

title: Customer Retention Supervisor
description:

Are you an experienced customer retention leader passionate about building high-performing teams and driving measurable business growth? This opportunity allows you to lead and develop a team of retention specialists within the fast-growing fintech and cryptocurrency industry. You will take ownership of customer reactivation, repeat transactions, and revenue recovery while remaining actively involved in outbound customer engagement. Combining hands-on leadership with strategic campaign management, you will develop effective retention processes, coach team members, and continuously improve customer conversion rates. Working in a dynamic, performance-driven environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen customer relationships and maximise business results. This is an ideal role for a proactive leader who enjoys mentoring people, analysing performance, and turning customer engagement strategies into tangible revenue.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead, supervise, and motivate a team of Customer Retention Specialists, establishing clear performance objectives, responsibilities, and accountability standards.
  • Conduct outbound customer calls personally to encourage repeat transactions, reconnect with inactive customers, and demonstrate effective retention techniques by example.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), calling workflows, scripts, and training materials to strengthen team performance.
  • Organise daily outreach activities, manage agent schedules, and allocate campaign assignments to ensure efficient customer engagement.
  • Design and execute customer retention campaigns, including promotional offers, discount incentives, abandoned transaction follow-ups, and reactivation initiatives.
  • Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), including call volumes, conversion rates, repeat transactions, customer reactivation rates, and revenue recovered.
  • Conduct regular call evaluations, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen agents' communication and sales skills.
  • Analyse customer behaviour, transaction activity, and campaign performance to identify retention opportunities and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Maintain accurate customer relationship management (CRM) records, agent scorecards, performance dashboards, and regular operational reports.
  • Manage escalated customer concerns and collaborate with Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effective issue resolution.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and training initiatives to build and maintain a capable, results-oriented retention team.
  • Use relevant digital and AI-powered tools to improve research, script development, workflow efficiency, and overall team productivity.

Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in customer retention, outbound sales, contact centre operations, or a similar customer-facing environment.
  • Demonstrated success in customer conversion, retention, and reactivation, with experience managing performance-driven teams and achieving measurable commercial results.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate teams, manage performance, and encourage continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, particularly when engaging customers over the phone.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable improvement plans.
  • Ability to balance direct customer engagement with team supervision and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards.
  • Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage.
  • Basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies, combined with a genuine interest in financial technology, is considered a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Additional financial rewards directly linked to individual achievements and overall team performance.
  • Paid Annual Leave: 10 days of paid vacation per year.
