title: 2027 Electrical Apprentice Signal Trainee (Chesapeake, VA)
description:
Requisition 40471: 2027 Electrical Apprentice Signal Trainee (Chesapeake, VA)

Description

At Norfolk Southern, we believe that our people power progress. Our culture is built on our SPIRIT values—Safety, Performance, Integrity, Respect, Innovation, and Teamwork—which guide how we work, lead, and grow together. If you're ready to launch a career in railroad signal maintenance and contribute to the safety and reliability of train operations, we invite you to explore the Apprentice Signal Trainee role.

This hands-on, field-based position prepares individuals for a career in signal maintenance through structured classroom instruction and on-the-job training. Apprentice Signal Trainees learn to install, inspect, and maintain signal systems that are critical to safe and efficient rail operations.

What Should You Know

  • This is a seniority-based union position. You will be required to bid on available positions, which may be located outside your training location. Relocation may be necessary based on the outcome of the bid process. Relocation assistance is not provided for this position.

  • You must be available to work on-call, 24/7, including holidays, nights and weekends.

  • Extensive travel is required during training (up to 75%).

  • You will be required to join the Brotherhood of Railroad Signalmen (BRS) within 60 days of establishing seniority.

  • You must obtain a Class A CDL within 90 days of hire (training provided by Norfolk Southern)

Training

Training lasts approximately 52 weeks and includes both classroom and field instruction.

Click on the link below to learn more about our training program:

  • Classroom Training: Three sessions (3 weeks each) at the NS Training Center in McDonough, GA. Hotel accommodations, mileage reimbursement, and meal stipends provided.

  • Field Training: Hands-on experience with construction and maintenance crews across your seniority district.

  • Evaluations: Periodic written and practical assessments.

Successful completion of the training program places apprentices on the seniority roster and makes them eligible to bid on Signal Maintainer position.

Seniority Districts:

  • Eastern Region North (ERN)

  • Norfolk & Western (NW)

  • Southern Lines East (SLE)

  • Southern Lines West (SLW)

  • WRE (Western Region East (WRE)

  • Western Region West (WRW)

A detailed overview of the seniority districts is available in the following video:

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform FRA-required inspections and testing of signal systems and grade crossings.

  • Install, maintain, and repair signal equipment including signal lights, switch machines, and electrical switch locks

  • Crossing warning devices and interlocking systems

  • Positive Train Control (PTC) and cab signal systems

  • Read and interpret electrical schematics and technical diagrams.

  • Operate hand tools, electrical testing instruments, and heavy equipment

  • Accurately document inspections, repairs, and installations.

  • Work safely in outdoor environments under varying weather conditions.

  • Respond to on-call assignments, including nights and weekends.

Qualifications – Required

  • You must be 18 years or older.

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

  • You must obtain a Class A CDL within 90 days of hire (training provided by Norfolk Southern)

  • This includes passing a commercial driver medical certification examination.

  • Must pass pre-employment Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) drug and alcohol screening.

  • Must not have a conviction for, or completed state action to cancel, revoke, suspend, or deny a motor vehicle drivers license for, operating a motor vehicle while under the influence of or impaired by alcohol or a controlled substance

  • In the past 36 months, Must not have conviction for, or completed state action to cancel, revoke, suspend, or deny a motor vehicle driver's license for, refusal to undergo such testing as is required by State or foreign law when a law enforcement official seeks to determine whether a person is operating a vehicle while under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.

Qualifications – Preferred

  • Technical certificate or associate degree in Electrical Technology, Electronics Engineering, or related field.

  • OSHA 10/30, First Aid/CPR, TWIC card.

  • 1–2 years in electrical, mechanical, or field service work.

  • Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Proficient in basic computer applications (Excel, Word, Outlook).

  • Effective time management and communication skills.

Physical and Mental Job Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.

  • Capable of climbing, bending, stooping, and working at heights.

  • Ability to walk long distances on uneven terrain.

  • Must pass FRA/FMCSA physical standards including:

  • Visual acuity (at least 20/40 in each eye separately and both together with or without corrective lenses).

  • Color vision (must pass FRA-approved tests; lenses to improve color vision are not permitted).

  • Hearing (no hearing loss greater than 40B average at 500, 1000, and 2000 Hz in better ear; may be met with hearing aid).

Work Conditions

  • Outdoor field work in all weather conditions.

  • Extensive travel during training (up to 75%).

  • On-call and weekend availability required.

  • Union membership required (BRS).

Compensation and Benefits

  • Weeks 1–3 (Classroom): $1,200 /week

  • Apprentice Periods:

  • First 130 days: $36.48/hr

  • Second 130 days: $36.85/hr

  • Post-Apprenticeship (Signal Maintainer): $37.98/hr+

Benefits Include:

  • Medical coverage begins the first day of the second month after hire

  • Health insurance (80/20 or 85/15 plan)

  • $20,000 life insurance

  • 401(k) eligibility from day one

  • Dental and vision coverage after one year of service

Company Overview

title: Ventilation Engineer
description:
Requisition ID: 100412

Job Category: Metals; Mining

Location: Brisbane, Queensland, Australia

Join a company that is passionately committed to the pursuit of a better world through positive change. With more than 70 years of business and technical expertise in mining, energy, and infrastructure, our 10,000 colleagues in 150 countries tirelessly work toward bettering the industries in which we operate. With practical solutions that are safe, innovative and sustainable, we think globally while acting locally. Are you looking for an opportunity to join a diverse group of professionals who are committed to remaining exceptional? We look forward to hearing from you.

If it isn't grown, it's mined. Our mining and metals teams help our clients to safely and sustainably mine the minerals and metals used in our everyday lives. Want to play a part of innovating and optimizing the mining life cycle on greenfield and brownfield facilities? Apply today!

Hatch is seeking a Ventilation Engineer to join our mine ventilation team based in our Brisbane office. The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, analysis, optimisation, and management of mine ventilation systems for underground mining projects across various commodities and geographies. This role involves working with concept studies through to detailed engineering and operational support.

The Mining Ventilation Engineer will play a key role in ensuring compliance with applicable safety regulations, operational requirements, and industry best practices while supporting Hatch's commitment to positive change through technical excellence and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support ventilation studies, assessments, and engineering calculations to help ensure underground mines maintain safe air quality, control heat and contaminants, and comply with operational and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist with ventilation data analysis by reviewing airflow, pressure, gas, and environmental monitoring data to identify trends, diagnose issues, and support informed operational decisions.
  • Contribute to ventilation system design and optimisation initiatives aimed at improving airflow efficiency, reducing energy consumption, supporting mine expansion plans, and enhancing overall safety and productivity.
  • Assist with the preparation of technical reports, presentations, and engineering documentation to clearly communicate findings, recommendations, and project outcomes to clients, site personnel, and project stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including mining engineers, ventilation specialists, geologists, and operational personnel to ensure ventilation requirements are effectively integrated into mine planning, project delivery, and day-to-day operations.

Preferred Skills and Knowledge

  • Relevant engineering degree in Mining, Mechanical, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Understanding of underground mining methods, mine ventilation principles, and ventilation infrastructure including mine fans.
  • Exposure to mine cooling/refrigeration systems and familiarity with software such as Ventsim, mine planning, or mine design tools is advantageous.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with a willingness to undertake site-based work and develop operational experience.

Why join us?

  • Work with great people to make a difference
  • Collaborate on exciting projects to develop innovative solutions
  • Top employer



What we offer you?

  • Global project exposure across complex, impactful industries
  • Strong focus on career growth, learning and mentorship
  • Collaborative, values-driven culture focused on innovation and excellence

Don't meet every single requirement? You don't need to. At Hatch, we are building a diverse, inclusive workplace that fosters innovation. If you're interested in this role, we encourage you to apply even if your past experiences don't perfectly align with the skills we've listed.


Hatch holds an innovate reconciliation action plan and we encourage Aboriginal and Torres Straight islanders to apply. As an accredited Employer of Choice for Gender Equality (WGEA) and Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to fostering a workforce in each of our locations that reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. title: Global Treasurer
description:
This role reports directly to the Controller, working closely with the CFO, Tax Director, Accounting Directors, and other senior finance leaders. The Global Treasurer will serve as Perficient’s senior treasury leader, setting the strategic direction for global treasury and risk management and advising the CFO and executive leadership on capital structure, liquidity, funding, and financial risk. This role is accountable for the Company’s global treasury strategy, policy framework, and governance, including strategic initiatives related to liquidity and capital strategy, foreign exchange and hedging strategy, debt and capital markets financing, banking partnerships, investments, enterprise risk and insurance, the real estate and lease portfolio, and oversight of treasury operations delivered by the treasury team and shared services. This is a hands-on leadership role: the Global Treasurer balances strategic direction with rolling up their sleeves to execute day-to-day treasury work directly. The Global Treasurer will provide leadership, oversight, and business partnership across the organization to ensure effective liquidity management, risk mitigation, compliance, and long-term value creation.

Develop and execute the global treasury strategy in alignment with the Company’s financial and business strategy, serving as a trusted advisor to the CFO and executive leadership on capital structure, liquidity, and financial risk.

· Define the treasury technology and automation roadmap and sponsor system implementations; ensure transaction processing, bank account reporting, payments, and cash positioning are executed accurately and efficiently by the treasury team and shared services.

· Set and oversee company-wide treasury policies, internal controls, and governance standards, including implementation and ongoing management of a SOX control framework for the Treasury function.

· Build and maintain strategic relationships with commercial and investment banking partners, lenders, and capital markets advisors; own the global banking structure and financing strategy, including credit facilities, and oversee related controls, and compliance with reporting requirements.

· Own the global foreign exchange risk strategy and hedging program; monitor exposure, approve strategies to reduce it, and report regularly to the CFO and senior leadership.

· Lead liquidity and capital strategy, including M&A funding, debt capacity, and short-term and long-term liquidity forecasting; personally build and maintain the modeling and reporting that inform executive and Board decision-making.

· Set investment, debt, counterparty, and other treasury-related risk policies to mitigate global treasury risks in alignment with the Company’s strategy.

· Set the strategy for global insurance programs and enterprise risk transfer, including oversight of relationships with insurance brokers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

· Set the strategy for the global real estate portfolio and oversee internal/external real estate partnerships.

· Partner with the Tax Director on strategies to maximize the efficiency of the global cash management program.

· Ensure timely and accurate completion, through the treasury team, of annual Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts reporting.

· Build, develop, and lead a high-performing global treasury team, while remaining hands-on in day-to-day treasury operations and delegating as the team grows.

Bachelor’s degree (BS) in finance, economics, accounting, or business; MBA, CTP, or CFA preferred.

· 12+ years of progressive professional experience in treasury, finance, accounting, or related fields, including senior-level experience leading global treasury functions; prior leadership of a team.

· Demonstrated experience developing and executing liquidity, capital structure, and banking strategy across multiple countries and legal entities.

· Experience designing, implementing, or managing foreign exchange exposure mitigation strategies, including hedging programs or other risk management mechanisms.

· Experience with capital markets, debt financing, and M&A funding, including negotiating credit facilities and managing lender relationships.

· Strategic Leadership Skills: Proven ability to develop and communicate a multi-year treasury vision, translate enterprise priorities into financial strategy, and influence senior executives and the Board.

· Communication Skills: Demonstrated ability to articulate analyses from the interpretation of financial reports and legal documents. Strong executive presence and ability to clearly communicate compelling messages to senior executives and finance partners. Experience presenting complex materials in a concise manner to senior executives to drive effective decision-making.

· Superior Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Demonstrated intellectual and analytical thoroughness as well as experience resolving complex business problems with well-structured analytics.

· Reasoning and Judgment Skills: Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.

· Team Skills: Team oriented, collaborative, diplomatic, and flexible, with demonstrated ability to articulate and drive towards desired outcomes. Must be able to lead across and through the matrix organization to ensure effective and efficient decision-making.

· Business Partnering and Leadership Skills: Demonstrated success engaging senior leadership in effective decision-making, with strong project management skills and the ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives across a broad range of stakeholders.

· Organization / Time Management Skills: Prioritize effectively across strategic initiatives and operational demands; delegate and develop others to achieve optimal efficiency and productivity while ensuring business deadlines and requirements are met.

· Systems skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Suite and Oracle; experience with treasury management systems, banking platforms, and reporting or forecasting tools preferred.

title: Senior Software Developer, Defence
description:
Senior Software Developer, Defence

Join our Sitaware Extensions Program and help deliver customised integrations and extensions to Systematic's defence product suite, from sensor interfaces to radio drivers. As Senior Software Developer, you will combine software design, implementation and testing in a close-knit team working in an exciting domain.

The job

You will contribute to the delivery of high-quality integrations and extensions, from requirements analysis through software design, implementation and testing. Beyond hands-on development, you will help apply and improve our development process, and share your knowledge to support the team's growth.

In short, you can look forward to:

  • Designing, implementing, documenting and debugging features, working primarily on back-end development (Java) and occasionally on front-end development (Angular)
  • Analysing requirements, breaking them into technical tasks, and clarifying acceptance criteria
  • Implementing and troubleshooting interfaces to hardware and external systems, such as sensors and radio interfaces
  • Developing and maintaining unit and integration tests, and designing for testability
  • Identifying issues and recommending improvements to code, tooling, pipelines and processes

Joining the team

You will be part of the Product Extension Team of around seven developers, test engineers and architects, part of the Sitaware Extensions Program within Defence Services. The team delivers customised integrations and extensions to Systematic's defence product suite, focusing on software- and hardware-related integrations such as sensor interfaces, radio drivers and interoperability with external systems, and continuously improves its own testing and development practices, methods and tools. This is a newly created position, so you will have real scope to shape how the role develops as the team continues to grow.

Your qualifications

To succeed in this role, you bring several years of software development experience gained in a structured, team-based environment, along with:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Technology or similar
  • Hands-on experience with Java (or a related object-oriented technology) for backend development, and Angular (or a similar modern framework) for frontend development
  • Fluent English; Danish is a nice-to-have

Alongside this, we value:

  • Strong analytical abilities, with a focused and open mindset
  • The ability to communicate intent and purpose clearly, both in writing and conversation
  • Enjoys collaborating closely within a cross-functional team

Onboarding includes two three-day stays in Aarhus, and you should expect occasional travel of around two to ten days a year, mostly within Europe. Some onsite hardware testing may also be required, depending on integration needs.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

title: Solution-Based Casework (SBC) Case Planner (Bronx Location)
description:
JOB TITLE: Solution-Based Casework (SBC) Case Planner
EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full-Time
LOCATION: Hybrid – 2-3 days in office (Bronx Location)
REPORTS TO: Solution-Based Casework Supervisor
SALARY: $62,197.89 Annually

ABOUT AAFSC:

For over 30 years, the Arab-American Family Support Center (AAFSC) has proudly served immigrants and refugees. We help children stay safe, families remain together, and newcomers navigate life in New York City. While our doors are open to all, AAFSC has expertise in serving Arab, Middle Eastern, North African, Muslim, and South Asian communities.

JOB OBJECTIVE:

To provide high-quality case planning, case work, and case management services to at-risk families referred by the Administration for Children’s Services. These families may be experiencing a wide range of challenges, including personal/marital/relationship problems, financial stressors, acculturation issues, family destabilization, and/or parent/child conflict. The Case Planner provides intensive preventive services to avoid foster care placement and ensure the safety and welfare of children in the home. He or she provides the family with services according to ACS standards and requirements. The Case Planner follows a Solution Based Casework (SBC) practice model. SBC is based on three theoretical foundations: family life cycle theory, relapse prevention/CBT theory, and solution-focused family therapy. Partnership with families in each and every case is critical to reducing risks and solutions should utilize prevention skills to achieve those goals.

PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Case Management & Advocacy

  • Ensure timely completion of SBC training & certification.

  • Conduct home visits and office visits to assess child safety and risk elements, complying with ACS requirements. Face-to-face contacts should be conducted twice per month, at a minimum and includes home visits (two home visits must be conducted if children 0-2 years old are present) and office visits (e.g., school, doctor’s office, AAFSC), as well as other out-of-home visits (e.g., park). More visits may be required.

  • Provide case work/case management services to families receiving Preventive Services (12 cases); which includes but is not limited to providing supportive casework, focusing on service goals, and child welfare laws, improving family relationships and bonding, coping skills, parenting, etc.

  • Ensure joint-home visits are conducted within 5 business days from the date of referral.

  • Evaluate and assess the current family functioning including child safety and home safety (e.g., assessing other adults in the home, ensuring safe sleep, working fire alarms, window guards, etc.).

  • Work in partnership with the family to formulate outcomes & service plans with the family.

  • Ensure all initial intake documents (AAFSC intake, Domestic Violence screening, child trafficking) are completed and processed accurately using AAFSC internal database (i.e., Apricot).

  • Advocate for the family by linking them to needed services in the community: medical, mental health, entitlements, day care, home health aide services, substance abuse treatment, anger management, etc. and follow up to monitor participation and progress.

  • In collaboration with the Conference Facilitator, support the facilitation of Family Team Conferences and Service Termination Conferences, as well as other relevant ACS-led conferences. Family Team Conferences must be conducted within 4 weeks of the FASP due date.

  • Ensure FASPs are launched 30 days prior to the due date and submitted to Supervisor 3 weeks prior to the due date.

  • Complete Initial, Comprehensive, all Reassessment FASPs, and Plan Amendments for all Advocate Preventive Only (ADVPO) cases offline.

  • Complete and Submit Child Trafficking Screening for Child Welfare Services and ADVPO cases.

  • Evaluate walk-ins and community referrals for needed services and potentially for advocacy cases.

  • Provide case coverage in the absence of a co-worker (as needed).

  • Schedule and coordinate monthly visits with FSU workers (applicable to FSU cases only).

Quality Assurance, Communication, and Documentation

  • Complete all documents required by ACS in a timely manner (5 business days) including but not limited to progress notes and FASPs using templates in a manner that reflects the progress or lack thereof, including the reaction of the family to services during the review period or contact.

  • Complete all ACS and internal forms required for case opening and closing as well as obtain consents and forms needed for other case activities. Obtain and maintain collateral contacts with all other service providers including school and medical reports on a regular basis.

  • Comply with all data entry requirements for database systems including inputting information in a timely manner (PROMIS, Connections, etc.).

  • Compile and organize appropriate client intake paperwork, surveys, and forms. Maintain casefiles, database entry, and record keeping in compliance with ACS, OCFS, and AAFSC requirements, in alignment with the Solution Based Casework Model guidelines (as needed).

  • Appropriately follow incident reporting procedures (as needed).

  • Maintain relationships with ACS personnel, including DCP workers, joint home visit ACS staff, and FSU workers, for ongoing ACS supervision.

  • Regularly collaborate and communicate with PPRS staff by responding to emails, maintaining an up-to-date Outlook calendar, participating in supervision meetings, and scheduling office days.

  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Trainings, Meetings, and Audit Preparation

  • Attend training provided by ACS, Solution Based Casework, and other organizations as required (minimum of 42 hours/6 days each fiscal year) and log training by submitting certificates to the Director of Training and Development.

  • Attend internal meetings as scheduled, collaborating with the multidisciplinary team (e.g., monthly supervision).

  • Assist in preparation of internal and external audits (COQI, PAMS, safety alerts, etc.) related to the program operation and delivery of services.

BACKGROUND & POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

A successful Case Planner at AAFSC is one that is both compassionate and objective. The candidate must be a good communicator and problem solver who is able to quickly respond to unforeseen challenges. In addition to these general skills and traits, AAFSC is looking for a candidate with the following skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required.

  • Familiarity with using PROMIS and Connections.

  • Computer skills in Microsoft Office suite and excellent writing skills are required.

  • Bilingual or multi-lingual fluency required. Arabic, Bangla/Bengali, Hindi, Spanish or Urdu skills strongly preferred.

  • Experience working with under-served students in urban schools, child welfare system, and/or community-based settings a plus.

  • Exercises discretion regarding sensitive personal and legal information.

  • Job contingent on pre-employment background checks.

  • U.S. Work authorization required.

We are an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud – Bare Metal Infrastructure Engineer based in Canada.

Working closely with network engineering and Kubernetes platform teams, you will help make physical infrastructure as accessible and reliable as cloud capacity.   • Develop the interfaces and tools used by the Kubernetes platform team to request infrastructure capacity, monitor host health, and coordinate maintenance activities.

  • Automate the full server lifecycle, including hardware burn-in, acceptance testing, fault remediation, staged firmware deployments, and return merchandise authorization (RMA) processes.

title: Licensed Aircraft Engineer (LAE) B2 Avionics
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, inspections and defect rectification on General Aviation and business aircraft.

  • Carry out troubleshooting and maintenance of aircraft avionics, electrical, communication, navigation and instrumentation systems.

  • Diagnose and rectify technical defects in accordance with approved maintenance data and procedures.

  • Conduct functional checks, operational tests and inspections following maintenance activities.

  • Interpret and utilise aircraft technical documentation, including Aircraft Maintenance Manuals (AMM), Wiring Diagram Manuals (WDM), Fault Isolation Manuals (FIM) and relevant Service Bulletins.

  • Perform avionics component replacement, wiring inspections, system modifications and associated maintenance tasks.

  • Ensure all maintenance activities are properly documented, including aircraft technical logs, work orders and maintenance records.

  • Certify maintenance work and issue Certificates of Release to Service (CRS), where authorised and within the scope of applicable licence privileges and company authorisation.

  • Support aircraft maintenance planning, parts identification, tooling requirements and coordination of maintenance activities.

  • Provide technical guidance and support to aircraft technicians and junior maintenance personnel.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable CAAS, FAA and other relevant aviation regulatory requirements.

  • Maintain high standards of safety, quality, housekeeping, tool control and human factors awareness.

  • Support Aircraft on Ground (AOG) maintenance requirements and other operational assignments when required.

Job Requirements

  • Possess a valid CAAS Aircraft Maintenance Licence (AML) Category B2, or an equivalent foreign licence acceptable for the applicable regulatory and authorisation requirements.

  • Relevant aircraft type training or ratings will be an advantage.

  • Minimum 3 years of relevant aircraft maintenance experience preferred.

  • Experience in avionics troubleshooting, electrical systems and aircraft defect rectification.

  • Familiarity with General Aviation, business aircraft or light aircraft maintenance will be an advantage.

  • Knowledge of aircraft maintenance manuals, technical documentation and airworthiness requirements.

  • Familiarity with CAAS and/or FAA Part 145 maintenance organisation requirements will be an advantage.

  • Able to work independently and as part of a maintenance team.

  • Good communication skills and proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Responsible, meticulous and committed to maintaining high standards of safety and quality.

    Preferred Experience

    Experience with the following aircraft types will be an advantage:

    • Diamond DA40, DA42 and DA62.

    • Cessna aircraft, including Cessna 172.

    • Bristell aircraft.

    • Other General Aviation and business aircraft.

    Experience in avionics system installation, troubleshooting, functional testing and maintenance within a CAAS or FAA approved maintenance organisation will also be an added advantage.

title: Customer Retention Supervisor
description:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards.
  • Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage.

Benefits:

  • Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Additional financial rewards directly linked to individual achievements and overall team performance.
  • Paid Annual Leave: 10 days of paid vacation per year.
  • Public Holidays: Paid time off on all U.S. federal holidays.

  • High-Growth Industry Exposure: Work within the rapidly evolving global fintech and cryptocurrency sector.
  • Direct Business Impact: Take ownership of retention initiatives that directly contribute to customer engagement, recovered revenue, and business growth.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Därför är detta jobb för dig

Knightec Group är med och utvecklar nästa generation av inbyggda och uppkopplade system. Tillsammans med våra kunder tar vi fram framtidssäkra mjukvaru- och hårdvarulösningar, från realtidssystem till molnintegrerade produkter.

Vi söker dig som har några års erfarenhet inom embedded-utveckling som vill fortsätta att växa i rollen. Hos oss kommer du få som är intresserad av att jobba i projekt som spänner från klassisk embeddedutveckling till framtidens lösningar inom device to cloud, ett område där vi satsar stort.

Arbetsuppgifter

Du blir en del av affärsområdet Software & Cloud, där vi i Göteborg är omkring 150 kompetenta och engagerade kollegor. Vi arbetar i en bredd av uppdrag, allt från hårdvarunära utveckling i realtidssystem till arkitektur och systemintegration med molnet.

Du kommer få arbeta i projekt som passar din erfarenhet och intressen, i våra inhouse-team eller ute hos kund. Samtidigt får du möjlighet att vara med och bidra i utvecklingen av vår device to cloud-satsning.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

• Design och implementation av embedded-mjukvara i C/C++

• Integration mellan inbyggda enheter och molnplattformar

• Delta i kravarbete, arkitektur, test och kvalitetssäkring

• Samarbete i tvärfunktionella team inom mjukvara, hårdvara och cloud

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har några års erfarenhet inom embedded och som vill fortsätta utvecklas, både tekniskt och tillsammans med andra. Du gillar att arbeta brett och är nyfiken.

Vi tror att du har:

• Minst 3 års erfarenhet av C/C++-utveckling för inbyggda system

• Civilingenjörsexamen inom datateknik, elektroteknik eller motsvarande

• Erfarenhet av Python

• Grundläggande erfarenhet av kravställning, design och test

• Förståelse för realtidssystem och hårdvarunära utveckling

• Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

• B-körkort

Meriterande är erfarenhet av:

• Embedded Linux och realtids-OS

• Cloud-teknologier (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

• CI/CD och moderna verktygskedjor

• Cyber-/cloud-säkerhet

• Projekt inom fordon, medtech, försvar eller andra reglerade branscher

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet – vi tror att du är nyfiken, samarbetsinriktad och gärna delar med dig av din kunskap.

En spännande resa med Knightec Group

Knightec Group är idag en av Norra Europas ledande strategiska partners inom produkt- och digital tjänsteutveckling – hur häftigt är inte det?

Genom att förena ingenjörskompetens, digital expertis och affärsförståelse hjälper vi våra kunder att omvandla ny teknik till verkliga lösningar som skapar värde. Vi arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan affärsstrategi och teknikutveckling och stöttar våra kunder genom hela resan – från de första idéerna till utveckling, implementering och vidare utveckling.

På Knightec Group samlas människor med olika perspektiv, erfarenheter och specialistområden. Tillsammans skapar vi innovation som gör verklig skillnad – för företag, människor och samhället i stort.

För våra medarbetare innebär det stora möjligheter att vara med och forma framtidens lösningar genom meningsfulla projekt i teknikens absoluta framkant. Här får du inte bara utvecklas och växa i din roll – du blir också en del av ett team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och modet att utmana driver oss framåt.

Låter det som platsen för dig? Häng med på vår fortsatta resa!

Praktisk information

Detta är en heltidstjänst, placerad på vårt kontor i Göteborg, Lindholmsallén 2. Resor kan förekomma till våra kunder i Göteborgsregionen. Startdatum är så snart som möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse.

Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Om du har några frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Victoria Olsson, Talent Acquisition Specialist. Observera att vi, på grund av GDPR, endast tar emot ansökningar via vår karriärsida.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Assistant Manager - Inventory & Reverse Logistics
description:
The Assistant Manager supports the Inventory Manager in leading daily warehouse operations and directly oversees the Inventory and Reverse Logistics teams. This role supervises the Reverse Logistics Lead and Inventory Lead, coordinates floor operations, inventory control, and returns processing, and uses operational data to improve stock accuracy, reverse logistics workflows, and fulfillment efficiency. The Assistant Manager also partners across departments to resolve complex discrepancies and implement scalable process improvements.

Success in this role is measured by inventory accuracy, timely and accurate returns processing, effective discrepancy resolution, safe operations, and continuous improvement across Inventory and Reverse Logistics workflows.

Responsibilities

• Operational Leadership: Directly supervise and support the Reverse Logistics Lead and Inventory Lead. Assign daily work, set priorities, manage performance, coach team members, and support their ongoing development.

• Reverse Logistics Strategy and Execution: Oversee Bulk, Return for Sale (RFS), and general inventory returns processing. Ensure Return Authorizations (RAs) are created on time, logs are accurate and current, and returned inventory is routed to the appropriate disposition channel. Manage Open Box processing, bulk partner returns, and charitable donations.

• Inventory Control & Discrepancy Resolution: Support overall inventory accuracy by maintaining cycle count schedules, auditing stock movements, and partnering with Receiving, Accounts Payable, and Member Services to resolve receiving and return discrepancies.

• Cross-Functional and System Coordination: Serve as the liaison between warehouse leads and partner departments to keep product, inventory, and return statuses aligned. Manage Jira ticket workflows for website and product-status updates, and maintain accurate system records in NetSuite.

• Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Analyze returns trends, inventory variances, and operational logs using Microsoft Excel. Proactively identify process gaps, mitigate operational risk, and implement scalable workflow improvements.

• Safety and Standards: Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment; reinforce warehouse safety protocols; identify and escalate hazards; and model compliance with established operating procedures.

• Operational Support: Complete additional assigned duties to support changing reverse logistics, inventory, and fulfillment center needs.

Requirements

Skills/Requirements

• Hands-on experience with NetSuite ERP (or equivalent WMS) is required.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas, and data analysis).

• Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills across technical, operational, and customer support channels.

• Attention to detail is needed to ensure accuracy in data analysis, processing, and reporting of reverse logistics functions.

• Excellent time management skills to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

• At least three years of experience in inventory control, reverse logistics, or warehouse operations, including demonstrated supervisory or team-leadership experience.

• Proactive in identifying opportunities for process improvement, risk mitigation, and optimization of reverse logistics

management practices.

Preferred Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s Degree

• 3+ years of experience in project-based work.

• Basic knowledge of warehouse equipment- scanners, printers, pallet jacks, etc.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position will have supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment

This position operates on-site at the GOVX Fulfillment Center in La Vergne, Tennessee, across both a professional office environment and an adjacent warehouse facility. The role routinely uses computers, phones, photocopiers, printers, and packing equipment.

Physical/Mental Demands

• Physical – This role will require some lifting to 40 lbs.

• Mental – Problem-solving, making decisions, interpreting data, organizing, reading/writing.

• Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Travel

No travel is expected for this position.

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of the activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay.
  • Paid Time Off, Paid Sick Leave, and Paid Holidays.
  • Competitive insurance benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance.
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA) available.
  • Voluntary benefits including Critical Illness, Group Accident, and Voluntary Life.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with discretionary company match.
  • Employee discounts on the GOVX website.
  • Opportunities for career advancement and training.

Pay Range
$60, 000 - $62,000 annually, with benefits listed above.

AAP/EEO Statement
EOE/Veterans/Disabled

The position will require the successful completion of a background check and drug testing before starting employment.


About GOVX, Inc.

Savings for Those Who Serve

GOVX was founded in 2011 to offer exclusive benefits to those who serve our country. The GOVX membership is comprised of current and former members of the American military, law enforcement, firefighting, medical services, and government personnel. We are dedicated to supporting these communities and to offering unique value to our members, while delivering an authentic platform for brands to reach our growing customer base. As the largest and fastest growing digital platform serving this deserving audience, we are committed to stretching the limits of ecommerce to deliver the best assortment for our members’ on-duty and off-duty needs.

title: Project Manger
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Project Manager to coordinate and drive activities across the full breadth of Endosiq's programme — clinical studies, regulatory submissions, intellectual property, and external partnerships.

This is a cross-functional coordination role. You will work closely with the technical, clinical, and management teams, and manage a range of external specialists including regulatory consultants, clinical research organisations, hospital partners, and IP attorneys. The ability to keep multiple workstreams moving simultaneously, maintain clear documentation, and communicate progress concisely to management is essential.

You will report to the CEO of Trendlines Medical Singapore and work closely with the Trendlines portfolio team.

What You Will Be Doing

Project Planning and Tracking

● Own the overall project plan — maintain timelines, milestones, and workstream status across regulatory, clinical, IP, and commercial activities.

● Identify schedule risks and dependencies early; follow up on open actions and keep stakeholders accountable.

● Prepare regular management updates and project reports for internal and external stakeholders.

● Coordinate meetings, set agendas, document decisions, and track follow-up actions.

Regulatory and Quality

● Coordinate regulatory submission activities with external regulatory consultants and specialists.

● Support preparation and organisation of regulatory documentation and submission packages.

● Assist with quality-related processes and maintain records in an organised and audit-ready manner.

Clinical Study and Hospital Coordination

● Coordinate clinical study activities —scheduling, site liaison, documentation, and progress tracking.

● Manage day-to-day coordination with hospital partners, clinical investigators, and research institutions.

● Support preparation of clinical study documentation including protocols, reports, and ethics submissions where required.

Intellectual Property and Patents

● Coordinate patent and IP-related activities with external patent attorneys and IP specialists.

● Track IP filing timelines, maintain records, and support preparation of related documentation.

● Monitor IP-related deadlines and ensure relevant parties are informed and on schedule.

Vendor and Consultant Management

● Manage day-to-day coordination with external consultants, vendors, and service providers across all workstreams.

● Track deliverables, timelines, and invoices; flag issues and escalate where needed.

Documentation and Record Keeping

● Maintain organised and up-to-date project records, correspondence files, and document repositories.

● Ensure documentation standards are upheld across regulatory, clinical, and IP workstreams.

Commercialisation Support

● Support commercialisation and product launch activities as the programme progresses, including coordination of market access, partnership, and business development activities where required.

What We Are Looking For

Required

● Degree: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Healthcare, Biomedical, or a related field.

● Experience: 3 to 5years of working experience in healthcare, MedTech, technology, or a related industry.

● Coordination skills: demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, keep stakeholders aligned, and maintain clear documentation and follow-through.

● Communication: able to write clearly and concisely for both technical and non-technical audiences; comfortable preparing management reports and stakeholder updates.

● Organised and detail-oriented: disciplined approach to record keeping, deadline tracking, and documentation management.

Advantageous

● External partner experience: prior experience working with consultants, vendors, hospitals, research institutions, or external specialists in a coordination capacity.

● Regulatory, clinical, quality, or IP exposure: a basic working understanding of any of these processes — formal expertise is not required, but familiarity helps.

● MedTech or digital health background: experience in a medical device or software-as-a-medical-device (SaMD) environment is an advantage.

● Startup experience: comfortable in a small, fast-moving team where scope evolves and initiative is expected.

Role Overview

The role will work closely with business stakeholders, data teams, technical teams and project stakeholders to understand business requirements, support data migration activities, and ensure the accuracy, completeness and integrity of migrated data.

The successful candidate will act as a bridge between business and technical teams, translating business requirements into clear functional requirements and supporting data mapping, validation, reconciliation and issue resolution throughout the migration lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Requirements

What You’ll Bring

We are looking for someone who is analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable working across both business and technical environments. You should be able to understand the business context behind data, investigate issues at a detailed level, and communicate findings clearly to different stakeholder groups.

This is an opportunity to contribute to a transformation-focused project while gaining broad exposure across Business Analysis, Data Migration, Data Validation, SQL, Stakeholder Management and Business Process Improvement.

title: Right of Way Project Manager
description:
Project: A major natural gas pipeline project in the Permian Basin, Texas
Reports to: VP of Land & ROW (and client project management where assigned to a client-embedded role)
Classification: Full-time
Location: Permian Basin, Texas — on-site and field-based; extensive travel across the project area as assigned

Purpose
The Project Manager owns Gray Hawk’s delivery of right-of-way and land services on assigned projects — from mobilization through completion. This role serves as the primary point of contact between the client (and project leadership) and Gray Hawk’s field organization, translating project objectives, priorities, and schedules into clear field direction and holding the project team accountable for on-time, on-budget, and compliant delivery. The role operates with significant autonomy and is measured by the quality, pace, and reliability of the work Gray Hawk delivers.

Core Responsibilities
• Serve as the day-to-day liaison between client management and Gray Hawk field teams — receiving project objectives, priorities, and schedule changes and translating them into clear, actionable field direction.
• Direct and coordinate all right-of-way supervisors and agents, title staff, document and/or database specialists, and other Gray Hawk personnel assigned to the project.
• Assign parcels and workloads, set production targets, and manage the full acquisition workflow to meet project milestones and schedule.
• Track and report acquisition progress to the client on a regular cadence — parcel status, executed agreements, outstanding tracts, and overall project pace.
• Review and quality-control all documentation, agreements, and deliverables before they are submitted to the client.
• Identify, troubleshoot, and escalate title defects, curative issues, problem parcels, and difficult or legally represented landowners.
• Manage scope and budget adherence; promptly flag any change that affects cost or timeline to the client and Gray Hawk leadership.
• Coordinate field logistics across the project geography — staffing coverage, scheduling, and travel.
• Ensure all field work complies with client requirements, applicable regulations, and Gray Hawk safety and documentation standards; confirm every team member has completed the Field Safety acknowledgment and Safety Training before working alone in the field.
• Onboard, support, and mentor ROW agents and field staff; reinforce the Gray Hawk Proactive Standard — agents actively pursue landowners after first contact rather than waiting.
• Maintain accurate, current project records in Gray Hawk’s systems (SharePoint, OneDrive) and the project’s land-management database.

Success Metrics
• Field team operating under clear assignments with no active parcels left unassigned.
• Reporting cadence to the client established and consistently met.
• No unresolved escalations aging beyond 3 days without a documented status and path to resolution.
• Acquisition milestones met or exceeded on schedule across assigned projects.
• Client regards Gray Hawk as a reliable, well-managed delivery partner — reflected in client feedback and renewed or expanded scope.
• Zero material documentation errors on executed agreements.
• Stable field-team performance and retention; agents consistently operating to the Gray Hawk Proactive Standard.

Required Qualifications
• 5+ years managing right-of-way or land acquisition projects, preferably on natural gas pipelines.
• Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-phase ROW programs — schedule, staffing, cost controls, reporting and multidisciplinary interfaces — and leading field teams of ROW agents and support staff.
• Leadership experience on FERC-regulated natural gas pipeline projects.
• Texas pipeline experience, including work with the Texas Railroad Commission.
• Working knowledge of Texas condemnation (eminent domain) law and procedure for pipelines.
• Working knowledge of title research, easements, curative processes, and the full ROW acquisition workflow.
• Strong client-facing communication and reporting skills; comfortable serving as the face of Gray Hawk to a client’s management team.
• Proficiency with SharePoint, OneDrive and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel).
• Experience with land-management databases (such as Irth Land Management or comparable) and the ability to learn new client databases quickly.
• Valid driver’s license and the ability and willingness to travel extensively to and across project areas.
• Must supply their own mobile phone that can receive email, and a computer capable of doing the job effectively.
• Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent right-of-way experience or IRWA certification (SR/WA or RW/AC) accepted in its place.
• Available to start within weeks of an offer and to work on-site in the Permian Basin.

Preferred Qualifications
• Direct experience on large-diameter natural gas pipeline right-of-way projects.
• Experience across multiple asset types (pipeline, electric transmission, renewables).
• SR/WA or RW/AC certification (IRWA).
• Prior experience as a client-embedded or client-facing project lead.

Don’t meet every requirement? If you have strong FERC pipeline leadership experience but not in Texas, we still want to hear from you.

title: Research Associate II, mRNA technologies
description:
Repertoire Immune Medicines is a clinical-stage biotechnology company working to unlock and direct the remarkable power of the human immune system to prevent or treat cancer, as well as resetting the immune system to treat autoimmune disorders. The company is founded on the belief that the repertoire of T cell receptor (TCR)-antigen codes that drive health and disease represents one of the greatest opportunities for innovation in medical science. Repertoire scientists created and developed the DECODE suite of technologies, which allow in-depth characterization of TCR-antigen pairs, and the ability to rationally design and develop novel targeted immune medicines.

From its sites in Watertown, Massachusetts, and Zurich, Switzerland, Repertoire’s team of more than 80 is creating a new category of immune medicines enabled from its DECODE discovery platform. Repertoire is currently using its proprietary platform to discover novel epitopes and TCRs from patients with autoimmune diseases such as type 1 diabetes and multiple sclerosis as well as to enable development of immune oncology based therapeutics to treat solid tumors.

Repertoire was founded in 2019 by Flagship Pioneering and is supported by a strong investor base. The DECODE platform has been validated through four strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies—Bristol Myers Squibb, Genentech, Eli Lilly, and Pfizer—representing over $4.5 billion in disclosed total deal value and $185 million in upfront payments received to date.

Role Overview
We are seeking a motivated Research Associate II to join our Integrated Therapeutic Engineering and Design (ITED) team and help advance the development of cutting edge mRNA-LNP work in autoimmunity and cancer vaccines. In this lab-based role, you will play a key part in design and production of immune-silent mRNAs that deliver disease-modifying epitopes and immunomodulators to target multiple autoimmune disorders. You will perform all techniques associated with mRNA production, including in-vitro synthesis and purification of mRNA, QC and innate immune reactivity of the associated mRNA, and downstream applications related to the expression of the mRNA gene products. The ideal candidate is proficient with advanced molecular biology techniques, such as IVT, PCR, primer design, and cDNA preparation for sequencing, and brings bench experience with cell culture work and protein analysis work including ELISAs and western blots. You will own experimental design, implementation, and data analysis, and share your results with your supervisor and the broader team in an effective and timely manner. Drive to execute, experimental rigor, and scientific curiosity are essential to success in this role. Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills will enable you to thrive within our highly collaborative, cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute experiments as a key contributor to the ITED team, under the supervision of your manager and scientific project leads.
  • Manage large-scale productions of high quality in vitro transcribed mRNA, including purification and QC assessments with documentation.
  • Assess the production of various protein products from the mRNAs produced, using techniques such as ELISAs, western blots and flow cytometry.
  • Cross-train with the LNP team to learn complete mRNA-LNP encapsulation techniques
  • Maintain good laboratory practices, including accurate ELN documentation, instrument and reagent validation, and adherence to lab safety policies.
  • Present data and analysis at cross-disciplinary team meetings and build working relationships that move projects forward.
Qualifications/ Desired Experience
  • B.S. or M.S. in Biochemistry, Biology, Bioengineering, Immunology, or a similar field.
  • 2+ years of academic or biotech/pharma laboratory experience.
  • Experience with mRNA IVT and AKTA / FPLC techniques preferred
  • Demonstrated understanding of complex molecular biology techniques is strongly preferred (e.g., PCR, primer design, DNA purification, RNA production and purification).
  • Laboratory skills including sterile cell-culture, flow cytometry, ELISAs, western blots, strongly preferred
  • Strong organizational skills, excellent attention to detail, and data analysis skills are required.
  • Knowledge of innate and adaptive immunology is beneficial.
  • Experience with FlowJo, SnapGene, and Prism is preferred.
  • Desire and ability to quickly learn new lab techniques and understand the significance to program goals.

title: Instrument Processing Technician
description:
Regions Hospital is looking for an Instrument Processing Technician to join our team!

The Instrument Processing Technician works under the direction of the Sterile Processing Manager and is responsible for the proper handling, cleaning, disinfecting, assembly, and sterilization of instrumentation and patient-related equipment to render items safe for handling and use.

The Technician works in three main areas:

Sterilization:

  • Loads, unloads, and safely operates all sterilizers according to policies and procedures.

  • Completes all monitoring paperwork, sterilization records, and records of instrument sets within required timeline.

  • Maintains sterility of equipment and supplies.

  • Transports, handles, and stores sterile instruments and supplies per appropriate standards.

Decontamination:

  • Treats all instruments and equipment in the decontamination areas appropriately.

  • Follows proper cleaning procedures for items being cleaned.

  • Organizes and sorts instrument sets and equipment for proper cleaning, decontamination and ensures appropriate method of cleaning is used.

  • Performs presoaking, loading of instruments in the ultrasonic/medivator, and washer/disinfector, as well as performs manual cleaning/washing.

  • Prioritizes work according to direction and Operating Room demand, monitoring flow, and timing.

Instrumentation:

  • Inspects and reassembles clean instrumentation and equipment according to standard operating procedures.

  • Sorts instruments according to type.

  • Assembles instruments according to appropriate recipe.

  • Prepares instrument sets and appropriately places in either rigid containers or prepares for wrapping with proper identification, entering into queue for sterilization.

  • Maintains appropriate levels of sterile instrument sets and individual instrumentation relative to Operating Room scheduling.

Work Schedule:

  • Sunday-Thursday, 11:00 p.m.-7:30 a.m. with rotating weekends and holidays by seniority.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent OR

  • Completion of an associate degree program or higher OR

  • Certificate of completion for a Central Service Technician OR

  • Enrollment in an associate degree program or higher with completion of a clinical internship in sterile processing.

  • Ability to read and write English proficiently.

  • Ability to interpret colorimetric determinations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Six months (1040 hours) of experience in sterile processing or surgical instrumentation.

Additional Information:

This is a union 1.0 FTE (80 hours per pay period) night shift position, working in Saint Paul, MN. The full salary range for this position is $23.92-$33.52 per hour, based on experience and internal equity, plus shift differentials. This position is non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act, and is eligible for benefits. Our benefits include medical and dental insurance (which begin on the first day of the month following start), 401(k) with match, disability insurance, fertility benefits, tuition reimbursement, educational reimbursement toward continuing education, and we are a qualified non-profit employer under the federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness program. We offer an onsite employee fitness center and an onsite employee clinic to make it more convenient for our staff to get the care they need, and have a Center for Employee Resilience that provides support and evidence-based practices to bring relief and build resiliency. Regions is also proud to be a Beyond the Yellow Ribbon Company.

description:

Organization

Vancouver is consistently ranked as one of the world’s most liveable and environmentally sustainable cities. Recognized among BC’s Top Employers and Canada’s Greenest Employers, the City of Vancouver is seeking colleagues who can help advance our core commitments to exceptional public service, sustainability, equity, and an outstanding quality of life for all residents.

With a strong commitment to being a City of Reconciliation, we invite you to join our dedicated team and become part of an innovative, inclusive, and engaging workplace. A career with the City of Vancouver and within the broader public service, offers meaningful work where you play a key role in ensuring equitable access to services, upholding ethical governance, and supporting the needs of citizens with integrity and dedication.

Britannia is a unique community centre providing services to the Grandview Woodland and Strathcona neighbourhoods. The Indigenous Recreation Programmer I plays a vital role in Britannia’s ReconciliACTION efforts by ensuring the effective operation and implementation of core Indigenous programs, including BEST and Weaving Community Together. Working collaboratively in a community development environment, this position focuses on program delivery, relationship-building, mentorship, and program planning that centers Indigenous values and cultural protocols. The successful candidate will fluidly balance event planning, capacity-building workshops, and direct community engagement to support these ongoing initiatives.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

  • Program & Event Delivery: Ensure the effective operation and implementation of Indigenous programs (including BEST and WCT) by planning, promoting, and delivering activities, cultural workshops, gatherings, and forums.

  • Administration & Supervision: Recruit, train, and supervise Program Assistants; manage related clerical duties, statistical tracking, and reporting; assist with writing funding applications and program reports.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated working knowledge of Indigenous cultures, history, values, and cultural protocols.
  • Proven success in building relationships and working collaboratively with Indigenous communities, specifically with youth, Elders, and seniors.
  • Strong understanding of the barriers to participation in mainstream recreational settings for excluded populations, and the ability to adapt programs accordingly.
  • Ability to independently plan, coordinate, and deliver recreational and capacity-building programs.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate diverse community needs with tact, diplomacy, and consistency.
  • Ability to supervise staff, maintain accurate financial/statistical records, and write clear reports and funding applications.
  • Working knowledge of standard safety practices and policies applicable to recreational programming.

title: Principal Scientist, Product Transfer
description:
Job Title: Principal Scientist, Product Transfer

Location: Cherry Hill, NJ

Job Type: Full time

Req ID: 12822

About Us:

As a developer, manufacturer, and supplier of essential medicines, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. and its affiliates’ mission is to bring Better Health. Within Reach. Every Day.® for millions of patients around the world. We are a trusted, reliable partner and dependable source of over 800 high-quality generic, specialty and branded pharmaceutical products that hospitals, physicians and pharmacists need to treat their patients across North America, the Middle East, North Africa and Europe. Through our 32 manufacturing plants, three R&D centers, and 9,500+ employees worldwide, we are always hard at work creating high-quality medicines and making them accessible to the people who need them.

Description:

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. We are seeking a talented and motivated Prinicipal Scientist, Product Transfer to join our team.

In this role, you will be responsible for transferring products from R&D to Operations, including supporting process development and registration, performing scale-up and validation, start-up of commercial production, and transfer to lifecycle support. Minimize obstacles during development, product transfer, validation, and commercialization through utilization of risk-mitigation strategies, best practice sharing, and influence with R&D and Operations colleagues.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrate influence, leadership, and influential teamwork skills with development partners/customers during the process development and registration of new product NDAs and ANDAs, ensuring that all project timelines are met.
  • Drive Process Risk Analysis, Scale-up/Transfer trials, and Process Validation of new products as the Operations team representative, and influence development partners to ensure that new products meet requirements for quality, cost and manufacturability.
  • Prepare evaluation protocols/reports, validation protocols/reports, master formula cards and other documents for assigned products/projects to meet established project timelines.
  • Perform peer review of documentation to drive right-first-time performance of department and to ensure accuracy of PT Launch documentation that is delivered to customers (e.g. Master Manufacturing Formulae, validation protocols and reports, submission documentation, etc...).
  • Drive continuous improvement activities for launched products through initial commercial production phase, until transfer of launched products to lifecycle support with Process/Quality Flow.
  • Mentor and develop other members of the PT Launch department. Act as a subject matter expert on core technologies and/or process engineering topics (e.g. particular pieces of equipment, statistical analysis, validation approaches, etc.).

Qualifications:

We value the skills and experiences candidates bring to the table. While we have listed some qualifications below, we encourage candidates to apply even if they do not meet all of them:

  • B.S. in Chemistry, Engineering, Pharmacy, or related scientific discipline with 8+ years of relevant pharmaceutical experience, or 10+ years of relevant experience in another technical field; M.S. with 6+ years of pharmaceutical experience or 8+ years in another technical field; or Ph.D. with 4+ years of relevant pharmaceutical experience or 8+ years in another technical field. Relevant experience includes technology transfer, process/product development, quality assurance, manufacturing, and/or process engineering.
  • Expert knowledge of pharmaceutical development and manufacturing requirements, including cGMP, DEA, and FDA regulations and guidance.
  • Strong expertise in pharmaceutical production, formulation development, process scale-up, optimization, validation, and technology transfer.
  • Subject Matter Expertise in two or more core pharmaceutical processing technologies, with demonstrated ability to develop, scale up, and/or transfer complex pharmaceutical processes and dosage forms.
  • Expert knowledge of pharmaceutical processing equipment, including operation, critical equipment parameters, and troubleshooting. Experience with equipment such as high-shear mixers, bin blenders, tablet presses, granulators, film coaters, and liquid mixing tanks preferred.
  • Expertise in experimental design and methodology, including designing complex studies and analyzing data to support process development, transfer, and validation. Experience with statistical design and analysis software preferred.
  • Advanced problem-solving and root-cause investigation skills, with the ability to identify complex technical issues and develop effective corrective actions.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply technical expertise to influence product development, production, process optimization, and continuous improvement.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with SAP, TrackWise, and/or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) preferred.
  • Experience leading complex technical projects, cross-functional teams, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound scientific judgment, and lead strategic and tactical activities with minimal supervision.
  • Strong leadership, teamwork, and influencing skills, with experience facilitating complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to train, coach, and mentor colleagues on technical principles, pharmaceutical processes, equipment, and process optimization.

Compensation:

Base Salary: $98,000.00 to $161,700.00 annually. The compensation for this position will be determined during the interview process and will vary based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, work location, prior experience and job-related knowledge, relevant skills and expertise, current business needs, and market factors. The Talent Acquisition team can provide more details about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

  • A generous paid time off (PTO) bank starting with 20 days (prorated based on hire date). Additional days granted upon reaching work milestone anniversaries
  • 3 personal days (prorated based on hire date)
  • 11 company paid holidays
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, vision, mental health, disability, life insurance, prescription drug coverage, and a variety of voluntary benefits
  • Employee discount program

*Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and depend on the job classification, role, and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change as well as specific plan or program terms.

Mathematical Skills:

Reasoning Ability:

  • Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.

Physical Requirements:

  • Be able to climb, lift up to 50lbs unassisted.

Work Environment:

  • Job requires climbing and working in high places on plant equipment occasionally.
  • Ability to work around moving parts on machines, in all types of weather, various heights and in enclosed spaces.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

Being part of VCNA is being part of building famous landmarks such as Toronto's CN Tower, Roy Thompson Hall, Maple Leaf Gardens and the Darlington Nuclear Station and Ryerson Centre, St. Regis Chicago and 150 N. Riverside, Louis High-Speed Rail in Chicago and more!

  • Opportunities to collaborate with teams around the globe and growth opportunities in different areas.

title: Bespoke Enterprise Solution Architect
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Bespoke Enterprise Solution Architect with a strong software engineering foundation to design and deliver customised enterprise solutions addressing complex business and technical requirements. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of relevant Solution Architecture experience, supported by prior hands-on software development experience at a senior level before transitioning into architecture.

This role requires the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure and implementable technical solutions while providing architectural and technical leadership throughout the delivery lifecycle. Experience with ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, industry-leading Enterprise Asset Management Systems is advantageous.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture and Design

• Lead the end-to-end architecture and technical design of bespoke enterprise applications and solutions.

• Translate business, functional and non-functional requirements into practical solution architectures and technical designs.

• Prepare solution blueprints, architecture diagrams, integration designs, data flows, technical decision records and deployment approaches.

• Design solution architectures that appropriately balance bespoke software development, enterprise platforms, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) products and cloud services based on business, technical, security and operational requirements.

• Determine whether requirements should be addressed through configuration, platform extension, systems integration or bespoke software development, considering maintainability, scalability, security and implementation complexity.

• Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, maintainable and aligned with customer requirements and technology roadmaps.

• Evaluate and recommend suitable platforms, frameworks, products and architectural approaches.


Application Development and Integration

• Provide technical direction to software development and engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.

• Define application architecture, APIs, interfaces, integration patterns and data flows between enterprise systems.

• Review technical designs and implementation approaches for alignment with approved architecture and engineering standards.

• Apply practical software development experience when assessing technical feasibility, complexity and implementation risks.

• Support the resolution of complex application, integration, performance and production issues where required.

Technical Leadership and Delivery Governance

• Work closely with Project Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, Infrastructure, Cloud and Cybersecurity teams to support successful delivery.

• Provide architecture governance and technical guidance across design, development, testing, deployment and operational handover.

• Identify technical risks, dependencies and constraints, and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.

• Guide delivery teams on source control, CI/CD, DevSecOps and release management practices.

• Conduct technical reviews to ensure delivered solutions remain aligned with the approved architecture.

• Mentor development teams and support the consistent application of technical and engineering standards.

Pre-Sales and Client Engagement

• Participate in customer discovery sessions, requirements workshops and technical discussions.

• Develop solution architectures, technical proposals, implementation approaches, sizing and technical estimates for tenders and proposals.

• Conduct technical presentations, solution walkthroughs and demonstrations for customers.

• Work with Sales and Business Development teams to develop technically feasible and commercially appropriate solutions.

• Liaise with technology vendors and partners where third-party products or platforms form part of the overall solution.

Experience Requirements

• Minimum 3–5 years of relevant Solution Architecture experience, preferably involving bespoke enterprise applications, systems integration or digital solutions.

• Prior hands-on software development experience at a mid-to-senior level is mandatory and must have been acquired before transitioning into a Solution Architecture role.

• Candidates should have demonstrated mid-to-senior level responsibility for application design, software development, systems integration, troubleshooting, technical decision-making and providing technical guidance to other developers.

• Previous roles may include Senior Software Engineer, Senior Backend Developer, Senior Full-Stack Developer, Technical Lead or an equivalent position. An exact job title is not required where equivalent responsibilities and technical seniority can be demonstrated.

• Strong practical experience in application design, software development, systems integration, APIs, databases and troubleshooting.

• Experience across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design through development, testing, deployment and production support.

• Experience providing technical direction, design guidance and technical leadership to software development teams.

• Practical understanding of cloud, application, database, integration and infrastructure architectures.

• Experience designing and integrating applications using REST APIs, web services, messaging and other enterprise integration approaches.

• Customer-facing experience in technical workshops, architecture discussions, solution presentations and/or pre-sales activities is advantageous.

• Preferably exxperience in platforms such as ServiceNOW and Microsoft Dynamics 365

Education and Qualification Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.

• Architecture certification such as TOGAF is advantageous.

• Relevant cloud architecture certification, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Certified Solutions Architect, is advantageous.

• Relevant ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Business Central, industry-leading Enterprise Asset Management Systems, Appian certifications are advantageous.

title: Freeze Dryer Operator
description:
Freeze Dryer Operator

Job Description – April 2020

Supervisor’s Title: Production Team Leader

Department: Production

At Glanbia Dairy Nutrition, our portfolio centers on dairy and non-dairy nutritional ingredients. We co-innovate and deliver ingredient solutions and precision premixes for use in the mainstream food and beverage, infant and clinical, and functional nutrition markets. We are the number one provider of whey-based nutritional ingredients globally and the number one producer of American-style cheddar cheese. Our protein systems have transformed the bar and beverage categories — bringing increased levels of protein, cleaner labels and greater product functionality to market. We have a direct presence in 21 countries, with manufacturing facilities in the US, Germany and China, and international sales and technical offices around the world.

Job Summary

Handles the operation of various pieces of equipment used in processing whey.

Essential Functions

  • Efficiently operate all whey processing equipment (Freeze Dryer, Hydroflaker, Packaging Equipment, & Sterile filter if required)

  • Trouble shoots equipment to improve and maintain operating efficiencies
  • Operate and maintain all CIP systems
  • Safely handle, measure, mix, and dispose of cleaning and sanitizing chemicals used in the Clean-In-Place (CIP) process in accordance with established procedures, safety data sheets (SDS), and company safety policies.
  • Keep work area clean and uncluttered
  • Assist with training people or other operators
