  • Each employee shall comply with occupational safety and health standards and all rules, regulations, and orders issued pursuant to the Occupational Safety and Health Act which are applicable to his/her own actions and conduct.

Additional Functions

  • Regular and timely attendance required

Qualifications

  • Computer experience helpful

  • Cannot have any lifting restrictions

The physical demands described represent those that must be met by an employee and the work environment characteristics are those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Requirements

  • Rarely (1-25%) stand, sit, talk or hear, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, and reach with hands and arms.
  • Specific vision requirements for this job include close vision (clear vision at 20 inches or less); distance vision (clear vision at 20 feet or more), color vision (ability to identify and distinguish colors), peripheral vision (ability to observe an area that can be seen up and down or to the left and right while eyes are fixed on a given point); depth perception (three-dimensional vision, ability to judge distances and spatial relationships); ability to adjust focus (ability to adjust the eye to bring an object into sharp focus).

Typical Environmental Conditions

May be exposed to humidity, intense heat and cold, outdoor weather conditions, and fumes and toxic chemicals.

May work in areas with mechanical moving parts, above ground with risk of fall, or areas with risk of electrical shock.

title: Director, Strategic Investors
description:
Create your best future and join Westpac as a Director, Strategic Investors

What’s the role?

As a Director in our Strategic Investors team, you’ll be at the centre of how Westpac builds and grows relationships with superannuation funds and institutional investors across Melbourne. You’ll spend your time deepening trusted partnerships with key decision‑makers across investment, treasury and risk teams, and connecting clients to the breadth of Westpac’s capabilities.

This is a relationship‑led role where you’ll originate and deliver integrated solutions across capital markets, funding, risk management and transaction banking. You’ll play a key role in expanding our network across the investor ecosystem, strengthening coverage depth, and positioning Westpac as a long‑term partner to providers of patient capital.

This is a full‑time, Melbourne‑based opportunity within our Corporate and Institutional Bank, offering you the platform to influence outcomes for clients while helping shape Westpac’s presence in the institutional investor market.

What do I need?

To thrive in this role, you’ll bring strong investor insight, commercial judgement and the confidence to build meaningful, long‑term relationships.

  • Experience working with institutional investors, superannuation funds, asset managers or financial institutions.
  • A strong understanding of investor behaviour, asset allocation, portfolio construction and operating models.
  • Ability to originate or facilitate opportunities across debt and private markets, and connect clients to capital and investment flows.
  • Knowledge of transaction banking, payments and liquidity management, with awareness of emerging digital asset and payment trends.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to balance relationship development, risk management and commercial outcomes in a regulated environment.

Why join us?

We’re obsessed with becoming our customers' #1 banking partner for life and we’re looking for people who are passionate about helping us achieve that goal. In return, we’re committed to making Westpac the best place to work in the country. Here are just a few of the ways we’re already doing that:

  • Special offers on banking products and discounts from top brands, including generous employee-only mortgage rates!
  • Flexible work arrangements to help you achieve a greater work/life balance, and a variety of leave options including Culture, Lifestyle and Wellbeing leave.
  • Tailored learning and development opportunities to help your grow your career within the bank.
  • Lots of opportunities to ‘give back’ to the Community by getting involved in our many volunteering initiatives.

Create your future today

To get started, simply click on the APPLY or APPLY NOW button

We’re all about creating a supportive and inclusive community. We welcome everyone – no matter your age, gender, background, or abilities. We also provide additional support to welcome our veterans, Indigenous Australians and neurodiverse community.

If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, you can find out more information and additional contact details by visiting the "People with Disability and/or needing Accessibility Requirements" page on our website.

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
Role: Cyber Security Engineer

Duration: Permanent

Location: Buona Vista, Changi - 4 days at client site, 1 day from Ayer Rajah

Experience : 3-5 years

The Cybersecurity Engineer will be responsible for coordinating VAPT activities, analyzing security logs and alerts, reviewing firewall configurations and access rules, managing remediation of security findings, supporting security incident investigation, and maintaining the necessary security documentation and compliance evidence. The role will also support security patching, configuration hardening, risk assessment and audit requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 operational support, maintenance and troubleshooting for network and cybersecurity infrastructure to ensure system availability, security compliance and operational stability.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, health checks and operational monitoring of network and security equipment.
  • Manage firewall operations, including rule administration, configuration changes, troubleshooting and verification in accordance with established security policies.
  • Provide operational support and maintenance for Hardware Security Modules (HSM), ensuring availability and proper functioning.
  • Monitor Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms, investigate security alerts, analyse events, identify potential threats and escalate incidents to the relevant teams.
  • Administer and maintain Symantec Endpoint Protection Manager (SEPM), including monitoring endpoint security status and supporting security policy enforcement.
  • Monitor Aruba ClearPass and PAAM platforms, investigate operational issues and coordinate remediation to maintain service availability and access security.
  • Support Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) remediation activities, including tracking findings, coordinating corrective actions and performing remediation verification.
  • Conduct quarterly security and compliance checks and support IM8 compliance governance to ensure adherence to applicable security standards, policies and requirements.
  • Perform incident, problem and change management activities, including incident investigation, escalation, root cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support patch management, configuration management and security hardening activities to maintain infrastructure integrity and reduce security risks.
  • Conduct testing and verification of infrastructure changes, patches, configurations and security remediation activities to ensure operational readiness and minimise service disruptions.
  • Coordinate incident response and resolution with relevant stakeholders, technical teams and service providers in accordance with established procedures and service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Maintain accurate operational documentation, incident records, configuration baselines, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and knowledge base articles.
  • Support day-to-day cybersecurity Business-as-Usual (BAU) operations, ensuring timely resolution of operational issues and adherence to established security policies, operational procedures and service-level requirements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of proven experience in cybersecurity or information security roles, with a focus on L2 support or similar responsibilities.
  • Minimally 1-2 years of experience in supporting mission critical systems with a stringent SLA of 99.9%
  • Strong understanding of security protocols, TCP/IP, network security, operating systems (Linux, Windows), and cloud security concepts. Well-versed in IT Service Management (ITSM) standards, processes, guidelines and best practices is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience with security tools such as SIEM, firewalls, vulnerability scanners (e.g., Tenable), and incident response platforms.
  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or CISSP are highly valued.

title: Senior Solutions Consultant (Saas - Pre-Sales)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Solutions Consultant (SaaS – Pre-Sales) based in the United States.

The Senior Solutions Consultant will play a key role in winning complex enterprise deals within the food and beverage manufacturing industry.
Partnering closely with Account Executives, you will lead the pre-sales consulting process, from discovery and tailored demonstrations to solution design and rollout planning.
You will act as a trusted advisor to manufacturing leaders, translating operational challenges into compelling technology solutions and measurable business outcomes.
Through strategic storytelling and value-based selling, you will help prospects understand how digital transformation can improve food safety, quality, compliance, and production efficiency.
You will also contribute to deal strategy, competitive positioning, and cross-functional collaboration with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams.
This is an opportunity to combine manufacturing expertise, consultative selling, and modern SaaS technology in a fast-growing, innovation-driven environment.

Accountabilities

The Senior Solutions Consultant will own the pre-sales consulting journey and work alongside Account Executives to advance strategic opportunities, demonstrate business value, and secure enterprise customers. Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead the end-to-end pre-sales consulting process, including discovery, tailored product demonstrations, solution scoping, deal strategy, technical diligence, rollout planning, and business value alignment.

  • Partner with Account Executives to develop and execute strategies for complex, competitive enterprise opportunities.

  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations that connect platform capabilities to prospects' operational priorities and business objectives.

  • Maintain the demonstration environment and develop reusable demo assets, playbooks, and supporting materials.

  • Support RFP responses, technical and security evaluations, and the preparation of complex Statements of Work (SOWs), ensuring responses address business outcomes rather than simply technical requirements.

  • Drive deal progression as a strategic advisor, solution consultant, and value translator, taking ownership of outcomes throughout the sales cycle.

  • Map key stakeholders, identify potential risks, assess competitors, and determine the best positioning to strengthen each opportunity.

  • Research opportunities and maintain accurate, up-to-date deal information in the CRM.

  • Translate complex operational and technical requirements into clear, persuasive solution narratives.

  • Articulate the platform's ROI and business transformation potential to influence purchasing decisions among business and technical stakeholders.

  • Use customer success stories and relevant industry examples to demonstrate credibility and communicate measurable impact.

  • Leverage call recordings and analysis tools to improve discovery, accountability, and continuous performance.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product teams to incorporate industry trends, best practices, and regulatory considerations into sales engagements.

  • Bring customer feedback and insights from the field to internal teams to help inform product development, positioning, and messaging.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to food and beverage manufacturers, demonstrating operational and food safety, quality assurance, and FSQA expertise.

  • Use AI-enabled tools throughout pre-sales activities, including discovery preparation, call analysis, solution narratives, ROI cases, RFPs, security responses, SOW drafts, competitive research, and demo development.

  • Create repeatable AI prompts and workflows while validating generated outputs against reliable sources, including CRM records, call recordings, product documentation, approved templates, and subject-matter experts.

  • Help other Solutions Consultants develop effective AI practices and contribute to establishing consistent team standards.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve sales practices, challenge ineffective approaches, and introduce creative, technology-driven ways to win business.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is an experienced pre-sales professional who combines enterprise SaaS expertise with strong consultative selling abilities and practical knowledge of manufacturing operations. The role requires:

    • Proven experience as a lead pre-sales professional or Solutions Consultant managing complex, competitive, large enterprise deals.

    • A successful track record of supporting and winning enterprise sales opportunities, preferably within the SaaS industry.

    • Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to deliver compelling, value-based presentations to both business and technical stakeholders.

    • A consultative approach supported by excellent storytelling, active listening, and problem-solving abilities.

    • Hands-on operational experience in manufacturing, ideally within the food and beverage sector.

    • Understanding of plant operations, food safety and quality assurance (FSQA), continuous improvement, production processes, and supplier quality management workflows.

    • Ability to connect operational challenges with technology solutions and communicate their business impact.

    • A proactive, self-directed mindset and the ability to establish direction in a fast-paced, collaborative sales environment.

    • Strong competitive drive, preparation, and persistence, with a clear sense of ownership over deal outcomes.

    • A technology-oriented mindset and the ability to quickly learn new platforms and tools.

    • Comfort working with integrations, data analysis, and APIs.

    • Practical experience using AI tools in everyday pre-sales activities, including building repeatable prompts and workflows.

    • Ability to validate AI-generated content against authoritative sources before using or sharing it.

    • Willingness to help colleagues adopt effective AI workflows and contribute to shared standards and best practices.

    • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with sales, marketing, product, and customer success teams.

      • Benefits

      • Base salary of approximately $150,000, with additional commission; final compensation depends on experience.

      • Competitive compensation plan.

      • Opportunity to participate in stock options.

      • Health benefits.

      • Self Care Paid Time Off (PTO) plan.

      • Flexible working schedule.

      • Remote work flexibility.

      • Annual investment in professional development.

      • Opportunity to join a fast-growing technology company with significant growth potential.

      • Collaborative team culture and opportunities to work across functions.

      • Meaningful work helping food and beverage manufacturers improve operational efficiency, quality, and safety.

title: Video & Photo Editor - 1472
description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Video and Photo Editor (Real Estate)

Compensation range: $1,500 - $2,000 AUD/month

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an Australian real estate photography and videography business based in Perth, specialising in high-quality property photography and video content. As the business grows, they are looking for a dedicated editor to support their post-production workload and help expand their creative capabilities.

There is also potential to support additional videographers within the team as the business expands, as well as contribute to content creation for a new real estate platform.

Role Overview: We are looking for a skilled Photo & Video Editor to produce high-quality, natural-looking property photos and videos. You will manage the editing workflow from reviewing incoming footage to delivering completed projects, bringing creativity and attention to detail beyond automated editing tools. This is a full-time, long-term opportunity for someone who can work independently and grow with the business.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Edit approximately 1–2 real estate videos per day, delivering polished and professionally finished content.
  • Edit property photographs, including colour correction, lighting adjustments, exposure and removal of unwanted elements.
  • Apply creative judgement to produce natural-looking results, particularly when editing interior lighting and property footage.
  • Review incoming shoots and uploaded content each morning and manage editing priorities.
  • Organise, process and upload files before delivering completed projects to clients.
  • Follow established editing preferences, workflows and brand guidelines.
  • Communicate progress and flag any issues with footage or project requirements.
  • Potentially take on additional editing work from other videographers as the business grows.

Requirements

  • Strong professional experience in both photo and video editing.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or equivalent professional video editing software.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop or equivalent photo editing software.
  • Good understanding of colour grading, colour correction, exposure and lighting.
  • Strong creative eye and attention to detail, with the ability to produce natural-looking edits.
  • Ability to work independently, manage workloads and meet deadlines.
  • Good organisational and file management skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in real estate photography and videography.
  • Experience working with Australian or US clients.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted editing tools and automated workflows.
  • Experience with HDR photography, Dropbox and digital file delivery platforms.

Candidates from adjacent industries such as architecture, interiors, commercial videography and hospitality are welcome to apply if their portfolio demonstrates the required quality and editing style.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical editing assessment using raw property footage and reference examples provided by the client. The assessment will cover both video and photo editing, with a focus on technical ability, creativity and overall output quality.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

title: FULL-TIME TEACHERS
description:

We are seeking committed and enthusiastic Primary School Tutors to deliver quality instruction in English, Mathematics and Science. Interested candidates are welcome to submit their CV along with details of their teaching experience, subject specialisations and availability.

title: Construction Assistant Project Manager
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced General Contractor Assistant Project Manager to join our team and play a crucial role in ensuring the successful execution of healthcare construction projects from inception to completion.

About Us
In 1999, armed with an Electrical Engineering degree, 14 years of business experience with Hoechst
Celanse and a restless entrepreneurial spirit, Francisco Alvarado decided to embark on a new venture
and Marand Builders, Inc was established. Since the conception of Marand, our goal has been to
understand the individual needs of our customers and provide them with a customized solution. We
have built our reputation on reliability, attentiveness, and quality of execution. We succeed when we
have provided our clients with the best construction experience. We started in Charlotte, NC, but rapidly expanded to cover the Carolinas, Mid-Atlantic and Southeast US regions. We have 7 regional offices in
Virginia, North Carolina, Georgia, and Florida. Our team of highly talented professionals has allowed us
to become a preferred vendor with many of our clients, exceeding 95% repeat business. Marand
specializes in serving the healthcare, financial services, commercial / administrative and light-industrial
industries.

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • At two years of experience in the commercial construction industry, overseeing all aspects of ground-up projects in healthcare, financial, and light industrial sectors.
  • The ability to manage more than 2 projects at one time and have an ambitious approach to balancing workload in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple teams, subcontractors, and stakeholders
  • Proficient in project reporting software, MS Office, and blueprint reading
  • Knowledge of building codes, safety regulations, and quality standards
  • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a proactive and results-oriented approach
  • A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel to various job sites

Requirements
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
  • 2 years of commercial construction experience
  • Proficient with technology
  • Must have the ability to manage multiple projects/activities in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
  • Should have strong communication skills that allow him/her to interact comfortably with everyone from project owners to tradesmen.
  • Must have a basic understanding of the construction process, including materials, equipment, and techniques.
  • Travel is a requirement of this job. Travel can be up to 25%.

Responsibilities
  • Typically share the responsibilities of managing the project budget, writing contracts, approving invoices, and updating the project schedule.
  • Coordinate among subcontractors and help to resolve any issues or conflicts that arise during the job.
  • In some cases, the Assistant Project Manager might manage the project independently, while the Project Manager might assist with major issues or complications.
  • Will benefit from skills such as blueprint reading and the ability to use scheduling software.
  • Organize, process, and distribute pertinent project documents.
  • Assist in the development and updating of the project schedule.
  • Expedite documents and material and equipment deliveries to meet the project schedule.
  • Assist in maintaining cost control data.
  • Maintain mutually satisfying long-term relationships with customers, architects, engineers, subcontractors, vendors, and employees.
  • Perform various duties in support of the Project Manager.
  • Assist the Project team in mobilization, including procurement of permits, trailer set-up, etc.
  • Assist the PM in development of a schedule of values and estimate listing and maintenance.
  • Assist in updating the overall construction schedule on a regular basis.
  • Assist in developing short interval schedules for use at weekly coordination meetings (?).
  • Assist in the implementation and tracking of LEED requirements.
  • Administer the document control for shop drawings, Submittals, Subcontracts/Purchase Orders, insurance certificates/Bonds, R.F.I.’s, Plans and specifications, Warranties/as-builts and manuals, Notices to owner/Lien Releases, Construction Bulletins, Change Order Requests from the owner, back charges.
  • Review shop drawings and submittals to verify compliance with contract documents.
  • Assist the Project Team in the preparation of Cost Reports.
  • Assist in subcontractor applications for payment/vendor invoice processing.
  • Attend project-related meetings and assist with the preparation and dissemination of minutes and attendee’s roster.
  • Assist in the punch list completion process.
  • Assist the project team in all close-out procedures and activities.
  • Assist in the implementation of warranty work at the direction of the Project Manager.

Physical Demands:
  • The individual typically works in an office environment and uses a computer, telephone and other office equipment as needed to perform duties.

title: Project Mgr, Sr Staff
description:
PS Job Title: Project Mgr, Sr Staff

Work Place Flexibility: Onsite

Legal Entity: Entergy New Orleans, LLC

Job Summary:

This role supports OpCo leadership by driving execution of enterprise aligned priorities, regulatory readiness, and operational performance. It ensures accurate financial and regulatory reporting, maintains an effective operating rhythm, and advance’s reliability by partnering across the Center of Excellences including Operations, Engineering, Work Management, Construction, Strategic Planning, and Asset Management to translate plans into executable field actions to improve reliability. The role will support the Reliability Vice President over New Orleans with overseeing resource deployment and Productivity KPIs, monitors capital and O&M budgets, and translates plans into executable field actions. It provides day-to-day support in guiding our team in a matrixed environment, strengthening organizational capability through coaching and development, and supports storm response activities by assisting in storm reporting, and comprehensive after-action reviews. The position reinforces safety culture and operational risk controls while driving accountability and execution excellence.

Job Duties/Responsibilities:

• Reliability – Supports system reliability by coordinating cross-functional project activities across the Center of Excellence: Operations, Planning, Reliability Performance, Work Management, Engineering, and Construction. Ensures project plans are executable, aligns crews and schedules, coordinates resource needs, and monitors the quality and progress of capital and O&M reliability initiatives such as the execution of the reliability plan.

• Matrixed Coordination & Accountability – Provides day-to-day project guidance to peers and matrixed partners across Construction, Work Management, and Engineering. Ensures priorities are clearly defined, support needs are understood, and communication with Centers of Excellence remains transparent and consistent. Fosters alignment and accountability among project participants.

• Organizational Development – Coaches and mentors team members and project contributors. Conducts routine check-ins, reinforces safety and productivity expectations, and provides constructive performance feedback to support development of high-potential project resources.

Participates in After‑Action Reviews and helps implement continuous improvements. Reinforces adherence to safety standards and operational risk controls including switching, audit/near-miss closure, and serious injury prevention. title: Instrument Processing Technician
description:
Regions Hospital is looking for an Instrument Processing Technician to join our team!

The Instrument Processing Technician works under the direction of the Sterile Processing Manager and is responsible for the proper handling, cleaning, disinfecting, assembly, and sterilization of instrumentation and patient-related equipment to render items safe for handling and use.

The Technician works in three main areas:

Sterilization:

  • Loads, unloads, and safely operates all sterilizers according to policies and procedures.

  • Completes all monitoring paperwork, sterilization records, and records of instrument sets within required timeline.

  • Maintains sterility of equipment and supplies.

  • Transports, handles, and stores sterile instruments and supplies per appropriate standards.

Decontamination:

  • Treats all instruments and equipment in the decontamination areas appropriately.

  • Follows proper cleaning procedures for items being cleaned.

  • Organizes and sorts instrument sets and equipment for proper cleaning, decontamination and ensures appropriate method of cleaning is used.

  • Performs presoaking, loading of instruments in the ultrasonic/medivator, and washer/disinfector, as well as performs manual cleaning/washing.

  • Prioritizes work according to direction and Operating Room demand, monitoring flow, and timing.

Instrumentation:

  • Inspects and reassembles clean instrumentation and equipment according to standard operating procedures.

  • Sorts instruments according to type.

  • Assembles instruments according to appropriate recipe.

  • Prepares instrument sets and appropriately places in either rigid containers or prepares for wrapping with proper identification, entering into queue for sterilization.

  • Maintains appropriate levels of sterile instrument sets and individual instrumentation relative to Operating Room scheduling.

Work Schedule:

  • Monday-Friday, 3:00-11:30 p.m. with rotating weekends and holidays by seniority.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent OR

  • Completion of an associate degree program or higher OR

  • Certificate of completion for a Central Service Technician OR

  • Enrollment in an associate degree program or higher with completion of a clinical internship in sterile processing.

  • Ability to read and write English proficiently.

  • Ability to interpret colorimetric determinations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Six months (1040 hours) of experience in sterile processing or surgical instrumentation.

Additional Information:

This is a union 1.0 FTE (80 hours per pay period) evening shift position, working in Saint Paul, MN. The full salary range for this position is $23.92-$33.52 per hour, based on experience and internal equity, plus shift differentials. This position is non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act, and is eligible for benefits. Our benefits include medical and dental insurance (which begin on the first day of the month following start), 401(k) with match, disability insurance, fertility benefits, tuition reimbursement, educational reimbursement toward continuing education, and we are a qualified non-profit employer under the federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness program. We offer an onsite employee fitness center and an onsite employee clinic to make it more convenient for our staff to get the care they need, and have a Center for Employee Resilience that provides support and evidence-based practices to bring relief and build resiliency. Regions is also proud to be a Beyond the Yellow Ribbon Company.

title: Excavator Trainer
description:

We are seeking an experienced and responsible Excavator Trainer to conduct hydraulic excavator operation training and equip trainees with the necessary knowledge and practical skills for safe machine operation.

The successful candidate will primarily be responsible for training activities. When there are no scheduled training sessions, he will assist with excavator operating duties and other related operational tasks as assigned

  • Positive working attitude with good communication skills.

  • Working Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

  • Working Locations: Changi

title: Customer Retention Supervisor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Retention Supervisor based in Turkey.

Are you an experienced customer retention leader passionate about building high-performing teams and driving measurable business growth? This opportunity allows you to lead and develop a team of retention specialists within the fast-growing fintech and cryptocurrency industry. You will take ownership of customer reactivation, repeat transactions, and revenue recovery while remaining actively involved in outbound customer engagement. Combining hands-on leadership with strategic campaign management, you will develop effective retention processes, coach team members, and continuously improve customer conversion rates. Working in a dynamic, performance-driven environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen customer relationships and maximise business results. This is an ideal role for a proactive leader who enjoys mentoring people, analysing performance, and turning customer engagement strategies into tangible revenue.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead, supervise, and motivate a team of Customer Retention Specialists, establishing clear performance objectives, responsibilities, and accountability standards.
  • Conduct outbound customer calls personally to encourage repeat transactions, reconnect with inactive customers, and demonstrate effective retention techniques by example.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), calling workflows, scripts, and training materials to strengthen team performance.
  • Organise daily outreach activities, manage agent schedules, and allocate campaign assignments to ensure efficient customer engagement.
  • Design and execute customer retention campaigns, including promotional offers, discount incentives, abandoned transaction follow-ups, and reactivation initiatives.
  • Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), including call volumes, conversion rates, repeat transactions, customer reactivation rates, and revenue recovered.
  • Conduct regular call evaluations, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen agents' communication and sales skills.
  • Analyse customer behaviour, transaction activity, and campaign performance to identify retention opportunities and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Maintain accurate customer relationship management (CRM) records, agent scorecards, performance dashboards, and regular operational reports.
  • Manage escalated customer concerns and collaborate with Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effective issue resolution.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and training initiatives to build and maintain a capable, results-oriented retention team.
  • Use relevant digital and AI-powered tools to improve research, script development, workflow efficiency, and overall team productivity.

Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in customer retention, outbound sales, contact centre operations, or a similar customer-facing environment.
  • Demonstrated success in customer conversion, retention, and reactivation, with experience managing performance-driven teams and achieving measurable commercial results.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate teams, manage performance, and encourage continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, particularly when engaging customers over the phone.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable improvement plans.
  • Ability to balance direct customer engagement with team supervision and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards.
  • Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage.
  • Basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies, combined with a genuine interest in financial technology, is considered a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Additional financial rewards directly linked to individual achievements and overall team performance.
  • Paid Annual Leave: 10 days of paid vacation per year.
  • Public Holidays: Paid time off on all U.S. federal holidays.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere in Anywhere, provided you have a professional home-working setup.
  • Leadership and Career Development: Opportunity to lead, develop, and shape a customer retention team while strengthening your management expertise.
  • High-Growth Industry Exposure: Work within the rapidly evolving global fintech and cryptocurrency sector.
  • Direct Business Impact: Take ownership of retention initiatives that directly contribute to customer engagement, recovered revenue, and business growth.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive, high-trust working environment that values initiative, accountability, and professional development.
  • AI-Enabled Work Environment: Opportunities to leverage modern AI tools to improve workflows, customer engagement, and operational efficiency.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be a professional team player with customer focus and ability to take initiative and direction
  • 18 years of age or older
  • Highly adaptable and professional

title: Solution-Based Casework (SBC) Case Planner (Queens Location)
description:
JOB TITLE: Solution-Based Casework (SBC) Case Planner
EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full-Time
LOCATION: Hybrid – 2-3 days in office (Queens Location)
REPORTS TO: Solution-Based Casework Supervisor
SALARY: $62,166.99 Annually

ABOUT AAFSC:

For over 30 years, the Arab-American Family Support Center (AAFSC) has proudly served immigrants and refugees. We help children stay safe, families remain together, and newcomers navigate life in New York City. While our doors are open to all, AAFSC has expertise in serving Arab, Middle Eastern, North African, Muslim, and South Asian communities.

JOB OBJECTIVE:

To provide high-quality case planning, case work, and case management services to at-risk families referred by the Administration for Children’s Services. These families may be experiencing a wide range of challenges, including personal/marital/relationship problems, financial stressors, acculturation issues, family destabilization, and/or parent/child conflict. The Case Planner provides intensive preventive services to avoid foster care placement and ensure the safety and welfare of children in the home. He or she provides the family with services according to ACS standards and requirements. The Case Planner follows a Solution Based Casework (SBC) practice model. SBC is based on three theoretical foundations: family life cycle theory, relapse prevention/CBT theory, and solution-focused family therapy. Partnership with families in each and every case is critical to reducing risks and solutions should utilize prevention skills to achieve those goals.

PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Case Management & Advocacy

  • Ensure timely completion of SBC training & certification.

  • Conduct home visits and office visits to assess child safety and risk elements, complying with ACS requirements. Face-to-face contacts should be conducted twice per month, at a minimum and includes home visits (two home visits must be conducted if children 0-2 years old are present) and office visits (e.g., school, doctor’s office, AAFSC), as well as other out-of-home visits (e.g., park). More visits may be required.

  • Provide case work/case management services to families receiving Preventive Services (12 cases); which includes but is not limited to providing supportive casework, focusing on service goals, and child welfare laws, improving family relationships and bonding, coping skills, parenting, etc.

  • Ensure joint-home visits are conducted within 5 business days from the date of referral.

  • Evaluate and assess the current family functioning including child safety and home safety (e.g., assessing other adults in the home, ensuring safe sleep, working fire alarms, window guards, etc.).

  • Work in partnership with the family to formulate outcomes & service plans with the family.

  • Ensure all initial intake documents (AAFSC intake, Domestic Violence screening, child trafficking) are completed and processed accurately using AAFSC internal database (i.e., Apricot).

  • Advocate for the family by linking them to needed services in the community: medical, mental health, entitlements, day care, home health aide services, substance abuse treatment, anger management, etc. and follow up to monitor participation and progress.

  • In collaboration with the Conference Facilitator, support the facilitation of Family Team Conferences and Service Termination Conferences, as well as other relevant ACS-led conferences. Family Team Conferences must be conducted within 4 weeks of the FASP due date.

  • Ensure FASPs are launched 30 days prior to the due date and submitted to Supervisor 3 weeks prior to the due date.

  • Complete Initial, Comprehensive, all Reassessment FASPs, and Plan Amendments for all Advocate Preventive Only (ADVPO) cases offline.

  • Complete and Submit Child Trafficking Screening for Child Welfare Services and ADVPO cases.

  • Evaluate walk-ins and community referrals for needed services and potentially for advocacy cases.

  • Provide case coverage in the absence of a co-worker (as needed).

  • Schedule and coordinate monthly visits with FSU workers (applicable to FSU cases only).

Quality Assurance, Communication, and Documentation

  • Complete all documents required by ACS in a timely manner (5 business days) including but not limited to progress notes and FASPs using templates in a manner that reflects the progress or lack thereof, including the reaction of the family to services during the review period or contact.

  • Complete all ACS and internal forms required for case opening and closing as well as obtain consents and forms needed for other case activities. Obtain and maintain collateral contacts with all other service providers including school and medical reports on a regular basis.

  • Comply with all data entry requirements for database systems including inputting information in a timely manner (PROMIS, Connections, etc.).

  • Compile and organize appropriate client intake paperwork, surveys, and forms. Maintain casefiles, database entry, and record keeping in compliance with ACS, OCFS, and AAFSC requirements, in alignment with the Solution Based Casework Model guidelines (as needed).

  • Appropriately follow incident reporting procedures (as needed).

  • Maintain relationships with ACS personnel, including DCP workers, joint home visit ACS staff, and FSU workers, for ongoing ACS supervision.

  • Regularly collaborate and communicate with PPRS staff by responding to emails, maintaining an up-to-date Outlook calendar, participating in supervision meetings, and scheduling office days.

  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Trainings, Meetings, and Audit Preparation

  • Attend training provided by ACS, Solution Based Casework, and other organizations as required (minimum of 42 hours/6 days each fiscal year) and log training by submitting certificates to the Director of Training and Development.

  • Attend internal meetings as scheduled, collaborating with the multidisciplinary team (e.g., monthly supervision).

  • Assist in preparation of internal and external audits (COQI, PAMS, safety alerts, etc.) related to the program operation and delivery of services.

BACKGROUND & POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

A successful Case Planner at AAFSC is one that is both compassionate and objective. The candidate must be a good communicator and problem solver who is able to quickly respond to unforeseen challenges. In addition to these general skills and traits, AAFSC is looking for a candidate with the following skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required.

  • Familiarity with using PROMIS and Connections.

  • Computer skills in Microsoft Office suite and excellent writing skills are required.

  • Bilingual or multi-lingual fluency required. Arabic, Bangla/Bengali, Hindi, Spanish or Urdu skills strongly preferred.

  • Experience working with under-served students in urban schools, child welfare system, and/or community-based settings a plus.

  • Exercises discretion regarding sensitive personal and legal information.

  • Job contingent on pre-employment background checks.

  • U.S. Work authorization required.

We are an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.

  • Develop and implement risk mitigation measures and contingency plans to minimise project delays, equipment failures, and unexpected operational disruptions.
  • Coordinate with project teams and relevant stakeholders to ensure that work activities comply with approved project specifications, quality standards, and applicable safety requirements.
  • Monitor non-conformities, technical defects, and project-related issues, ensuring that corrective actions are properly implemented and documented.
  • Review project performance and recommend improvements to project management procedures, technical coordination, and operational efficiency.

9. Overseas Business Travel and Site Coordination

10. Project Reporting and Management Responsibilities

  • Provide regular updates to senior management on project performance, contractual matters, financial exposure, technical issues, and operational risks.

title: Principal Engineer, Data Engineering
description:
The data you will build pipelines for is not transactional data or clickstream data. It is experimental measurement data from precision product development instruments — each data point costs real time and resources to generate. Getting the data infrastructure right for this kind of scientific data is a genuinely different engineering challenge from standard web-scale or financial data work. You will develop rare expertise in ML-ready scientific data pipelines that very few data engineers in Singapore or globally have built.

Key Responsibilities

  • Feature Engineering Pipelines: Build and maintain reliable, versioned feature engineering pipelines that transform raw engineering, sensor, and operational data into structured ML-ready feature sets — delivered to the specification defined
  • Data Quality Frameworks: Design and operate data quality checks covering completeness, schema consistency, statistical distribution stability, and label accuracy across all AI training datasets. Alert the ML team when data quality degrades before it impacts model training. Collaborate with team who performs final downstream validation.
  • Data Versioning, Lineage & Drift Detection: Build and maintain training data versioning and lineage tracking — ensuring full reproducibility of all model training runs and early alerting when deployment data diverges from training distributions.
  • Data Contracts & Governance — Guided Implementation: Implement and maintain agreed data contracts between upstream data producers and downstream ML consumers, following governance standards established with guidance from ML Engineer. Establish access control and retention practices for all AI data assets.
  • Real-Time Streaming — Sensor Data Ingestion: Contribute to real-time sensor data ingestion pipelines under technical direction. Develops operational ownership progressively over 6–12 months. Not a solo day-1 requirement.
  • Synthetic Data Pipeline Support: Build pipeline infrastructure to operationalize synthetic data generation workstreams. With generative model methodology provided, builds ingestion, storage, and versioning infrastructure.
  • MLOps Data Layer: Build and maintain the training dataset registry, feature store, and model input validation — tightly integrated with the AI platform (AWS Kubernetes, PortKey, Agent Gateway, LangFuse, AWS Guardrails, Elastic Search etc.).

Qualifications

Requirements:

Education

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in AI, Computer Science, Data Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field. AI major preferred; strong data engineering fundamentals required.

Experience

  • At least 2-3 years Demonstrated project experience building end-to-end data pipelines — academic, personal, or internship contexts — is the primary evaluation criterion. Python, SQL, and pipeline design fundamentals must be solid and demonstrable through project evidence.

Must Have Skills:

  • Python: Strong proficiency — primary pipeline development language
  • SQL: Strong proficiency — complex queries, window functions, data transformation logic
  • Scalable Pipeline Design: Batch pipeline architecture; reliability, schema management, fault tolerance; Pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, AWS Glue Jobs)
  • Data Quality Principles: Completeness checks, schema validation, distribution stability monitoring
  • Data Versioning & Lineage: Reproducibility of training data; ability to trace data origin and transformations
  • ML Data Lifecycle Awareness: Basic understanding of how data pipelines connect to ML model training. Awareness that data quality and pipeline design affect model performance downstream — specifically, awareness of risks like train/test data leakage and label quality impact on model accuracy. Does not require prior ML work experience; requires curiosity and conceptual understanding.

Good to have Skills:

  • Feature store (Feast, Tecton) · Synthetic data generation (VAE, GAN, diffusion models) · Data Built Tool (DBT) · Data Load Tool DLT · Annotation platform integration (Label Studio, CVAT) · MES / LIMS system integration · Active learning data loop design · Data lakehouse (Iceberg, Dremio, AWS Glue, AWS Lake Formation) / Redhsift

title: Associate Director of Case Management
description:
Location: Los Angeles

Compensation: $110,000 - $115,000 per year, exempt

Organization Overview

Founded in 2004, Brilliant Corners provides innovative housing and housing-related services to those transitioning from or at risk of homelessness or institutionalization. We develop, own, and manage multi-family supportive housing and licensed residential care homes. Additionally, we implement a broad array of scattered-site, one-on-one supportive housing, and clinical case management programs through partnerships with developmental services, homeless services, veteran services, and health care sectors.

In short, we do good work.

We have offices statewide with a staff of passionate people. While we are growing rapidly, we are also selective: We’re seeking inspired, talented people who want to bring profound change and who have fun doing it.

Department Summary

The Case Management Department at Brilliant Corners includes three programs located in Los Angeles County, all of which provide intensive case management services within a supportive housing context. Our participants include people experiencing or at-risk of homelessness and people exiting institutions, such as jails or hospitals. Our programs provide services in different types of housing settings, including scattered-site and project-based. Our team of Case Managers are dedicated to a Housing First approach that values client agency, dignity, and personal growth.

Position Summary

The Associate Director of Case Management will oversee a portfolio of case management programs. The Associate Director will work closely with the Director of Case Management and Deputy Chief Program Officers to successfully implement and scale our case management programs. The Associate Director of Case Management will establish strong relationships with our funder stakeholders in Los Angeles County. The Associate Director of Case Management will uphold the culture and values of the Case Management Department and agency, and coach and support staff to ensure excellent service delivery and performance. The position is ideal for a person with proven leadership who is strategic, person-centered, collaborative, and committed to social justice and racial equity.

Position Responsibilities

  1. Oversee a portfolio of case management contracts across Los Angeles County
  2. Provide direct supervision to Program Managers, and coach and support teams to provide excellent, comprehensive services to all clients.
  3. Collaborate with all program funders and stakeholders, including HSH, JCOD, Probation, Chrysalis, DPSS, Housing Authorities, and LAHSA.
  4. Partner closely with our internal teams to support clients obtain positive housing outcomes
  5. Regularly represent Brilliant Corners with partner agencies and key stakeholders in order to strengthen existing relationships and develop new partnerships.
  6. Provide oversight of program budgets and expenditures in collaboration with Director, Program Managers, and the Finance Team.
  7. Support Director with work planning and vision setting for the department, including any efforts to grow the department.
  8. Enhance performance benchmarks and quality controls in order to ensure the delivery of high-quality services and clean annual audits.
  9. Cultivate leadership and professional growth through the establishment of training and coaching opportunities for both supervisory and direct service roles.
  10. Support efforts to expand opportunities for client engagement and feedback.
  11. Serve on the Brilliant Corners agency-wide Leadership Team, responsible for informing and implementing agency wide policy initiatives.

Requirements

Professional Experience

  • Master’s Degree in Social Work or related clinical field required; LCSW licensure preferred
  • Demonstrated leadership as evidenced by increasing levels of responsibility and management over the course of the candidate’s career
  • At least 3 years of experience supervising a team
  • At least 3 years of experience providing direct mental health and/or intensive case management services to vulnerable populations
  • Experience working with individuals with complex health needs and/or individuals who have experienced homelessness
  • Experience developing and monitoring program budgets strongly preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Ability

  • Demonstrated management and team-building experience
  • Strong interpersonal and client engagement skills
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills
  • Flexibility regarding scheduling and prioritizing of tasks
  • Ability to work independently and utilize critical thinking skills in decision-making situations
  • Well-versed in relevant evidence-based practices, including Motivational Interviewing, Harm Reduction, and Trauma-Informed Care
  • Demonstrates the necessary attitudes, knowledge and skills to deliver culturally responsive services and work effectively in cross-cultural situations
  • Basic computer knowledge, MS Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel required; familiarity with Salesforce a plus
  • Possession of a valid, clean California driver’s license and a personal insured vehicle are required

Core Competencies

  • Dealing with Ambiguity: Remains productive and effective in uncertain, rapidly changing situations by quickly analyzing information to adapt approach. Demonstrates flexibility, composure and good judgment despite challenges
  • Building Effective Teams: Builds cohesive, high-performing teams through collaboration, positive culture, coaching, cross-functional work, and recognition of successes
  • Priority Setting: Focuses on highest impact priorities advancing strategic objectives. Aligns resources, eliminates roadblocks, and provides direction through a compelling vision
  • Managing through Systems: Designs and implements systems, processes and infrastructures enabling effective execution, oversight, empowerment and accountability. Drives results through indirect influence and continuous improvement
  • Functional/Technical Expertise: Demonstrates strong functional knowledge and sound judgement across relevant program areas, enabling effective oversight, strategic decision-making, partner engagement, and development of program leaders.

Organizational Values

  • Humanity: Putting people first: We are committed to meeting people where they’re at, honoring their dignity, diversity, and experience.
  • Community: Building a better future: Sustainable housing solutions are fostered through partnership, collaboration, and human connection.
  • Ingenuity: Innovating for transformation: Systems-change requires relentless determination, thinking outside the box and challenging the status quo.

Mindsets

  • You’re a people person. You invest in relationships and love to cultivate the talents of the people around you. You are the cheerleader for your team. You enjoy providing great customer service.
  • You’re a talented leader. You act with confidence and integrity with an eye towards solutions. Your peers and team naturally look to you for guidance. You are energized as much by the success of your team as your own personal success.
  • You’re a system thinker who puts people at the center. You see opportunities for improvement wherever you look and know how to get buy-in from others to make it real. You know how to take things to scale without feeling bureaucratic.
  • You embody a collaborative spirit. You’re able to work collaboratively with program partners, service providers, and landlords. Partners know that you are empathetic and fair in your decisions.

Physical Requirements

Candidates should have physical mobility for tasks such as standing, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, twisting, and walking on uneven surfaces. They should be capable of performing stationary tasks like sitting for up to 6 to 8 hours a day. Additionally, candidates should be able to lift, carry, push, pull light to moderate weights up to 15 pounds safely. Requires mental acuity for analytical reasoning and document interpretation.

You are an experienced event leader who still loves being in the weeds. You can lead a client call, build a budget, troubleshoot a production challenge, coach a producer, and walk into an event and immediately see what needs attention.

title: Scientist 2, Data Science
description:
Role Overview

The Data Science team within our Operations function builds analytics and machine learning solutions that develop advanced analytics tools and machine learning models to solve complex business problems using mathematics, statistics, and machine learning methods, and take ideas from concept through data preparation, model building, application development, and system integration. You will work hands-on across advanced analytics and machine learning model development, data preparation, and application development, using tools and environments including Python, GitHub, Linux, Docker, and machine learning algorithms.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Automate data extraction, cleaning, processing, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis using Python, R, and SQL across structured and unstructured operational datasets.
  • Develop advanced machine learning and deep learning models to support operational excellence, predict outcomes of interest, and identify patterns across enterprise datasets
  • Build and deploy end-to-end analytics applications, covering data preparation, model development, and system integration
  • Visualize analytical findings and model outputs using enterprise BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms to create intelligent dashboards that support operational decision-making.
  • Validate and monitor deployed models in production, tracking performance drift and retraining as needed to maintain accuracy and reliability.
  • Document model methodologies, data pipelines, and application architecture using version-controlled repositories to support reproducibility and team collaboration.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and present results to engineering and operations partners across functions.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate workflows, while critically evaluating outputs before use.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Data Science, AI, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data manipulation, pipeline development, and model implementation.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms spanning regression, classification, clustering, and deep learning methods.
  • Familiarity with software development tools and environments including version control, Linux-based systems, and containerization tools
  • Experience building data visualizations or dashboards using enterprise BI tools (e.g., Tableau or Power BI)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying machine learning models to production environments using MLOps practices or containerized workflows.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure for data storage, model training, or deployment.
  • Exposure to generative AI or large language model (LLM) applications in an analytical or engineering context.
  • Knowledge of statistical modeling techniques including time series analysis, anomaly detection, or survival analysis
  • Experience with R for statistical analysis and modeling.

Skills

  • Ability to work across the full data science lifecycle, from messy raw data to a deployed, monitored model, without losing sight of the business problem being solved.
  • Strong statistical reasoning and the ability to choose the right modeling approach for the problem at hand, not just the most complex one.
  • Clear communicator who can translate model outputs and analytical findings into conclusions that engineering and operations partners can act on, reflecting a commitment to enabling customer and stakeholder success
  • Collaborative working style with the ability to contribute meaningfully within a team of engineers, data scientists, and business partners while driving progress on independent workstreams.
  • Disciplined approach to code quality, documentation, and reproducibility, treating version control and peer review as standard practice rather than optional steps.
  • Curiosity-driven problem solver who brings both rigor and creativity to analytical challenges, identifying improvement opportunities large and small.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About BIT：

BIT (formerly Matrixport) is a global digital asset financial services and infrastructure group. Headquartered in Singapore and founded in 2019, BIT bridges traditional finance and digital assets through governance-driven financial services and technology.

The firm manages over US$7 billion in assets and facilitates more than US$7 billion in monthly trading volume. BIT offers services including custody, trading, asset and wealth management, liquidity and financing solutions, and tokenised real-world assets (RWA), serving institutional and professional investors globally.

BIT Group entities maintain a licensed and regulated footprint across Singapore, Hong Kong, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and Bhutan.

For more information, visit www.bit.com

About the Role:

We're hiring a Software Engineer focused on blockchain security and protocol design. You'll work at the intersection of cryptography, distributed systems, and adversarial security — redesigning and hardening wallet and core systems against protocol- and architecture-level threats. This is a builder's role for someone who thinks like an attacker and designs like an engineer.

What You'll Do:

Protocol Analysis & Design

  • Analyze and evaluate how mainstream blockchain protocols work under the hood (Ethereum/EVM, Cosmos SDK, Substrate, Solana, etc.), and redesign wallet systems grounded in secure cryptographic mechanisms.
  • Develop hardening and mitigation plans for the wallet system against known protocol-level vulnerabilities and emerging risks.

System Security Re-architecture & Hardening

  • Drive security-requirement-driven re-architecture and maintenance of existing software systems.
  • Embed security assumptions at the architecture level, designing and implementing defense-in-depth for critical modules to reduce single points of failure and ambiguous trust boundaries.

Research, Audit & Response

  • Track cutting-edge blockchain attack techniques and defenses, and turn research into shippable system improvements.
  • Participate in or lead security audits of internal systems and open-source dependencies, driving remediation and architectural improvements.

Background & Experience:

  • Bachelors degree or above preferred in Computer Science, Cryptography, or Network/Cyber Security.
  • Fresh graduate or up to 2 years of work experience.

Core Technical Skills:

  • Development & architecture: Strong command of at least one systems-programming language among Java / Go / Rust / C++. Proficient in distributed systems design, concurrency models, and performance optimization.
  • Security domain knowledge: Familiar with threat modeling, secure coding standards, penetration-testing mindset, and supply-chain security.

Key Soft Skills:

  • Security mindset & risk thinking: Operates on a "zero trust" principle by default and reasons systematically about attack surfaces.
  • Analysis & abstraction: Translates complex, ambiguous security requirements into clear, verifiable technical architecture and module designs.
  • Engineering craft & influence: Builds a security culture across the team through design docs, code reviews, and tech talks.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of the full technical stack of at least one mainstream blockchain (networking, consensus, execution, storage). Strong grasp of smart contract security and common vulnerability patterns.
  • Practical command of how public-key cryptography, hash functions, zero-knowledge proofs, and threshold signatures apply — and where their risks lie — in real systems.

title: Customer Retention Supervisor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Retention Supervisor based in Greece.

Are you an experienced customer retention leader passionate about building high-performing teams and driving measurable business growth? This opportunity allows you to lead and develop a team of retention specialists within the fast-growing fintech and cryptocurrency industry. You will take ownership of customer reactivation, repeat transactions, and revenue recovery while remaining actively involved in outbound customer engagement. Combining hands-on leadership with strategic campaign management, you will develop effective retention processes, coach team members, and continuously improve customer conversion rates. Working in a dynamic, performance-driven environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen customer relationships and maximise business results. This is an ideal role for a proactive leader who enjoys mentoring people, analysing performance, and turning customer engagement strategies into tangible revenue.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead, supervise, and motivate a team of Customer Retention Specialists, establishing clear performance objectives, responsibilities, and accountability standards.
  • Conduct outbound customer calls personally to encourage repeat transactions, reconnect with inactive customers, and demonstrate effective retention techniques by example.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), calling workflows, scripts, and training materials to strengthen team performance.
  • Organise daily outreach activities, manage agent schedules, and allocate campaign assignments to ensure efficient customer engagement.
  • Design and execute customer retention campaigns, including promotional offers, discount incentives, abandoned transaction follow-ups, and reactivation initiatives.
  • Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), including call volumes, conversion rates, repeat transactions, customer reactivation rates, and revenue recovered.
  • Conduct regular call evaluations, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen agents' communication and sales skills.
  • Analyse customer behaviour, transaction activity, and campaign performance to identify retention opportunities and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Maintain accurate customer relationship management (CRM) records, agent scorecards, performance dashboards, and regular operational reports.
  • Manage escalated customer concerns and collaborate with Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effective issue resolution.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and training initiatives to build and maintain a capable, results-oriented retention team.
  • Use relevant digital and AI-powered tools to improve research, script development, workflow efficiency, and overall team productivity.

Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in customer retention, outbound sales, contact centre operations, or a similar customer-facing environment.
  • Demonstrated success in customer conversion, retention, and reactivation, with experience managing performance-driven teams and achieving measurable commercial results.
  • Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate teams, manage performance, and encourage continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, particularly when engaging customers over the phone.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable improvement plans.
  • Ability to balance direct customer engagement with team supervision and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards.
  • Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage.
  • Basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies, combined with a genuine interest in financial technology, is considered a plus.

Benefits:

  • Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Additional financial rewards directly linked to individual achievements and overall team performance.
  • Paid Annual Leave: 10 days of paid vacation per year.
  • Public Holidays: Paid time off on all U.S. federal holidays.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere in Anywhere, provided you have a professional home-working setup.
  • Leadership and Career Development: Opportunity to lead, develop, and shape a customer retention team while strengthening your management expertise.

title: Seasonal Retail Assistant - GRIND
description:
GRIND is recruiting

Seasonal Retail Assistant
Fixed Term · Battersea Power Station Grind, United Kingdom

A bit about us.
Grind is a coffee company that lives in London. Since opening Shoreditch Grind in 2011, we've expanded across London with cafés, coffee trucks and a state-of-the-art coffee roastery.
Our cafes and coffee shops are the beating heart of Grind, they are where it all began. We're a bustling hub in the heart of London's most iconic places, known for serving our specialty coffee and renowned bottomless brunches.

We think coffee can be a force for good. Whether it's through creating the UK's first compostable coffee pods, our plastic-free packaging or carbon-free shipping - we're on a mission to be the world's most sustainable coffee company.
In 2023, we created our charity, the Better Coffee Foundation, to undo the damage done by the global coffee industry - in our first year, we recovered 43 million pods' worth of ocean-bound plastic.

A bit about the role.
We’re looking for a confident, customer-focused Seasonal Retail Assistant to join our Battersea truck. This is a sales-led role focused on helping customers discover Grind beyond their daily coffee — from bean to cup and pod machines to beans, pods, subscriptions, accessories and merch. You’ll understand what each customer is looking for, make thoughtful recommendations and spot opportunities to add to their purchase without making it feel like a hard sell.
This role is a 3-month fixed-term contract, with flexibility aligned to our Friday–Sunday opening hours, initially supporting the team during a period of increased seasonal demand. While this is a fixed-term position, there may be opportunities to explore longer-term roles within the business depending on performance and future business needs.

Role responsibilities.
  • Welcome customers and create a warm, knowledgeable Grind experience.
  • Proactively start conversations and understand what each customer is looking for.
  • Build strong knowledge of our coffee machines, blends, pods, subscriptions, accessories and merchandise.
  • Confidently demonstrate products and help customers choose the right option for them.
  • Recommend relevant add-ons and complementary products to increase basket value.
  • Introduce customers to Grind subscriptions and other ways to enjoy Grind at home.
  • Work towards sales targets including conversion, average transaction value and add-on sales.
  • Keep retail displays stocked, organised and looking their best, supporting replenishment, product availability and smooth day-to-day retail operations.
  • Bringing Always Focused, Never Finished to life through constant improvement, fresh thinking and innovation across every touchpoint of the customer journey.
You’ll have.
  • Previous experience in retail, hospitality, customer service or sales.
  • A natural ability to build rapport and start conversations with customers.
  • Confidence recommending products, upselling and asking for the sale.
  • A proactive, commercially minded approach with great attention to customer experience.
  • An interest in coffee and enthusiasm for becoming an expert in Grind’s products.
Diversity and Inclusion.
Grind is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, age, veteran status, or disability status.
If there are any adjustments you need to help you bring your best self to an interview with us please let us know.

Benefits and Perks.
  • Discounts online: Up to 40% off our retail line online.
  • SpectrumLife: Access our confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for personal and professional support.
  • Crew Card: Enjoy 50% off all food and drinks, plus two free coffees a day at Grind locations.
  • Friends & Family Discount: Share the love with discounts for your friends and family on our website and at our sites.
  • Meals on Duty: Enjoy a staff meal on shifts over 6 hours.
  • Social Events: Join us for team social events to connect and have fun.

Up to £14ph + Retail Sales Incentives

title: Distribution Lineman

JOB INFORMATION
