• Job Code: 105132 or 105703

• Job Grade: L1 or 25

JOB SUMMARY

We are hiring for either a Distribution Lineman or Distribution Lineman Apprentice based on candidates' qualifications.

Performs a variety of duties related to the installation, operation, repair, and maintenance of overhead and/or underground distribution systems, transmission facilities, and street light systems to provide continuous and dependable electric service to customers.

LEVEL OF RESPONSIBILITY

• The apprentice level is a training program consisting of classes, Computer Based Curriculum and on-the-job training to obtain the qualifications to achieve the journey (fully qualified) level of the job. As training is satisfactorily completed and performance meets expectations, the apprentice moves to higher levels of responsibility and correspondingly higher pay until the journey level is achieved.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

• May investigate and document events of cut or damaged cable and other company facilities, as needed.

• May operate a variety of electronic and other test equipment with a high degree of efficiency, as needed.

• Members in the apprentice program perform duties related to the craft and consistent with their achieved level within the program which may include:

• Climb poles, set poles and string wire, utilizes and operates equipment (e.g., aerial bucket trucks, and other construction equipment), materials, and manpower in a safe, efficient and effective manner.

• Constructs and maintains overhead and underground distribution or transmission systems in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures.

• All other duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS

Distribution Lineman Qualifications:

• High School Diploma/GED and 5 years progressive Lineman experience and completion of OGE Apprentice Program; Or

• High School Diploma/GED and 1 year of equivalent Journey Lineman experience (i.e. Electric Utility certified Journeyman Lineman).

Distribution Lineman Apprentice Qualifications:

• Associate's Degree in a Technical discipline (i.e. Electronics/Engineering Technology/Power Plant Operations/High Voltage/etc); Or

• High School Diploma/GED and a certificate of completion/diploma in Electrical Power Technology, High Voltage, or related Power Line Technology; Or

• High School Diploma/GED and prior military experience for at least one enlistment as documented on DD Form 214 combined with utility line experience; Or

• High School Diploma/GED and utility line experience.

• Required to climb poles and work at heights up to and exceeding thirty (30) feet.

• Requires wearing Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

• Required to work away from home for extended periods, as needed.

• Required to operate motor vehicle safely in all traffic, weather and light conditions.

• May be required to work under hazardous conditions.

• Required to work non-standard work schedules to include on-call, overtime, weekends, holidays, and call-outs.

• Exposed to extreme conditions and inclement weather.

• Maintains or obtain all required certifications (e.g., Class A Switching, Confined Space, etc.).

• Completes required training (e.g., Forklift Operation, C.P.R., Defensive driving, FERC, etc.).

SPECIAL SAFETY REQUIREMENTS

• The extraction, compression, processing, manufacturing, handling, packaging, storage, disposal, treatment or transport of potentially volatile, flammable, combustible materials, elements, chemicals or any other highly regulated component;

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Who We Are:
Yoga Alliance is the largest nonprofit membership association of yoga professionals, practitioners, and advocates around the globe. We believe if more people practice yoga, the better the world will be. We’re here to amplify the power of yoga and to make it accessible to anyone wherever they are, under whatever circumstances by:

  • Uplifting the transformative power of yoga,
  • Surfacing and reducing barriers to the practice, and
  • Building, engaging, and supporting the yoga community.

Our member-driven community is a diverse collective of wisdom holders, yoga educators, and teachers expanding their expertise; a welcoming space for those newly exploring yoga; a place for seasoned practitioners to deepen their practice; and a supportive hub where community leaders, organizations, and businesses can leverage yoga for social good.

At the core of Yoga Alliance lies a profound commitment to our people. Here, every team member is empowered to lead, innovate, dream, create, and grow. Diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility and belonging guide our way of being in work and in working with each other. We champion a culture of collaboration, where learning from failures is as valued as achieving success. Together, we challenge the status quo and push the boundaries of what is possible.

About the Role:
Reporting to the Director of Digital Experience Yoga Alliance is seeking a Salesforce Developer to join our team.

Salesforce is the backbone of how we serve our members ​-- it holds​ their ​critical information and powers credentialing, membership, and communications. ​Yoga Alliance is adding this newly created role to ​its team to give the platform a dedicated in-house owner who can strengthen and grow ​Salesforce over time. Reporting to the Director of Digital Experience, this role will partner cross-functionally with internal teams and ​externally with the implementation partner to ​ensure the Salesforce environment​ is reliable and stable, ​as well as manage day-to-day requests from members and staff, and help ​deliver the improvements on ​the product roadmap.

What You Will Do:

Administration and Configuration

  • Own incident response during renewals, launches, and peak periods, making time-sensitive calls and coordinating fixes with the external partner when needed.
  • Manage users, profiles, permission sets, roles, and license assignments across the organization
  • Build and maintain declarative automation with Flow, validation rules, and approval processes.
  • Configure objects, fields, page layouts, record types, and Lightning App pages.
  • Build and maintain CRM and operational reports and dashboards: membership records, case volume, renewals, and internal team dashboards.
  • Maintain data quality across records through deduplication, standardization, and ongoing hygiene.
  • Work through the support and enhancement backlog, prioritizing the highest-impact tickets first.

Development

  • Write, test, and maintain Apex (triggers, classes, batch and scheduled jobs) where configuration alone is not enough.
  • Build Lightning Web Components for custom interfaces.
  • Build and configure member portal experiences on Experience Cloud within the product and UX direction set by the Director of Digital Experience.
  • Support and maintain the platform's integrations over REST and SOAP APIs: Absorb LMS (SSO enrollment and completion sync), Stripe and Blackthorn payments, Marketing Cloud journey triggers, and Pendo.
  • Write unit tests that meet Salesforce's 75% minimum, with higher coverage on business-critical logic.
  • Run deployments and sandbox refreshes following the release schedule and environment strategy set by the Director of Digital Experience and the external implementation partner.

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Own user acceptance testing and post-launch stabilization across a launch-heavy roadmap, including participating in UAT cycles, triaging defects, and resolving the post-launch backlog after each release.
  • Translate defined business requirements into technical designs and build specifications, advising stakeholders on feasibility, effort, and tradeoffs.
  • Collaborate day-to-day with the external implementation partner on assigned development and release items, with the partner relationship and scoping staying with the Director of Digital Experience.
  • Document configuration, customizations, and decisions so the org stays maintainable.
  • Track Salesforce releases and adopt relevant features and best practices.

What You Will Bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience across administration and development.
  • Salesforce Administrator certification.
  • Salesforce Platform App Builder certification.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.
  • Strong command of the Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and organizational-wide defaults.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, or Marketing Cloud
    • Declarative automation, especially Flow
    • Source control and deployment tooling: Salesforce DX, Git, and CI/CD
    • Coordinating work with external implementation or development partners
  • Working proficiency in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Familiarity with REST and SOAP API integrations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong project management skills with a proven track record of proactively managing expectations and ensuring consistent follow through and delivery.
  • Demonstrated commitment to and experience advancing diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging in the workplace or community settings.
  • Curious and proactively scans the horizon to stay abreast of technology, creative approaches, and novel ideas to experiment, test, and apply.
  • Ability to travel as needed to Yoga Alliance’s Arlington, VA office to participate in organizational meetings, trainings and retreats.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II certification.
  • Experience with credentialing or certification systems: renewals, application flows, and the underlying data model. Ideally at a membership organization, nonprofit, or association.
  • Experience with data deduplication and data quality tooling within Salesforce.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum delivery.
  • Experience coordinating work with external implementation or development partners.

We encourage individuals to apply even if they do not have any of the desired qualifications.

What We Offer:
Yoga Alliance provides robust employee benefits including comprehensive health insurance plan offerings that are 100% employer paid for employees and 65% paid for dependents, a matching 401K plan, a generous paid-leave program including parental leave and sabbatical leave, and reimbursement for professional development opportunities. Employees enjoy a casual dress code so they can arrive to work as their most authentic selves. Our organizational culture is supportive and collaborative with conscious attention to body and mind health.

Location:
This position is remote and will require the individual to be able to travel as needed. Yoga Alliance is based in Arlington, Virginia within sight of the historic northwest region of Washington, DC.

Salary Range:
$102,000 - $112,000 (commensurate with experience). This position is a full-time, exempt position.

Application and Timeline:
Interested applicants are encouraged to apply by November 16, 2026 to ensure priority consideration of your application. We will continue to review applications on a rolling basis after this priority deadline until the position is filled.

A cover letter is required and all cover letters will be read during the application review process.

Please, no phone calls or walk-ins.

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace:
At Yoga Alliance, we value a diverse team and a culture of inclusivity and belonging. We encourage applications from all individuals without regard to an individuals' race, color, sex, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. Women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Chemical Process Technician
description:
Perdue Foods has a goal of becoming the most trusted name in premium proteins by creating products for consumers and for retail and foodservice customers around the globe while changing the way animals are raised for food. It is part of Perdue Farms, a fourth-generation, family-owned food and agricultural business deeply rooted in tradition yet with a forward-thinking mindset. We believe that success starts with our people, and our culture is built on a foundation of teamwork, integrity, and respect, where every voice matters and everyone is encouraged to contribute to our shared goals. We are dedicated to creating a supportive, inclusive environment where associates feel valued and inspired to make an impact, both within the company and in the communities we serve. From promoting growth and development to prioritizing work-life balance, we’re committed to helping our team members thrive. That's Perdue.

Summary

Help drive food, safety and operational excellence across our production facility. As a Chemical Process Technician, you will maintain and operate equipment associated with antimicrobial applications throughout the plant, ensuring processes are performed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with quality and food safety standards. You will partner with production and maintenance teams to monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance plant operations. This role is ideal for a dependable, detail-oriented professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and takes pride in supporting the delivery of high-quality products.

This position has a base rate of $25.50 per hour, with opportunities for pay premiums, shift differentials and overtime where applicable. Annual bonus available (variable depending on performance).

In addition to hourly wages, Perdue offers a competitive benefits package, including medical/Rx, 401(k) with employer match after 1 year, critical illness, accident insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, optional group life insurance, short-term and long-term disability protection, flexible spending accounts and paid time off.

Principal Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Operate the PCC system to meet intervention requirements for on-time shift startup and maintain continuous production in the facility.
  • Perform titrations of intervention levels accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Document results clearly and make necessary adjustments to maintain control.
  • Complete all documentation associated with bird temperatures, PAA levels, pH, makeup water GPM, and water levels.
  • Ensure all required paperwork is completed and submitted to the QA/HACCP office at the end of each shift.
  • Report system issues to facility leadership, including maintenance and production.
  • Perform minor troubleshooting and maintenance of systems.
  • Utilize all chemical safety processes and personal protective equipment in accordance with company policy.
  • Communicate with chemical vendors and technical support as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Education and Experience

  • Demonstrate strong reading, communication, math, writing, and analytical skills.
  • Possess experience with chemical handling and dosing pump applications.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of blueprints and electrical schematics.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.

Physical Requirements and Environmental Factors

  • Work in temperature conditions ranging from less than 32°F to over 85°F.
  • Experience damp environments with ambient moisture levels.
  • Walk and stand on surfaces that may be wet, dry, greasy, uneven, or constructed of metal grating.
  • Handle exposure to chlorinated water, ammonia vapors exceeding 5 ppm, carbon fuel fumes, lubricating oils, hydraulic oils, and PAA.
  • Work in noise levels ranging from 90–94.9 dB.
  • Use tools such as screwdrivers, pliers, and knives.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment including hearing protection, eye protection, rubber gloves, cotton gloves, hard hat, apron, lab coat, and hair net.
  • Walk distances exceeding 100 feet as needed.
  • Stand with variable mobility and sit for periods of less than one hour with intermittent movement.
  • Lift up to 20–40 pounds from floor level to a height of 4–5 feet with extended reach beyond 24 inches.
  • Perform lifting in bent positions and reach for durations up to one hour.
  • Grasp objects such as poultry parts, hand tools, equipment handles, and containers using both hands for up to 76–100% of the time.

Perdue Farms Inc. is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Founded in October 1997, CoAsia is a Taiwan-listed semiconductor and mobile solutions company with nearly 30 years of industry experience. We collaborate closely with leading global technology partners, including Samsung Semiconductor, to deliver advanced semiconductor components and solutions such as Application Processors (AP), Memory, AMOLED and CMOS Image Sensors (CIS) to customers worldwide.

  • Coordinate with R&D, sales and product engineering teams to address customer requirements and develop regional business opportunities.

  • Good spoken and written English; Chinese proficiency is preferred.

Prenez la tête de la croissance nationale d’Architecture49 dans le secteur de la santé et contribuez à façonner des environnements de soins plus résilients, inclusifs et performants partout au Canada. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous mobiliserez les équipes, les clients et les partenaires de l’industrie autour d’une vision commune qui combine excellence en conception, innovation, développement durable et résultats durables pour les communautés.

Votre impact

  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre la stratégie nationale d’Architecture49 dans le secteur de la santé afin d’accroître sa présence et sa part de marché au Canada.
  • Diriger les stratégies relatives aux appels d’offres majeurs, aux partenariats, aux modèles contractuels et aux initiatives de développement des affaires.
  • Conseiller les équipes et les clients sur les modèles d’approvisionnement et de réalisation, notamment la conception-construction, les partenariats public-privé, la conception-construction progressive, la réalisation intégrée de projets et les modèles d’alliance.
  • Renforcer les relations avec les autorités de santé, les ministères, les hôpitaux, les organismes d’infrastructure, les entrepreneurs, les consultants et les partenaires de l’industrie.
  • Faire progresser la recherche et l’innovation en matière de planification des soins, d’expérience des patients, de bien-être du personnel, de résilience et de nouveaux modèles de prestation des soins.
  • Promouvoir des infrastructures de santé à faibles émissions de carbone, résilientes aux changements climatiques, culturellement sécurisantes et hautement performantes.
  • Diriger l’adoption d’outils numériques, de la modélisation des données du bâtiment, de la prise de décision fondée sur les données et des applications responsables de l’intelligence artificielle.
  • Encadrer et mobiliser les leaders du secteur de la santé partout au Canada afin de soutenir le recrutement, la planification de la relève, le partage des connaissances et le développement des capacités.

Les compétences qui vous distinguent

  • Diplôme professionnel en architecture et inscription en règle à titre d’architecte au Canada.
  • Au moins 15 ans d’expérience en leadership dans les domaines de l’architecture, de la planification, de la conception ou de la réalisation de projets dans le secteur de la santé.
  • Expérience approfondie dans la réalisation d’établissements de santé complexes et la direction de grands appels d’offres en infrastructure.
  • Solide connaissance des modèles canadiens d’approvisionnement et de réalisation de projets de santé, notamment la conception-construction et les partenariats public-privé.
  • Réseau de relations bien établi au sein des secteurs canadiens de la santé, de l’architecture et des infrastructures.
  • Réussite démontrée en développement des affaires, en gestion des relations avec les clients, en gouvernance de projet et en leadership d’équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Réputation reconnue à l’échelle nationale en matière de leadership éclairé, de participation à l’industrie, de communication et de présentations publiques.
  • Capacité à voyager partout au Canada; la maîtrise du français et de l’anglais constitue un atout.

Pourquoi choisir WSP?

Nous existons pour façonner des communautés et faire progresser l’humanité.

Les ingénieurs, conseillers et scientifiques les plus brillants du monde entier ont choisi WSP comme milieu professionnel.

  • Fièrement canadienne – nous sommes parmi les 100 meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026.
  • Une communauté mondiale d’experts – votre prochaine idée, votre prochain mentor ou votre prochaine opportunité est toujours à portée de main.
  • Des possibilités illimitées commencent ici. Que ce soit à travers le pays ou à l’échelle mondiale, nous vous aiderons à adapter votre rôle à vos ambitions, parce que votre croissance alimente la nôtre.
  • Flexibilité et équilibre réel – nous reconnaissons l’importance de l’équilibre dans nos vies et vous encourageons à prioriser le vôtre.

Shared Health leads the planning and coordinates the integration of patient-centered clinical and preventive health services across Manitoba. The organization also delivers some province-wide health services and supports centralized administrative and business functions for Manitoba health organizations.

Position Overview

The Shared Health Mental Health and Addictions program provides a range of mental health and addiction services across the healthcare continuum that support and promote recovery. Through collaboration and partnership across various health, social service and community sectors the program strives to promote mental health and well-being for all, to reduce inequities and the impact of mental health and addiction problems and to work towards sustainability of mentally healthy individuals and communities.

The Crisis Response Centre is a ground-breaking development in the delivery of crisis services and is the first of its kind in Canada to offer a constellation of walk-in, mobile and scheduled crisis response services. This service offers mental health crisis services seven days a week, 24 hours a day. The centre includes a multi-disciplinary team of psychiatrists, nurses, social workers along with other clinicians and support workers with expertise in mental health as well as an understanding of the service needs of persons with an accompanying substance use disorder. The Crisis Stabilization is a separate but linked service that will remain at a separate location. Up to 20,000 people are anticipated to access the Crisis Response Services each year.

Under the general direction of the Manager - Crisis Response Services and Clinical Team Leaders, and in collaboration with the CRC Clinical Team, the incumbent is responsible for providing clinical services to individuals in mental health or psychosocial crisis.

The Employer may use this posting to establish an eligibility list. Such lists may be maintained for a period of time not exceeding six (6) months.

The Crisis Response Centre has a mandate to provide service in French; preference will be given to bilingual (French/English) candidates.

  • BN or RPN required.
  • Knowledge of Crisis Intervention Theory.
  • Applied Suicide Intervention Skills Training (ASIST).

  • Active participation in professional associations e.g. Association of Registered Nurses of Manitoba (ARNM) preferred.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Effective Crisis Intervention skills.
  • Expertise in the area of mental health.
  • Knowledge and understanding of psychosocial rehab and recovery.

Not Applicable

title: Case Officer

description:
Discover a career with purpose at MBIE

  • Play a key role supporting independent statutory Boards and high-quality regulatory decision-making
  • Use your organisation, judgement and relationship skills in a varied case management and Board support role
  • Join a friendly team delivering important work across multiple occupational regulation schemes
  • Wellington based, permanent position
  • Salary range: $68,380–$77,359 + KiwiSaver + Wellness Benefits

About the Role - Tēnei tūranga:

Occupational Regulation supports complaints, licensing and registration functions across a range of occupational schemes, including Electrical Workers, Licensed Building Practitioners, Immigration Advisers, Motor Vehicle Traders, Auctioneers and Pool Inspectors.


We are looking for a Case Officer to provide high-quality case management, administrative and secretarial support to Occupational Regulation’s complaints and Board support functions.


In this varied role, you will support independent statutory Boards, investigators and internal stakeholders by preparing matters for Board consideration, coordinating meetings and hearings, managing documentation, preparing agendas and papers, recording accurate minutes, and supporting decisions and correspondence.

About you:

You will be a highly organised, proactive administrator or case management professional with strong judgement, discretion and attention to detail. You will be confident working with deadlines, sensitive information and a wide range of stakeholders, including Board members, senior leaders, legal advisers, complainants and respondents.


Experience supporting Boards, committees, panels, hearings or other formal decision-making forums is highly desirable. You will understand the importance of confidentiality, accuracy, natural justice, customer service and timely follow-through. Some travel may be required.

Ngā pukenga me ngā wheako e hiahiatia ana - Skills and Experience Required

  • Experience supporting Boards, committees, panels, hearings or senior decision-making groups is highly desirable.
  • Strong relationship management skills and confidence working with Board members, senior leaders, legal advisers and external parties.
  • Experience preparing agendas and papers, coordinating meetings or hearings, recording minutes and tracking actions.
  • Ability to manage correspondence, shared inboxes, case files, records and time-sensitive documentation accurately.
  • Excellent organisation, attention to detail and ability to prioritise competing deadlines.
  • Sound judgement, discretion and ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and constructive working style.
  • Good computer literacy, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Adobe Acrobat Pro and case management or document management systems.
  • Must have the legal right to live and work in New Zealand.

About MBIE - Ētahi kōrero mō MBIE:

MBIE's goal is to create a resilient and high-performing economy that delivers real and ongoing quality of life for all New Zealanders.

We do this by working with others to create an environment that supports businesses to be more productive and internationally competitive, enables all New Zealanders to participate in the economy through improved job opportunities and by working to ensure quality housing is more affordable.

People are at the heart of our mahi, our way of working is guided by our values which shape our behaviours.

  • Mahi Tahi – Better Together
  • Māia – Bold and brave
  • Pae Kahurangi – Build our Future
  • Pono Me Te Tika – Own It

Our aspirations are echoed in our Māori identity – Hīkina Whakatutuki – which broadly means ‘lifting to make successful'.

MBIE recognises the partnership founded under Te Tiriti o Waitangi between Māori and the Crown and is committed to giving effect to Te Tiriti o Waitangi. We will do this through enduring, meaningful and effective partnerships with iwi, Māori, other Māori groups/organisations and the Crown, as this is critical to enable economic and social development, both for Māori and for wider Aotearoa New Zealand. We are committed to continuing to partner with iwi in order to find new sustainable solutions to address long standing systemic and cross-cutting issues facing Māori and wider Aotearoa New Zealand and we are also committed to identifying opportunities for iwi to lead and creating an enabling environment for iwi to leverage these opportunities.

E mōhio ana a Hīkina Whakatutuki i puea ake te kōtuinga I waenganui i a ngāi Māori me te Karauna i Te Tiriti o Waitangi, ā, kei te whai ia ki te whakaū ake i Te Tiriti o Waitangi. Mā te whai kiko o ngā kōtuinga ahunga roa o ngā iwi, o ngāi Māori, me ētahi atu rōpū Māori ki te Karauna, ka tutuki tēnei. He āhuatanga nui tēnei e āhei ai ngā mahi whanaketanga ā-ohanga, ā-pāpori hoki ki a ngāi Māori me Aotearoa whānui. E whai tonu ana mātou ki te kōtui atu ki ngā iwi mō te rapu huarahi hou ki te whakaara i ngā kaupapa kua roa nei e tāmi ana i a ngāi Māori me Aotearoa whānui, ā, e whai ana hoki ki te tautohu i ngā āheinga kōkiritanga mā ngā iwi, me te tautoko i ngā iwi kia whai mana ake ai ēnei āheinga.

title: Sr Mgr System Safety - 90344553 - Wilmington, Philadelphia
description:
This role may be headquartered from Wilmington, DE or Philadelphia, PA.

Your success is a train ride away!

As we move America’s workforce toward the future, Amtrak connects businesses and communities across the country. We employ more than 20,000 diverse, energetic professionals in a variety of career fields throughout the United States. The safety of our passengers, our employees, the public and our operating environment is our priority, and the success of our railroad is due to our employees.

Are you ready to join our team?

Our values of ‘Do the Right Thing, Excel Together and Put Customers First’ are at the heart of what matters most to us, and our Core Capabilities, ‘Building Trust, Accountability, Effective Communication, Customer Focus, and Proactive Safety & Security’ are what every employee needs to know and do to be most impactful at Amtrak. By living the Amtrak values, focusing on our capabilities, and actively embracing and fostering diverse ideas, backgrounds, and perspectives, together we will honor our past and make Amtrak a company of the future.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, System Safety supports the continuous improvement and effective implementation of Amtrak’s System Safety Program. The position leads human factors and human performance integration, System Safety Program Plan governance, state partner coordination, fatigue risk management oversight, safety recommendation management, and cross-functional program improvements. Serving as a System Safety subject matter expert, the role applies safety findings, trends, and human performance principles to strengthen safety culture, employee reporting, organizational change, technology implementation, corrective actions, investigations, and other safety programs. The position works across Amtrak departments and with regulators and external partners to clarify responsibilities, maintain required plans and agreements, and advance data-informed safety improvements.

Essential Functions

  • Manage System Safety Program Plan and related safety-document governance, including revisions, approvals, version control, distribution, implementation tracking, state partner supplements and agreements, recurring reviews, regulatory submissions, and updates required by applicable laws, regulations, and guidance.
  • Serve as Amtrak’s System Safety subject matter expert for human factors and human performance, applying relevant principles to fatigue management, safety culture, employee reporting, organizational change, technology implementation, corrective actions, investigations, risk mitigation, and other assigned safety matters; coordinate related research, initiatives, and pilot programs with the Federal Railroad Administration, Transport Canada, and other external organizations.
  • Provide management oversight of Amtrak’s Fatigue Risk Management Programs and manage the coordination and tracking of National Transportation Safety Board and Federal Railroad Administration safety recommendations, including assigned actions, supporting documentation, regulatory plans and notifications, status reporting, follow-up, correspondence, and formal responses.
  • Lead System Safety improvement initiatives, special projects, and emerging assignments that cross program areas or involve multiple departments or external partners; use safety data, findings, trends, and program information to support decisions, identify improvement opportunities, and monitor program effectiveness.
  • Serve as a System Safety liaison for state-supported service partners and prepare reports, executive briefings, regulatory correspondence, and presentations; when assigned, serve in an acting capacity for the Director, System Safety Programs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in safety, engineering, transportation, public administration, business, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Nine or more years of progressively responsible experience in system safety, Safety Management Systems, regulatory compliance, railroad operations, program management, or a related field.
  • Experience interpreting and applying regulations, policies, agreements, and technical requirements in a regulated environment, including managing corrective actions, regulatory commitments, or complex action-tracking processes.
  • Experience applying human factors or human performance principles within a safety-critical environment and using safety data, trends, findings, or other performance information to support decisions and evaluate safety-program effectiveness.
  • Experience coordinating with regulators, public agencies, external partners, or other organizations with shared responsibilities and developing formal documents that define responsibilities between organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Eleven or more years of progressively responsible experience in system safety, Safety Management Systems, regulatory compliance, railroad operations, program management, or a related field.
  • Formal education, training, certification, or demonstrated experience in Safety Management Systems, human factors, human performance, ergonomics, safety culture, organizational psychology, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in passenger rail, freight rail, or public transportation and experience with document management.
  • In-depth knowledge of 49 CFR Part 270 and applicable Transport Canada fatigue and Railway Safety Management System requirements.
  • Experience leading projects, process improvements, organizational changes, or special assignments involving multiple departments or external partners.

description:

  • Handle other technical projects and ad-hoc engineering tasks as assigned.

  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, TCP/IP, DNS, routing and troubleshooting.

  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong sense of ownership, responsibility and willingness to learn new technologies.

  • Good command of written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA or GPU resource management.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Experience with LLM integration, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LangChain or AI APIs.

  • Knowledge of MLOps, model serving and AI workload optimization.

  • Experience with Kubernetes-based infrastructure and cloud-native technologies.

  • Previous experience in cloud computing, data centers, telecommunications or technology infrastructure environments.

title: Vessel Operator (Dry Bulk)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Vessel Operator to manage the end-to-end operations of approximately 4 Capesize bulk carriers transporting iron ore.

The successful candidate will oversee voyages from fixture confirmation through completion, ensuring safe and efficient execution in accordance with Charter Party requirements. The role requires close coordination with Masters, charterers, brokers, port agents, terminals and internal commercial teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the daily commercial operations of approximately 4 Capesize vessels.

  • Oversee iron-ore voyages from fixture confirmation through final completion.

  • Review Charter Party terms, fixture recaps and voyage instructions.

  • Issue clear voyage and operational instructions to Masters and relevant stakeholders.

  • Coordinate vessel arrivals, berthing, loading and discharging with agents, terminals and charterers.

  • Monitor vessel schedules, cargo readiness, port restrictions and weather conditions.

  • Arrange bunkers and monitor fuel consumption, speed and vessel performance.

  • Track voyage progress and proactively address delays or operational issues.

  • Manage voyage documentation, including Bills of Lading, Notices of Readiness, Statements of Facts and Letters of Indemnity.

  • Monitor compliance with Charter Party requirements and contractual obligations.

  • Prepare and update voyage estimates, voyage P&L and operational cost reports.

  • Review port disbursement accounts, bunker invoices and other voyage-related expenses.

  • Assist with laytime calculations, demurrage and despatch claims.

  • Coordinate with technical, marine, finance and commercial teams to resolve voyage-related matters.

  • Maintain accurate operational records and provide regular vessel-status updates.

  • Support incident management, claims handling and dispute resolution when required.

  • Ensure all voyages comply with applicable safety, environmental and regulatory requirements.

Requirements

  • Diploma or degree in Maritime Studies, Shipping, Logistics or a related discipline.

  • 3–5 years of experience in dry-bulk vessel operations.

  • Hands-on experience operating Capesize bulk carriers is strongly preferred.

  • Experience handling iron-ore cargoes and major bulk terminals would be advantageous.

  • Good knowledge of voyage execution, Charter Party terms and post-fixture operations.

  • Familiarity with Bills of Lading, Notices of Readiness, Statements of Facts and Letters of Indemnity.

  • Understanding of bunkering, vessel-performance monitoring, voyage calculations and port operations.

  • Experience managing multiple vessels or voyages simultaneously.

  • Strong commercial awareness, numerical ability and attention to detail.

  • Able to make timely decisions and resolve operational issues independently.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and voyage-management systems.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Willing to provide operational support outside standard office hours when required.

title: AI Research Scientist
description:
About This Role — The Mission

This is not a generalist AI research role.

We are looking for a researcher who has spent serious time thinking about how physics constraints interact with neural network training — and who wants to see that methodology deployed against real product development problems, not just validated on benchmark datasets. You will be the person who designs what the ML engineers build. Your acquisition functions will drive real laboratory experiments. Your PINNs methodology will run in product development. The work you originate here will be tested against physical ground truth in ways that most academic scientific ML researchers never get access to.

  • Area A — Scientific ML & PINNs Methodology Origination: Originate and advance PINNs methodology — design physics-constrained loss function architectures, validate digital twin ML components against domain physics (with storage domain expert), and deliver validated prototypes with complete technical documentation to implement. As the sole PINNs methodology originator on the team — this capability cannot be delegated or substituted.
  • Area B — Uncertainty Quantification & Bayesian Experimental Design (hold one of B or C): Lead research into Bayesian deep learning, active learning acquisition function design, ensemble uncertainty methods, and Bayesian experimental design frameworks for autonomous experiment selection. Transfer validated acquisition function designs for active learning pipeline integration.
  • Area C — Causal ML & Reliability Modeling (substitute for B if reliability-focused): Own causal inference framework product development for reliability root cause analysis — structural causal model (SCM) design, causal discovery, and causal intervention planning for product development improvement.
  • Synthetic Data Methodology : Design physics-constrained generative model approaches (diffusion models, VAEs) for synthetic data generation. Deliver validated methodology and training recipes for pipeline operationalization.
  • IP & Domain InterMface: Demonstrate strong research output through preprints, or patent disclosures. Interface with storage domain expert to validate physics constraints before deployment. Produce validated research prototypes with complete technical documentation to team-handoff standard. Participate in design reviews as the research methodology authority.

Qualifications

Requirements

Education:

  • Master's or PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or related field. Strong AI/ML research focus and scientific computing background required.

Experience:

  • For Master's degree: 1–3 years work or research experience in scientific ML or applied AI roles. For PhD: Open — no minimum work experience required. Research depth is the primary criterion. Peer-reviewed publication (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, Nature MI, or domain-specific venues), strong PhD research, or significant open-source scientific ML contribution.

Must have skills:

  • PyTorch or JAX: Expert — deep research-level implementation capability
  • Area A — Scientific ML & PINNs (Required): PINNs methodology design, physics-constrained loss function architecture, digital twin modeling. The most critical capability on the team.
  • Area B — UQ & Bayesian Methods (one of B or C required): Bayesian deep learning, Bayesian experimental design, active learning acquisition function design, ensemble uncertainty quantification
  • Area C — Causal ML (substitute for B if reliability-focused): Structural causal models (SCM), causal discovery, causal inference for reliability and yield root cause analysis
  • Demonstrated Research Output: Publication, preprint, PhD thesis chapter, or significant open-source scientific ML contribution in at least one primary area
  • Prototype-to-Documentation Handoff: Produce validated research prototypes with complete technical documentation

Good to have skills:

  • Diffusion models (DDPM, conditional diffusion) — physics-constrained synthetic data generation
  • Graph neural networks (GNN) — materials property prediction, failure propagation modeling
  • Neural ODEs — dynamic systems and degradation trajectory modeling
  • Foundation model fine-tuning — domain adaptation for scientific tasks
  • RL for scientific discovery — exploration strategies in experimental search spaces
  • Top-venue publication (NeurIPS / ICML / ICLR / Nature MI) — strong bonus signal
  • Materials science, semiconductor, or precision product development domain background

title: Tietoliikenneasiantuntija, Insta Advance
description:
Haluatko työskennellä monipuolisten verkkoratkaisujen parissa ja päästä hyödyntämään osaamistasi niin käytännön tekemisessä kuin verkkojen suunnittelussa? Etsimme nyt Insta Advancelle tietoliikenneasiantuntijaa pitkäkestoisiin ja teknisesti monipuolisiin IT-projekteihin.

Insta on turvallisen ja kestävän tulevaisuuden ratkaisija. Olemme edelläkävijä ja luotettava kumppani teollisuuden, puolustuksen, ohjelmistokonsultoinnin ja kyberturvallisuuden asiakkaillemme. Yhdistämällä huippuosaamisen ja älykkään teknologian kehitämme turvallisuutta ja suorituskykyä yhä nopeammin muuttuvassa digitalisoituvassa maailmassa. Ihmiset, osaaminen ja vastuullisuus ovat toimintakulttuurimme perusta.

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?
Tietoliikenneasiantuntijana työskentelet infrapainotteisten verkkoratkaisujen suunnittelun, rakentamisen ja ylläpidon parissa. Työnkuvaa voidaan painottaa osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan joko käytännönläheiseen verkkotyöhön tai enemmän suunnitteluun.

Käytännönläheisessä työssä asennat ja konfiguroit verkkolaitteita, ylläpidät ja valvot verkkoja sekä selvität vikoja ja häiriötilanteita. Työskentelet esimerkiksi reitittimien, kytkinten ja palomuurien parissa. Suunnittelupainotteisessa tehtävässä puolestaan suunnittelet verkkoja ja verkkoratkaisuja sekä teet tiivistä yhteistyötä niiden käytännön toteutuksesta vastaavien asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Sinun ei tarvitse hallita valmiiksi molempia puolia, vaan voit myös laajentaa osaamistasi työn kautta käytännön tekemisestä suunnitteluun tai päinvastoin.

Työskentelet osana monialaista teknistä tiimiä yhdessä muun muassa sovellustuen, arkkitehdin ja muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Projektit ovat pitkäkestoisia ja teknisesti monipuolisia, joten pääset hyödyntämään nykyistä verkko-osaamistasi ja samalla kehittämään sitä edelleen.

Työpisteesi sijaitsee joko Espoon Keilarannassa tai Tampereen Sarankulmassa, ja työ tehdään pääasiassa lähityönä Instan toimistolla. Työskentelyä on satunnaisesti myös asiakkaiden tiloissa, ja tehtävään voi sisältyä päivämatkoja Suomessa.

Etsimme tehtävään pitkäaikaista tekijää, jonka kanssa tavoitteena on rakentaa pysyvä ura Installa. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen, ja se solmitaan alkuun Biisonin kanssa. Olet alusta lähtien tärkeä osa Instan työyhteisöä ja tavoitteena onkin siirtyminen 9–12 kuukauden jälkeen Instan omaksi työntekijäksi.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
Sinulla on hyvä tekninen osaamispohja tietoliikenteestä sekä ymmärrystä IP-verkoista ja TCP/IP:stä. Reitittimet, kytkimet ja palomuurit ovat sinulle tuttuja, ja sinulla on kokemusta verkkoratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja/tai ylläpidosta. Lisäksi toivomme sinulta kokemusta vianmäärityksestä ja verkkojen toimintaan liittyvien ongelmatilanteiden selvittämisestä.

Osaamisesi voi painottua suunnitteluun tai käytännön verkkotyöhön, eikä sinun tarvitse hallita molempia puolia yhtä vahvasti. Olennaisinta on riittävä tekninen pohja, jonka päälle voit kasvattaa osaamistasi tehtävässä.

Soveltuva koulutus tai vastaava käytännön kokemuksen kautta kertynyt osaaminen antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan. Tarvitset lisäksi sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista osaamista sekä hyvää kirjallista englannin kielen taitoa. Arvostamme huolellista ja pitkäjänteistä työotetta, ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja halua oppia uutta.

Tehtävään valittavalle henkilölle tullaan teettämään perusmuotoinen turvallisuusselvitys sisältäen ulkomaansidonnaisuuksien selvityksen.

Miksi meille?
Insta on suomalainen, pitkän historian omaava teknologiayhtiö, joka kehittää ratkaisuja teollisuuden, puolustuksen, ohjelmistokonsultoinnin ja kyberturvallisuuden tarpeisiin. Pitkäjänteinen tekeminen, asiakaslähtöisyys ja vahva suomalainen arvopohja näkyvät sekä tavassa tehdä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden kanssa että siinä, miten ihmisistä pidetään huolta arjessa.

Pääset työskentelemään pitkäaikaisissa asiakkuuksissa ja projekteissa, joissa rakennetaan aidosti merkityksellisiä ratkaisuja suomalaiselle puolustukselle. Työyhteisössä yhdistyvät korkea asiantuntijuus, osaavat kollegat ja matalan kynnyksen yhteistyö. Meillä luotetaan ihmisiin ja tarjotaan aktiivisesti mahdollisuuksia uuden oppimiseen ja osaamisen syventämiseen.

Tehtävän palkkahaarukka on alustavasti 4500–5500 euroa kuukaudessa, ja lopullinen palkka määritellään kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko?
Mikäli mielenkiintosi heräsi, haluamme ehdottomasti kuulla sinusta lisää! Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 26.11.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja valinta tehdään heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa, jonka kanssa työsuhde myös solmitaan. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Biisonin rekrytointikonsultti Nea Repo, nea.repo@biisoni.fi.

Huomioithan, että käsittelemme vain rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta tulleet hakemukset, emme ota hakemuksia vastaan sähköpostitse.

  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and training initiatives to build and maintain a capable, results-oriented retention team.

Requirements:

  • Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, particularly when engaging customers over the phone.

title: Temporary Program Associate
description:

Organization Overview
Founded in 2004, Brilliant Corners provides innovative housing and housing-related services to California’s most vulnerable individuals, with an emphasis on those transitioning from, or at risk of, homelessness or institutionalization. We develop, own, and manage multi-family supportive housing and licensed residential care homes. We implement a broad array of scattered-site, one-on-one supportive housing, and clinical case management programs through partnerships with developmental services, homeless services, veterans’ services, and health care sectors.

In short, we do good work.

We have offices statewide with a staff of passionate people. While we are growing rapidly, we are also
selective: We’re seeking inspired, talented people who want to be effecting profound change and who
have fun doing it.

Department Summary
The San Francisco Housing Platform (SFHP) represents a portfolio of programs within the Northern California Housing Services Department that provide scattered-site supportive housing and rapid rehousing to individuals exiting or at risk of experiencing homelessness. The Housing Platform is supported by the San Francisco Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing (HSH). The goal of the SFHP is to offer a streamlined set of tools to support individuals in becoming and staying successfully housed. To serve the Housing Platform, Brilliant Corners identifies and secures units across the Bay Area, provides move-in assistance and rental subsidy disbursements, coordinates with case managers, and assists with neighborhood relations.

Position Summary
The Program Associate provides critical support to the Housing Services team through administrative back-office functions, keeping up-to-date records, preparing check requests, updating financial ledgers, and supporting in the development of reports. They use company-designed project management tools to ensure timely, cost-effective, and well-organized project coordination. The purpose of this position is to perform administrative back-office functions of moderate complexity and difficulty in accordance with the office procedure of this department. May include a combination of bookkeeping, typing or word processing, and filing; attending department events including team meetings, workshops and site meetings as required.

Position Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain files and manage documents and information systems to ensure objectives are achieved.
  • Rental Subsidy administration- gathering correct tenant lease information and remitting payments monthly. Adding Vendor information to Salesforce.
  • Verify expense reports, credit card charges and underlying receipts. Support invoicing needs and remitting checks to vendors as needed for staff travel and client move-in expenses.
  • Compose and type routine correspondence and reports.
  • Processing client referrals- reviewing documentation to ensure referral packets are complete, running background reports, and submitting names to finance for Intacct ID creation.
  • Assists in obtaining appropriate signatures, approvals, and transferring all financial information to appropriate departments for further processing.
  • Provides administrative support to manager and supervisors; communicate with Housing Specialists, Housing Coordinators, and funders to answer questions, disseminate, or explain information.
  • Support staff with financial questions- looking up check statuses and amounts, reviewing client ledgers to identify where payments are missing or incorrect, etc
  • Effectively and accurately communicate program information to project stakeholders and team members.
  • Track, manage, file, and update databases (Billing Tracker, , and all required regulatory documents)
  • Client Income Recertification- contacting clients on an annual basis to obtain updated income documents and recalculate rent portions. Fielding client questions about the process.
  • Support meetings and special occasions by scheduling, preparing mailings, and assembling materials.
  • Work closely and collaboratively with other departments and staff.
  • Perform special assignments, studies, and routine administrative functions as directed.
  • Other duties and projects as needed/assigned.

Requirements

Professional Experience

  • 1 to 2 years of successful administrative, project coordination or comparable experience.
  • Knowledge of or experience in non-profit housing development related services a plus.
  • Experience with homeless, veteran, and/or developmentally-disabled populations a plus.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Bilingual a plus
  • Demonstrated writing and researching skills
  • Proficiency in common word processing, desktop publishing, and database software applications
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and planning skills a must
  • High degree of attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines efficiently and simultaneously
  • Solid team player who can work well collaboratively on projects and under pressure
  • Demonstrates the necessary attitudes, knowledge and skills to deliver culturally competent services and work effectively in cross-cultural situations



Core Competencies

  • Dealing with Ambiguity: Remains productive and effective in uncertain, rapidly changing situations by quickly analyzing information to adapt approach. Demonstrates flexibility, composure and good judgment despite challenges
  • Technical Learning: Quickly learns and applies new technical skills, knowledge, and industry expertise. Seeks guidance when needed to ensure quality
  • Decision Quality: Demonstrates sound judgment by analyzing information, proposing practical solutions, and resourcefully overcoming obstacles. Seeks guidance when needed to ensure quality outcomes
  • Planning: Proactively plans and organizes work to achieve goals efficiently. Monitors progress, prioritizes competing demands, and persists despite setbacks


Organizational Values

  • Humanity: Putting people first: We are committed to meeting people where they’re at, honoring their dignity, diversity, and experience.
  • Community: Building a better future: Sustainable housing solutions are fostered through partnership, collaboration, and human connection.
  • Ingenuity: Innovating for transformation: Systems-change requires relentless determination, thinking outside the box and challenging the status quo.



Physical Requirements

They should be capable of performing stationary tasks like sitting for up to 6 to 8 hours a day. Additionally, candidates should be able to lift, carry, push, pull light to moderate weights up to 15 pounds safely. Requires mental acuity for analytical reasoning and document interpretation.

title: Plate Fitter 1st Class
description:
Plate Fitter 1st Class

We are seeking an experienced Plate Fitter to join our team. The ideal candidate will have previous shipyard or heavy industrial experience, the ability to read and interpret blueprints and drawings, and a strong commitment to safety and quality. Candidates must be dependable, team-oriented, and available to work the overtime as needed.

Candidates must successfully pass required background screening and meet U.S. Person requirements for access to ITAR-controlled and CUI information.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

This position is responsible for the following: Other duties may be assigned.

  1. Must have a basic understanding of mathematics and be able to perform operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, as well as work fractions.
  2. Ability to interpret blueprints and perform lay outs and fabricate metal structural parts, such as plates, bulkheads, and frames, and braces them in position within hull of ship for riveting or welding.
  3. Quality Control: before using verify material compatibility with specifications.
  4. Lays out position of parts on metal, working from blueprints or templates and using scribe and hand tools.
  5. Locates and marks reference lines, such as center, buttock, and frame lines.
  6. Positions parts in hull of ship, assisted by Rigger.
  7. Align parts in relation to each other, using jacks, turnbuckles, clips, wedges, and mauls.
  8. Marks location of holes to be drilled and installs temporary fasteners to hold part in place for welding or riveting.
  9. Install packing, gaskets, liners, and structural accessories and members, such as doors, hatches, brackets, and clips.
  10. May prepare molds and templates for fabrication of nonstandard parts.

  11. Remove high spots and cut bevels, using hand files, portable grinders and cutting torches.

  12. May tack weld clips and brackets in place prior to permanent welding.
  13. May roll, bend, flange, cut, and shape plates, beams, and other heavy metal parts, using shop machinery, such as plate rolls, presses, bending brakes, and joggle machines.
  14. Safely and efficiently use various hand, power and cutting tools.

  15. Be able to use large machinery such as a metal shear, metal brake and band saw.

Required Education & Experience:

  1. High School Diploma and/or one year certificate from college or technical school preferred.

  2. Must be able to pass a hands-on test when applicable and/or marine/industrial plate/structural fitting experience:

  • 1st Class: 3-5 years

  • 2nd Class: 1-3 years

Working Conditions:

  1. Open-air conditions such as noisy, hot, cold, etc.
  2. Must wear hearing, eye, head protection and proper PPE.
  3. Some climbing (100 feet) and lifting (50 lbs.) involved.
  4. Traverse gangways and scaffolding at varying heights while wearing fall prevention equipment.
  5. Working with hot and sometimes hazardous materials.
  6. Aboard ships, both on and offshore as well as confined spaces.
  7. Must be able to stand and operate equipment for up to four continuous hours.
  8. The work requires long periods of sitting in awkward positions, standing on a variety of surfaces and at differing angles, bending over, crouching, and climbing up and over obstructions such as scaffolding, ladders, and internal barge and boat structural members.

Necessary Equipment Operation:

  1. Cutting Torch
  2. Squares
  3. Levels
  4. Hand and Power Tools

Special Skills:

  1. Ability to work under deadlines and schedule pressures.
  2. Ability to read and interpret blueprints, sketches, drawings, and technical manuals.
  3. Perform basic mathematical functions.
  4. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  5. High performance and a strong team player.
  6. Commitment to company values and safety program.

title: Polsktalande personlig assistent sökes – timvikarie i Ljungbyhed (Klippan)
description:
Vill du bli en viktig del av min vardag?

Hej! 😊

Jag är en snäll och glad man som tycker om att njuta av livet och hitta på roliga saker. Jag älskar att promenera, åka husbil och följa med på olika utflykter.

Nu söker jag dig som talar polska och vill vara med och göra min vardag trygg, aktiv och meningsfull.

Lite om mig och mina behov

Jag har cerebral pares (CP), en intellektuell funktionsnedsättning och en hörselnedsättning. Det innebär att jag behöver stöd och hjälp i min vardag.

Jag kommunicerar inte med tal, men jag har mitt eget sätt att visa vad jag vill, tycker om och behöver. Därför är det viktigt att du är lyhörd, uppmärksam och har tålamod att lära känna mig.

Jag har mina dagliga rutiner som är väldigt viktiga för mig. De hjälper mig att känna trygghet och må bra. Jag behöver någon som förstår vikten av struktur, förutsägbarhet och att följa mina rutiner.

Jag tycker om att vara aktiv och söker någon som gärna följer med mig på promenader, husbilsresor och andra roliga aktiviteter.

Vem söker jag?

Jag söker dig som:

  • Talar polska, eftersom det är viktigt för min kommunikation och trygghet.

  • Har ett varmt hjärta och vill hjälpa andra.

  • Är lyhörd, omtänksam och tålmodig.

  • Är trygg, positiv och ansvarstagande.

  • Respekterar rutiner och struktur.

  • Är aktiv, engagerad och har god initiativförmåga.

  • Är intresserad av rehabilitering och vardagsnära träning.

  • Är flexibel och har hög arbetsmoral.

  • Inte är allergisk mot pälsdjur, eftersom både hund och katt finns i hemmet.

Tidigare erfarenhet av personlig assistans eller arbete med personer med funktionsnedsättningar är meriterande, men vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Det viktigaste för mig är att du har hjärtat på rätt ställe, vill lära känna mig och respekterar mitt sätt att leva.

Arbetsplats: Ljungbyhed, nära Klippan i Skåne.

Arbetstider och anställningsform

Vi söker nu flexibla timvikarier som kan arbeta vid behov.

Arbetspassen är förlagda till dagar, kvällar och helger.

Vi söker framför allt dig som har möjlighet att hoppa in med kort varsel vid sjukdom, semester eller annan frånvaro hos ordinarie personal.

Det är viktigt att du är flexibel, ansvarstagande och har möjlighet att anpassa dig efter behov.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Hos oss på Vår Omtanke får du:

  • Friskvårdsbidrag

  • Möjlighet till utbildning och kompetensutveckling

  • En trygg och välplanerad introduktion

  • Ett meningsfullt och varierande arbete

  • Möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad i en annan människas vardag

Anställningsvillkor

Anställningsform: Timanställning vid behov

Arbetstider: Dag, kväll och helg

Tillträde: Snarast

Lön: Fast timlön enligt överenskommelse. Övriga ersättningar utgår enligt kollektivavtal.

Vad händer nu?

Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag. Därför ser vi gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Din ansökan behandlas av rekryteringsansvariga på Vår Omtanke.

Har du frågor om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Är du en varm, engagerad och flexibel person som vill göra skillnad i min vardag? Då hoppas jag att just du söker! 🌷

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Associate Director
description:
The role

As an Associate Director, you will lead client relationships and day-to-day delivery across a portfolio of complex, high-profile mandates. You will turn political, policy, geopolitical, media and stakeholder developments into clear counsel, while ensuring our work is strategically sharp, commercially relevant and executed to a consistently high standard.

This role sits at the intersection of corporate advisory and strategic communications. You will be expected to operate confidently with senior client stakeholders, shape account strategy, lead teams and translate intelligence into action. The portfolio requires experience relevant to global financial information and technology businesses, hyperscale digital infrastructure and data centres, international philanthropy and development, and science, technology and public-sector research ecosystems.

What you will be entrusted with

  • Client relationship leadership. Act as the day-to-day strategic lead for a portfolio of accounts, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, understanding their business and reputational priorities, anticipating needs and ensuring our counsel creates tangible value. Take ownership of account health, delivery quality and opportunities to deepen the partnership.
  • Corporate advisory. Develop and deliver advice on corporate reputation, positioning, stakeholder strategy and issues with business significance. Connect communications recommendations to wider organisational, market and policy realities, and help clients make decisions with greater confidence.
  • Policy and geopolitical monitoring. Lead monitoring and interpretation of policy, regulatory and geopolitical developments across Asia and relevant global markets. Identify the implications for clients early and translate complex developments into concise intelligence, scenarios, risk assessments and practical recommendations.
  • Strategic media relations and engagement. Shape earned-media strategy and senior executive engagement programmes, from narrative and story development through to journalist mapping, relationship building, briefing and proactive media engagement. Bring strong editorial judgement and an understanding of how business, technology, policy and societal issues are covered across the region.
  • Account strategy and integrated delivery. Set the strategic direction for accounts and translate it into focused programmes of work. Coordinate across disciplines and markets, uphold quality and pace, and ensure outputs are grounded in evidence and aligned to the client’s objectives.
  • Team management and development. Lead and develop account teams, setting clear expectations, delegating effectively, coaching junior colleagues and creating an environment of accountability and high performance. Review work critically and help teams strengthen their advisory, writing and client-management skills.
  • Commercial management and growth. Support the commercial performance of accounts through strong scope, budget and resource management. Identify opportunities to expand our work by spotting emerging client needs and converting trusted counsel into relevant new mandates.

What we’re looking for

  • A seasoned corporate communications, public affairs, strategic communications or corporate advisory professional, typically with 6–10+ years’ relevant experience; we will calibrate level according to depth of client leadership, strategic counsel and team-management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading significant client or stakeholder relationships, with the judgement and presence to advise senior executives and manage complex, fast-moving mandates across Asia.
  • Strong policy and geopolitical literacy, with experience monitoring developments across Asia and explaining what they mean for organisations, sectors and reputation.
  • Proven strategic media-relations capability, including strong editorial judgement, media strategy, senior spokesperson counsel and relationships with relevant business, financial, technology and/or policy media.
  • Relevant sector experience in one or more of the following: financial information, financial markets and enterprise technology; data centres, cloud or digital infrastructure; philanthropy, foundations, international development or social impact; science, technology, innovation, research institutions or government-linked organisations.
  • Excellent writing and synthesis skills. You can turn complex information into concise, authoritative advice, narratives, briefing materials and senior-level client deliverables.
  • Experience managing and developing teams, with a high bar for quality and the ability to create clarity, accountability and momentum across multiple workstreams.
  • Commercial awareness and sound account-management discipline, including scoping, resourcing and identifying opportunities to grow relationships through relevant advisory work.
  • Curiosity, judgement and composure. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, finding the signal in the noise and knowing when an issue requires escalation or a stronger point of view.

Why join us

You’ll work with senior advisors and ambitious organisations on mandates where business, policy, reputation and communications intersect. You’ll have the opportunity to lead meaningful client relationships, shape counsel that influences decisions, and develop a team around the standards that define exceptional advisory work.

Beyond the licence to operate, we help leaders lead with confidence. If that’s the kind of work you want to shape, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Sensors & Intelligence
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Sensors & Intelligence based in Canada.

This is an opportunity to shape the next generation of machine learning models for understanding human movement, performance, and physiology. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, biomechanics, physiological signal processing, and computer vision, leveraging large-scale multimodal workout data. Your research will help create general-purpose representations of how people move, exert effort, experience fatigue, and adapt over time. These capabilities will support intelligent coaching, movement feedback, personalized training progression, and advanced musculoskeletal health applications. Combining foundational research with real-world product development, you will influence scientific direction, publish impactful work, and collaborate with engineering teams to bring new capabilities to users. You will also mentor colleagues and help shape the growth of a multidisciplinary research team.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead research and development of multimodal foundation models that learn from synchronized sensor, video, and physiological data.

  • Design self-supervised pretraining approaches for long, heterogeneous time-series datasets.

  • Develop sensor fusion techniques that account for different sampling rates, sensor noise, synchronization errors, and missing data modalities.

  • Advance computer vision methods for 2D and 3D human pose estimation, motion reconstruction, and movement quality assessment.

  • Build machine learning models to estimate biomechanical and physiological measures, including joint kinematics, physical load, effort, fatigue, and recovery.

  • Establish evaluation frameworks and benchmarks to assess model generalization across different users, body types, movements, and equipment conditions.

  • Validate model predictions against high-quality reference measurements, such as motion capture systems, force plates, and clinical-grade physiological sensors.

  • Partner with ML Engineering teams to adapt research models for cloud deployment and on-device inference.

  • Publish research regularly at leading academic and industry venues, and represent the team through presentations, collaborations, and participation in the research community.

  • Mentor scientists and engineers while helping define the scientific priorities and technical direction of the Sensors & Intelligence team.

    • Requirements:

    • Proven ability to conduct independent research, supported by a strong publication record at relevant conferences or journals, such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, IMWUT/UbiComp, CHI, IEEE TBME, or the Journal of Biomechanics.

    • PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Biomechanics, or a related discipline is strongly preferred. Candidates with equivalent research experience and a strong publication record are also encouraged to apply.

    • Deep expertise in at least one of the following areas: sensor fusion, biomechanics, physiological signal modeling, or computer vision applied to human motion.

    • Practical experience designing, training, and debugging transformer architectures, including attention mechanisms, time-series positional encoding, and multimodal tokenization.

    • Strong end-to-end machine learning development skills using PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow, covering data curation, model training, experimentation, and analysis.

    • Solid understanding of signal processing techniques, including filtering, calibration, temporal alignment, and frequency-domain analysis.

    • Strong experimental design capabilities, including building ablation studies, preventing subject-level data leakage, and distinguishing meaningful performance improvements from statistical noise.

    • Ability to independently identify, structure, and lead ambiguous research challenges toward measurable product outcomes.

    • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical findings to research, engineering, and product stakeholders.

      • Additional experience that would be an advantage:

      • Experience pretraining or scaling foundation models, including distributed training and an understanding of model scaling behavior.

      • Familiarity with musculoskeletal modeling tools such as OpenSim, MuJoCo, or MyoSim, or experience with physics-informed machine learning.

      • Experience working with wearable physiological signals, including IMU, PPG, heart rate variability (HRV), or EMG data.

      • Knowledge of personalization methods, few-shot adaptation, or uncertainty quantification.

      • Experience with model compression or efficient architectures for edge and on-device deployment.

      • Background in human-subject research, data collection protocols, or scientific validation studies.

      • Interest in fitness, sports science, or digital health.

        • Candidates are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet every listed qualification. Diverse backgrounds, research perspectives, and transferable experience are valued.

        Benefits:

        • Annual base salary ranging from CA$160,000 to CA$185,000, depending on experience, background, and location.

        • Equity participation.

        • Health insurance.

        • Retirement savings benefits.

        • Life insurance.

        • Disability benefits.

        • Flexible paid time off.

        • Parental leave.

        • Additional employee benefits and support.

  • System Modeling such as Homer Pro, PVsyst, Helioscope, WindFarmer, WASP, PSSE, and PSCAD

We’re entrepreneurs with a technical soul. Our flat organizational structure creates an atmosphere of openness and participation. We build practical solutions that are safe, innovative, and sustainable. Our ultimate goal is to achieve no harm for our people, our clients, and our communities.

title: Junior Data Scientist - AX26008
description:
Headquartered in Singapore, Actxa Pte Ltd is a deep tech company founded in 2015 that leverages artificial intelligence to create next generation preventive healthcare solutions.

We create evidence-based, personalized health insights in the domains of physical activities, sleep quality, body composition, stress and recovery, heart health and blood glucose evaluation and monitoring.

To improve population health, Actxa establishes worldwide partnerships and research collaborations to develop critical preventive health models to help people avert chronic diseases such as diabetes and hypertension.

We believe in positively impacting the lives of people around us and the environment we live in through the use of technology. Hence, we are committed to providing a conducive environment for all employees to realize their full potential, who in turn have the opportunity to continuously drive innovation.

We have opportunities for you to grow your career path and are looking for talented professionals to join our team.

What will you do?

The Data Scientist researches, develops and validates the algorithms and AI models behind Actxa's preventive health insights. The role turns wearable sensor data and health datasets into reliable insights on activity, sleep, stress, recovery, heart health, blood glucose and nutrition, and helps build generative AI features such as personalized health insights and conversational coaching.

Working within the R&D team and alongside software engineers and research partners, the role supports Actxa's product roadmap and its research collaborations, with an emphasis on sound methods, careful validation and clear documentation.

  • Research and develop algorithms that turn wearable sensor data (e.g. PPG, accelerometer, heart rate variability) into insights on activity, sleep, stress, recovery and heart health
  • Build and improve models for blood glucose estimation and nutrition, including food recognition and nutrition data pipelines
  • Develop generative AI and LLM-based features such as personalized health insights, conversational coaching and behavioral nudging
  • Help design and run research studies with clinical and academic partners, covering protocol preparation, data collection and data quality checks
  • Clean, organize and analyze health datasets using statistical modelling, machine learning and deep learning methods
  • Test and validate algorithms and AI model outputs against reference data, and document methods and results clearly
  • Work with software engineers to bring models into Actxa's apps and products
  • Use AI-assisted tools (e.g. coding assistants, AI research agents) in day-to-day research and development, while critically validating their outputs
  • Contribute to research publications and invention disclosures

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Statistics or a related discipline
  • 0 to 2 years of relevant experience; fresh graduates with strong internship or project experience are welcome
  • Good working knowledge of Python and SQL, and libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn and PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Solid foundation in statistics and machine learning
  • Experience with signal processing or time-series data from wearables is a plus
  • Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, or frameworks such as Hugging Face, LangChain or LLM APIs is a plus
  • Exposure to clinical or health research, or to glucose and nutrition data, is a plus
  • Keen interest in digital health, wellness and preventive healthcare
  • Able to explain findings clearly to non-technical colleagues
  • Positive, adaptable and comfortable in a small team where priorities can shift
  • A natural tenacity, resilience and determination
